local local_class = newclass('BossDreamerFallingStarBattleAction')

local star_class = {
	cs_action = nil,
	character = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,

	aoe_idx = nil,

	fo_star = nil,

	fx_star = nil,
	fx_contrail = nil
}
star_class.mt = { __index = star_class }

function star_class:new(cs_action, c, cs_battle_action, f_dur, expl_r, expl_hp_ratio, aoe_r, aoe_dur, aoe_term, aoe_mod, fo_star)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.cs_action = cs_action
	obj.character = c
	obj.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		idle = 2,
		move = 3,
		expl = 4
	}

	self.duration = f_dur
	self.explosion_radius = expl_r
	self.explosion_hp_ratio = expl_hp_ratio

	self.aoe_duration = aoe_dur

	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
	self.aoe_spec.radius = aoe_r
	self.aoe_spec.duration = aoe_dur
	self.aoe_spec.modifier = aoe_mod
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = aoe_term

	obj.fo_star = fo_star

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	return obj
end

function star_class:trigger()
	return self.current_state ~= nil and self.current_state == self.state.none
end

function star_class:start(pos, target)
	self.position = pos
	self.start_pos = pos
	self.target = target
	self.aoe_idx = nil

	if self.on_aoe_finish_func == nil then
		self.on_aoe_finish_func = function(is_immediate, pos)
			self:on_aoe_finish(is_immediate, pos)
		end
	end

	-- idle이지만 트래킹 후 움직여야하기때문에 이 다음 스테이트 결정권은 부모가 가짐
	self:change_state(self.state.idle)
end

function star_class:move_start(end_pos)
	self.end_pos = end_pos
	self.distance = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).magnitude
	self.direction = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).normalized
	self.speed = self.distance / self.duration
	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function star_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_star)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.expl then
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.idle then
		self.direction = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		self.fx_star = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.start_pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('star_spawn', self.character.Position)
		self.fx_star.transform.rotation = self:get_rot()

	elseif next_state == self.state.move then
		self.fx_star = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('star', self.start_pos, vector_util.down)
		self.direction = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		self.fx_star.transform.rotation = self:get_rot()
		self.fx_contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('contrail', self.start_pos, vector_util.zero, self.fx_star.transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fire', self.start_pos)
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_star, self.start_pos)

	elseif next_state == self.state.expl then
		self:publish_explosion()
		self:generate_aoe(self.end_pos)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_star)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_contrail)

		self.fo_star.Position = self.end_pos
		self.fo_star.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = self.fo_star.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = self.fo_star
		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(self.fo_star, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(self.fo_star.FieldObjectController,
				CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(self.fo_star, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

	else
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_star)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_contrail)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function star_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		self.direction = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		self.fx_star.transform.rotation = self:get_rot()
		-- next state 변경은 parent

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self:update_move(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.expl)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.expl then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

	end
end

function star_class:update_move(dt)
	if self.fx_star == nil then
		return
	end

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	self.position = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_star, self.position)
	self.fx_star.transform.rotation = self:get_rot()
end

function star_class:get_rot()
	local up_dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 1, -1).normalized
	local dir = (self.direction - unity_class.vector3.Dot(self.direction, up_dir) * up_dir).normalized
	local dir_perp = unity_class.vector3.Dot(dir, up_dir) * up_dir + unity_class.vector3.Cross(dir, up_dir)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir_perp, up_dir)

	return rot
end

function star_class:update_rot(dt)
	local up_dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 1, -1).normalized
	local dir = (self.direction - unity_class.vector3.Dot(self.direction, up_dir) * up_dir).normalized
	local dir_perp = unity_class.vector3.Dot(dir, up_dir) * up_dir + unity_class.vector3.Cross(dir, up_dir)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir_perp, up_dir)
	self.fx_star.transform.rotation = rot
end

function star_class:publish_explosion()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.end_pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * self.explosion_hp_ratio)
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_dreamer_hit_01')
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function star_class:generate_aoe(pos)
	local fx = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe')
	self.aoe_idx = stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, fx, self.aoe_spec, nil, nil, self.on_aoe_finish_func)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('aoe_spawn', self.character.Position)
end

function star_class:destroy_aoe()
	if self.aoe_idx == nil then
		return
	end

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoeByIndex(self.character, self.aoe_idx)
end

function star_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
end

function star_class:cancel()
	self:destroy_aoe()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function star_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.fo_star) then
		return
	end

	self:reset_fo_star()

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Destroyer, self.fo_star) then
		self:destroy_aoe()
	end
end

function star_class:reset_fo_star()
	self.fo_star.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.fo_star.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
end

function star_class:on_aoe_finish(is_immediate, pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('aoe_end', pos)
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5,
	}

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.2)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.6)

	self.spawn_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnAmount', 3)
	self.spawn_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnOffset', 8.0)
	self.spawn_angle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnAngleOffset', 20.0)
	self.falling_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallingDuration', 0.5)
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionRadius', 2.5)
	self.explosion_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionHpRatio', 0.1)
	self.star_monster_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StarMonsterId', 104740)

	self.aoe_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOERadius', 2.5)
	self.aoe_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEDuration', 4.0)
	self.aoe_spawn_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOESpawnDistance', 3.0)
	self.aoe_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEDamageTerm', 1.0)
	self.aoe_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AOEDamageModifier', 1.0)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(self.aoe_radius)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- etc
	self.action_sfx_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionSfxTiming', 0.15)

	self.idle_list = {}
	self.delay_list = {}
	self.active_list = {}
	self.target_pos_list = {}

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self.target_pos_list = {}
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self:cancel_all_star()
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show()
		self:summon_stars()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position)
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.action_sfx_running = false

		self:set_target_pos_list()
		self:shoot_star(table.remove(self.target_pos_list, 1))

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_star_list(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_sfx_timing and self.action_sfx_running == false then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', self.character.Position)
			self.action_sfx_running = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count >= self.spawn_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_star_list(dt)
	for i = #self.delay_list, 1, -1 do
		local star = self.delay_list[i]
		star:update_frame(dt)
	end

	for i = #self.active_list, 1, -1 do
		local star = self.active_list[i]
		if star:trigger() then
			table.insert(self.idle_list, table.remove(self.active_list, i))
		else
			star:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = self.target.Position
	local xmin = self.limit_bound.min.x
	local xmax = self.limit_bound.max.x
	local zmin = self.limit_bound.min.z
	local zmax = self.limit_bound.max.z

	pos.x = math.max(xmin, math.min(xmax, pos.x))
	pos.z = math.max(zmin, math.min(zmax, pos.z))

	self.target_pos = pos
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos)
end

function local_class:create_star(fo)
	return star_class:new(self, self.character, self.cs_battle_action,
			self.falling_duration, self.explosion_radius, self.explosion_hp_ratio,
			self.aoe_radius, self.aoe_duration, self.aoe_damage_term, self.aoe_damage_modifier, fo)
end

function local_class:get_star()
	if #self.idle_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.idle_list, 1)
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:summon_stars()
	for i = 1, self.spawn_amount do
		local angle-- = 360 / self.spawn_amount * (i - 1)
		if self.spawn_amount % 2 == 1 then
			-- 홀수일 경우
			local middle_index = math.ceil(self.spawn_amount / 2)
			angle = self.spawn_angle_offset * (i - middle_index)
		else
			-- 짝수일 경우
			angle = self.spawn_angle_offset * ((i - 1) - (self.spawn_amount / 2) + 0.5)
		end

		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, vector_util.forward) * vector_util.up).normalized
		local pos = self.character.Position + self.spawn_offset * dir

		local star = self:get_star()
		if star ~= nil and star:trigger() then
			star:start(pos, self.target)
			table.insert(self.delay_list, star)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_destination(bound, target_pos, radius, distance, pos_list)
	local function get_rand_pos()
		local angle = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, 359.9999)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0).normalized
		local pos = target_pos + (dir * vector_util.forward) * distance

		return pos
		--local x = target_pos.x + (distance + radius) * math.cos(angle)
		--local y = target_pos.y
		--local z = target_pos.z + (distance + radius) * math.sin(angle)

		--x = math.max(bound.min.x, math.min(bound.max.x, x))
		--z = math.max(bound.min.z, math.min(bound.max.z, z))
		--
		--return vector(x, y, z)
	end

	local function is_valid_pos(pos)
		if not bound:Contains(pos) then
			return false
		end

		for _, v in pairs(pos_list) do
			local diff = (v - pos).magnitude
			if diff > distance then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	-- >> main
	local max_loop = 100
	local r_pos
	for _ = 1, max_loop do
		r_pos = get_rand_pos()
		if is_valid_pos(r_pos) then
			return r_pos
		end
	end

	-- 100번 돌려도 안되면 걍 리턴
	return r_pos
end

function local_class:set_target_pos_list()
	if #self.target_pos_list > 0 then
		return
	end

	table.insert(self.target_pos_list, self.target_pos)

	for _ = 2, self.spawn_amount do
		local angle = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, 359.9999)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0).normalized
		local pos = self.target_pos + (dir * vector_util.forward) * self.explosion_radius
		table.insert(self.target_pos_list, pos)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_star(pos)
	if #self.delay_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local star = table.remove(self.delay_list, 1)
	star:move_start(pos)
	table.insert(self.active_list, star)
end

function local_class:routine_load_monster()
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 80)
	if stage ~= nil then
		if stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId) ~= nil then
			local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
			exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.spawn_amount do
		local id = self.star_monster_id
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(id)
		if spec == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND MONSTER SPEC!!! ID = ' .. id)
			break
		end

		local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		coroutine.yield(loader)
		local monster = loader.Character
		if monster == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND Character!!! ID = ' .. id)
			break
		end

		monster.Name = 'boss_dreamer_moonstone_' .. i
		monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
		monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		monster.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
		monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
		table.insert(self.idle_list, self:create_star(monster))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	sfx:Stop()

		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if self.fx_prepare ~= nil then
			self.fx_prepare:Dispose()
			self.fx_prepare = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.fx_prepare = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare1', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare2', self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position)

		self:set_projs()
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

	self:update_proj(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count >= self.action_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	for i = #self.active_projs, 1, -1 do
		local proj = self.active_projs[i]
		-- trigger == true >> can useable
		if proj:trigger() then
			self:return_proj(table.remove(self.active_projs, i))
		else
			proj:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_proj()
	return proj_class:new(self, self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.projectile_speed, self.projectile_radius,
			self.explosion_radius, self.explosion_modifier)
end

function local_class:get_proj()
	if #self.idle_projs > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.idle_projs, 1)
	end

	return self:create_proj()
end

function local_class:return_proj(proj)
	if proj == nil then
		return
	end

	table.insert(self.idle_projs, proj)
end

function local_class:set_projs()
	for i, v in pairs(self.marker_list) do

		local proj = self:get_proj()
		if proj:trigger() then

			proj:start(pos, delay, self.target)

			print('### PROJECTILE STATE ERROR!!!')
		end
	end
end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_dreamer_clear_action' then
		for i = #self.active_projs, 1, -1 do
			local proj = table.remove(self.active_projs, i)
			proj:cancel()
			self:return_proj(proj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then

		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil

	end

function local_class:random_position_within_bounds(bounds, position, radius, distance)
	-- x, z방향 교점 list
	local x_list = {}
	local z_list = {}
	local coll_enum = {
		up = 1 << 0,
		down = 1 << 1,
		left = 1 << 2,
		right = 1 << 3,
	}

	local coll_num = 0
	local direction_lists = {
		{ coll_enum.up, 'up', x_list },
		{ coll_enum.left, 'left', z_list },
		{ coll_enum.down, 'down', x_list },
		{ coll_enum.right, 'right', z_list },
	}

	-- 충돌 방향을 계산하고 리스트에 추가
	for _, dir in ipairs(direction_lists) do
		local list = bounds_util.circle_intersect_line(bounds, dir[2], position, distance)
		if #list > 0 then
			for _, v in pairs(list) do
				table.insert(dir[3], { v, vector_util.sqr_distance(bounds.center, vector(v.x, bounds.center.y, v.y)) })
			end
			coll_num = coll_num | dir[1]
		end
	end

	-- x_list와 z_list를 정렬
	local function sort_list(list)
		if #list > 1 then
			table.sort(list, function(a, b)
				return a[2] < b[2]
			end)
		end
	end

	sort_list(x_list)
	sort_list(z_list)

	if #x_list + #z_list < 2 then
		local rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, 359.9999)
		local rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rand_angle, 0).normalized

		local f_pos = position + (rand_dir * vector_util.forward).normalized * distance
		return f_pos
	end

	local point1, point2
	if #x_list > 0 and #z_list > 0 then
		point1 = x_list[1][1]
		point2 = z_list[1][1]
	elseif #x_list == 0 then
		point1 = z_list[1][1]
		point2 = z_list[2][1]
	else
		point1 = x_list[1][1]
		point2 = x_list[2][1]
	end

	local pos1 = vector(point1.x, 0, point1.y)
	local pos2 = vector(point2.x, 0, point2.y)

	local c_pos1, c_pos2
	local swap_needed

	-- 조건에 따른 c_pos 설정
	if coll_num == (coll_enum.up | coll_enum.left) then
		swap_needed = pos1.z >= pos2.z
	elseif coll_num == (coll_enum.up | coll_enum.right) then
		swap_needed = pos1.z <= pos2.z
	elseif coll_num == (coll_enum.down | coll_enum.left) then
		swap_needed = pos1.x <= pos2.x
	elseif coll_num == (coll_enum.down | coll_enum.right) then
		swap_needed = pos1.x >= pos2.x
	elseif coll_num == coll_enum.up then
		swap_needed = pos1.x >= pos2.x
	elseif coll_num == coll_enum.left then
		swap_needed = pos1.z >= pos2.z
	elseif coll_num == coll_enum.down then
		swap_needed = pos1.x <= pos2.x
	elseif coll_num == coll_enum.right then
		swap_needed = pos1.z <= pos2.z
	else
		print('coll num wrong!!! coll num = ', coll_num)
	end

	if swap_needed then
		c_pos1 = self:get_circle_coll_pos(pos2.x, pos2.z, radius, position.x, position.z, distance)
		c_pos2 = self:get_circle_coll_pos(pos1.x, pos1.z, radius, position.x, position.z, distance)
	else
		c_pos1 = self:get_circle_coll_pos(pos1.x, pos1.z, radius, position.x, position.z, distance)
		c_pos2 = self:get_circle_coll_pos(pos2.x, pos2.z, radius, position.x, position.z, distance)
	end

	local c_vec1 = c_pos1 - position
	local c_vec2 = c_pos2 - position
	local angle = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(c_vec2, c_vec1).eulerAngles.y
	local rand_num = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, angle)
	local rand_dir = (unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rand_num, vector_util.up) * c_vec2).normalized

	local f_pos = position + rand_dir * distance
	return f_pos
end

function local_class:get_circle_coll_pos(cx0, cy0, radius0, cx1, cy1, radius1)
	local dx = cx0 - cx1
	local dy = cy0 - cy1
	local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

	local a = (radius0 * radius0 - radius1 * radius1 + dist * dist) / (2 * dist)
	local h = math.sqrt(radius0 * radius0 - a * a)

	local cx2 = cx0 + a * (cx1 - cx0) / dist
	local cy2 = cy0 + a * (cy1 - cy0) / dist

	local p1 = vector((cx2 + h * (cy1 - cy0) / dist), 0, (cy2 - h * (cx1 - cx0) / dist))
	local p2 = vector((cx2 - h * (cy1 - cy0) / dist), 0, (cy2 + h * (cx1 - cx0) / dist))

	local d1 = vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, p1)
	local d2 = vector_util.sqr_distance(self.zone_bound.center, p2)

	local p1_in = CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.spawn_bound, p1)
	local p2_in = CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.spawn_bound, p2)

	if p1_in and p2_in == false then
		return p1
	end

	if p1_in == false and p2_in then
		return p2
	end

	if d1 > d2 then
		return p2
	end

	return p1
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_dreamer_clear_action' then
		for _, v in pairs(self.active_list) do
			v:cancel()
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,

	}

	-- preapre

	self.sword_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SwordLength', 8.0)
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.2)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.attack_range_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRangeAngle', 330.0)
	self.rotation_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RotationAngle', 330.0)
	self.safe_angle = 360 - self.rotation_angle

	self.sword_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SwordTiming', 1.4)
	self.sword_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SwordOffset', 1.0)

	-- prepare 동안 rect calc -> action 동안 arc calc
	local size = vector(self.sword_length, 1, self.sword_width)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, self.prepare_duration, self.damage_term, true)
	self.calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.arc_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.sword_length, 0, 1, self.action_duration, self.damage_term)
	self.arc_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, self.arc_info)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(self.sword_length, self.attack_range_angle)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_prepare)
		self.calc:End()
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.fx_prepare = nil
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.arc_calc:End()
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_sword)
		self.fx_sword = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)

		self:set_start_dir()

		local ar_angle = self.curr_angle + 180 + self.safe_angle / 2
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self:get_dir_by_angle(ar_angle))
		self.attack_range:Show()

		local s_dir = self:get_dir_by_angle(self.start_angle + 90)
		self.offset_start = self.character.Position + -s_dir * (self.sword_width / 2)
		local e_dir = self:get_dir_by_angle(self.end_angle + 90)
		self.offset_end = self.character.Position + e_dir * (self.sword_width / 2)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action', self.character.Position)
		self.arc_calc:Start()
		local fx_action = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.character.Position)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.curr_angle + 120, vector_util.up)
		fx_action.transform.localRotation = rot

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_sword)
		self.fx_sword = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.fx_sword ~= nil then
			self:publish_damage(self.calc, dt)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.sword_timing and self.fx_sword == nil then
			self:spawn_sword_fx()
			self.calc:Start()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_sword(dt)
		self:publish_damage(self.arc_calc, dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function local_class:update_sword(dt)
	self.prev_angle = self.curr_angle

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.action_duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	self.curr_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.start_angle, self.end_angle, progress)

	local q = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.curr_angle, 0).normalized
	self.curr_dir = (q * vector_util.forward).normalized

	local lerp = vector_util.lerp(self.offset_start, self.offset_end, progress)
	self.fix_pos = lerp + (self.curr_dir * self.sword_offset)
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_sword, self.fix_pos, self.curr_dir)
end

function local_class:publish_damage(calc, dt)
	calc.Position = self.character.Position
	calc.Direction = self.curr_dir

	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		local angle_diff = math.abs(self.curr_angle - self.prev_angle) + (self.sword_width / self.sword_length * (180 / math.pi))
		self.arc_info.Angle = angle_diff
	end

	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = self:get_dir_by_angle(self.curr_angle - 90)
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_dreamer_hit_01')
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:spawn_sword_fx()
	local f_pos = self.character.Position + (self.curr_dir * self.sword_offset)
	self.fx_sword = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('sword', f_pos, self.curr_dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spawn', self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:set_start_dir()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	if diff.x > 0 then
		if diff.z > 0 then
			-- top right
			self.curr_angle = 90
			self.start_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.left * self.sword_width
			self.end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.right * self.sword_width
		else
			-- bot right
			self.curr_angle = 180
			self.start_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.right * self.sword_width
			self.end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.left * self.sword_width
		end
	else
		if diff.z > 0 then
			-- top left
			self.curr_angle = 0
			self.start_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * self.sword_width
			self.end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.back * self.sword_width
		else
			-- bot left
			self.curr_angle = 270
			self.start_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.back * self.sword_width
			self.end_pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * self.sword_width
		end
	end

	self.start_angle = self.curr_angle
	self.end_angle = self.curr_angle - self.rotation_angle
	self.curr_dir = self:get_dir_by_angle(self.start_angle)
	self.prev_angle = self.start_angle
end

function local_class:get_dir_by_angle(angle)
	local q = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0).normalized
	local dir = (q * vector_util.forward).normalized
	return dir
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.fx_scratch2 = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action', self.tracking_pos2)
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.tracking_pos2, nil, self.aoe_spec, nil)

function local_class:cancel()

		end

	end

	fx:Dispose()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

end

return {

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

	self.throw_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ThrowDuration', 1)
	self.explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionDuration', 0.1)
	self.explosion_calc_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionCalculatorDuration', self.explosion_duration)
	self.core_create_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'CoreCreateDelay', self.explosion_duration)
	local cube_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HitRange', 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionModifier', 0)
	self.explosion_knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionKnockBackFactor', CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong)
	self.explosion_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionKnockBackForce', 1)

	-- 레이저 파라미터 파싱
	self.laser_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'LaserCount', 3)
	self.laser_extend = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserExtendTime', 1)
	self.laser_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserIntervalTime', 0.2)
	self.laser_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserDuration', 5)
	self.laser_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserLength', 15)
	self.laser_breadth = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserBreadth', 1)
	self.laser_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserModifier', 1)
	local laser_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserDamageTerm', 0.1)
	self.laser_knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'LaserKnockBackFactor', CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong)
	self.laser_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LaserKnockBackForce', 1)

	-- 레이저 큐브 범위표시기
	self.throw_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, cube_range, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.throw_range:Hide()
	self.throw_range_active = false

	-- 레이저 큐브 판정기
	local cube_col_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(cube_range, self.explosion_calc_duration, -1)
	self.cube_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, cube_col_info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 레이저 크기 설정
	local laser_size = unity_class.vector3(self.laser_length, self.laser_breadth, self.laser_breadth)
	local laser_size_2d = vector_util.get_xz(laser_size)

	-- 레이저 범위 표시기
	self.visual_laser_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, laser_size_2d, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.visual_laser_ranges, range)
	end
	self.laser_range_active = false

	-- 레이저 가상 범위
	self.virtual_laser_range_pool = {}
	for _ = 1, self.laser_count * 2 do
		local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, laser_size_2d.x, laser_size_2d.y, 0)
		table.insert(self.virtual_laser_range_pool, range)
	end

	-- 레이저 충돌판정
	self.laser_calculator_pool = {}
	for _ = 1, self.laser_count * 2 do
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(laser_size, 99,
				laser_damage_term, true)
		local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, collision_info)
		table.insert(self.laser_calculator_pool, {info = collision_info, calculator = attack_calculator})
	end

	-- 내부 캐릭터 상태
	self.owner_state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 내부 레이저 큐브 상태
	self.cube_state = {
		none = 1,
		throw = 2,
		explosion = 3,
		extend = 4,
		interval = 5,
		progress = 6
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.none)
	self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.none)

	-- 에셋 접근용 기본 키
	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'
	self.post_key = 'post'

	-- 에셋 접근용 추가 키
	self.cube_throw_key = 'cube'
	self.cube_explosion_key = 'explosion'
	self.laser_core_key = 'core'
	self.laser_key = 'laser'

	-- 효과음 접근용 추가 키
	self.laser_extend_key = 'extend'
end

--region 큐브 투척 범위표시기 관리 함수
function local_class:start_throw_range(position)
	if not self.throw_range_active then
		self.throw_range_active = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.throw_range, position)
		self.throw_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.action_delay + self.throw_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.throw_range))
	end
end

function local_class:setup_throw_range(position)
	if self.throw_range_active then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.throw_range, position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.throw_range))
	end
end

function local_class:end_throw_range()
	if self.throw_range_active then
		self.throw_range_active = false
		self.throw_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.throw_range))
	end
end
--endregion

--region 레이저 범위표시기 관리 함수
function local_class:start_laser_range(position, direction, time)
	if not self.laser_range_active then
		self.laser_range_active = true

		for idx = 1, 2 do
			local range = self.visual_laser_ranges[idx]
			direction = -direction
			range:Show(time)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, position, direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setup_laser_range(position, direction)
	if self.laser_range_active then
		for idx = 1, 2 do
			local range = self.visual_laser_ranges[idx]
			direction = -direction
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, position, direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:end_laser_range()
	if self.laser_range_active then
		self.laser_range_active = false

		for idx = 1, 2 do
			local range = self.visual_laser_ranges[idx]
			range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 큐브 투척 그림자 관리 함수
function local_class:create_shadow(position)
	self.cube_shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('customSprite', position)
	if is_unity_null(self.cube_shadow) then return end

	local custom_sprite = self.cube_shadow:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	if not is_unity_null(custom_sprite) then
		custom_sprite.Atlas = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get('spritesheets/battle', 'battle_custom')
		custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'shadow.png'
		custom_sprite.PixelToWorld = 0.02
		custom_sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = true
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
		custom_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Default'
		custom_sprite.SortingOrder = -1
		custom_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
	self:update_shadow(position)
end

function local_class:update_shadow(position)
	if not is_unity_null(self.cube_shadow) then
		position.y =  field:GetTileInfoAt(position):GetHeightAt(position) + 0.03

		self.cube_shadow.transform.localPosition = position
		self.cube_shadow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_owner_state ~= self.owner_state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.none)
	if self.current_cube_state ~= self.cube_state.throw then
		self:end_throw_range()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_cube_state ~= nil and self.current_cube_state ~= self.cube_state.none then
		self:update_cube(dt)
	end

	if self.current_owner_state ~= nil and self.current_owner_state ~= self.owner_state.none then
		self:update_owner(dt)
	end
end

--region 시전자 상태 변경/갱신
function local_class:change_owner_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_owner_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.owner_state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.prepare_key)
		self:start_throw_range(self.target.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.owner_state.action then
		self.owner_action_delayed = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.cube_dest - self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.action_key)

		-- Sync한 목적지로 위치 변경
		self:setup_throw_range(self.cube_dest)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.owner_state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.post_key)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.owner_time_passed = 0
	self.current_owner_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_owner(dt)
	self.owner_time_passed = self.owner_time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.prepare then
		self:setup_throw_range(self.target.Position)

		if self.owner_time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			-- 투척 위치 Sync
			local point = self.target.Position
			point.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(point):GetHeightAt(point)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, point)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.action then
		-- 투적 딜레이
		if self.owner_action_delayed and self.owner_time_passed > self.action_delay then
			self.owner_action_delayed = false
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.throw)
		end

		if self.owner_time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_owner_state == self.owner_state.post then
		if self.owner_time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.none)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 큐브/레이저 상태 변경/갱신
function local_class:change_cube_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_cube_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.throw then
		if not is_unity_null(self.cube_preset) then
			self.cube_preset:Dispose()
		end
		self.cube_preset = nil
		if not is_unity_null(self.cube_shadow) then
			self.cube_shadow:Dispose()
		end
		self.cube_shadow = nil

		-- 큐브 범위표시 종료
		self:end_throw_range()
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.explosion then
		self.cube_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.extend then
		if next_state ~= self.cube_state.interval then
			self:end_laser_range()
		end
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.interval then
		self:end_laser_range()
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.cube_state.throw then
		-- 큪브 투척시 시작지점과 높이 설정
		self.cube_start = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cube_throw_key)
		self.cube_height = (self.cube_start - self.cube_dest).magnitude + 4
		self.cube_preset = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cube_throw_key, self.cube_start)
		if not is_unity_null(self.cube_preset) then
			self:create_shadow(self.cube_start)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.cube_state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cube_explosion_key, self.cube_dest)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cube_explosion_key, self.cube_dest)
		self.cube_calculator.Position = self.cube_dest
		self.cube_calculator:Start()

	elseif next_state == self.cube_state.extend then
		local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.cube_dest).normalized
		if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.cube_dest - self.character.Position).normalized
		end
		self:start_laser_range(self.cube_dest, direction, self.laser_extend + self.laser_interval)

	elseif next_state == self.cube_state.interval then
		self.stored_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.cube_dest).normalized
		if self.stored_direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			self.stored_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.cube_dest - self.character.Position).normalized
		end
		self:setup_laser_range(self.cube_dest, self.stored_direction)
	end

	self.cube_time_passed = 0
	self.current_cube_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_cube(dt)
	self.cube_time_passed = self.cube_time_passed + dt

	-- 사용중인 레이저 타격 체크
	if self.laser_holders ~= nil then
		for cur = 1, #self.laser_holders do
			local cur_calculator = self.laser_holders[cur].calculator_holder.calculator
			local hits = cur_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for idx = 0, hits.Count - 1 do
				local fo = hits[idx]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.cube_dest).normalized

					-- 넉백 방향은 레이저 방향에 수직한 방향 (디폴트 : Right)
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_laser_direction = cur_calculator.Direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_laser_direction:IsCounterClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * cur_calculator.Direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * cur_calculator.Direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.laser_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.laser_knock_back_factor
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.laser_knock_back_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			hits:Dispose()
		end
	end

	-- 레이저/큐브의 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.throw then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.cube_time_passed / self.throw_duration)
		local xzPos = self.cube_start * (1 - progress) + self.cube_dest * progress
		local pos = xzPos + self.cube_height * progress * (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.up

		if not is_unity_null(self.cube_preset) then
			local rotDir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.cube_time_passed * 360, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
			effect_util.update_object(self.cube_preset, pos, rotDir)
			-- 물체가 생성되있을때만 그림자 위치 갱신을 시도
			self:update_shadow(pos)
		end
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.throw_duration then
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.explosion then
		-- 폭발 넉백부여 데미지 처리
		if self.cube_time_passed <= self.explosion_calc_duration then
			local hits = self.cube_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for idx = 0, hits.Count - 1 do
				local fo = hits[idx]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.cube_dest).normalized
					local knock_direction = direction
					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.cube_dest - self.character.Position).normalized
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.explosion_knock_back_factor
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.explosion_knock_back_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			hits:Dispose()
		end
		-- 코어 이펙트 생성시간 도달시 코어 생성
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.core_create_delay then
			if is_unity_null(self.core_effect) then
				self.core_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_core_key, self.cube_dest)
			end
		end
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.extend)
		end
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.extend then
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.laser_extend then
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.interval)
		else
			-- 레이저 범위 표시기 방향 업데이트
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.cube_dest).normalized
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.cube_dest - self.character.Position).normalized
			end

			self:setup_laser_range(self.cube_dest, direction)
		end
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.interval then
		-- 레이저 생성방향 sync
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.laser_interval then
			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character,
					self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.stored_direction)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_cube_state == self.cube_state.progress then
		if self.cube_time_passed > self.laser_duration then
			self:remove_laser()
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.none)
		end
	end
end

-- 레이저 생성
function local_class:create_laser(position, direction)
	local comparer_size = self.laser_breadth / 4
	local comparer_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(position, unity_class.vector3.one * comparer_size)
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		direction = -direction

		-- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
				comparer_bound,
				CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle,
				direction * self.laser_length, true)

		local min_dist = self.laser_length
		--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을
		if closest_object ~= nil then
			-- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
			min_dist = math.min(
					CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(comparer_bound, closest_object.Bounds,
							direction) + comparer_size, self.laser_length)
		end

		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_key, position, direction)
		-- 충돌거리에 따라 레이저 크기 재설정
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(min_dist / self.laser_length, 1, 1)

		local range = table.remove(self.virtual_laser_range_pool)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, position, direction, self.target.Position.y)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))

		local holder = table.remove(self.laser_calculator_pool)
		-- 충돌거리에 따라 충돌체 크기 재설정
		holder.info.Size = unity_class.vector3(min_dist, self.laser_breadth, self.laser_breadth)
		holder.calculator.Position = position
		holder.calculator.Direction = direction
		holder.calculator:Start()
		table.insert(self.laser_holders, {
			pooled_object = effect,
			virtual_range = range,
			calculator_holder = holder
		})
	end
end

-- 생성되있는 레이저 제거
function local_class:remove_laser()
	if not is_unity_null(self.core_effect) then
		self.core_effect:Dispose()
		self.core_effect = nil
	end

	if self.laser_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.laser_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.laser_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	if self.laser_holders ~= nil then
		for idx = #self.laser_holders, 1, -1 do
			local removed = table.remove(self.laser_holders, idx)

			-- 이펙트 해제
			if not is_unity_null(removed.pooled_object) then
				removed.pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			removed.pooled_object = nil
			-- 가상 범위 반납
			if removed.virtual_range ~= nil then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, removed.virtual_range))
				table.insert(self.virtual_laser_range_pool, removed.virtual_range)
				removed.virtual_range = nil
			end
			-- 판정기 반납
			if removed.calculator_holder ~= nil then
				removed.calculator_holder.calculator:End()
				table.insert(self.laser_calculator_pool, removed.calculator_holder)
				removed.calculator_holder = nil
			end
		end

		self.laser_holders = nil
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.none)
	self:end_throw_range()
	self:remove_laser()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if info.Positions ~= nil then
		-- 큐브 위치 Sync
		local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)

		-- Sync시 남아있는 큐브/레이저가 있을경우 소멸처리
		if self.current_cube_state ~= self.cube_state.none then
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.none)
			self:end_throw_range()
			self:remove_laser()
		end

		self.cube_dest = pos
		self:change_owner_state(self.owner_state.action)
	elseif info.Directions ~= nil then
		-- 레이저 방향 Sync
		local dir = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

		-- 레이저가 하나도 생성되있지 않은 경우 효과음 출력 시작
		if self.laser_holders == nil then
			self.laser_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_key, self.cube_dest)
			self.laser_holders = {}
		end

		-- 레이저 전개
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.laser_extend_key, self.cube_dest)
		self:create_laser(self.cube_dest, dir)

		if #self.laser_holders < self.laser_count * 2 then
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.extend)
		else
			self:change_cube_state(self.cube_state.progress)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	-- 범위표시기 정리
	if is_unity_null(self.throw_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.throw_range)
	end
	self.throw_range = nil

	if self.visual_laser_ranges ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.visual_laser_ranges) do
			if is_unity_null(range) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(range)
			end
		end
		self.visual_laser_ranges = nil
	end

	self.cube_calculator = nil
	self.virtual_laser_range_pool = nil
	self.laser_calculator_pool = nil
	self.laser_holders = nil

	self.throw_range_active = nil
	self.laser_range_active = nil

	-- Spec 정리
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil

	self.throw_duration = nil
	self.explosion_duration = nil
	self.explosion_calc_duration = nil
	self.core_create_delay = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.explosion_knock_back_factor = nil

	-- 상태 관련 변수 해제

local local_class = newclass('BossFakeGuardianThunderCharge')

--선더차지 : 타겟은 전제 플레이어 AI 및 매뉴얼 캐릭터 쪽으로 N 회차 돌진 하도록 한다.
-- prepare 단계에서부터 낙뢰 시작
-- 낙뢰 1초간 attack range 보여주고 실행->반복
-- 낙뢰 2회 맞으면 에어본

-- 돌진 경우 N회 반복하도록
-- 돌진중에도 낙뢰 루틴 계속 하도록.
-- 돌진 맞으면 돌진방향으로 넉백
-- 돌진하는 최종 위치에 낙뢰

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.character = c
	-- FIXME : 사용은 안하고 있는데...

	-- 낙뢰 데미지 계수

	self.charge_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ChargeCount", 3)
	self.charge_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeTerm", 0.25)
	-- 차지 데미지 계수

	self.action_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDelay", 0.1)
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)
	-- 차지 실행시 속도 배율
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeSpeed", 1)
	--차지 이펙트
	self.charge_fx = nil

	self.crash_camera_shake_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrashCameraShakeModifier", 0.2)
	self.crash_camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrashCameraShakeDuration", 0.5)

	self.cloud_camera_shake_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CLoudCameraShakeModifier", 0.2)
	self.cloud_camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CLoudCameraShakeDuration", 0.5)

	-- 돌진시 발생하는 낙뢰수

	-- 차지 어택레인지 생성
	self.charge_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.charge_range:Hide(0)

	self.cloud_key = 'cloud'
	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	self.thunder_key = 'thunder'
	self.groggy_key = 'groggy'

	self.quadrant_contains_list = { }
	-- 낙뢰 어택레인지 생성
	-- thunder_max_amount 이후의 range 는 돌진시의 낙뢰용으로 사용한다.
	self.thunder_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.thunder_max_amount + self.charge_thunder_amount do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
