	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		--초기
		none = 1,
		-- 준비 (캐스팅, 낙뢰 시작)
		prepare = 2,
		-- 돌진Thun
		action = 3,
		-- 돌진 후 벽 충돌. 여기서 다시 self.charge_count 숫자 만큼 action 으로 되돌림.
		after_crash = 4,
		-- 마무리
		post = 5
	}
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.charge_direction = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.zone_quadrants = nil
	self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions = nil

	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.target = nil

	self.is_groggy = false
	self.active_thunders = { }
	self.active_charge_thunders = { }
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

--배틀액션 시작
function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		--print('trigger state', self.current_state)
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end
	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.target = target

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 캐릭터 방향 고정
	-- 애니메이션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
	-- 이모션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.cast_key)

	--보스캐릭터이므로 카메라연출 및 스킬 보이스 없음
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position,  unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	return true
end

--낙뢰 준비
function local_class:prepare_thunder()
-- 준비루틴에서 1초에 걸쳐서 attack range 보여주고 끝나면 낙뢰 실행
	-- 낙뢰시에는 파티 전체를 타겟으로 --pooled_list 임

	local thunder_remains = self.thunder_max_amount
	local targets = user_party
	for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
		-- 힛 가능한 타겟이라면 낙뢰 떨구고 낙뢰 카운드 증가
		local thunder_position = targets[i].Position
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, targets[i]) then
			-- 타격 가능하다면 해당 플레이어 위치에 낙뢰준비
			-- 타겟 되는 포지션이 어느사분면에 포함되어있는지..
			local range = self:get_thunder_range()
			self:check_position_in_quadrant(thunder_position)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, self.character.Position.y)
			range:Show(self.thunder_term)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.active_thunders, {
				attack_range = range,
				position = thunder_position
			})
			thunder_remains = thunder_remains - 1
		end
	end
	-- 랜덤 위치가 아니라 맵을 사분면으로 나누어서 없는 사분면을 선택.
	-- 선택된 사분면을 9분할 하여 그중 하나에 떨구도록 한다.
	-- 비어있는 사분면 체크
	local empty_quadrants = { true, true, true, true }
	for i = 1, #self.quadrant_contains_list do
		empty_quadrants[self.quadrant_contains_list[i]] = false
	end

	-- 비어있는 사분면에 대한 공격. 구등분된 구역중 하나에 낙뢰를 뿌리도록 한다.
	for i = 1, #empty_quadrants do
		if empty_quadrants[i] then
			if thunder_remains > 0 then
				local region_index = unity_class.random.Range(1, #self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions[i] + 1)
				region_index = math.floor(region_index)
				local bound = self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions[i][region_index]
				local thunder_position = bound.center + vector(unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5), 0 , unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5))
				-- 여기서 확정난 선더 포지션에 레인지 준비
				local range = self:get_thunder_range()
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, self.character.Position.y)
				range:Show(self.thunder_term)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
				table.insert(self.active_thunders,{
					attack_range = range,
					position = thunder_position
				})
				thunder_remains = thunder_remains - 1
			end
		end
	end
	self.quadrant_contains_list = nil
	self.quadrant_contains_list = { }
end

--낙뢰 때리는 루틴
function local_class:thunder_routine()
	--self.thunder_ranges 에서 지정된 위치에 낙뢰 실행
	if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			local range = self.active_thunders[i]
			if range ~= nil then
				local thunder_position = range.position
				self:falling_thunder_damage(thunder_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key, thunder_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, thunder_position)
				self:return_thunder_range(range.attack_range)
				table.remove(self.active_thunders, i)
			end
		end
		--번개 실행횟수 증가
		self.current_thunder_count = self.current_thunder_count + 1
	end
end

-- 돌진 준비루틴
--돌진후 충돌시에도 발동하기 때문에 마지막 돌진에서도 체크 함.
function local_class:prepare_charge()
	if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)-- vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end
		self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, direction)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		--돌진 및 관련 애니메이션 종료
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.charge_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))

		-- 돌진시에는 매뉴얼 캐릭터를 타겟으로
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.charge_direction)
		-- 돌진 방향 보정
		-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
		local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.charge_direction)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

-- 액션루틴 실행될때 한번 호출.
function local_class:prepare_charge_thunder()
	local range = self:get_thunder_range()
	local dir =  self.charge_direction * self.charge_distance
	local thunder_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.BoundaryFromPoint(self.zone_bound, self.character.Position, dir)
	thunder_position = thunder_position + self.charge_direction * (-self.thunder_radius)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, self.character.Position.y)
	range:Show(self.thunder_term)
	table.insert(self.active_charge_thunders, {
		--어택레인지
		attack_range = range,
		-- 공격될 위치
		position = thunder_position,
		-- 생성되고 나서 지난 시간
		time_passed = 0,
		-- 실행되어 완료 처리 되었는가.
		is_done = false
	})
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
end

--돌진 시작하고나서 n초 후 번개
function local_class:charge_thunder_routine(dt)
	for i = #self.active_charge_thunders, 1, -1 do
		local range = self.active_charge_thunders[i]
		if range ~= nil then
			if not range.is_done then
				--각 낙뢰 발돌시간 체크를 따로 한다.
				range.time_passed = range.time_passed + dt
				if range.time_passed >= self.charge_thunder_waiting_time then
					self:falling_thunder_damage(range.position)
					range.is_done = true
					self:return_thunder_range(range.attack_range)
					table.remove(self.active_charge_thunders, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


function local_class:cloud_routine()
	local cloud = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool(self.cloud_key)
	local target_position = stage.StageCamera.Transform.position + cloud.Offset

	--배틀액션에 설정된 이펙트 로드 함수로 불러오는 경우에 방향이 다르게 출력되어 오브젝트풀에서 인서턴시에이트 시킨다.
	self.cloud_effect = cloud:Instantiate(target_position,
			stage.StageCamera.Transform.rotation, stage.StageCamera.Transform);
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cloud_key, self.target.Position)
	stage_camera:Shake(self.cloud_camera_shake_modifier, self.cloud_camera_shake_duration)
end

function local_class:charge_routine(dt)
	--돌진방향으로 튕겨냄. + 돌진위치 끝에 낙뢰
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt
	move_info.magnitude = move_info.magnitude * self.charge_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백방향이돌진 방향과 같음.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--타격 가능한가
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.active_thunders ~= nil then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end
			table.remove(self.active_thunders, i)
		end
	end

	if self.active_charge_thunders ~= nil then
		for i = #self.active_charge_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end
			table.remove(self.active_charge_thunders, i)
		end
	end

	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		for i = #self.thunder_ranges, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				self.thunder_ranges[i]:Hide(0)
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_range) then
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cloud_effect) then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cloud_effect = nil

	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- 현재 state exite 처리
	-- 현재 스테이트 준비단계 정려
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			for i = 1, #self.active_thunders do
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		self:cloud_routine()
	-- 액션 단계 낙뢰 + 돌진 동시에 정리함.
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		--부딛힌 후 어디 끼지 않도록
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		-- 계산기 종료
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		-- 공격범위 종료. 낙뢰는 따로 도느느 기능이기 때문에 여기서 정리하지 않음.
		if self.charge_range ~= nil then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
		end

		-- 공격 종료되었으므로 카운트 증가
		self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1
		--애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 연기 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.smoke_fx) then
			self.smoke_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.smoke_fx = nil

		-- 바람 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.wind_fx) then
			self.wind_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.wind_fx = nil

		--액션 빠져나올때 이거 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
			self.charge_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.charge_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		--돌진애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		--공격큐 종료
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		--종료처리 종료하면 현재 애니메이션 제거
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 배틀 스테이트 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 큐 이벤트 시작
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		-- 준비 애니메이션
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		-- 준비 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)
		-- 번개 준비
		self:prepare_thunder()
		--  돌진 준비
		self:prepare_charge()
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 돌진 번개 준비
		self:prepare_charge_thunder()

		-- 돌진 시작
		-- 캐릭터는 통과해서 지나가야 하기 때문에 이걸로..
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
		-- 돌진 애니메이션 시작
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key)
		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		-- 돌진해서 지나갈때 쓰는 연기, 바람 이펙트
		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smoke", self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.wind_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.after_crash then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.action_delay))
		end
		if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
			-- 다시 돌진 사용 준비
			self:prepare_charge()
		else
			-- 재 차지 준비 하는게 아니라면 그로기 상태에 돌입함.
			self.is_groggy = true
			--그로기 애니메이션 플레이
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.groggy_key)
			local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 어택레인지 제거
		for i = 1, #self.active_thunders do
			self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
		end

		for i = 1, #self.active_charge_thunders do
			self:return_thunder_range(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range)
		end
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none and self.current_state ~= self.state.post then
		-- none 이나 post 가 아닌 이상 번개루틴은 계속 돌것이다.
		--낙뢰 텀 때마다 낙뢰 루틴 실행
		--번개 떨궈지는 숫자까지만 실행
		self.time_thunder = self.time_thunder + dt
		if self.time_thunder >= self.thunder_term then
			if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
				self.time_thunder = 0
				self:thunder_routine()
				--thunder_routine 에서 카운트 증가 하므로 아래에서 한번 더 체크 해야 한다.
				if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
					self:prepare_thunder()
				else
					-- 번개가 모두 떨어진 이후 차지가 끝나있는 상태라면 포스트로 보냄
					if self.current_charge_count >= self.charge_count then
						self:change_state(self.state.post)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.action or self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		self:charge_thunder_routine(dt)
	end
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			-- 돌진 루틴 실행.
			self:charge_routine(dt)
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		if not self.is_groggy then
			--차지 카운트에 따라 종료와 재실행으로 나눔
			if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay then
				if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.action)
				else
					-- 차지가 끝났을때 번개가 끝나있다면 포스트로 보냄
					if self.current_thunder_count >= self.thunder_count then
						self:change_state(self.state.post)
					end
				end
			end
		else -- 그로기 상태라면 그로기 상태 끝날때까지 뭐 안함.
			if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
				self.is_groggy = false
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
				self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
				battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				-- 충돌 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
				stage.StageCamera:Shake(self.crash_camera_shake_modifier, self.crash_camera_shake_duration)
				-- 이동 블락 되었다면 다음 돌진으로
				self:change_state(self.state.after_crash)
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:falling_thunder_damage(damage_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, damage_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key, damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.thunder_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_position_in_quadrant(target_position)
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		if self.zone_quadrants[i]:Contains(target_position) then
			--몇번 사분면에 있는지 체크 하여 플레이어수가 4명이 안될경우 여기에 없는 사분면에 번개를 떨어뜨리도록 한다.
			table.insert(self.quadrant_contains_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- 사분면 검사할때는 이거 쓸꺼기 때문에 로컬로 선언하지 않고 들고 있는다..
	self.zone_quadrants = { }
	-- zone bound 4등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 2
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 2
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	-- 1사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 2사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 3사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))
	-- 4사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))

	--9분면 검사용으로 사용한다
	self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions = {}
	-- zone quadrant 9등분 해서 저장
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		center = self.zone_quadrants[i].center
		modX = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.x / 3
		modZ = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.z / 3
		size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_quadrants[i].size.y, modZ)
		local nine_region = { }
		-- 9분할된 9분면 바운드..
		--1
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--2
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
		--3
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--4
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
		--5
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
		--6
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
		--7
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
		--8
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
		--9
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

		table.insert(self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions, nine_region)
	end
end

--사용할 레인지 가져오기. 없으면 생성.
function local_class:get_thunder_range()
	if #self.thunder_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.thunder_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide(0)
		return range
	end
end

-- 사용된 레인지 반환하여 리스트에 포함.
function local_class:return_thunder_range(range)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide(0)
	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.thunder_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()
	if not self.active_thunders == nil then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders.attack_range)
				self.active_thunders[i].attack_range = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.active_thunders = nil

	if not self.active_charge_thunders == nil then
		for i = #self.active_charge_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range)
				self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.active_charge_thunders = nil

	if not self.thunder_ranges == nil then
		for i = #self.thunder_ranges, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.thunder_ranges[i])
				self.thunder_ranges[i] = nil
			end
			table.remove(self.thunder_ranges, i)
		end
	end
	self.thunder_ranges = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.charge_range)
	end
	self.charge_range = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil

function local_class:check_shot_position(pos)
	--최초 벽충돌한 위치를 기준으로 x,y기점 반대편 벽으로 이동
	local x,z

	--상단 이동인지 하단이동인지?
	self.bound_move_direction = nil
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bounds.center.x then --우측벽
		x = self.zone_bounds.max.x
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.center.x then --좌측벽
		x = self.zone_bounds.min.x
	end

	if pos.z <= self.zone_bounds.center.z then --하단
		z = self.zone_bounds.min.z
		self.bound_move_direction = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif pos.z > self.zone_bounds.center.z then --상단
		z = self.zone_bounds.max.z
		self.bound_move_direction = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return vector(x, 0.1, z) + (self.bound_move_direction * 1.5)
end

function local_class:set_shot_move_position(pos)
	if self.bound_move_direction == nil then return end

	local target_x
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bounds.center.x then --우측벽
		target_x = self.zone_bounds.max.x
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.center.x then --좌측벽
		target_x = self.zone_bounds.min.x
	end

	self.shot_start_pos = pos
	self.shot_dest_pos = vector(target_x, 0, self.shot_dest_pos.z) + (self.bound_move_direction * self.shot_reflect_height)
	self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_start_pos
	self.shot_passed_time = 0
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_enabled = true
	self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
	self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		if self.is_jump_start then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shot_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
	if self.shot_object then
		self.shot_object:Dispose()
	end
	self.shot_passed_time = 0

	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.stomp_attack_range) then
		self.stomp_attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cloud_effect) then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cloud_effect = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_active_stomp_attack_range = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.stomp_attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder then
		for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
		self.shot_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(
				self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.shot_dest_pos = self.character.Position + (self.shot_direction * self.shot_distance)
		self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.character.Position
		self.shot_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.shot_move_duration = self.shot_diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
		self.shot_passed_time = 0

		--이전 투사체가 남아있다면 삭제
		if not is_unity_null(self.shot_object) then
			self.shot_object:Dispose()
		end
		self.shot_object = nil
		if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
			self.shot_sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot_cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder_cast", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--시작은 타겟의 방향으로 벽에 충돌할때까지 보낸다.
		self.shot_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot",
				self.character.Position)
		self.shot_object.transform.position = self.character.Position
		self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.move_wall

		self.shot_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", self.shot_object.transform.position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_cast")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
		self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.jump_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local a = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.stomp_attack_range, self.target_position)
		self.stomp_attack_range:Show(self.dangling_duration + self.fall_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))

		local cloud_effect_pool = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('cloud')
		local target_position = stage.StageCamera.Transform.position + cloud_effect_pool.Offset
		self.cloud_effect = cloud_effect_pool:Instantiate(target_position,
				stage.StageCamera.Transform.rotation, stage.StageCamera.Transform);
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cloud', nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.stomp_attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.stomp_attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_jump_start = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))
		self.stomp_attack_range:Hide()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude, self.stomp_camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--추가 공격 어택레인지
		self.thunder_start_pos = self.character.Position
		for i = 1, #self.thunder_attack_range_list do
			local center_angle = 360 / self.thunder_amount * i
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (360 / 2), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
			local dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position) + dir * self.thunder_distance
			local ar = self.thunder_attack_range_list[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, dest_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.thunder_start_pos))
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.thunder_prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.thunder then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("thunder")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("thunder", self.character.Position)
		for i = 1, #self.thunder_attack_calculator_list do
			local center_angle = 360 / self.thunder_amount * i
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (360 / 2), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
			local dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position) + dir * self.thunder_distance

			self.thunder_attack_calculator_list[i].Position = dest_pos
			self.thunder_attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder", dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
		self.current_state = next_state
end

--최초 발사 후 벽에 근접했는지 체크
function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.shot_object.transform.position, 0.3)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
			return true
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_shot_state ~= self.shot_state.none then
		self:shot_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			local target_pos = self.target_position
			local dest = target_pos
			self.target_position = dest
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if not self.is_start_stomp_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
			self.is_start_stomp_animation = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration - 0.2 and not self.is_start_stomp_effect then

			--TODO:thunder effect 보스위치에 뿌려주야된다.
			local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position) + 0.1)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", effect_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder", effect_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", effect_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("thunder", effect_pos)
			self.is_start_stomp_effect = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
					battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
				if self.current_repeat_count < self.stomp_repeat_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.thunder_prepare)
				end
			else
				self:stomp_damage_update(dt)
			end
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.thunder_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.thunder_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.thunder)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder then
		if self.time_passed >= self.thunder_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:thunder_damage_update()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stomp_damage_update(dt)
	local objects = self.stomp_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.stomp_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:thunder_damage_update(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_calculator_list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

				if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:shot_update(dt)
	self.shot_passed_time = self.shot_passed_time + dt
	if is_unity_null(self.shot_object) then
		return
	end

	--이동
	if self.current_shot_state == self.shot_state.move_wall then
		if not self:check_battle_zone_by_wall() then
			self.shot_object.transform.position =
			self.shot_start_pos + self.shot_passed_time / self.shot_move_duration * self.shot_diff
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:SetPosition(self.shot_object.transform.position)
			end
		else
			--벽에 닿았다면 스테이트를 변경하고 지그재그 이동루틴
			self.shot_start_pos = self.shot_object.transform.position
			self.shot_dest_pos = self:check_shot_position(self.shot_start_pos)
			self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_start_pos
			self.shot_move_duration = self.shot_diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
			self.shot_passed_time = 0
			self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.bound_wall
		end
	elseif self.current_shot_state == self.shot_state.bound_wall then
		if self.shot_object.transform.position.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z - self.zone_margin or
				self.shot_object.transform.position.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z + self.zone_margin then
			--zone을 벗어나면 종료
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:Stop()
			end
			self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
			self.shot_object:Dispose()
			self.shot_object = nil
			self.shot_passed_time = 0

			return
		end
		local dist = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_object.transform.position
		if dist.magnitude > 0.5 then
			self.shot_object.transform.position =
			self.shot_start_pos + self.shot_passed_time / self.shot_move_duration * self.shot_diff
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:SetPosition(self.shot_object.transform.position)
			end
		else
			self:set_shot_move_position(self.shot_object.transform.position)
		end
	end

	--충돌

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.shot_object.transform.position, self.shot_radius)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

		local is_hit_delayed = false
		for i = #self.shot_hit_list, 1, -1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.shot_hit_list[i].fo) then
				self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time = self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
				if self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
					is_hit_delayed = true
				else
					table.remove(self.shot_hit_list, i)
				end
			end
		end

		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.shot_dest_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.shot_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.shot_damage_delay })
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
			v = nil
		end
	end
	self.thunder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.shot_attack_caclulator = nil
	self.stomp_attack_calculator = nil
	self.thunder_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.shot_state = nil
	self.shot_object = nil
	self.shot_direction = nil
	self.current_shot_state = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.shot_hit_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.shot_start_pos = nil
	self.shot_dest_pos = nil
	self.shot_diff = nil
	self.shot_sfx = nil
	self.cloud_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFakeKnightCharge')

--선더차지 : 타겟은 전제 플레이어 AI 및 매뉴얼 캐릭터 쪽으로 N 회차 돌진 하도록 한다.
-- prepare 단계에서부터 낙뢰 시작
-- 낙뢰 1초간 attack range 보여주고 실행->반복
-- 낙뢰 2회 맞으면 에어본

-- 돌진 경우 N회 반복하도록
-- 돌진중에도 낙뢰 루틴 계속 하도록.
-- 돌진 맞으면 돌진방향으로 넉백
-- 돌진하는 최종 위치에 낙뢰

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	-- FIXME : 사용은 안하고 있는데...

	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 20)
	--돌진 너비

	self.charge_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ChargeCount", 3)
	self.charge_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeTerm", 0.25)

	self.thunder_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.thunder_max_amount + self.charge_thunder_amount do

--배틀액션 시작
function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		--print('trigger state', self.current_state)
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end
	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.target = target

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 캐릭터 방향 고정
	-- 애니메이션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
	-- 이모션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.cast_key)

	--보스캐릭터이므로 카메라연출 및 스킬 보이스 없음
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position,  unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	return true
end

-- 돌진 준비루틴
--돌진후 충돌시에도 발동하기 때문에 마지막 돌진에서도 체크 함.
function local_class:prepare_charge()
	if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)-- vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
		end
		self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, direction)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		--돌진 및 관련 애니메이션 종료
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.charge_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))

		-- 돌진시에는 매뉴얼 캐릭터를 타겟으로
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.charge_direction)
		-- 돌진 방향 보정
		-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
		local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.charge_direction)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

-- 액션루틴 실행될때 한번 호출.
function local_class:prepare_charge_thunder()
	local range = self:get_thunder_range()
	local dir =  self.charge_direction * self.charge_distance
	local thunder_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.BoundaryFromPoint(self.zone_bound, self.character.Position, dir)
	thunder_position = thunder_position + self.charge_direction * (-self.thunder_radius)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, self.character.Position.y)
	range:Show(self.thunder_term)
	table.insert(self.active_charge_thunders, {
		--어택레인지
		attack_range = range,
		-- 공격될 위치
		position = thunder_position,
		-- 생성되고 나서 지난 시간
		time_passed = 0,
		-- 실행되어 완료 처리 되었는가.
		is_done = false
	})
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
end

--돌진 시작하고나서 n초 후 번개
function local_class:charge_thunder_routine(dt)
	for i = #self.active_charge_thunders, 1, -1 do
		local range = self.active_charge_thunders[i]
		if range ~= nil then
			if not range.is_done then
				--각 낙뢰 발돌시간 체크를 따로 한다.
				range.time_passed = range.time_passed + dt
				if range.time_passed >= self.charge_thunder_waiting_time then
					self:falling_thunder_damage(range.position)
					range.is_done = true
					self:return_thunder_range(range.attack_range)
					table.remove(self.active_charge_thunders, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:charge_routine(dt)
	--돌진방향으로 튕겨냄. + 돌진위치 끝에 낙뢰
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt
	move_info.magnitude = move_info.magnitude * self.charge_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백방향이돌진 방향과 같음.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--타격 가능한가
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:cancel()


	if self.active_charge_thunders ~= nil then
		for i = #self.active_charge_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end
			table.remove(self.active_charge_thunders, i)
		end
	end

	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		for i = #self.thunder_ranges, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				self.thunder_ranges[i]:Hide(0)
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_range) then
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cloud_effect) then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cloud_effect = nil

	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- 현재 state exite 처리
	-- 현재 스테이트 준비단계 정려
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	-- 액션 단계 낙뢰 + 돌진 동시에 정리함.
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		--부딛힌 후 어디 끼지 않도록
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		-- 계산기 종료
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		-- 공격범위 종료. 낙뢰는 따로 도느느 기능이기 때문에 여기서 정리하지 않음.
		if self.charge_range ~= nil then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_range))
		end

		-- 공격 종료되었으므로 카운트 증가
		self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1
		--애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 연기 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.smoke_fx) then
			self.smoke_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.smoke_fx = nil

		-- 바람 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.wind_fx) then
			self.wind_fx:TriggeredDispose()
		end
		self.wind_fx = nil

		--액션 빠져나올때 이거 제거
		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
			self.charge_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.charge_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		--돌진애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		--공격큐 종료
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		--종료처리 종료하면 현재 애니메이션 제거
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 배틀 스테이트 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 큐 이벤트 시작
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		-- 준비 애니메이션
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		-- 준비 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)

		--  돌진 준비
		self:prepare_charge()
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 돌진 번개 준비
		self:prepare_charge_thunder()

		-- 돌진 시작
		-- 캐릭터는 통과해서 지나가야 하기 때문에 이걸로..
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
		-- 돌진 애니메이션 시작
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key)
		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		-- 돌진해서 지나갈때 쓰는 연기, 바람 이펙트
		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smoke", self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.wind_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.after_crash then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
			-- 다시 돌진 사용 준비
			self:prepare_charge()
		else
			-- 재 차지 준비 하는게 아니라면 그로기 상태에 돌입함.
			self.is_groggy = true
			--그로기 애니메이션 플레이
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.groggy_key)
			local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		for i = 1, #self.active_charge_thunders do
			self:return_thunder_range(self.active_charge_thunders[i].attack_range)
		end
		self.charge_range:Hide(0)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.action or self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		self:charge_thunder_routine(dt)
	end
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			-- 돌진 루틴 실행.
			self:charge_routine(dt)
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		if not self.is_groggy then
			--차지 카운트에 따라 종료와 재실행으로 나눔
			if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay then
				if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.action)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		else -- 그로기 상태라면 그로기 상태 끝날때까지 뭐 안함.
			if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
				self.is_groggy = false
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
				self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
				battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				-- 충돌 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
				stage.StageCamera:Shake(self.crash_camera_shake_modifier, self.crash_camera_shake_duration)
				-- 이동 블락 되었다면 다음 돌진으로
				self:change_state(self.state.after_crash)
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:falling_thunder_damage(damage_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, damage_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key, damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.thunder_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_position_in_quadrant(target_position)
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		if self.zone_quadrants[i]:Contains(target_position) then
			--몇번 사분면에 있는지 체크 하여 플레이어수가 4명이 안될경우 여기에 없는 사분면에 번개를 떨어뜨리도록 한다.
			table.insert(self.quadrant_contains_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- 사분면 검사할때는 이거 쓸꺼기 때문에 로컬로 선언하지 않고 들고 있는다..
	self.zone_quadrants = { }
	-- zone bound 4등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 2
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 2
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	-- 1사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 2사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 3사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))
	-- 4사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))

	--9분면 검사용으로 사용한다
	self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions = {}
	-- zone quadrant 9등분 해서 저장
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		center = self.zone_quadrants[i].center
		modX = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.x / 3
		modZ = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.z / 3
		size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_quadrants[i].size.y, modZ)
		local nine_region = { }
		-- 9분할된 9분면 바운드..
		--1
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--2
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
		--3
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--4
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
		--5
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
		--6
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
		--7
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
		--8
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
		--9
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

		table.insert(self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions, nine_region)
	end
end

--사용할 레인지 가져오기. 없으면 생성.
function local_class:get_thunder_range()
	if #self.thunder_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.thunder_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide(0)
		return range
	end
end

-- 사용된 레인지 반환하여 리스트에 포함.
function local_class:return_thunder_range(range)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide(0)
	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.thunder_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if not self.active_charge_thunders == nil then

return {

	self.wall_margin = 2 --바운드 z축 시작마진을 끝에서 얼마를 줄건지
	self.shot_object = nil
	self.shot_direction = nil
	self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.shot_hit_list = {}
	self.shot_passed_time = 0
	self.zone_margin = 3

	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_enabled = true
	self.shot_sfx = nil

	self.shot_start_pos = nil
	self.shot_dest_pos = nil
	self.shot_diff = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:check_shot_position(pos)
	--최초 벽충돌한 위치를 기준으로 x,y기점 반대편 벽으로 이동
	local x,z

	--상단 이동인지 하단이동인지?
	self.bound_move_direction = nil
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bounds.center.x then --우측벽
		x = self.zone_bounds.max.x
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.center.x then --좌측벽
		x = self.zone_bounds.min.x
	end

	if pos.z <= self.zone_bounds.center.z then --하단
		z = self.zone_bounds.min.z
		self.bound_move_direction = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif pos.z > self.zone_bounds.center.z then --상단
		z = self.zone_bounds.max.z
		self.bound_move_direction = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return vector(x, 0.1, z) + (self.bound_move_direction * 1.5)
end

function local_class:set_shot_move_position(pos)
	if self.bound_move_direction == nil then return end

	local target_x
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bounds.center.x then --우측벽
		target_x = self.zone_bounds.max.x
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.center.x then --좌측벽
		target_x = self.zone_bounds.min.x
	end

	self.shot_start_pos = pos
	self.shot_dest_pos = vector(target_x, 0, self.shot_dest_pos.z) + (self.bound_move_direction * self.shot_reflect_height)
	self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_start_pos
	self.shot_passed_time = 0
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_enabled = true
	self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
	self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shot_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
	if self.shot_object then
		self.shot_object:Dispose()
	end
	self.shot_passed_time = 0

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
		self.shot_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(
				self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
		self.shot_dest_pos = self.character.Position + (self.shot_direction * self.shot_distance)
		self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.character.Position
		self.shot_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.shot_move_duration = self.shot_diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
		self.shot_passed_time = 0

		--이전 투사체가 남아있다면 삭제
		if not is_unity_null(self.shot_object) then
			self.shot_object:Dispose()
		end
		self.shot_object = nil
		if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
			self.shot_sfx:Stop()
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shot_cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder_cast", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--시작은 타겟의 방향으로 벽에 충돌할때까지 보낸다.
		self.shot_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot",
				self.character.Position)
		self.shot_object.transform.position = self.character.Position
		self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.move_wall

		self.shot_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", self.shot_object.transform.position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
		self.current_state = next_state
end

--최초 발사 후 벽에 근접했는지 체크
function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.shot_object.transform.position, 0.3)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
			return true
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_shot_state ~= self.shot_state.none then
		self:shot_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shot_update(dt)
	self.shot_passed_time = self.shot_passed_time + dt
	if is_unity_null(self.shot_object) then
		return
	end

	--이동
	if self.current_shot_state == self.shot_state.move_wall then
		if not self:check_battle_zone_by_wall() then
			self.shot_object.transform.position =
			self.shot_start_pos + self.shot_passed_time / self.shot_move_duration * self.shot_diff
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:SetPosition(self.shot_object.transform.position)
			end
		else
			--벽에 닿았다면 스테이트를 변경하고 지그재그 이동루틴
			self.shot_start_pos = self.shot_object.transform.position
			self.shot_dest_pos = self:check_shot_position(self.shot_start_pos)
			self.shot_diff = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_start_pos
			self.shot_move_duration = self.shot_diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
			self.shot_passed_time = 0
			self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.bound_wall
		end
	elseif self.current_shot_state == self.shot_state.bound_wall then
		if self.shot_object.transform.position.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z - self.zone_margin or
				self.shot_object.transform.position.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z + self.zone_margin then
			--zone을 벗어나면 종료
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:Stop()
			end
			self.current_shot_state = self.shot_state.none
			self.shot_object:Dispose()
			self.shot_object = nil
			self.shot_passed_time = 0

			return
		end
		local dist = self.shot_dest_pos - self.shot_object.transform.position
		if dist.magnitude > 0.5 then
			self.shot_object.transform.position =
			self.shot_start_pos + self.shot_passed_time / self.shot_move_duration * self.shot_diff
			if self.shot_sfx ~= nil then
				self.shot_sfx:SetPosition(self.shot_object.transform.position)
			end
		else
			self:set_shot_move_position(self.shot_object.transform.position)
		end
	end

	--충돌

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.shot_object.transform.position, self.shot_radius)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

		local is_hit_delayed = false
		for i = #self.shot_hit_list, 1, -1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.shot_hit_list[i].fo) then
				self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time = self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
				if self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
					is_hit_delayed = true
				else
					table.remove(self.shot_hit_list, i)
				end
			end
		end

		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.shot_dest_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.shot_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.shot_damage_delay })
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.thunder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.shot_attack_caclulator = nil
	self.stomp_attack_calculator = nil
	self.thunder_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.shot_state = nil
	self.shot_object = nil
	self.shot_direction = nil
	self.current_shot_state = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.shot_hit_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.shot_start_pos = nil
	self.shot_dest_pos = nil
	self.shot_diff = nil
	self.shot_sfx = nil
	self.cloud_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--배틀액션 시작
function local_class:trigger()

		--print('trigger state', self.current_state)
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end
	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.target = target

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 캐릭터 방향 고정
	-- 애니메이션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
	-- 이모션
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.cast_key)

	--보스캐릭터이므로 카메라연출 및 스킬 보이스 없음
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position,  unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
