end

--낙뢰 준비
function local_class:prepare_thunder()
	-- 준비루틴에서 1초에 걸쳐서 attack range 보여주고 끝나면 낙뢰 실행
	-- 낙뢰시에는 파티 전체를 타겟으로 --pooled_list 임

	local thunder_remains = self.thunder_max_amount
	local targets = user_party
	for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
		-- 힛 가능한 타겟이라면 낙뢰 떨구고 낙뢰 카운드 증가
		local thunder_position = targets[i].Position
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, targets[i]) then
			-- 타격 가능하다면 해당 플레이어 위치에 낙뢰준비
			-- 타겟 되는 포지션이 어느사분면에 포함되어있는지..
			local range = self:get_thunder_range()
			self:check_position_in_quadrant(thunder_position)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, 0.5)
			range:Show(self.thunder_term)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			table.insert(self.active_thunders, {
				attack_range = range,
				position = thunder_position
			})
			thunder_remains = thunder_remains - 1
		end
	end
	-- 랜덤 위치가 아니라 맵을 사분면으로 나누어서 없는 사분면을 선택.
	-- 선택된 사분면을 9분할 하여 그중 하나에 떨구도록 한다.
	-- 비어있는 사분면 체크
	local empty_quadrants = { true, true, true, true }
	for i = 1, #self.quadrant_contains_list do
		empty_quadrants[self.quadrant_contains_list[i]] = false
	end

	-- 비어있는 사분면에 대한 공격. 구등분된 구역중 하나에 낙뢰를 뿌리도록 한다.
	for i = 1, #empty_quadrants do
		if empty_quadrants[i] then
			if thunder_remains > 0 then
				local region_index = unity_class.random.Range(1, #self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions[i] + 1)
				region_index = math.floor(region_index)
				local bound = self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions[i][region_index]
				local thunder_position = bound.center + vector(unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5), 0 , unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5))
				-- 여기서 확정난 선더 포지션에 레인지 준비
				local range = self:get_thunder_range()
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, thunder_position, 0.5)
				range:Show(self.thunder_term)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
				table.insert(self.active_thunders,{
					attack_range = range,
					position = thunder_position
				})
				thunder_remains = thunder_remains - 1
			end
		end
	end
	self.quadrant_contains_list = nil
	self.quadrant_contains_list = { }
end

--낙뢰 때리는 루틴
function local_class:thunder_routine()
	--self.thunder_ranges 에서 지정된 위치에 낙뢰 실행
	if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			local range = self.active_thunders[i]
			if range ~= nil then
				local thunder_position = range.position
				self:falling_thunder_damage(thunder_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key, thunder_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, thunder_position)
				self:return_thunder_range(range.attack_range)
				table.remove(self.active_thunders, i)
			end
		end
		--번개 실행횟수 증가
		self.current_thunder_count = self.current_thunder_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:cloud_routine()
	local cloud = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool(self.cloud_key)
	local target_position = stage.StageCamera.Transform.position + cloud.Offset

	--배틀액션에 설정된 이펙트 로드 함수로 불러오는 경우에 방향이 다르게 출력되어 오브젝트풀에서 인서턴시에이트 시킨다.
	self.cloud_effect = cloud:Instantiate(target_position,
		stage.StageCamera.Transform.rotation, stage.StageCamera.Transform);

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cloud_key, self.target.Position)
	stage_camera:Shake(self.cloud_camera_shake_modifier, self.cloud_camera_shake_duration)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--타격 가능한가
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:cancel()

	self.is_thunder_runable = false

	if self.active_thunders ~= nil then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end
			table.remove(self.active_thunders, i)
		end
	end

	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		for i = #self.thunder_ranges, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				self.thunder_ranges[i]:Hide(0)
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cloud_effect) then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cloud_effect = nil

	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.time_thunder = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	-- 현재 state exite 처리
	-- 현재 스테이트 준비단계 정려
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.is_thunder_runable = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			for i = 1, #self.active_thunders do
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
			end
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		self:cloud_routine()
		-- 액션 단계 낙뢰 + 돌진 동시에 정리함.
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		--애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_crash then
		--돌진애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		--공격큐 종료
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		--종료처리 종료하면 현재 애니메이션 제거
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 배틀 스테이트 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 큐 이벤트 시작
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		-- 준비 애니메이션
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		-- 준비 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)
		-- 번개 준비
		self:prepare_thunder()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.after_crash then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.action_delay))
		end

		-- 재 차지 준비 하는게 아니라면 그로기 상태에 돌입함.
		self.is_groggy = true
		--그로기 애니메이션 플레이
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.groggy_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.groggy_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion(self.groggy_key)
		local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		-- 어택레인지 제거
		for i = 1, #self.active_thunders do
			self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:check_thunder_runable()
	if self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	if not self.is_thunder_runable then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self:check_thunder_runable() then
		self.time_thunder = self.time_thunder + dt
		if self.time_thunder >= self.thunder_term then
			if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
				self.time_thunder = 0
				self:thunder_routine()
				--thunder_routine 에서 카운트 증가 하므로 아래에서 한번 더 체크 해야 한다.
				if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunder_count then
					self:prepare_thunder()
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.none)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end


	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:falling_thunder_damage(damage_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, damage_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key, damage_pos)
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(damage_pos, self.thunder_radius, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_position_in_quadrant(target_position)
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		if self.zone_quadrants[i]:Contains(target_position) then
			--몇번 사분면에 있는지 체크 하여 플레이어수가 4명이 안될경우 여기에 없는 사분면에 번개를 떨어뜨리도록 한다.
			table.insert(self.quadrant_contains_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	-- 사분면 검사할때는 이거 쓸꺼기 때문에 로컬로 선언하지 않고 들고 있는다..
	self.zone_quadrants = { }
	-- zone bound 4등분 해서 저장
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 2
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 2
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	-- 1사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 2사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, modZ/2), size))
	-- 3사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))
	-- 4사분면
	table.insert(self.zone_quadrants, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX/2, 0, -modZ/2), size))

	--9분면 검사용으로 사용한다
	self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions = {}
	-- zone quadrant 9등분 해서 저장
	for i = 1, #self.zone_quadrants do
		center = self.zone_quadrants[i].center
		modX = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.x / 3
		modZ = self.zone_quadrants[i].size.z / 3
		size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_quadrants[i].size.y, modZ)
		local nine_region = { }
		-- 9분할된 9분면 바운드..
		--1
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--2
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
		--3
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
		--4
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
		--5
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
		--6
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
		--7
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
		--8
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
		--9
		table.insert(nine_region, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

		table.insert(self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions, nine_region)
	end
end

--사용할 레인지 가져오기. 없으면 생성.
function local_class:get_thunder_range()
	if #self.thunder_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.thunder_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.thunder_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide(0)
		return range
	end
end

-- 사용된 레인지 반환하여 리스트에 포함.
function local_class:return_thunder_range(range)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide(0)
	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.thunder_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()
	if not self.active_thunders == nil then
		for i = #self.active_thunders, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.active_thunders[i].attack_range) then
				self:return_thunder_range(self.active_thunders.attack_range)
				self.active_thunders[i].attack_range = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.active_thunders = nil

	if not self.thunder_ranges == nil then
		for i = #self.thunder_ranges, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.thunder_ranges[i])
				self.thunder_ranges[i] = nil
			end
			table.remove(self.thunder_ranges, i)
		end
	end
	self.thunder_ranges = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.thunder_max_amount = nil
	self.thunder_term = nil
	self.thunder_radius = nil
	self.thunder_count = nil
	self.thunder_modifier = nil

	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.cloud_camera_shake_modifier = nil
	self.cloud_camera_shake_duration = nil

	self.action_delay = nil

	self.cloud_key = nil
	self.cast_key = nil
	self.charge_key = nil
	self.thunder_key = nil

	self.quadrant_contains_list = nil

	if self.thunder_ranges ~= nil then
		for i=1 , #self.thunder_ranges do
			if not is_unity_null(self.thunder_ranges[i]) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.thunder_ranges[i])
			end
		end
	end
	self.thunder_ranges = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.zone_quadrants = nil
	self.zone_quadrant_nine_regions = nil
	self.current_charge_count = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_enabled = true
	self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
	self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		if self.is_jump_start then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.stomp_attack_range) then
		self.stomp_attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cloud_effect) then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cloud_effect = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_active_stomp_attack_range = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.stomp_attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder then
		for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_cast")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
		self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.jump_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local a = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.stomp_attack_range, self.target.Position)
		self.stomp_attack_range:Show(self.dangling_duration + self.fall_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))

		local cloud_effect_pool = self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('cloud')
		local target_position = stage.StageCamera.Transform.position + cloud_effect_pool.Offset
		self.cloud_effect = cloud_effect_pool:Instantiate(target_position,
				stage.StageCamera.Transform.rotation, stage.StageCamera.Transform);
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cloud', nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.stomp_attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.stomp_attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_jump_start = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_attack_range))
		self.stomp_attack_range:Hide()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude, self.stomp_camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--추가 공격 어택레인지
		self.thunder_start_pos = self.character.Position
		for i = 1, #self.thunder_attack_range_list do
			local center_angle = 360 / self.thunder_amount * i
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (360 / 2), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
			local dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position) + dir * self.thunder_distance

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.thunder_attack_range_list[i], dest_pos, battle_util.get_height(self.thunder_start_pos))
			self.thunder_attack_range_list[i]:Show(self.thunder_prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.thunder_attack_range_list[i]))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.thunder then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("thunder")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("thunder", self.character.Position)
		for i = 1, #self.thunder_attack_calculator_list do
			local center_angle = 360 / self.thunder_amount * i
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (360 / 2), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
			local dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position) + dir * self.thunder_distance

			self.thunder_attack_calculator_list[i].Position = dest_pos
			self.thunder_attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder", dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
		self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			local target_pos = self.target_position
			local dest = target_pos
			self.target_position = dest
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if not self.is_start_stomp_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
			self.is_start_stomp_animation = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration - 0.2 and not self.is_start_stomp_effect then

			--TODO:thunder effect 보스위치에 뿌려주야된다.
			local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position) + 0.1)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", effect_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("thunder", effect_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", effect_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("thunder", effect_pos)
			self.is_start_stomp_effect = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
					battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
				if self.current_repeat_count < self.stomp_repeat_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.thunder_prepare)
				end
			else
				self:stomp_damage_update(dt)
			end
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.thunder_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.thunder_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.thunder)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thunder then
		if self.time_passed >= self.thunder_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:thunder_damage_update()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stomp_damage_update(dt)
	local objects = self.stomp_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.stomp_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:thunder_damage_update(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_calculator_list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

				if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.thunder_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	for _,v in pairs(self.thunder_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
			v = nil
		end
	end
	self.thunder_attack_range_list = nil
	self.stomp_attack_calculator = nil
	self.thunder_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.shot_start_pos = nil
	self.shot_dest_pos = nil
	self.shot_diff = nil
	self.shot_sfx = nil
	self.cloud_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function wave_projectile:shoot(from, to, duration, move_end_callback)
	self.active = true

	local dir = (to - from).normalized
	self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_preset_name, from, dir)
	self:set_transform(from, dir)
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, self.dir)
	self:set_target_pos(to)
	self:init_move_to_target(duration, move_end_callback)
	self:set_attack_calculator(duration)
end

function wave_projectile:set_attack_calculator(duration)
	self:end_attack_calculator()

	local main_charge_info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	main_charge_info.Center = self.pos
	main_charge_info.DamageTerm = -1
	main_charge_info.Duration = duration
	main_charge_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.width, 1, self.width)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.shooter, main_charge_info, false, 0, 0)
	self.attack_calculator:Start()

function wave_projectile:set_target_pos(target_pos)
	self.target_pos = target_pos
end

function wave_projectile:init_move_to_target(duration, move_end_callback)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	if not self.target_pos then
		return
	end

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.move_duration = 0
		self:set_transform(self.target_pos, self.dir)
		return
	end

	self.base_pos = self.pos
	self.move_duration = duration
	self.move_time_left = self.move_duration
	local dir = (self.target_pos - self.base_pos).normalized
	self:set_transform(self.pos, dir)

	self.move_end_callback = move_end_callback
end

function wave_projectile:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	if self.move_time_left <= 0 then
		return
	end

	self.move_time_left = self.move_time_left - dt

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(self.move_duration - self.move_time_left, 0, 1, self.move_duration)
	local pos = vector_util.lerp(self.base_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
	self:set_transform(pos, self.dir)

	self:process_damage(dt)

	if self.move_time_left <= 0 then
		if self.move_end_callback then
			self.move_end_callback(self.action, self, self.target_pos)
			self.move_end_callback = nil
			self.active = false
		end
	end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		cast = 3,
		action = 4,
		shoot_delay = 5,
		shoot = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	-- 파라미터
	self.plunge_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallHeight', 3)
	self.plunge_speed = math.max(0.1, CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallSpeed', 1))
	self.plunge_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallAttackRadius', 2)
	self.shoot_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootOffset', 0.5)
	self.projectile_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileSpeed', 25)
	self.projectile_effect_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileEffectLength', 8.5)
	self.projectile_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileWidth', 1)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	-- duration
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 1)

	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootInterval', 0.5)

	self.plunge_duration = (plunge_animation_duration - 0.1) / self.plunge_speed

	self.plunge_attack_range =  CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.plunge_radius)

	self.shadow_transform = self.character.Transform:Find('shadow')

	self.wave_preset_name = 'wave'

function local_class:new_shoot_info(direction, range)

	return shoot_info
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.center)
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.size)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), info:GetPositionAt(1))
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end

	local index = 0
	local show_type = CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward
	local init_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local length = self.shoot_directions_json.Count - 1
	self.shoot_info_sets = {}
	for i = 0, length do
		local param = self.shoot_directions_json[i]
		local directions_x = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(param, 'DirectionX')
		local directions_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(param, 'DirectionZ')
		local info_set = {}
		for j,v in pairs(directions_x) do
			index = index + 1
			local x = v
			local z = directions_z[j]
			local dir = unity_class.vector3(x,0,z).normalized
			local range_size = unity_class.vector2(self:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir), self.projectile_width)
			if not self.attack_range_pool[index] then
				self.attack_range_pool[index] = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(init_pos, range_size, show_type)
			end
			local attack_range = self.attack_range_pool[index]
			attack_range:Hide()
			local shoot_info = self:new_shoot_info(dir, attack_range)
			table.insert(info_set, shoot_info)
		end
		table.insert(self.shoot_info_sets, info_set)
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir_vector3)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.center.x, self.zone_bound.center.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > self.zone_bound.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < self.zone_bound.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > self.zone_bound.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.min.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < self.zone_bound.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.zone_bound.max.x,self.zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.cast then
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.plunge_attack_range))
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot_delay then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			self:remove_projectile_risk_map()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_delay then
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	elseif next_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = self.plunge_speed

		local current_pos = self.character.Position
		self.plunge_attack_range.Position = current_pos
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.plunge_attack_range))
		self:set_projectile_risk_map(current_pos)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local info_set = self.shoot_info_sets[1]
		for _,info in pairs(info_set) do
			local attack_range = info.attack_range
			attack_range:Show(self.shoot_start_delay)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:remove_projectile_risk_map()
		self:clear_shoot_info_sets()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_projectiles(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		else
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.prepare_duration) * 0.5
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.plunge_height)
			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * math.cos(math.pi * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.plunge_duration then
			-- 원형 범위 데미지
			local current_pos = self.character.Position
			local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(current_pos, self.plunge_radius)
			for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
				local fo = collide_objs[i]

				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - current_pos).normalized

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			collide_objs:Dispose()
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.impact_preset_name, current_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', user_party.Leader)

			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_delay)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.plunge_duration) * 0.5
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, math.cos(math.pi * progress) * self.plunge_height)
			self.shadow_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * math.sin(math.pi * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_start_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_count == #self.shoot_info_sets then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval * self.shoot_count then
			self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
			local info_set = self.shoot_info_sets[self.shoot_count]
			for _, info in pairs(info_set) do
				local dir = info.direction
				local attack_range = info.attack_range
				attack_range:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))

				local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset * dir
				local target_pos = shoot_pos + self.projectile_effect_length * dir
				self:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, nil, self.on_move_end_callback)
			end
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', user_party.Leader)

			local next_info_set = self.shoot_info_sets[self.shoot_count + 1]
			if next_info_set then
				for _, info in pairs(next_info_set) do
					local attack_range = info.attack_range
					attack_range:Show(self.shoot_interval)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_projectiles(dt)
	for _,projectile in pairs(self.projectiles) do
		if projectile.active then
			projectile:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_projectile()
	local index = self:get_first_nil_index(self.projectiles)
	local projectile = wave_projectile:new(self, self.damage_modifier, self.wave_preset_name, self.projectile_width, self.knock_back_force, index)
	self.projectiles[index] = projectile

	return projectile
end

function local_class:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, proj, on_move_end_callback)
	local diff = target_pos - shoot_pos
	local dist = diff.magnitude
	local duration = dist / self.projectile_speed

	if not proj then
		local projectile = self:create_projectile()
		projectile:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, on_move_end_callback)
	else
		proj:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, on_move_end_callback)
	end
end

function local_class:set_projectile_risk_map(pos)
	if not self.shoot_info_sets then
		return
	end

	for _,info_set in pairs(self.shoot_info_sets) do
		for _,info in pairs(info_set) do
			local dir = info.direction
			local attack_range = info.attack_range
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, pos + dir * self.shoot_offset, dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_projectile_risk_map()
	if not self.shoot_info_sets then
		return
	end

	for _,info_set in pairs(self.shoot_info_sets) do
		for _,info in pairs(info_set) do
			local attack_range = info.attack_range
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_shoot_info_sets()
	if not self.shoot_info_sets then
		return
	end

	for _,info_set in pairs(self.shoot_info_sets) do
		for _,info in pairs(info_set) do
			info.attack_range:Hide()
			info.attack_range = nil
			info.direction = nil
		end
		info_set = nil
	end
	self.shoot_info_sets = nil
end

function local_class:on_move_end_callback(proj, pos)
	self:dispose_projectile(proj)
end

function local_class:dispose_projectile(proj)
	self.projectiles[proj.index] = nil
	proj:dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	self.plunge_attack_range =  nil
	self.shadow_transform = nil

	self.impact_preset_name = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.projectiles = nil
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_first_nil_index(table)
	local i = 1
	while table[i] ~= nil do
		i = i + 1
	end
	return i
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'cleave_start'}))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cast_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local transform = stage_camera.Transform
		local ef = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cleave", transform.position, unity_class.vector3.zero, transform)
		ef.transform.rotation = transform.rotation

		--캐릭터 조종 불가
		self:lock_target()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,{ 'reset_gimmick_gauge' }))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.break_sfx_delay and not self.is_break_sfx then
				self.is_break_sfx = true
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("break")
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("break2")
			end

			if self.time_passed >= self.controll_lock_duration and self.is_shield_start then
				self:release_target()
			end

			if self.time_passed >= self.damage_delay then
				if self.is_shield_start then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,{'cleave_shield_break'}))
					self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
				else
					self:release_target()

					self:update_damage()
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:lock_target()
	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			v.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
			v.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, v, self.speed_cap_buff_name,
					1, false, false)

			if battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
				-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
				v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(v, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			else
				local controller = v.FieldObjectController
				cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
				controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_lock_target = true
end

function local_class:release_target()
	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			-- 애니메이션 제거
			v:RemoveAnimation()
			-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, v, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
			if battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
				local state = v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
				if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
					v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(v)
				end
			else
				local controller = v.FieldObjectController
				cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
				controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_lock_target = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFallenQueenCleaveEnhancedBattleAction')

--region blast_projectile
local projectile = {
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	shooter = nil,
	index = nil,
	target= nil,
	pos = nil,
	dir = nil,
	fx = nil,
	trail_fx = nil,
	blast_damage_modifier = nil,
	aoe_damage_modifier = nil,
	aoe_damage_term = nil,
	base_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	projectile_fall_height = nil,
	radius = nil,
	aoe_duration = nil,
	range_duration = nil,
	chase_duration = nil,
	blast_knock_back_force = nil,
	aoe_knock_back_force = nil,
	projectile_preset = 'projectile',
	contrail_preset = 'contrail',
	aoe_loop_preset = 'aoe_loop',
	aoe_end_preset = 'aoe_end',
	post_duration = 1,
	trail_dispose_delay = 1,
	state = {
		none = 1,
		chase = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		aoe = 4,
		post = 5
	}
}
projectile.mt = { __index = projectile }

function projectile:new(parent_class, target, index, attack_range)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.shooter = parent_class.character
	obj.index = index
	obj.target = target
	obj.dir = unity_class.vector3.down

	obj.shoot_duration = 0
	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.active = true
	obj:change_state(obj.state.chase)

	obj.attack_range = attack_range
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(obj.attack_range, target.Position)
	obj.attack_range:Show(obj.range_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(obj.shooter, obj.attack_range))

	return obj
end

function projectile:set_param(radius, projectile_fall_height, blast_knock_back_force, blast_damage_modifier, aoe_knock_back_force,
							  aoe_damage_modifier, aoe_damage_term, aoe_duration, chase_duration, range_duration)
	self.radius = radius
	self.projectile_fall_height = projectile_fall_height
	self.blast_knock_back_force = blast_knock_back_force
	self.blast_damage_modifier = blast_damage_modifier
	self.aoe_knock_back_force = aoe_knock_back_force
	self.aoe_damage_modifier = aoe_damage_modifier
	self.aoe_damage_term = aoe_damage_term
	self.aoe_duration = aoe_duration
	self.chase_duration = chase_duration
	self.range_duration = range_duration
end

function projectile:shoot(from, to, duration, explode)
	self:init_shoot(from, to, duration, explode)
end

function projectile:set_transform(pos, dir)
	self.pos = pos
	self.dir = dir
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, self.dir)
	end
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.pos, self.dir)
	end
end

function projectile:init_shoot(from, to, duration)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.shoot_duration = 0
		self:set_transform(to, self.dir)
		return
	end

	self.base_pos = from
	self.target_pos = to
	self.shoot_duration = duration
	self.time_passed = 0
	local dir = (self.target_pos - self.base_pos).normalized
	self.pos = self.base_pos
	self.fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_preset, self.base_pos, dir)
	self.trail_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_preset, self.base_pos, dir)

	--attack_calculator
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.target_pos
	info.DamageTerm = self.aoe_damage_term
	info.Duration = self.aoe_duration
	info.Radius = self.radius
	info.Height = 1
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.aoe_attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.shooter, info, true)

	self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
end

function projectile:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- 투사체 충돌 판정 하지 않음
function projectile:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.chase then
		if self.time_passed >= self.chase_duration then
			local target_pos = self.target.Position
			local shoot_pos = self.shooter.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * self.projectile_fall_height
			local duration = math.max(0, self.range_duration - self.chase_duration)
			self:init_shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration)
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		else
			local pos = self.target.Position
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.shooter, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_duration then
			self:explode(self.target_pos)

			if self.fx then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
				self.fx = nil
			end
			self:set_transform(self.target_pos, self.dir)

			if self.attack_range then
				self.attack_range:Hide()
			end

			self.aoe_attack_calculator:Start()
			self.aoe_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.aoe_loop_preset, self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self:change_state(self.state.aoe)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.shoot_duration
			local pos = vector_util.lerp(self.base_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
			self:set_transform(pos, self.dir)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.aoe then
		if self.time_passed >= self.aoe_duration then
			if self.aoe_fx then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aoe_fx)
				self.aoe_fx = nil
			end
			if self.aoe_attack_calculator then
				self.aoe_attack_calculator:End()
				self.aoe_attack_calculator = nil
			end
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.shooter, self.attack_range))

			self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.aoe_end_preset, self.pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.trail_fx and self.time_passed >= self.trail_dispose_delay then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
				self.trail_fx = nil
			end

			local objects = self.aoe_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]
				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.pos).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.shooter
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.aoe_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.aoe_knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self.active = false
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function projectile:explode(pos)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.shooter, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.shooter
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.blast_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.blast_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	local sfx = self.cs_action:PlaySfx('aoe', user_party.Leader)
	sfx:SetPosition(pos)
	self.aoe_sfx_loop = self.cs_action:PlaySfx('aoe_loop', user_party.Leader)
	self.aoe_sfx_loop:SetPosition(pos)
	--self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blast', pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
end

function projectile:dispose()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
		self.fx = nil
	end
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end
	if self.aoe_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aoe_fx)
		self.aoe_fx = nil
	end
	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.shooter, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
	if self.aoe_sfx_loop then
		self.aoe_sfx_loop:FadeOut(1)
		self.aoe_sfx_loop = nil
	end

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.pos = nil
	self.dir = nil
	self.shooter = nil
	self.active = nil
end
--endregion

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 전멸기 파라미터
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 1)
	self.damage_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageDelay', 0.5)
	self.controll_lock_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ControllLockDuration', 0.3)
	self.speed_cap_buff_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'SpeedCapBuffName',
			'buff_villain_android_manual_bug_care')

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.3)
	self.break_sfx_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BreakEffectDelay', 1)

	-- 폭격 파라미터
	projectile:set_param(
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BlastRadius', 1.5),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BlastFallHeight', 20),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BlastKnockBackForce', 1),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BlastDamageModifier', 1),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeKnockBackForce', 1),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDamageModifier', 0.5),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDamageTerm', 0.5),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AoeDuration', 1.5),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChaseDuration', 1),
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRangeDuration', 1.5)
	)

	self.max_shoot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MaxShootAmount', 3)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootInterval', 2)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		groggy = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	self.target = nil
	self.is_shield_start = false
	self.is_lock_target = false
	self.is_break_sfx = false
	self.target_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil

	self.projectiles = {}
	self.attack_range_pool = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(_)
	if self.projectiles then
		for _, proj in pairs(self.projectiles) do
			self:dispose_projectile(proj)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'cleave_shield_start' then
			self.is_shield_start = true
			self.shield_position = unity_class.vector3(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1)), 0, tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)))
			local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.shield_position):GetHeightAt(self.shield_position)
			self.shield_position.y = floor_height
			self.shield_radius = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3))
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'cleave_shield_end' then
			self.is_shield_start = false
			self.shield_position = nil
			self.shield_radius = nil
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.target_list = nil
	self.is_break_sfx = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_lock_target then
		self:release_target()
	end

	if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		self.cast_effect = nil
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'cleave_end'}))

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end

		if self.cast_sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.cast_sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.cast_sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:release_target()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'cleave_end'}))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'cleave_start'}))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cast_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', user_party.Leader)

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.shoot_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local transform = stage_camera.Transform
		local ef = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cleave', transform.position, unity_class.vector3.zero, transform)
		ef.transform.rotation = transform.rotation

		--캐릭터 조종 불가
		self:lock_target()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,{ 'reset_gimmick_gauge' }))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action', user_party.Leader)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action2', user_party.Leader)
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_projectiles(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		elseif self.shoot_count < self.max_shoot_amount and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_count * self.shoot_interval then
			self:shoot()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.break_sfx_delay and not self.is_break_sfx then
				self.is_break_sfx = true
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break', user_party.Leader)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break2', user_party.Leader)
			end

			if self.time_passed >= self.controll_lock_duration and self.is_shield_start then
				self:release_target()
			end

			if self.time_passed >= self.damage_delay then
				local is_groggy = self.is_shield_start
				if is_groggy then
					local target_dist = (self.shield_position - self.target.Position).magnitude
					is_groggy = target_dist < self.shield_radius
				end
				if is_groggy then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,{'cleave_shield_break'}))
					self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
				else
					self:release_target()

					self:update_damage()
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(_)
	if not self.target_list then
		return
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:lock_target()
	if not self.target_list then
		return
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			v.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
			v.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, v, self.speed_cap_buff_name,
					1, false, false)

			if battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
				local state = v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
				-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
				if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
					v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(v, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
				end
			else
				local controller = v.FieldObjectController
				cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
				controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_lock_target = true
end

function local_class:release_target()
	if not self.target_list then
		return
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			-- 애니메이션 제거
			v:RemoveAnimation()
			-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, v, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
			if battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
				local state = v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
				if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
					v.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(v)
				end
			else
				local controller = v.FieldObjectController
				cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
				controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_lock_target = false
end

function local_class:update_projectiles(dt)
	if not self.projectiles then
		return
	end

	for _,proj in pairs(self.projectiles) do
		if proj.active then
			proj:update_frame(dt)
		else
			self:dispose_projectile(proj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count and self.shoot_count + 1 or 1
	local index = self.shoot_count
	local attack_range
	local pool_count = #self.attack_range_pool
	if pool_count > 0 then
		attack_range = self.attack_range_pool[pool_count]
		table.remove(self.attack_range_pool, pool_count)
		pool_count = pool_count - 1
	else
		attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, projectile.radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	end
	local new_projectile = projectile:new(self, self.target, index, attack_range)
	self.projectiles[index] = new_projectile
end

function local_class:dispose_projectile(proj)
	table.insert(self.attack_range_pool, proj.attack_range)
	self.projectiles[proj.index] = nil
	proj:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target_list = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.projectiles then
		for _,proj in pairs(self.projectiles) do
			self:dispose_projectile(proj)
		end
		self.projectiles = nil
	end
	self.attack_range_pool = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	--회오리 생성 존 나눔
	local center = self.zone_bound.center
	local modX = self.zone_bound.size.x / 4
	local modZ = self.zone_bound.size.z / 4
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX * 2, self.zone_bound.size.y, modZ * 2)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

function local_class:get_tornado_random_pos(pos)
	--해당 위치 기준으로 원형의 랜덤영역을 반환
	local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0, 360)
	local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(0, self.zone_bound.size.x / 4)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	return pos + dir * random_range

function local_class:get_tornado_pos_list()
	local list = {}
	local ignore_list = {}
	for _,v in pairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		--타겟의 위치 기준으로 타겟이 없는 존의 center반환
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(v, self.target.Bounds) then
			table.insert(list, v.center)
		else
			table.insert(ignore_list, v.center)
		end
	end

	if #list == 0 then
		--존중앙이라 전체가 겹쳤을때
		table.insert(list, vector(self.zone_bound.center.x, 0, self.zone_bound.max.z - self.tornado_radius))
		table.insert(list, vector(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.tornado_radius, 0, self.zone_bound.min.z + self.tornado_radius))
		table.insert(list, vector(self.zone_bound.max.x - self.tornado_radius, 0, self.zone_bound.min.z + self.tornado_radius))
		return list
	elseif #list < 3 then
		table.insert(list, ignore_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #ignore_list)])
	end

	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		v = self:get_tornado_random_pos(v)
	end

	return list

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

		local pos_list = self:get_tornado_pos_list()

		self.tornado_info_list = {}
		for i = 1, self.tornado_count do

			self.tornado_info_list[i].effect = effect
			self.tornado_info_list[i].is_active = true
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = self.tornado_info_list[i].pos

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
