function local_class:update_tornado(dt)
	for i = 1, self.tornado_count do
		if self.tornado_info_list[i] == nil then return end

		local info = self.tornado_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			if info.state == self.tornado_state.tracking then
				--추적
				if info.time_passed < self.tornado_tracking_duration then
					info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
					local diff = self.target.Position - info.pos
					local move_position = info.pos + (diff.normalized * self.tornado_speed * dt)
					info.effect.transform.position = move_position
					info.pos = move_position
					self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = move_position
				else
					--돌진으로 이행
					info.time_passed = 0
					info.state = self.tornado_state.interval
				end
			elseif info.state == self.tornado_state.interval then
				if info.time_passed < self.tornado_charge_interval then
					info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				else
					info.time_passed = 0
					info.state = self.tornado_state.charge
					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - info.pos).normalized
					local dest_pos = info.pos + (dir * self.tornado_charge_distance)
					local diff = dest_pos - info.pos
					info.charge_start_pos = info.pos
					info.dest_pos = dest_pos
					info.diff = diff
					info.move_duration = diff.magnitude / self.tornado_charge_speed
				end
			elseif info.state == self.tornado_state.charge then
				if info.time_passed < info.move_duration then
					info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt

					if info.time_passed <= info.move_duration then
						local move_position = info.charge_start_pos + info.time_passed /
								info.move_duration * info.diff
						info.effect.transform.position = move_position
						info.pos = move_position
						info.Position = move_position
						self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = move_position
					else
						info.is_active = false
						if info.effect ~= nil then
							info.effect:Dispose()
							info.effect = nil
						end
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("tornado_end", info.pos)
						self.attack_calculator_list[i]:End()
					end
				end

		end

function local_class:update_tornado_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
		if self.tornado_info_list[i].is_active then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)

--필수 구현

		info.Height = 3
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, ac)

function local_class:cancel()

	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.wheel_info_list ~= nil then

			if v.wheel_effect ~= nil then
				v.wheel_effect:Dispose()
				v.wheel_effect = nil

	self.wheel_info_list = nil

	if self.attack_calculator_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:End()
			end
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end


	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
				if v ~= nil then
					v:Hide()
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spin then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.wheel_info_list = {}
		for i = 1, self.wheel_count do
			local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.wheel_count, 0)
					* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
			local summon_pos = (self.character.Position + self.wheel_start_offset) + dir * self.wheel_range
			summon_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summon_pos, battle_util.get_height(summon_pos))
			table.insert(self.wheel_info_list, {
				dir = dir,
				pos = summon_pos,
				is_active = false,
				is_start_charge = false
			})

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[i], summon_pos)
			self.attack_range_list[i]:Show(self.prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character,
					self.attack_range_list[i]))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.spin then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		for i = 1, self.wheel_count do
			local info = self.wheel_info_list[i]
			local wheel_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("sphere", info.pos)
			local contrail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail", info.pos)
			info.is_active = true
			info.wheel_effect = wheel_effect
			info.contrail_effect = contrail_effect

		self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = info.pos
		self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.is_spin_wheel = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))

		if self.current_charge_count < self.wheel_count then
			self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1
		end

		self.is_spin_wheel = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local start_pos = self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].pos
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - start_pos).normalized
		local dest_pos = start_pos + (dir * self.charge_distance)
		local diff = dest_pos - start_pos
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].charge_start_pos = start_pos
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].dest_pos = dest_pos
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].diff = diff
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].move_duration = diff.magnitude / self.charge_speed
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].time_passed = 0
		self.wheel_info_list[self.current_charge_count].is_start_charge = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")

		self.is_spin_wheel = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_wheel()

end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.is_spin_wheel then
		self:update_Wheel(dt)
		self:update_tracking_target(dt)
	end

	if self.wheel_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_wheel_charge(dt)
		self:update_wheel_damage(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.spin)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spin then
		if self.time_passed >= self.spin_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			if self.current_charge_count < self.wheel_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking_target(dt)
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

	if dist > 1 then

		local direction = diff.normalized
		local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.tracking_speed * dt)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = direction
		move_info.magnitude = move_dist
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction),
				true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	end
end

function local_class:update_Wheel(dt)
	self.spin_time_passed = self.spin_time_passed + dt
	for i = 1, self.wheel_count do
		if self.wheel_info_list[i].is_active and not self.wheel_info_list[i].is_start_charge then
			local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.wheel_count +
					(self.spin_time_passed * self.wheel_speed * 10), 0)	* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
			local pos = (self.character.Position + self.wheel_start_offset) + dir * self.wheel_range
			pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
			self.wheel_info_list[i].wheel_effect.transform.position = pos
			self.wheel_info_list[i].contrail_effect.transform.position = pos
			self.wheel_info_list[i].pos = pos
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_wheel_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
		if self.wheel_info_list[i].is_active then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.wheel_info_list[i].pos).normalized
					local knock_direction = direction
					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
					end
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.modifier = self.spin_damage_modifier
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.spin_knockback_force
					local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_wheel_charge(dt)
	for i = 1, self.wheel_count do
		local info = self.wheel_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			if info.is_start_charge then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				if info.time_passed <= info.move_duration then
					local move_position = info.charge_start_pos + info.time_passed /
							info.move_duration * info.diff
					info.wheel_effect.transform.position = move_position
					info.contrail_effect.transform.position = move_position
					info.pos = move_position
					info.Position = move_position
					self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = move_position

					if self:check_battle_zone_by_wall(self.wheel_info_list[i].pos) then
						--벽충돌 하면 폭발 이팩트 삭제
						self:dispose_Wheel(info, i)
						info.is_start_charge = false
						info.is_contrail_dealy = true
						info.time_passed = 0
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", info.pos)
						self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
					end
				else
					--시간 끝나면 이팩트 삭제 폭발도 해야되나??
					self:dispose_Wheel(info, i)
					info.is_start_charge = false
					info.is_contrail_dealy = true
					info.time_passed = 0
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", info.pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
				end
			end

			if info.is_contrail_dealy then
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
				if info.time_passed > self.contrail_delay then
					self:dispose_contrail(info)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_Wheel(info, index)
	if info ~= nil then
		info.is_active = false
		if info.wheel_effect ~= nil then
			info.wheel_effect:Dispose()
			info.wheel_effect = nil
		end
	end

	self.attack_calculator_list[index]:End()
end

function local_class:dispose_contrail(info)
	if info ~= nil then
		info.is_active = false
		if info.contrail_effect ~= nil then
			info.contrail_effect:Dispose()
			info.contrail_effect = nil
		end
	end
end

--벽 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, 0.2)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.wheel_start_offset = nil
	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.wheel_info_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

	self.tracking_shot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingMeteorSpeed", 15)
	self.shot_up_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeteorHeight", 20)

	self.tracking_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "TrackingShotCount", 8)

	self.blue_marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'BlueMarkerName', 'blue_marker_')
	self.red_marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'RedMarkerName', 'red_marker_')
	self.marker_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MarkerCount", 6)

	self.meteor_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeteorRadius", 1.5)
	self.meteor_phase_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeteorTypeHPRatio", 0.8)

	local red_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "RedMeteorOffset")
	self.red_meteor_offset = vector(red_offset[1], red_offset[2], red_offset[3])
	local blue_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "BlueMeteorOffset")
	self.blue_meteor_offset = vector(blue_offset[1], blue_offset[2], blue_offset[3])

	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportDuration", 0.15)
	self.teleport_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportPrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.teleport_effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportEffectDelay", 0.3)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1)
	self.blink_knockback_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BlinkKnockBackRadius", 2)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		teleport_prepare = 2,
		teleport = 3,
		prepare = 4,
		shoot_out_prepare = 5,
		shoot_out = 6,
		shoot_in_prepare = 7,
		shoot_in = 8,
		tracking_shoot_prepare = 9,
		tracking_shoot = 10,
		post = 11
	}

	--AttackRange
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count * 2 do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.meteor_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	--AttackRange
	self.tracking_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.tracking_shot_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.meteor_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.tracking_attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	self.shot_state = {
		up = 1,
		wait = 2,
		down = 3,
		dealy = 4
	}

	self.meteor_type = {
		red = 1,
		blue = 2
	}

	self.meteor_phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.current_shoot_out_count = 0
	self.current_shoot_in_count = 0
	self.current_tracking_shoot_count = 0
	self.shoot_time_passed = 0
	self.current_meteor_phase = self.meteor_phase.phase1
	self.shot_info_list = nil
	self.tracking_shot_info_list = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_marker_list()
	self.marker_list = {}
	self.shot_info_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local red_marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.red_marker_name .. i)
		local blue_marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.blue_marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, red_marker)
		table.insert(self.shot_info_list, {type = self.meteor_type.red, offset = self.red_meteor_offset})

		table.insert(self.marker_list, blue_marker)
		if self.current_meteor_phase == self.meteor_phase.phase1 then
			table.insert(self.shot_info_list, {type = self.meteor_type.red, offset = self.blue_meteor_offset})
		else
			table.insert(self.shot_info_list, {type = self.meteor_type.blue, offset = self.blue_meteor_offset})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.current_shoot_out_count = 0
	self.current_shoot_in_count = 0
	self.current_tracking_shoot_count = 0
	self.shoot_time_passed = 0
	self.current_meteor_phase = self.meteor_phase.phase1
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:reset_ailment()

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
					v.proj_effect:Dispose()
					v.proj_effect = nil
				end
				if v.contrail_effect ~= nil then
					v.contrail_effect:Dispose()
					v.contrail_effect = nil
				end
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
	end

	if self.tracking_shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.tracking_shot_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
					v.proj_effect:Dispose()
					v.proj_effect = nil
				end
				if v.contrail_effect ~= nil then
					v.contrail_effect:Dispose()
					v.contrail_effect = nil
				end
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.tracking_attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.tracking_attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_out_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_out then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_in_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_in then
		self:reset_ailment()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_shoot_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_shoot then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end

		--self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.teleport_finish = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink", self.character.Position)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.meteor_phase_hp_ratio then
			self.current_meteor_phase = self.meteor_phase.phase2
		end

		self:get_marker_list()

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_out_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_out then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_time_passed = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_in_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_time_passed = 0
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.shoot_in_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_in then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.tracking_shoot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.tracking_shot_info_list ~= nil then
			self.tracking_shot_info_list = nil
		end
		self.tracking_shot_info_list = {}
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot")
	elseif next_state == self.state.tracking_shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_time_passed = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_shot(dt)
	end

	if self.tracking_shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_tracking_shot(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:update_knock_back(dt)
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_out_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_out_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_out_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_out)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_out then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_out_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_in_prepare)
		else
			self:update_shoot_out(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_in_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_in_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_in)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_in then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_in_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking_shoot_prepare)
		else
			self:update_shoot_in(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_shoot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_shoot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking_shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_tracking_shoot(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.blink_knockback_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_shot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			if v.state == self.shot_state.up then
				local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
				if progress > 1 then
					v.state = self.shot_state.wait
				else
					local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = move_pos
					v.contrail_effect.transform.position = move_pos
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.down then
				local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
				if progress > 1 then
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos
					v.contrail_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos

					self:shot_explosion_damage(v.dest_pos)
					if v.type == self.meteor_type.red then
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_red_explosion", v.dest_pos)
					else
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_blue_explosion", v.dest_pos)
					end
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", v.dest_pos)
					self:create_bead(v.dest_pos, v.type)

					if self.attack_range_list[v.index] ~= nil then
						self.attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[v.index]))
					end

					if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
						v.proj_effect:Dispose()
						v.proj_effect = nil
					end

					v.state = self.shot_state.dealy
				else
					local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = move_pos
					v.contrail_effect.transform.position = move_pos
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.dealy then
				if v.time_passed > self.contrail_dealy then
					if v.contrail_effect ~= nil then
						v.contrail_effect:Dispose()
						v.contrail_effect = nil
					end
					v.is_active = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_bead(pos, mode)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_position',
				-- x좌표
				pos.x,
				-- y좌표
				pos.y,
				-- z좌표
				pos.z,
				mode
			}))
end

function local_class:update_shoot_out(dt)
	--좌우 랜덤각도로 total_count만큼 위로 발사
	self.shoot_time_passed = self.shoot_time_passed + dt

	if self.shoot_time_passed > self.shoot_out_interval * self.current_shoot_out_count then
		if self.current_shoot_out_count < #self.shot_info_list then
			self.current_shoot_out_count = self.current_shoot_out_count + 1

			local info = self.shot_info_list[self.current_shoot_out_count]
			local proj_effect, contrail_effect, start_pos, dest_pos = self:start_meteor_effect(info.type, info.offset)
			local diff = start_pos - dest_pos

			info.pos = start_pos
			info.start_pos = start_pos
			info.dest_pos = dest_pos
			info.time_passed = 0
			info.proj_effect = proj_effect
			info.contrail_effect = contrail_effect
			info.move_duration = diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
			info.is_active = true
			info.state = self.shot_state.up

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")
		end
	else
	end
end

function local_class:update_shoot_in(dt)
	self.shoot_time_passed = self.shoot_time_passed + dt

	if self.shoot_time_passed > self.shoot_in_interval * self.current_shoot_in_count then
		if self.current_shoot_in_count < #self.shot_info_list then
			self.current_shoot_in_count = self.current_shoot_in_count + 1

			local dest_pos = self.marker_list[self.current_shoot_in_count].position
			local start_pos = dest_pos + vector(0, self.shot_up_height, 0)
			local info = self.shot_info_list[self.current_shoot_in_count]
			local diff = start_pos - dest_pos
			info.index = self.current_shoot_in_count
			info.start_pos = start_pos
			info.dest_pos = dest_pos
			info.time_passed = 0
			info.move_duration = diff.magnitude / self.shot_down_speed
			info.state = self.shot_state.down
			info.diff = diff

			info.proj_effect.transform.position = start_pos
			info.contrail_effect.transform.position = start_pos
			local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, -90)
			info.proj_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
			info.contrail_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[info.index], dest_pos)
			self.attack_range_list[info.index]:Show(info.move_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[info.index]))
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking_shoot_prepare)
		end
	else
	end
end

function local_class:start_meteor_effect(type, offset)
	local proj_name = 'proj_red'
	local contrail_name = 'proj_red_contrail'
	local fire_name = 'proj_red_fire'
	local start_pos = self.character.Position + offset
	if type == self.meteor_type.blue then
		proj_name = 'proj_blue'
		contrail_name = 'proj_blue_contrail'
		fire_name = 'proj_blue_fire'
		start_pos = self.character.Position + offset
	end

	local proj_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(proj_name, start_pos)
	local contrail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(contrail_name, start_pos)

	local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(-15, 15)
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, random_angle) * unity_class.vector3.up
	local dest_pos = start_pos + dir * self.shot_up_height
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-random_angle, 90, 90)
	proj_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
	contrail_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(fire_name, start_pos)

	return proj_effect, contrail_effect, start_pos, dest_pos
end

function local_class:shot_explosion_damage(dest_pos, is_tracking_shot)
	--폭발 데미지 체크
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(dest_pos, self.meteor_radius)

	local damage = self.meteor_damage_modifier

	if is_tracking_shot then
		damage = self.tracking_meteor_damage_modifier
	end

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = damage

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_tracking_shoot(dt)
	self.shoot_time_passed = self.shoot_time_passed + dt

	if self.shoot_time_passed > self.tracking_shoot_interval * self.current_tracking_shoot_count then
		if self.current_tracking_shoot_count < self.tracking_shot_count then
			self.current_tracking_shoot_count = self.current_tracking_shoot_count + 1

			local dest_pos = self.target.Position
			local start_pos = dest_pos + vector(0, self.shot_up_height, 0)
			local diff = start_pos - dest_pos
			local move_duration = diff.magnitude / self.tracking_shot_speed

			local proj_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_chasing', start_pos)
			local contrail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_chasing_contrail', start_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")
			proj_effect.transform.position = start_pos
			contrail_effect.transform.position = start_pos
			local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, -90)
			proj_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
			contrail_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

			local ar = self.tracking_attack_range_list[self.current_tracking_shoot_count]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, dest_pos)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, move_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

			table.insert(self.tracking_shot_info_list, {
				index = self.current_tracking_shoot_count,
				start_pos = start_pos,
				dest_pos = dest_pos,
				time_passed = 0,
				move_duration = move_duration,
				state = self.shot_state.down,
				proj_effect = proj_effect,
				contrail_effect = contrail_effect,
				is_active = true
			})
		else
		end
	else
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking_shot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.tracking_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			if v.state == self.shot_state.down then
				local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
				if progress > 1 then
					--낙하 완료 후 폭파 데미지 준 뒤 & 포이즌에그 몬스터 생성
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos
					v.contrail_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos

					self:shot_explosion_damage(v.dest_pos, true)
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_chasing_explosion", v.dest_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", v.dest_pos)

					if self.tracking_attack_range_list[v.index] ~= nil then
						self.tracking_attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.tracking_attack_range_list[v.index]))
					end

					if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
						v.proj_effect:Dispose()
						v.proj_effect = nil
					end

					v.state = self.shot_state.dealy
				else
					local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = move_pos
					v.contrail_effect.transform.position = move_pos
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.dealy then
				if v.time_passed > self.contrail_dealy then
					if v.contrail_effect ~= nil then
						v.contrail_effect:Dispose()
						v.contrail_effect = nil
					end
					v.is_active = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.tracking_attack_range_list = nil
	self.shot_state = nil
	self.meteor_type = nil
	self.meteor_phase = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.current_meteor_phase = nil
	self.shot_info_list = nil
	self.tracking_shot_info_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,

local local_class = newclass('BossFallenQueenRadiantBlastBattleAction')

--region blade_projectile
local projectile = {
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	index = nil,
	pos = nil,
	dir = nil,
	fx = nil,
	trail_fx = nil,
	damage_modifier = nil,
	base_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	speed = nil,
	radius = nil,
	knock_back_force = nil,
	trail_dispose_delay = 1,
	state = {
		none = 1,
		move = 2,
		post = 3
	}
}
projectile.mt = { __index = projectile }

function projectile:new(parent_class, damage_modifier, fx, trail_fx, radius, knock_back_force, index)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.index = index
	obj.pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	obj.dir = unity_class.vector3.zero
	obj.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	obj.fx = fx
	obj.trail_fx = trail_fx
	obj.radius = radius
	obj.knock_back_force = knock_back_force

	obj.move_duration = 0
	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.active = true
	obj:change_state(obj.state.none)

	return obj
end

function projectile:shoot(from, to, duration, explode, attack_range, move_end_callback)
	local dir = (to - from).normalized
	self:set_transform(from, dir)
	self:set_target_pos(to)
	self:init_move_to_target(duration, explode, move_end_callback)
	if explode and attack_range then
		self.attack_range = attack_range
	end
end

function projectile:set_transform(pos, dir)
	self.pos = pos
	self.dir = unity_class.vector3(dir.x, 0, dir.y + dir.z)
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, self.dir)
	effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.pos, self.dir)
end

function projectile:set_target_pos(target_pos)
	self.target_pos = target_pos
end

function projectile:init_move_to_target(duration, explode, move_end_callback)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	if not self.target_pos then
		return
	end

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.move_duration = 0
		self:set_transform(self.pos, self.dir)
		return
	end

	self.base_pos = self.pos
	self.move_duration = duration
	self.time_passed = 0
	local dir = (self.target_pos - self.base_pos).normalized
	self:set_transform(self.pos, dir)

	self.explosion_ready = explode
	self.move_end_callback = move_end_callback

	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function projectile:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- 투사체 충돌 판정 하지 않음
function projectile:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			if self.attack_range then
				self.attack_range:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
				self.attack_range = nil
			end

			if self.move_end_callback then
				self.move_end_callback(self.action, self.target_pos, self.explosion_ready)
				self.move_end_callback = nil
			end

			if self.fx then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
				self.fx = nil
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.move_duration
			local pos = vector_util.lerp(self.base_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
			self:set_transform(pos, self.dir)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.trail_dispose_delay then
			self.active = false
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function projectile:dispose()
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
		self.fx = nil
	end
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.pos = nil
	self.dir = nil
	self.active = nil
	self.move_end_callback = nil

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
end
--endregion

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		cast = 2,
		cast_animation = 3,
		prepare = 4,
		action = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	-- params
	self.shoot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ShootAmount', 3)
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionRadius', 1)
	self.fall_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FallHeight', 30)
	self.chase_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChaseSpeed', 5)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)
	self.cast_end_fx_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastEndEffectStartTime', 0.5)

	--self.projectile_chase_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileChaseDuration', 3)
	self.projectile_fall_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ProjectileFallDelay', 1)

	self.spear_tip_slot_name = 'boss_fallen_queen2'

	-- duration
	local cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 1)
	self.cast_animation_duration = 1 -- 고정
	self.cast_duration = cast_duration - self.cast_animation_duration
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShootInterval', 0.4)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	-- presets
	self.projectile_preset_name = 'projectile'
	self.contrail_preset_name = 'contrail'
	self.explosion_preset_name = 'impact'
	self.cast_preset_name = 'cast'
	self.cast_end_preset_name = 'cast_end'

	-- animation
	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.shoot_interval_key = 'shoot_interval'
	self.shoot_key = 'shoot'

	self.main_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.main_attack_range:Hide()
	self.attack_range_pool = {}

	self.projectiles = {}
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if next_state ~= self.state.cast_animation then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_animation then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_fx = nil
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.main_attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	if next_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration + self.cast_animation_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(diff)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', user_party.Leader)
	elseif next_state == self.state.cast_animation then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)

		-- bone follower 생성
		if self.follower == nil then
			local spine_controller = self.character.SpineController
			self.follower = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('BlastCastEffectFollower')
			self.bone_follower = self.follower:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			self.bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
			self.bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
			self.bone_follower:SetBone('weapon_eff')
		end

		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_preset_name, self.follower.transform.position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero, self.follower.transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shoot_interval_key)

		local target_pos = self.target.Position
		self.main_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.projectile_fall_delay)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_range, target_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.shoot_key)
		self.shoot_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		if self.main_attack_range then
			self.main_attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_projectiles(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast_animation)
		else
			local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(diff)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast_animation then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_animation_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.cast_end_fx_time and self.cast_fx then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_end_preset_name, self.follower.transform.position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			-- 추격
			self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			local current_pos = self.character.Position
			local diff = self.target_pos - current_pos
			local dir = diff.normalized
			local move_magnitude = self.chase_speed * dt
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = move_magnitude
			move_info.types = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(diff)

			-- 어택레인지 추격
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_range, self.target_pos)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.shoot_count >= self.shoot_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval * self.shoot_count then
			local target_pos = self.target.Position
			local shoot_pos = target_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * self.fall_height
			if self.shoot_count ~= 0 then
				local attack_range
				local pool_count = #self.attack_range_pool
				if pool_count > 0 then
					attack_range = self.attack_range_pool[pool_count]
					table.remove(self.attack_range_pool, pool_count)
					pool_count = pool_count - 1
				else
					attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
				end
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, target_pos)
				attack_range:Show(self.projectile_fall_delay)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))
				self:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, self.projectile_fall_delay, nil, true, attack_range, self.on_move_end_callback)
			else
				self:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, self.projectile_fall_delay, nil, true, self.main_attack_range, function(self, fall_pos, explode)
					self:on_move_end_callback(fall_pos, explode)
					self.main_attack_range:Hide()
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
				end)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_projectiles(dt)
	for _,proj in pairs(self.projectiles) do
		if proj.active then
			proj:update_frame(dt)
		else
			self:dispose_projectile(proj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_projectile(pos)
	local index = self:get_first_nil_index(self.projectiles)
	local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local contrail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local new_projectile = projectile:new(self, self.damage_modifier, fx, contrail_fx, self.explosion_radius, self.knock_back_force, index)
	self.projectiles[index] = new_projectile

	return new_projectile
end

function local_class:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, proj, explode, attack_range, on_move_end_callback)
	if not proj then
		local new_projectile = self:create_projectile(shoot_pos)
		new_projectile:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, explode, attack_range, on_move_end_callback)
	else
		proj:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, explode, attack_range, on_move_end_callback)
	end

	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
end

function local_class:on_move_end_callback(fall_pos, explode)
	if explode then
		self:explode(fall_pos)
		local sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', user_party.Leader)
		sfx:SetPosition(fall_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:explode(pos)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
end

function local_class:dispose_projectile(proj)
	table.insert(self.attack_range_pool, proj.attack_range)
	self.projectiles[proj.index] = nil
	proj:dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.projectile_preset_name = nil
	self.explosion_preset_name = nil
	self.contrail_preset_name = nil
	self.cast_end_preset_name = nil
	self.cast_preset_name = nil

	self.projectiles = nil
	self.main_attack_range = nil

	self.attack_range_pool = nil
end

function local_class:get_first_nil_index(table)
