local local_class = newclass('BossFallenQueenRushBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		main_charge_delay = 3,
		main_charge = 4,
		sub_charge_interval = 5,
		sub_charge = 6,
		main_charge_interval = 7,
		post = 8
	}

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.chase_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChaseDuration', 0.7)
	self.interval_chase_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalChaseDuration', 0.7)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.main_charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MainRushSpeed', 30)
	self.main_charge_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MainRushCount', 3)
	self.main_charge_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MainRushInterval', 0.3)
	self.sub_charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubRushSpeed', 30)
	self.sub_charge_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SubRushCount', 3)
	self.sub_charge_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubRushInterval', 0.3)
	self.extra_image_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ExtraImageAmount', 2)
	local afterimage_alpha = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubRushAlpha', 0.5)
	local afterimage_tint = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'SubRushTint')
	self.afterimage_tint = CS.UnityEngine.Color(afterimage_tint[0], afterimage_tint[1], afterimage_tint[2], afterimage_tint[3])

	self.main_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MainDamageModifier', 0.5)
	local sub_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubDamageModifier', 0.5)
	self.knock_back_damage = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackDamage', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RushWidth', 2)
	self.default_charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RushDistance', 10)
	self.charge_fx_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, 'ChargeEffectOffset', unity_class.vector3.up)

	-- 돌진 횟수만큼 생성 후 사용 필요?
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			unity_class.vector2(self.default_charge_distance, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- preset
	self.afterimage_preset_name = 'afterimage'
	self.charge_preset_name = 'rush'
	self.trail_preset_name = 'contrail'

	-- animation
	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	self.charge_loop_name = 'rush_loop'

	self.rush_animation_preload = 0.2

	-- attack calculator
	self.main_charge_duration = self.default_charge_distance / self.main_charge_speed
	local main_charge_info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	main_charge_info.Center = self.character.Position
	main_charge_info.DamageTerm = -1
	main_charge_info.Duration = self.main_charge_duration
	main_charge_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(charge_width, 2, charge_width)
	self.main_attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, main_charge_info, true, 0, 0)

	self.center_offset = self.character.Bounds.center - self.character.Position

	local afterimage_proto = {
		cs_battle_action = self.cs_battle_action,
		character = self.character,
		center_offset = self.center_offset,
		damage_modifier = sub_damage_modifier,
		charge_width = charge_width,
		knock_back_damage = self.knock_back_damage,
		knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force,
		charge_preset_name = self.charge_preset_name,
		trail_preset_name = self.trail_preset_name,
		speed = self.sub_charge_speed,
		charge_fx_offset = self.charge_fx_offset,
		charge_fx_dispose_delay = 1,
		fx_alpha = afterimage_alpha,
		init_charge = function(self, pos, dir, look_direction, duration, delay, show_after_delay, do_damage, show_charge_fx)
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.charge_active = true
			self.delay = delay
			self.wait = delay > 0
			self.show_charge_fx = show_charge_fx
			self.charge_duration = duration
			self.show_after_delay = show_after_delay

			self.pos = pos
			self.dir = dir.normalized
			self.spine.Direction = look_direction
			local center = self.pos + self.center_offset
			local point = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(center + dir, center)
			self.spine.AimPoint = point
			if not show_after_delay then
				self:show(pos)
			end

			if do_damage then
				local sub_charge_info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
				sub_charge_info.Center = pos
				sub_charge_info.DamageTerm = -1
				sub_charge_info.Duration = duration
				sub_charge_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_width, 2, self.charge_width)
				self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, sub_charge_info, true, 0, 0)
				self.attack_calculator:Start()
			end
		end,
		attach_charge_fx = function(self, pos, dir)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_preset_name, pos, dir, self.fx.transform)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.trail_preset_name, pos, dir, self.fx.transform)
		end,
		show = function(self, pos)
			self.is_hidden = false
			self:set_pos(pos)
			self.spine:SetAlphaFade(self.fx_alpha, 0.2)
		end,
		hide = function(self)
			self.is_hidden = true
			self.spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
		end,
		set_pos = function(self, pos)
			self.pos = pos
			effect_util.update_object(self.fx, pos)
		end,
		update_charge = function(self, dt)
			if not self.charge_active then
				return
			end

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

			if self.wait then
				if self.time_passed > self.delay then
					self.wait = false
					if self.show_after_delay then
						self:show(self.pos)
					end
					if self.show_charge_fx then
						self:attach_charge_fx(self.fx.transform.localPosition + self.charge_fx_offset + self.dir * 0.5, self.dir)
					else
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.trail_preset_name,
								self.fx.transform.localPosition + self.charge_fx_offset + self.dir * 0.5, self.dir, self.fx.transform)
					end
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('sub_rush', user_party.Leader)
				end
			else
				if self.time_passed < self.delay + self.charge_duration then
					local magnitude = dt * self.speed
					local pos = self.pos + self.dir * magnitude
					self:set_pos(pos)

					self:update_damage(dt, pos)
				elseif not self.is_hidden then
					self:hide()
					if self.attack_calculator then
						self.attack_calculator:End()
						self.attack_calculator = nil
					end
				else
					if self.time_passed > self.delay + self.charge_duration + self.charge_fx_dispose_delay then
						self.show_charge_fx = false
						self.charge_active = false
					end
				end
			end
		end,
		update_damage = function(self, dt, pos)
			if not self.attack_calculator then
				return
			end
			if pos then
				self.attack_calculator.Position = pos
			end
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]
				local knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				local knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = self.dir
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end,
		dispose = function(self)
			self.charge_active = false
			self.spine:ResetAllColors()
			self.spine.AimPoint = nil
			self.fx:Dispose()
			if self.attack_calculator then
				self.attack_calculator:End()
			end
			self.attack_calculator = nil
		end
	}
	self.afterimage_meta = { __index = afterimage_proto }

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, target)
	return target_dist < self.default_charge_distance
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.center)
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.size)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), info:GetPositionAt(1))
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end
	self.constraint_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center - self.center_offset - unity_class.vector3.left * 0.1,
			self.zone_bound.size - self.character.Bounds.size - unity_class.vector3(0.2,0,0.2))

	self.afterimage_list = {}
	for _ = 1, self.sub_charge_amount + self.extra_image_amount do
		self:prepare_afterimage()
	end
	self.main_charge_count = 0

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:prepare_afterimage()
	local afterimage = {
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.afterimage_preset_name, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero),
		delay = self.sub_charge_interval,
		time_passed = 0
	}
	setmetatable(afterimage, self.afterimage_meta)
	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	local afterimage_spine = spine_util.get_spine_controller(afterimage.fx)
	afterimage_spine:AddColor(CS.Oak.ColorMixInfo(nil, self.afterimage_tint, 0.5, 0, true, 0))
	afterimage.spine = afterimage_spine
	afterimage.spine:SetAnimation(base_track, self.charge_loop_name, true)
	afterimage:hide()
	table.insert(self.afterimage_list, afterimage)
end

function local_class:get_target_pos(target)
	local t = target and target or self.target
	local target_pos = unity_class.vector3(t.Position.x, t.Position.y, t.Position.z)
	local zone_center = self.constraint_bound.center
	local extent_x = self.constraint_bound.extents.x
	local extent_z = self.constraint_bound.extents.z
	if target_pos.x > zone_center.x + extent_x then
		target_pos.x = zone_center.x + extent_x - 0.02
	elseif target_pos.x < zone_center.x - extent_x then
		target_pos.x = zone_center.x - extent_x
	end
	if target_pos.z > zone_center.z + extent_z then
		target_pos.z = zone_center.z + extent_z
	elseif target_pos.z < zone_center.z - extent_z then
		target_pos.z = zone_center.z - extent_z
	end
	return target_pos
end

function local_class:get_aim_pos(charge_dir, direction)
	local aim_dir = unity_class.vector3(charge_dir.x, charge_dir.y, charge_dir.z) + unity_class.vector3.down * 0.25
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		aim_dir.x = aim_dir.x + 0.1
		aim_dir.x = aim_dir.x * 0.9
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		aim_dir.z = aim_dir.z * 1.2
	else
		aim_dir.x = aim_dir.x + 0.15
		aim_dir.x = aim_dir.x * 1.2
	end
	return aim_dir
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.set_anim_flag = false
		if next_state ~= self.state.main_charge then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_charge then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.main_attack_calculator:End()
		if next_state ~= self.state.sub_charge_interval then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.character.SpineController.AimPoint = nil
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sub_charge_interval then
		if next_state ~= self.state.sub_charge then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sub_charge then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_charge_interval then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.set_anim_flag = false
		if next_state ~= self.state.main_charge then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		for _,afterimage in pairs(self.afterimage_list) do
			afterimage:dispose()
			setmetatable(afterimage, nil)
		end
		self.afterimage_list = nil
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.charge_distance = self.default_charge_distance
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
			self.charge_direction = unity_class.vector3.forward
		else
			self.charge_direction = diff.normalized
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', user_party.Leader)
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.look_direction = self.character.Direction
		-- 돌진 시작
		local charge_dir = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_direction.x, self.charge_direction.y, self.charge_direction.z)
		self.charge_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.main_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.main_attack_calculator:Start()
		local direction = self.character.Direction
		local fx_pos = self.character.Position + self.charge_fx_offset + charge_dir * (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and 2 or 1.3)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_preset_name, fx_pos, charge_dir, self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.trail_preset_name, fx_pos, charge_dir, self.character.Transform)
		self.sub_charge_count = 0
		self.main_charge_count = self.main_charge_count + 1

		local center = self.character.Bounds.center
		local aim_dir = self:get_aim_pos(charge_dir, direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.character, center + aim_dir, center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('rush', user_party.Leader)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction)
	elseif next_state == self.state.sub_charge_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 잔상 생성
		local afterimage = self:get_afterimage()
		afterimage:init_charge(self.charge_start_pos, self.charge_direction, self.look_direction, self.sub_charge_duration, self.sub_charge_interval, true, true, false)
		for i = 1, self.extra_image_amount do
			local extra_image = self:get_afterimage()
			local delay = self.sub_charge_interval + self.sub_charge_interval / (1 + self.extra_image_amount) * i
			extra_image:init_charge(self.charge_start_pos, self.charge_direction, self.look_direction, self.sub_charge_duration, delay, true, false, false)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.sub_charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.sub_charge_count = self.sub_charge_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_charge_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
			self.charge_direction = unity_class.vector3.forward
		else
			self.charge_direction = diff.normalized
		end
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.main_charge_interval)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:clear_afterimage_list()
		if self.attack_range then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_afterimage(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not self.set_anim_flag and self.prepare_duration - self.time_passed < self.rush_animation_preload then
			self.set_anim_flag = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.main_charge)
		elseif self.time_passed <= self.chase_duration then
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self:get_target_pos() - self.character.Position)
			if not vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
				self.charge_direction = diff.normalized
			end
			self.character.Direction = self.charge_direction:ToDirection()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		local direction = self.character.Direction
		local aim_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + self:get_aim_pos(self.charge_direction, direction)
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.character, aim_pos, self.character.Bounds.center)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_charge then
		if self:update_main_charge(dt) then
			-- 메인 돌진 종료, 실제 돌진한 거리 계산
			self.charge_distance = (self.character.Position - self.charge_start_pos).magnitude
			self.sub_charge_duration = self.charge_distance / self.sub_charge_speed
			self:change_state(self.state.sub_charge_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sub_charge_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.sub_charge_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.sub_charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sub_charge then
		if self.sub_charge_count == self.sub_charge_amount then
			if self.main_charge_count == self.main_charge_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.main_charge_interval)
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.sub_charge_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_charge_interval then
		if not self.set_anim_flag and self.main_charge_interval - self.time_passed < self.rush_animation_preload then
			self.set_anim_flag = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.main_charge_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.main_charge)
		elseif self.time_passed <= self.interval_chase_duration then
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self:get_target_pos() - self.character.Position)
			if not vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
				self.charge_direction = diff.normalized
			end
			self.character.Direction = self.charge_direction:ToDirection()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		local direction = self.character.Direction
		local aim_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + self:get_aim_pos(self.charge_direction, direction)
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.character, aim_pos, self.character.Bounds.center)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_afterimage(dt)
	if self.afterimage_list then
		for _, afterimage in pairs(self.afterimage_list) do
			afterimage:update_charge(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_afterimage()
	for _,afterimage in pairs(self.afterimage_list) do
		if not afterimage.charge_active then
			return afterimage
		end
	end
	self:prepare_afterimage()
	return self:get_afterimage()
end

function local_class:update_main_charge(dt)
	if self.time_passed < self.main_charge_duration then
		local dir = self.charge_direction
		local dist_to_bound = self:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir, self.constraint_bound)
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = dir
		move_info.magnitude = math.min(dt * self.main_charge_speed, dist_to_bound)

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir),
				false, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		self.main_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.main_attack_calculator.Direction = dir
		local objects = self.main_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			local direction = self.charge_direction.normalized
			local knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			local knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.main_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:clear_afterimage_list()
	if not self.afterimage_list then
		return
	end
	local num = #self.afterimage_list
	for i = num, 1, -1 do
		local image = self.afterimage_list[i]
		image:dispose()
		table.remove(self.afterimage_list, i)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()
	self:clear_afterimage_list()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.afterimage_meta = nil
	self.afterimage_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.constraint_bound = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir_vector3, zone_bound)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(self.character.Position.x, self.character.Position.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > zone_bound.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.min.x,zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.max.x,zone_bound.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2), result
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < zone_bound.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.min.x,zone_bound.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.max.x,zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2), result
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > zone_bound.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.min.x,zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.min.x,zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2), result
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < zone_bound.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.max.x,zone_bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(zone_bound.max.x,zone_bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2), result
		end
	end
	return 0
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:start(info)

	self.is_inhale_end_effect = false

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.absorb_effect ~= nil then
		self.absorb_effect:Dispose()
		self.absorb_effect = nil
	end

	if self.sphere_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.sphere_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			if self.attack_calculator_list[_] ~= nil then
				self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
			end
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
		self.attack_range_list = nil

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.absorb then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		for i = 1, self.sphere_count - 1 do
			local info = self.sphere_info_list[i]
			if info.effect ~= nil then
				info.effect:Dispose()
				info.effect = nil
			end
			self.attack_calculator_list[i]:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shield then
		if self.absorb_effect ~= nil then
			self.absorb_effect:Dispose()
			self.absorb_effect = nil
		end
		if self.absorb_start_effect ~= nil then
			self.absorb_start_effect:Dispose()
			self.absorb_start_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
		self.teleport_finish = false

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'fury_start'}))
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink", self.character.Position)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")

		--각 구슬 위치만 셋팅
		self:set_sphere_position()
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.attack_range_list = {}
		--구슬 생성 및 어택레인지
		for i = 1, self.sphere_count - 1 do
			local info = self.sphere_info_list[i]
			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("sphere", info.start_pos + vector(0, self.sphere_radius / 2, 0))
			info.effect = effect
			info.diff = info.dest_pos - info.start_pos
			info.is_active = true

			local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, unity_class.vector2(info.diff.magnitude,
					self.sphere_radius), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
			attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character,
					attack_range))
			table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)

			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = info.start_pos
			self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.absorb then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.absorb_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("absorb", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("absorb")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("absorb")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("absorb")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shield then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'add_fury'}))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shield")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'fury_end'}))
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:set_sphere_position()
	self.sphere_info_list = {}

	-- 가로라인
	local start_z_list = {
		self.zone_bound.min.z + self.sphere_radius,
		self.zone_bound.max.z - self.sphere_radius
	}
	-- 세로라인
	-- 세로는 각 끝점은 발사안함
	local start_x_list = {
		self.zone_bound.min.x + self.sphere_radius,
		self.zone_bound.max.x - self.sphere_radius
	}
	local interval_x = (self.zone_bound.size.x - self.sphere_radius * 2) / (self.sphere_width_count - 1)
	local interval_z = (self.zone_bound.size.z - self.sphere_radius * 2) / (self.sphere_height_count - 1)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local start_z = start_z_list[i]
		for j = 1, self.sphere_width_count do
			local dest_pos = vector(start_x_list[1] + (interval_x * (j - 1)), 0, start_z)
			dest_pos.y = battle_util.get_height(dest_pos)
			local info = {
				index = self.sphere_index,
				start_pos = dest_pos,
				pos = dest_pos,
				dest_pos = self.zone_bound.center,
				time_passed = 0,
				effect = nil,
				is_active = false
			}
			self.sphere_index = self.sphere_index + 1
			table.insert(self.sphere_info_list, info)
		end
	end


	for i = 1, 2 do
		local start_x = start_x_list[i]
		for j = 2, self.sphere_height_count - 1 do
			local dest_pos = vector(start_x, 0, start_z_list[1] + (interval_z * (j - 1)))
			dest_pos.y = battle_util.get_height(dest_pos)
			local info = {
				index = self.sphere_index,
				start_pos = dest_pos,
				pos = dest_pos,
				dest_pos = self.zone_bound.center,
				time_passed = 0,
				effect = nil,
				is_active = false
			}
			self.sphere_index = self.sphere_index + 1
			table.insert(self.sphere_info_list, info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:update_knock_back(dt)
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.absorb)
		else
			self:update_sphere_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.absorb then
		if self.time_passed >= self.absorb_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shield)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.inhale_end_effect_delay and not self.is_inhale_end_effect then
				if self.absorb_effect ~= nil then
					self.absorb_effect:Dispose()
					self.absorb_effect = nil
				end
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("absorb_end", self.zone_bound.center)
				self.is_inhale_end_effect = true
			end
			if self.time_passed >= self.big_inhale_effect_delay and not self.is_big_inhale_effect then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("inhale", self.zone_bound.center)
				self.is_big_inhale_effect = true
			end
			self:update_sphere(dt)
			self:update_sphere_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shield then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shield_duration then
			self.absorb_effect_start = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("absorb_start", self.zone_bound.center)
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_sphere(dt)
	for i = 1, self.sphere_count - 1 do
		local info = self.sphere_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			info.time_passed = info.time_passed + dt
			if info.time_passed <= self.sphere_move_duration then
				local move_position = info.start_pos + info.time_passed /
						self.sphere_move_duration * info.diff
				info.effect.transform.position = move_position
				info.pos = move_position
				self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = move_position
			else
				--이동 끝
				if info.effect ~= nil then
					info.effect:Dispose()
					info.effect = nil
				end
				self.attack_calculator_list[i]:End()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_sphere_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
		if self.sphere_info_list[i].is_active and self.attack_calculator_list[i].IsStarted then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.sphere_info_list[i].pos).normalized
					local knock_direction = direction
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * direction
					end
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
					local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.blink_knockback_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.sphere_info_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.absorb_effect = nil
	self.absorb_start_effect = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,

		self.tracking_smash_attack_range:Hide()

	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then

		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.tracking_smash_attack_range ~= nil then
			self.tracking_smash_attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.tracking_smash_attack_range))
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.tracking_smash_attack_range))

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.current_smash_count = self.current_smash_count + 1
		self.smash_time_passed = 0
		self.is_smash_start = true
		self:update_smash_damage(self.zone_bound.center, self.smash_radius_list[1], 0, self.current_smash_count)
		--스매쉬 이팩트

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_smash_start then
		self:update_smash(dt)
	end

	if self.is_tracking_smash_start then
		self:update_tracking_smash(dt)
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.teleport_pos
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.teleport_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:update_knock_back(dt)
				if self.is_tracking_teleport then
					self:change_state(self.state.tracking_smash_prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.smash_prepare)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.smash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.smash)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		if self.time_passed >= self.smash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self.is_tracking_teleport = true
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.target_tracking_duration then
				self.tracking_pos = self:get_tracking_pos(self.target.Position)
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.tracking_smash_attack_range, self.tracking_pos)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character,
						self.tracking_smash_attack_range))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_smash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_smash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking_smash)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking_smash then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_smash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_tracking_pos(pos)
	local final_dest_pos = pos
	if pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1] then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1]
	end
	if pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1] then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1]
	end
	if pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1] then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1]
	end
	if pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1] then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.tracking_smash_radius_list[1]
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:update_smash(dt)
	if self.current_smash_count > self.smash_count then
		self.is_smash_start = false
		return
	end

	if self.smash_time_passed > self.smash_interval_duration then
		self.current_smash_count = self.current_smash_count + 1
		self.smash_time_passed = 0

		if self.current_smash_count == 2 then
			--2단계 이팩트 및 데미지
			self:update_smash_damage(self.zone_bound.center, self.smash_radius_list[2], self.smash_radius_list[1], 2)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smash2", self.zone_bound.center)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash")
		elseif self.current_smash_count == 3 then
			--3단계 이팩트 및 데미지
			self:update_smash_damage(self.zone_bound.center, self.smash_radius_list[3], self.smash_radius_list[2], 3)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smash3", self.zone_bound.center)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash")
		end
	else
		self.smash_time_passed = self.smash_time_passed + dt
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking_smash(dt)
	if self.current_tracking_smash_count > self.tracking_smash_count then
		self.is_tracking_smash_start = false
		return
	end

	if self.tracking_smash_time_passed > self.tracking_smash_interval_duration then
		self.current_tracking_smash_count = self.current_tracking_smash_count + 1
		self.tracking_smash_time_passed = 0

		if self.current_tracking_smash_count == 2 then
			--2단계 이팩트 및 데미지
			self:update_smash_damage(self.tracking_pos, self.tracking_smash_radius_list[2], self.smash_radius_list[1], 2)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smash2", self.tracking_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("smash")
		end
	else
		self.tracking_smash_time_passed = self.tracking_smash_time_passed + dt
	end

--region blade_projectile
local queen_blade = {
	action = nil,

	dir = nil,

	attack_range = nil,
	base_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,

		none = 1,

	}
}
queen_blade.mt = { __index = queen_blade }

function queen_blade:new(parent_class, type, initial_pos, initial_dir, fx, trail_fx, radius, knock_back_force, index)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.index = index
	obj.type = type
	obj.pos = initial_pos
	obj.dir = initial_dir
	obj.fx = fx
	obj.trail_fx = trail_fx

	obj.knock_back_force = knock_back_force

	obj.move_duration = 0
	obj.time_passed = 0
	effect_util.update_object(fx, initial_pos, initial_dir)
	effect_util.update_object(trail_fx, initial_pos, initial_dir)

	obj.active = true
	obj:change_state(obj.state.none)

	return obj
end

function queen_blade:shoot(from, to, duration, explode, move_end_callback)
	local dir = (to - from).normalized
	self:set_transform(from, dir)
	self:set_target_pos(to)
	self:init_move_to_target(duration, explode, move_end_callback)
end

function queen_blade:create_attack_range(duration, attack_range)
	if not self.target_pos then
		return
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	else
		self.attack_range = attack_range
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	if duration then
		self.attack_range:Show(duration)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function queen_blade:update_attack_range(target_pos)
	if not self.attack_range then
		return
	end

	if target_pos then
		self:set_target_pos(target_pos)
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function queen_blade:hide_attack_range()
	if not self.attack_range then
		return
	end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function queen_blade:set_transform(pos, dir)
	self.pos = pos
	self.dir = unity_class.vector3(dir.x, 0, dir.y + dir.z).normalized
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, self.dir)
	effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.pos, self.dir)
end

function queen_blade:set_target_pos(target_pos)
	self.target_pos = target_pos
end

function queen_blade:init_move_to_target(duration, explode, move_end_callback)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	if not self.target_pos then
		return
	end

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.move_duration = 0
		self:set_transform(self.target_pos, self.dir)
		return
	end

	self.base_pos = self.pos
	self.move_duration = duration
	self.time_passed = 0
	local dir = self.target_pos - self.base_pos
	self:set_transform(self.pos, dir)

	self.explosion_ready = explode
	self.move_end_callback = move_end_callback

	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function queen_blade:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- 투사체 충돌 판정 하지 않음
function queen_blade:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			if self.attack_range then
				self:hide_attack_range()
			end
			self.attack_range = nil

			if self.move_end_callback then
				self.move_end_callback(self.action, self, self.target_pos, self.explosion_ready)
				self.move_end_callback = nil
			end

			if self.fx then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
				self.fx = nil
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.move_duration
			local pos = vector_util.lerp(self.base_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
			self:set_transform(pos, self.dir)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.trail_dispose_delay then
			self.active = false
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function queen_blade:dispose()
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
		self.fx = nil
	end
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.pos = nil
	self.dir = nil
	self.active = nil
	self.move_end_callback = nil
end

	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	local has_value, offset_json = params:TryGetValue('PortalOffsets')

		local red_offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(offset_json, 'red')

		local length = math.min(red_portal_x_offsets.Count, math.min(red_portal_y_offsets.Count, red_portal_z_offsets.Count))
		self.portal_offsets = {
			red = {},
			blue = {}
		}
		for i = 0, length - 1 do
			local vector = unity_class.vector3(red_portal_x_offsets[i], red_portal_y_offsets[i], red_portal_z_offsets[i])
			table.insert(self.portal_offsets['red'], vector)
		end
		length = math.min(blue_portal_x_offsets.Count, math.min(blue_portal_y_offsets.Count, blue_portal_z_offsets.Count))
		for i = 0, length - 1 do
			local vector = unity_class.vector3(blue_portal_x_offsets[i], blue_portal_y_offsets[i], blue_portal_z_offsets[i])
			table.insert(self.portal_offsets['blue'], vector)

	-- fx preset

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.center)
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.zone_bound.size)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), info:GetPositionAt(1))
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.zone_bound = battle_zone_bound
	end

	self.red_markers = {}
	self.blue_markers = {}
	local i = 0
	while true do
		i = i + 1
		local red_marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.red_marker_name .. i)
		local blue_marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.blue_marker_name .. i)
		local is_red_null = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(red_marker, typeof(CS.Oak.NullMarkerInfo))
		local is_blue_null = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(blue_marker, typeof(CS.Oak.NullMarkerInfo))
		if is_red_null and is_blue_null then
			break
		end

		if not is_red_null then
			table.insert(self.red_markers, red_marker.position)
		end
		if not is_blue_null then
			table.insert(self.blue_markers, blue_marker.position)
		end
	end

	if i == 1 then
		local top_left = self.zone_bound.center:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(-self.zone_bound.extents.x, 0, self.zone_bound.extents.z)
		local top_right = self.zone_bound.center:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.extents.x, 0, self.zone_bound.extents.z)
		local bottom_left = self.zone_bound.center:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(-self.zone_bound.extents.x, 0, -self.zone_bound.extents.z)
		local bottom_right = self.zone_bound.center:GetX0z() + unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.extents.x, 0, -self.zone_bound.extents.z)
		self.red_markers = {
			top_left + unity_class.vector3(2, 0, -2), top_right + unity_class.vector3(-2, 0, -2), bottom_left + unity_class.vector3(2, 0, 2), bottom_right + unity_class.vector3(-2, 0, 2),
			self.zone_bound.center + 3 * unity_class.vector3.left, self.zone_bound.center + 3 * unity_class.vector3.right
		}
		self.blue_markers = {
			self.zone_bound.center + 3 * unity_class.vector3.back, self.zone_bound.center + 3 * unity_class.vector3.forward,
			bottom_right + unity_class.vector3(-5, 0, 2), bottom_left + unity_class.vector3(5, 0, 2), top_right + unity_class.vector3(-5, 0, -2), top_left + unity_class.vector3(5, 0, -2)
		}
	end
	self.marker_count = #self.red_markers + #self.blue_markers

	self.always_red = self.bead_type_hp_ratio <= self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_marker then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_target_delay then
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot_target and self.current_projectile then
			self:dispose_projectile(self.current_projectile)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_target then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		local red_portals = self.portal_list['red']
		local blue_portals = self.portal_list['blue']
		if #red_portals > 0 then
			for i = #red_portals, 1, -1 do
				red_portals[i]:Dispose()
				table.remove(red_portals, i)
				local offset = self.portal_offsets['red'][i]
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.portal_end_red_preset_name, self.character.Position + offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		end
		if #blue_portals > 0 then
			for i = #blue_portals, 1, -1 do
				blue_portals[i]:Dispose()
				table.remove(blue_portals, i)
				local offset = self.portal_offsets['blue'][i]
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.portal_end_blue_preset_name, self.character.Position + offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		end
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 캐스팅
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		-- 웜홀 이펙트
		local red_offsets = self.portal_offsets['red']
		local blue_offsets = self.portal_offsets['blue']
		for _, pos in pairs(red_offsets) do
			local portal = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.portal_open_red_preset_name, self.character.Position + pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			if pos.x < 0 then
				local local_scale = portal.transform.localScale
				portal.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(-local_scale.x, local_scale.y, local_scale.z)
			end
			table.insert(self.portal_list['red'], portal)
		end
		for _, pos in pairs(blue_offsets) do
			local portal = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.always_red and
					self.portal_open_red_preset_name or self.portal_open_blue_preset_name,
					self.character.Position + pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			if pos.x < 0 then
				local local_scale = portal.transform.localScale
				portal.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(-local_scale.x, local_scale.y, local_scale.z)
			end
			table.insert(self.portal_list[self.always_red and 'red' or 'blue'], portal)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', user_party.Leader)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_marker then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')
		self.shoot_count = 0
		self.red_marker_index = 0
		self.blue_marker_index = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_target_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local target_pos = self.target.Position
		local shoot_pos = self:get_random_portal_pos(self.projectile_type.target)
		local dir = (target_pos - shoot_pos).normalized

		local attack_range
		local pool_count = #self.attack_range_pool
		if pool_count > 0 then
			attack_range = self.attack_range_pool[pool_count]
			table.remove(self.attack_range_pool, pool_count)
			pool_count = pool_count - 1
		else
			attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target_pos, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		end

		local index = self:get_first_nil_index(self.blade_projectiles)
		self.current_projectile = queen_blade:new(self, self.projectile_type.target, shoot_pos, dir, nil, nil,
				self.explosion_radius, self.knock_back_force, index)
		self.blade_projectiles[index] = self.current_projectile
		self.current_projectile:set_target_pos(target_pos)
		self.current_projectile:create_attack_range(self.tracking_duration, attack_range)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_target then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local target_pos = self.current_projectile.target_pos
		local shoot_pos = self.current_projectile.pos
		local diff = target_pos - shoot_pos
		local dist = diff.magnitude
		local duration = dist / self.projectile_speed
		local dir = self.current_projectile.dir
		self.current_projectile.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_chaser_preset_name, shoot_pos, dir)
		self.current_projectile.trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_chaser_preset_name, shoot_pos, dir)
		self:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, self.current_projectile, nil, true, self.on_move_end_callback)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 웜홀 이펙트 제거
		if self.portal_list then
			local red_portals = self.portal_list['red']
			local blue_portals = self.portal_list['blue']
			if #red_portals > 0 then
				for i = #red_portals, 1, -1 do
					red_portals[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(red_portals, i)
				end
			end
			if #blue_portals > 0 then
				for i = #blue_portals, 1, -1 do
					blue_portals[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(blue_portals, i)
				end
			end
		end
		self.target = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_blade_projectiles(dt)
	for _, projectile in pairs(self.blade_projectiles) do
		if projectile.active then
			projectile:update_frame(dt)
		else
			self:dispose_projectile(projectile)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_blade_projectiles(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if #self.blade_projectiles == 0 and self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_marker)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_marker then
		-- 지정된 위치 칼날 발사
		if self.shoot_count >= self.marker_count then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_target_delay)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval * self.shoot_count then
			local target_pos, is_red = self:get_next_marker_pos(self.shoot_count)
			is_red = self.always_red and true or is_red
			local type = is_red and self.projectile_type.red or self.projectile_type.blue
			local shoot_pos = self:get_random_portal_pos(type)
			local diff = target_pos - shoot_pos
			local dist = diff.magnitude
			local duration = dist / self.projectile_speed
			local projectile = self:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, nil, type, true, function(self, proj, fall_pos, explode)
				self:on_move_end_callback(proj, fall_pos, explode)
				if type == self.projectile_type.red then
					-- spawn red bead
					self:create_bead(fall_pos, self.bead_type.red)
				elseif type == self.projectile_type.blue then
					-- spawn blue bead
					self:create_bead(fall_pos, self.bead_type.blue)
				end
			end)

			local attack_range
			local pool_count = #self.attack_range_pool
			if pool_count > 0 then
				attack_range = self.attack_range_pool[pool_count]
				table.remove(self.attack_range_pool, pool_count)
				pool_count = pool_count - 1
			else
				attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target_pos, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
			end
			projectile:create_attack_range(duration, attack_range)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_target_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_target)
		else
			local target_pos = self.target.Position
			local current_pos = self.current_projectile.pos
			local dir = (target_pos - current_pos).normalized
			self.current_projectile:set_transform(current_pos, dir)
			self.current_projectile:update_attack_range(target_pos)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_target then
		-- 타겟 위치 칼날 발사
		if self.shoot_count == self.marker_count + self.shoot_target_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_target_delay)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_blade_projectile(pos, dir, type)
	local index = self:get_first_nil_index(self.blade_projectiles)
	local fx
	local trail_fx
	if type == self.projectile_type.red then
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_red_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_red_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif type == self.projectile_type.blue then
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_blue_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_blue_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	else
		fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_chaser_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		trail_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.contrail_chaser_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
	local projectile = queen_blade:new(self, type, pos, dir, fx, trail_fx, self.explosion_radius, self.knock_back_force, index)
	self.blade_projectiles[index] = projectile
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', user_party.Leader)

	return projectile
end

function local_class:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, proj, type, explode, on_move_end_callback)
	local dir = (target_pos - shoot_pos).normalized

	local projectile
	if not proj then
		projectile = self:create_blade_projectile(shoot_pos, dir, type)
	else
		projectile = proj
	end
	projectile:shoot(shoot_pos, target_pos, duration, explode, on_move_end_callback)

	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
	return projectile
end

function local_class:on_move_end_callback(proj, fall_pos, explode)
	if explode then
		self:explode(fall_pos, proj.type)
		if proj.type == self.projectile_type.target then
			local sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('target', user_party.Leader)
			sfx:SetPosition(fall_pos)
		else
			local sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', user_party.Leader)
			sfx:SetPosition(fall_pos)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explode(pos, type)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = type == self.projectile_type.target and self.target_damage_modifier or self.marker_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	if type == self.projectile_type.red then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_red_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif type == self.projectile_type.blue then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_blue_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_chaser_preset_name, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_projectile(proj)
	table.insert(self.attack_range_pool, proj.attack_range)
	self.blade_projectiles[proj.index] = nil
	proj:dispose()
end

function local_class:get_random_portal_pos(type)
	if type == self.projectile_type.red then
		local red_portal = self.portal_list['red']
		local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #red_portal)
		return red_portal[random_index].transform.position
	elseif type == self.projectile_type.blue then
		local blue_portal = self.portal_list['blue']
		local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #blue_portal)
		return blue_portal[random_index].transform.position
	else
		local red_portal = self.portal_list['red']
		local blue_portal = self.portal_list['blue']
		local red_count = #red_portal
		local blue_count = #blue_portal
		local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, red_count + blue_count)
		if random_index <= red_count then
			return red_portal[random_index].transform.position
		else
			return blue_portal[random_index - red_count].transform.position
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_next_marker_pos(count)
	local red = math.fmod(count, 2) == 1
	local blue = not red
	if red then
		red = self.red_markers[self.red_marker_index + 1]
	else
		blue = self.blue_markers[self.blue_marker_index + 1]
	end

	if not red and not blue then
		self.red_marker_index = 0
		self.blue_marker_index = 0
		return self:get_next_marker_pos(count)
	end

	if red then
		self.red_marker_index = self.red_marker_index + 1
		return self.red_markers[self.red_marker_index], true
	elseif blue then
		self.blue_marker_index = self.blue_marker_index + 1
		return self.blue_markers[self.blue_marker_index], false
	end
end

-- 기믹용 구슬 생성
function local_class:create_bead(pos, mode)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{
				-- 어떤 이벤트인지
				'blood_bead_drop_request_by_position',
				-- x좌표
				pos.x,
				-- y좌표
				pos.y,
				-- z좌표
				pos.z,
				mode
			}))
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()
	self:dispose_all_projectiles()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.bead_type = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	self.blade_projectiles = nil
	self.portal_offsets = nil
	self.portal_list = nil
	self.attack_range_pool = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_first_nil_index(table)
	local i = 1
	while table[i] ~= nil do
		i = i + 1
	end
	return i
end

function local_class:dispose_all_projectiles()
	if not self.blade_projectiles then
		return
	end
	for _, projectile in pairs(self.blade_projectiles) do
		self:dispose_projectile(projectile)
	end
end

function local_class:get_start_position_offset()
	return self.start_position_offset
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shield then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_laser(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		local current_pos = self.character.Position
		local target_pos = self.target.Position
		local diff = target_pos - current_pos
		local dir = diff.normalized
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.explosion_attack_range, target_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_attack_range))

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.chase_duration then
			-- 추격
			local dist = diff.magnitude
			local move_magnitude = math.min(dist, dt * self.chase_speed)
			local move_vector = move_magnitude * dir
			if not field:IsAnythingBlocking(self.character.Bounds, self.collision_mask, move_magnitude * dir) then
				self.character.Position = current_pos + move_vector
			end

			local fx_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + unity_class.vector3.up * self.projectile_height
			effect_util.update_object(self.super_nova_fx, fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.super_nova:update_frame(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shield_delay then
		-- 레이저 종료 대기
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shield then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shield_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_laser(dt)
	if not self.lasers then
		return
	end

	self.laser_time_left = self.laser_time_left - dt

	if self.laser_time_left <= 0 then
		self:clear_lasers()
		self:change_state(self.state.shield)
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.lasers do
		if i == 1 then
			-- 임시
			self.lasers[i]:update_frame(dt)
		else
			self.lasers[i]:update_frame(0)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:super_nova_explode(pos)
	if self.super_nova then
		self.super_nova:dispose()
	end
	self.super_nova = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.shield_delay)

	-- 폭발
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.super_nova_explosion_preset, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	self:clear_lasers()
	self.lasers = {}
	for _, dir in pairs(self.laser_shoot_directions) do
		local laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_preset, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local new_laser = laser:new(self, self.max_laser_length, pos, dir, self.laser_attack_calculator, self.laser_damage_modifier, laser_fx, self.zone_bound)
		table.insert(self.lasers, new_laser)
	end
	self.laser_core_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_core_preset, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	self.laser_time_left = self.laser_duration
	stage_camera:Shake(self.explosion_shake_magnitude, 1)

	self.explosion_attack_range:Hide()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_attack_range))

	local sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', user_party.Leader)
	sfx:SetPosition(pos)
end

function local_class:clear_lasers()
	if self.laser_core_fx then
		self.laser_core_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.laser_core_fx = nil

	if self.lasers then
		for _, l in pairs(self.lasers) do
			l:dispose()
		end
	end
	self.lasers = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:clear_lasers()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()
	self:clear_lasers()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.explosion_attack_range = nil

	self.collision_mask = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFoxFireBallBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	-- self.shot_number = 4
	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 2)
	self.shot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTiming", 0.15)

	self.proj_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjectileSpeed", 9)
	self.proj_exp_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDelay", 0.25)
	self.proj_exp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadius", 1.5)

	local enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced")

	if enhanced then
		self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
		self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
		self.aoe_spec.radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldRadius", 1.5)
		self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDuration", 7)
		self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageTerm", 0.5)
		self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldModifier", 2.5)
	end

	self.bolts = {}

	-- 포격 낙하 어택레인지
	self.fall_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
