end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			-- 미리 생성한 이펙트 삭제
			if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
				for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
					self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
				end
				self.prepared_fxs = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shot_complete then
			-- 미리 생성한 이펙트 삭제
			if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
				for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
					self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
				end
				self.prepared_fxs = nil
			end
		end
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare and next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("howl")

		-- 이펙트 4 개 미리 생성
		self.prepared_fxs = {}
		self.prepared_fx_timer = 0
		local org = self.character.Position
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local ox = (i - 2.5)
			local oy = 5 - math.abs(i - 2.5)
			local offset = unity_class.vector3(ox, oy, 0)
			local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("bolt", org + offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			eff.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
			table.insert(self.prepared_fxs, eff)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
		self.prepared_fx_timer = self.prepared_fx_timer + dt
		local pfx_scale_pg = self.prepared_fx_timer / self.prepare_duration
		local pfx_scale_val = 0.2 + math.min(pfx_scale_pg, 1) * 0.8
		local pfx_scale = unity_class.vector3(pfx_scale_val, pfx_scale_val, pfx_scale_val)
		for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
			self.prepared_fxs[i].transform.localScale = pfx_scale
		end
	end

	-- 포격 업데이트
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			local bolt_tp =  self.bolts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.bolts[i].time_passed = bolt_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if bolt_tp >= self.bolts[i].move_duration + self.proj_exp_delay then
				local t_pos = self.bolts[i].target_position
				-- 폭발 위치에 데미지
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.proj_exp_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.bolts[i].dest_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.bolts[i].dest_position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 어택레인지 반환
				self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
				self.bolts[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.bolts, i)

				if self.aoe_spec ~= nil then
					stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, t_pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("field"), self.aoe_spec)
					-- 사운드 AOEManager로 안넘기고 그냥 1회 재생 (Loop 아니므로)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("field", t_pos)
				end
			elseif bolt_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = bolt_tp / self.bolts[i].move_duration
				if prog > 1 then
					prog = 1
				end

				local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.bolts[i].start_position, self.bolts[i].dest_position, prog)

				if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.bolts[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true
			self:shoot_all_targets()
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_all_targets()
	-- 모든 적에게 발사
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, 3 do
			if index < targets.Count then
				self:shoot_to_pos(self.prepared_fxs[index+1].transform.position, targets[index].Position, self.prepared_fxs[index+1])
			else
				local random_pos = targets[0].Position + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, unity_class.random.Range(0, 360), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right * 3.5
				self:shoot_to_pos(self.prepared_fxs[index+1].transform.position, random_pos, self.prepared_fxs[index+1])
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()

		if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
			for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
				table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
			end
			self.prepared_fxs = nil
		end
	else
		if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
			for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
				self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
				table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
			end
			self.prepared_fxs = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_to_pos(origin, pos, object)
	local range = self:get_fall_range()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
	local dist = (pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
	local land_time = dist / self.proj_speed
	range:Show(land_time)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))

	local eff_dest_pos = pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.2, 0)

	local diff = eff_dest_pos - origin
	local dist = diff.magnitude

	table.insert(self.bolts, {
		start_position = origin,
		target_position = pos,
		dest_position = eff_dest_pos,
		move_duration = dist / self.proj_speed,
		time_passed = 0,
		pooled_object = object,
		attack_range = range
	})

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("bolt", origin)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)

	range:Hide()

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
			self.bolts[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거

	end

function local_class:dispose()

	self:force_cancel()

			end
		end
		self.fall_ranges = nil

local local_class = newclass('BossFoxFireBallRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	--한번에 발사되는 프로젝타일 갯수
	self.shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShotCount", 4)
	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 2)
	self.shot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTiming", 0.15)
	self.shot_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTerm", 0)

	self.proj_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjectileSpeed", 9)
	self.proj_exp_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDelay", 0.25)
	self.proj_exp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadius", 1.5)
	self.proj_sub_exp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SubExplosionRadius", 1)
	self.proj_sub_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SubProjtileDiatance", 2)

	local enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced")

	if enhanced then
		self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
		self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Circle
		self.aoe_spec.radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldRadius", 1.5)
		self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDuration", 7)
		self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageTerm", 0.5)
		self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldModifier", 2.5)
	end

	-- 어택레인지 리스크맵 사용 여부
	self.is_use_risk_map = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)

	-- 발사 타이밍이 액션 시간 + 발사 간격을 넘지 않음
	self.shot_timing = math.min(self.shot_timing, self.action_duration + self.shot_term)

	self.bolts = {}

	-- 포격 낙하 어택레인지
	self.fall_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.repeat_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end

	self.fall_sub_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, self.shot_count * self.repeat_count - self.repeat_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_sub_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.fall_sub_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 코옵에서 오너가 아닌 유저는 존 세팅되지 않았기 때문에 없으면 재설정 되도록
	if self.zone_bounds == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
		end
		self:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	end

end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			-- 미리 생성한 이펙트 삭제
			if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
				for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
					self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
				end
				self.prepared_fxs = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shot_complete then
			-- 미리 생성한 이펙트 삭제
			if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
				for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
					self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
					table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
				end
				self.prepared_fxs = nil
			end
		end
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare and next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("howl")

		-- 이펙트 self.shot_count만큼 미리 생성
		self.prepared_fxs = {}
		self.prepared_fx_timer = 0
		local org = self.character.Position
		local count_offset = self.shot_count + 1
		for i = 1, self.shot_count do
			local ox = (i - count_offset / 2)
			local oy = 5 - math.abs(i - count_offset / 2)
			local offset = unity_class.vector3(ox, oy, 0)
			local eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("bolt", org + offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			eff.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
			table.insert(self.prepared_fxs, eff)
			eff.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			eff.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
		self.prepared_fx_timer = self.prepared_fx_timer + dt
		local pfx_scale_pg = self.prepared_fx_timer / self.prepare_duration
		local pfx_scale_val = 0.2 + math.min(pfx_scale_pg, 1) * 0.8
		local pfx_scale = unity_class.vector3(pfx_scale_val, pfx_scale_val, pfx_scale_val)
		for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
			self.prepared_fxs[i].transform.localScale = pfx_scale
		end
	end

	-- 포격 업데이트
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			local bolt_tp =  self.bolts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.bolts[i].time_passed = bolt_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if bolt_tp >= self.bolts[i].move_duration + self.proj_exp_delay then
				local t_pos = self.bolts[i].target_position
				local exp_radius = self.proj_exp_radius
				if not self.bolts[i].is_main_shot then
					exp_radius = self.proj_sub_exp_radius
				end
				-- 폭발 위치에 데미지
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, exp_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.bolts[i].dest_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.bolts[i].dest_position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 어택레인지 반환
				if self.bolts[i].is_main_shot then
					self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
				else
					self:return_fall_sub_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
				end
				self.bolts[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.bolts, i)

				if self.aoe_spec ~= nil then
					stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, t_pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("field"), self.aoe_spec, nil, nil, nil, self.is_use_risk_map)
					-- 사운드 AOEManager로 안넘기고 그냥 1회 재생 (Loop 아니므로)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("field", t_pos)
				end
			elseif bolt_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = bolt_tp / self.bolts[i].move_duration
				if prog > 1 then
					prog = 1
				end

				local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.bolts[i].start_position, self.bolts[i].dest_position, prog)

				if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.bolts[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) and not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shot_timing then
			--TODO: 1타와 후속타를 분리 shotTerm이 존재한다면 후속타는 term이후에 발사한다.
			self:send_shoot_sync_command()
		end
		if self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.action_duration + self.shot_term then
			if self.action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:send_shoot_sync_command()
	-- Sync Command
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		local target_pos = targets[0].Position
		targets:Dispose()
		info:AppendInteger(self.action_count)
		info:AppendPosition(target_pos)
		for index = 1, self.shot_count -1 do
			local random_pos = self:get_random_position(target_pos, index)
			info:AppendPosition(random_pos)
		end
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	self:adjust_action_count(info:GetIntegerAt(0))
	self.shot_complete = true

	local pos_list = info.Positions
	if pos_list == nil then
		if self.prepared_fxs ~= nil then
			for i = #self.prepared_fxs, 1, -1 do
				self.prepared_fxs[i]:Dispose()
				table.remove(self.prepared_fxs, i)
			end
			self.prepared_fxs = nil
		end
		return
	end

	local pos_table = {}
	for i = 0, pos_list.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(pos_table, pos_list[i])
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_fire_ball, self, pos_table))
end

function local_class:adjust_action_count(target_action_count)
	if self.action_count >= target_action_count then
		return
	end

	for _ = self.action_count, target_action_count - 1 do
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		self:change_state(self.state.action)
		self.time_passed = self.shot_timing
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_fire_ball(target_positions)
	local fxs = self.prepared_fxs
	self.prepared_fxs = nil

	for index = 0, self.shot_count - 1 do
		if index == 0 then
			self:shoot_to_pos(fxs[index + 1].transform.position,
					target_positions[index + 1], fxs[index + 1], true)
		else
			self:shoot_to_pos(fxs[index + 1].transform.position,
					target_positions[index + 1], fxs[index + 1], false)
		end

		if index == 0 then
			wait_for_sec(self.shot_term)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_random_position(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index - 1
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / (self.shot_count - 1)
	local range = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 30, shot_area_angle * index)

	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, range, 0)
			* unity_class.vector3.right * self.proj_sub_distance

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bounds.min.x - 2 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x + 2 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z - 2 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z + 2 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	return random_pos
end

function local_class:shoot_to_pos(origin, pos, object, is_main_shot)
	local range = nil
	if is_main_shot then
		range = self:get_fall_range()
	else
		range = self:get_fall_sub_range()
	end
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
	local dist = (pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
	local land_time = dist / self.proj_speed
	range:Show(land_time)

	if self.is_use_risk_map then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	local eff_dest_pos = pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.2, 0)

	local diff = eff_dest_pos - origin
	local dist = diff.magnitude

	table.insert(self.bolts, {
		start_position = origin,
		target_position = pos,
		dest_position = eff_dest_pos,
		move_duration = dist / self.proj_speed,
		time_passed = 0,
		pooled_object = object,
		attack_range = range,
		is_main_shot = is_main_shot
	})

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("bolt", origin)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:get_fall_sub_range()
	if #self.fall_sub_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_sub_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_sub_exp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	if self.is_use_risk_map then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	range:Hide()

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_sub_range(range)
	if self.is_use_risk_map then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	range:Hide()

	if self.fall_sub_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_sub_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.bolts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bolts, 1, -1 do
			if self.bolts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
				self.bolts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bolts[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			if self.bolts[i].is_main_shot then
				self:return_fall_range(self.bolts[i].attack_range)
			else

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 존 바운드 필수
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 원기옥 및 구슬이 추격할 대상, 순간이동 할 센터 위치, 구슬 2개가 생성될 위치 정보로 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	-- 순간이동 할 센터 위치
	info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bound.center))
	-- 구슬 생성될 위치 gen
	-- FIXME: 코드 개선 필요.
	local pick = random_util.get_random_int(1,8)
	local candidate_idxes
	if pick == 1 then
		candidate_idxes = {3, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	elseif pick == 2 then
		candidate_idxes = {4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	elseif pick == 3 then
		candidate_idxes = {1, 4, 6, 7, 8}
	elseif pick == 4 then
		candidate_idxes = {2, 3, 5, 7, 8}
	elseif pick == 5 then
		candidate_idxes = {1, 2, 4, 6, 7}
	elseif pick == 6 then
		candidate_idxes = {1, 2, 3, 5, 8}
	elseif pick == 7 then
		candidate_idxes = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
	elseif pick == 8 then
		candidate_idxes = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6}
	end

	local next_pick_roll = random_util.get_values_in_array(candidate_idxes, {count = 1})
	local next_pick = next_pick_roll[1]

	info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.edge_positions[pick]))
	info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.edge_positions[next_pick]))

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.current_action_count = 0

	-- 센터 위치
	local teleport_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("reset", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.character.Position = teleport_position
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink")
	self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	-- 레이저 생성 지점
	self.laser_point_a = info:GetPositionAt(1)
	self.laser_point_b = info:GetPositionAt(2)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	-- laser 는 캔슬 시 바로 캔슬
	if self.laser_fx_a ~= nil then
		self.laser_fx_a:Dispose()
		self.laser_fx_a = nil
	end
	if self.laser_fx_b ~= nil then
		self.laser_fx_b:Dispose()
		self.laser_fx_b = nil
	end
	if self.laser_sfx_loop_a ~= nil then
		self.laser_sfx_loop_a:Stop()
		self.laser_sfx_loop_a = nil
	end
	if self.laser_sfx_loop_b ~= nil then
		self.laser_sfx_loop_b:Stop()
		self.laser_sfx_loop_b = nil
	end

	self.laser_calculator_a:End()
	self.laser_calculator_b:End()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_a))
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_b))

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.laser_attack_range_a:Hide()
		self.laser_attack_range_b:Hide()

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.bomb_ranges[1]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[1]))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			if self.growl_sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.growl_sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.growl_sfx_holder = nil
			end

			if self.prepared_fx ~= nil then
				self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
				self.prepared_fx = nil
			end
		end
		self.growl_sfx_holder = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot_done then
			self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.recharge and next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			if self.prepared_fx ~= nil then
				self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
				self.prepared_fx = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recharge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count+1]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count+1]))

			if self.prepared_fx ~= nil then
				self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
				self.prepared_fx = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		-- 준비 사운드 두개 (growl은 delay 먹여서 재생됨)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.growl_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("growl")

		self.last_direction_a = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.laser_point_a).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.laser_attack_range_a, self.laser_point_a, self.last_direction_a)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_a))
		self.laser_attack_range_a:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		self.last_direction_b = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.laser_point_b).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.laser_attack_range_b, self.laser_point_b, self.last_direction_b)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_b))
		self.laser_attack_range_b:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.bomb_ranges[1], self.last_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_ranges[1]))
		self.bomb_ranges[1]:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.shoot_timing)

		self.prepared_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,self.bomb_height,0), unity_class.vector3.zero)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot_done = false
		self.current_action_count = self.current_action_count + 1

		if self.current_action_count == 1 then
			self.laser_calculator_a.Position = self.laser_point_a
			self.laser_calculator_a.Direction = self.last_direction_a
			self.laser_calculator_a:Start()
			self.laser_fx_a = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", self.laser_point_a, self.last_direction_a)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("laser_on", self.laser_point_a)
			self.laser_sfx_loop_a = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("laser_loop", self.laser_point_a)

			self.laser_calculator_b.Position = self.laser_point_b
			self.laser_calculator_b.Direction = self.last_direction_b
			self.laser_calculator_b:Start()
			self.laser_fx_b = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", self.laser_point_b, self.last_direction_b)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("laser_on", self.laser_point_b)
			self.laser_sfx_loop_b = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("laser_loop", self.laser_point_b)
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.recharge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count + 1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.recharge_duration + self.shoot_timing)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_laser_helper(calculator, dt)
	if calculator.IsStarted then
		local objects = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - calculator.Position).normalized
				local knock_direction = battle_util.get_vertical_direction(calculator.Direction, direction)

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.laser_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.laser_knockback_factor
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = self.laser_knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if calculator.IsFinished then
			calculator:End()

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.bomb_contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bomb_contexts, 1, -1 do
			local bomb_tp =  self.bomb_contexts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.bomb_contexts[i].time_passed = bomb_tp

			-- 완료시 삭제
			if bomb_tp >= self.bomb_fall_duration then
				local b_position = self.bomb_contexts[i].dest_pos
				-- 낙하 위치에 데미지
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(b_position, self.bomb_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", b_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", b_position)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object = nil

				-- 어택레인지 종료
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range))
				self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()

				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.bomb_contexts, i)
			elseif bomb_tp >= 0 then
				local prog = bomb_tp / self.bomb_fall_duration
				local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.bomb_contexts[i].start_pos, self.bomb_contexts[i].dest_pos, prog) +
						self.bomb_height * (1 - prog * prog) * unity_class.vector3.up
				local calc_scale = 0.3 + math.min(prog, 1) * 0.5

				if self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
					self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(calc_scale, calc_scale, calc_scale)
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end


	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self:update_laser_helper(self.laser_calculator_a, dt) then
		if self.laser_fx_a ~= nil then
			self.laser_fx_a:Dispose()
			self.laser_fx_a = nil
		end
		if self.laser_sfx_loop_a ~= nil then
			self.laser_sfx_loop_a:Stop()
			self.laser_sfx_loop_a = nil
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_a))
	end

	if self:update_laser_helper(self.laser_calculator_b, dt) then
		if self.laser_fx_b ~= nil then
			self.laser_fx_b:Dispose()
			self.laser_fx_b = nil
		end
		if self.laser_sfx_loop_b ~= nil then
			self.laser_sfx_loop_b:Stop()
			self.laser_sfx_loop_b = nil
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_b))
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 레어지 어택 레인지 타겟 추적
		self.last_direction_a = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.laser_point_a).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.laser_attack_range_a, self.laser_point_a, self.last_direction_a)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_a))

		self.last_direction_b = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.laser_point_b).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.laser_attack_range_b, self.laser_point_b, self.last_direction_b)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range_b))

		-- 원기옥 어택 레인지 타겟 추적
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		-- 준비 시간 완료 시 다음 스테이트로 진행
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot_done and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shoot_done = true

			-- 원기옥 데이터 추가
			local calc_pos = self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,self.bomb_height,0)
			local orb_eff = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("bomb", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			orb_eff.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)

			table.insert(self.bomb_contexts, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				dest_pos = self.last_position,
				time_passed = 0,
				height = self.bomb_height,
				pooled_object = orb_eff,
				attack_range = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count]
			})

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		-- 횟수 남아 있다면 recharge, 다 끝났다면 post로 이동
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.recharge)
			else
				if self.prepared_fx ~= nil then
					self.prepared_fx:Dispose()
					self.prepared_fx = nil
				end
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recharge then
		-- 레인지 업데이트
		self.last_position = self.target.Position
		local ar = self.bomb_ranges[self.current_action_count + 1]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, self.last_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		-- recharge 완료시 다시 action
		if self.time_passed >= self.recharge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	-- 바로 중지
	if self.bomb_contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.bomb_contexts, 1, -1 do
			if self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object ~= nil then
				self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.bomb_contexts[i].pooled_object = nil
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range))
			self.bomb_contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()
			table.remove(self.bomb_contexts, i)
		end
	end

	self:cancel()
end

	self:force_cancel()

local local_class = newclass('BossFoxSpiritDashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.mine_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineDamageModifier", 0.8)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)

	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 0.25)
	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 3)

	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 15)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeWidth", 2)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.25)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced")
	self.shoot_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTerm", 0.2)
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionRadius", 1)
	self.mine_lifetime = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MineLifeTime", 3)

	self.is_center_teleport = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "CenterTeleport", true)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 어택레인지 리스크맵 사용 여부
	self.is_use_risk_map = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 2, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 강화패턴 관련 객체
	if self.enhanced then
		self.mines = {}

		self.fall_ranges = {}
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius)
			table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
		end
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- 코옵에서 오너가 아닌 유저는 존 세팅되지 않았기 때문에 없으면 재설정 되도록
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
		end
		self:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	end

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.start_positions == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 돌진 대상, 최초 순간이동 할 위치 커맨드로 발행
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	--상, 하, 좌, 우 중 대상에서 가장 먼 곳
	local select_position = target.Position
	local max_dist = -1

	for _, pos in ipairs(self.start_positions) do
		local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - pos).magnitude
		if dist > max_dist then
			max_dist = dist
			select_position = pos
		end
	end
	info:AppendPosition(select_position)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local teleport_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)

	if self.is_center_teleport then
		teleport_position = self.zone_bound.center
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("reset", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	--텔레포트시 옵스타클 벗어나서 하도록 수정.
	teleport_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.character.Position, teleport_position, false)
	self.character.Position = teleport_position

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink")

	self.current_action_count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.synced = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.last_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_action_count = self.current_action_count + 1
		self.synced = false
		self.shoot_timer = self.shoot_term * 0.8
		self.charge_direction = self.last_direction
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		-- 돌진 시작
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)

		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("interval")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 포격 업데이트
	if self.mines ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.mines, 1, -1 do
			local bolt_tp =  self.mines[i].time_passed + dt
			self.mines[i].time_passed = bolt_tp

			local m_pos = self.mines[i].position

			-- 충돌 검사
			local hit = false
			local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(m_pos, self.explosion_radius, 4)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects.Values[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.mine_damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					hit = true
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			if hit or bolt_tp >= self.mine_lifetime then
				-- 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", m_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", m_pos)
				-- 오브젝트 삭제
				if not is_unity_null(self.mines[i].pooled_object) then
					self.mines[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.mines[i].pooled_object = nil
				-- 어택레인지 반환
				self:return_fall_range(self.mines[i].attack_range)
				self.mines[i].attack_range = nil
				-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
				table.remove(self.mines, i)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.last_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		if not self.last_direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			self.last_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, self.last_direction)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)

			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			-- 장애물 투척
			if self.enhanced and self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self.shoot_timer = self.shoot_timer + dt
				if self.shoot_timer >= self.shoot_term then
					self.shoot_timer = self.shoot_timer - self.shoot_term

					self:shoot_to_pos(self.character.Position)
				end
			end
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self.last_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_to_pos(pos)
	local range = self:get_fall_range()
	range.Position = pos

	if self.is_use_risk_map then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	table.insert(self.mines, {
		position = pos,
		time_passed = 0,
		pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("bolt", pos + unity_class.vector3(0,0.05,0), unity_class.vector3.zero),
		attack_range = range
	})
	self.mines[#self.mines].pooled_object.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.mines[#self.mines].pooled_object.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("bolt", pos)
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius)
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	if self.is_use_risk_map then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.mines ~= nil then
		for i = #self.mines, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.mines[i].pooled_object) then
				self.mines[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.mines[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_fall_range(self.mines[i].attack_range)
			self.mines[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.mines, i)
		end
	end

	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1));
		if self.current_action_count + 1 == idx then
			self.last_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action and not self.synced then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self.synced = true

					-- 다음 돌진 위해 싱크 커맨드
					local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
					info:AppendNumber(self.current_action_count + 1)

					local dir_to_charge = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
					info:AppendDirection(dir_to_charge)

					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.start_positions = nil
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	local char_ext = self.character.Bounds.extents + unity_class.vector3(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)

	self.zone_bound = bound
	self.zone_bound.extents = self.zone_bound.extents - char_ext

	local min = bound.min
	local max = bound.max
	local center = bound.center

	-- 존 상하좌우 위치
	self.start_positions = {
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, center.y, max.z-char_ext.z),
		unity_class.vector3(min.x+char_ext.x, center.y, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(max.x-char_ext.x, center.y, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, center.y, min.z+char_ext.z)
	}
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

local local_class = newclass('BossFoxSpiritSummonBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 3)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)
	self.attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0.2)

	self.charge_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargePrepareDuration", 0.25)

	self.spirit_traking_duration = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SpiritTrakingDuration", 0.2)
	self.spirit_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "SpiritCount", 3)
	self.spirit_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritExplosionRadius", 1)
	self.spirit_explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritExplosionDamage", 1.2)
	self.spirit_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritRadius", 0.5)
	self.spirit_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritDistance", 2)
	self.spirit_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritSpeed", 20)
	self.spirit_charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritChargeDistance", 5)
	self.spirit_charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritChargeDuration", 0.5)
	self.spirit_charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpiritChargeSpeed", 10)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	-- 어택레인지 리스크맵 사용 여부
	self.is_use_risk_map = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.spirit_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.spirit_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.spirit_attack_range_list, range)
	end

	self.charge_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				unity_class.vector2(self.spirit_charge_distance, self.spirit_radius), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.charge_attack_range_list, range)
	end

	self.attack_calculator_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
		local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = 1
		info.Duration = 10
		info.Radius = self.spirit_radius
		info.Height = 3
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, ac)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트

		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		summon = 3,
		charge_prepare = 4,

		post = 6
	}

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:dispose_spirit()

	for _,v in pairs(self.spirit_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			v:Hide()
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.charge_attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			v:Hide()
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		for _,v in pairs(self.spirit_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()

			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			for _,v in pairs(self.spirit_attack_range_list) do
				v:Hide()

				if self.is_use_risk_map then
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
				end
			end
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.summon then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		for _,v in pairs(self.charge_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
			self.attack_calculator_list[i]:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		--TODO:소환 위치 계산
		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		self.spirit_info_list = {}
		for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
			local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.spirit_count, 0)
					* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
			local summon_pos = self.target_pos + dir * self.spirit_distance
			summon_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summon_pos, battle_util.get_height(summon_pos))
			table.insert(self.spirit_info_list, {
				dir = dir,
				pos = summon_pos,
				is_active = true,
				spirit_obj = nil,
				spirit_charge_obj = nil,
				spirit_charge_trail = nil,
				spirit_trail = nil,
				dest_pos = nil,
				move_diff = nil,
				charge_start_pos = nil
			})

			local ar = self.spirit_attack_range_list[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, summon_pos)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)

			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
			end
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.summon then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--TODO:attack calc setting
		for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
			self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("spirit",
					self.spirit_info_list[i].pos)
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = self.spirit_info_list[i].pos
			self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("summon")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon")
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))
		--TODO:charge attackrange setting
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge_prepare")
		for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
			local pos = self.spirit_info_list[i].pos
			local dir = (self.target_pos - pos).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range_list[i], pos, dir)
			self.charge_attack_range_list[i]:Show(self.charge_prepare_duration)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--현재 spirit위치에서 target_pos방향으로 charge_distance만큼 돌진
		for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
			if self.spirit_info_list[i].is_active then
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.spirit_info_list[i].pos).normalized
				local dest_pos = self.spirit_info_list[i].pos + (dir * self.spirit_charge_distance)
				self.spirit_info_list[i].charge_start_pos = self.spirit_info_list[i].pos
				self.spirit_info_list[i].dest_pos = dest_pos
				self.spirit_info_list[i].move_diff = dest_pos - self.spirit_info_list[i].pos
				self.spirit_info_list[i].move_duration = self.spirit_info_list[i].move_diff.magnitude / self.spirit_charge_speed

				--Effect
				if self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj ~= nil then
					self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj:Dispose()
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("spirit_explosion",
							self.spirit_info_list[i].pos)
				end

				self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot",
						self.spirit_info_list[i].pos)
				local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, dir)
				self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj.transform.rotation = rot
				self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("trail",
						self.spirit_info_list[i].pos)
				self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_trail.transform:SetParent(self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj.transform)
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state >= self.state.summon and self.current_state < self.state.post then
		self:spirit_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.summon)
		else
			for i = 1, self.spirit_count do

				local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.spirit_count, 0)
						* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
				local summon_pos = self.target.Position + dir * self.spirit_distance
				summon_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summon_pos, battle_util.get_height(summon_pos))
				self.spirit_info_list[i].dir = dir
				self.spirit_info_list[i].pos = summon_pos
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.spirit_attack_range_list[i], summon_pos)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.summon then
		-- 도깨비 불 회전 및 데미지판정
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			if self.time_passed < self.spirit_traking_duration then
				self.target_pos = self.target.Position
			end

			for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
				if self.spirit_info_list[i].is_active then
					local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.spirit_count +
							(self.time_passed * self.spirit_speed * 10), 0)	* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
					local pos = self.target_pos + dir * self.spirit_distance
					pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
					self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj.transform.position = pos
					self.spirit_info_list[i].pos = pos
					self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = pos
				end
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed >= self.spirit_charge_duration then
			self:dispose_spirit()
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:spirit_charge_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:spirit_update(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
		if self.spirit_info_list[i].is_active then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					self:explosion_spirit(self.spirit_info_list[i].pos)
					self.spirit_info_list[i].is_active = false
					if self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj ~= nil then
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj:Dispose()
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj = nil
					end
					if self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj ~= nil then
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj:Dispose()
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj = nil
					end
					if self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_trail ~= nil then
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_trail:Dispose()
						self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_trail = nil
					end
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_spirit(target_pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.spirit_explosion_radius)

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("charge_explosion", target_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge_explosion", target_pos)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else

			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - target_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.spirit_explosion_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:spirit_charge_update(dt)
	for i = 1, self.spirit_count do
		if self.spirit_info_list[i].is_active and self.time_passed <= self.spirit_info_list[i].move_duration then
			local move_position = self.spirit_info_list[i].charge_start_pos + self.time_passed /
					self.spirit_info_list[i].move_duration * self.spirit_info_list[i].move_diff
			self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_charge_obj.transform.position = move_position
			self.spirit_info_list[i].spirit_obj.transform.position = move_position
			self.spirit_info_list[i].pos = move_position
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = move_position

			--벽에 충돌하지 않도록 수정

		end
	end
