--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.667)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)

	local attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 3)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 180)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0.08)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.36)
	self.teleport_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TeleportOffset", 0.6)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = attack_radius
	info.Angle = attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 어택레인지 리스크맵 사용 여부
	self.is_use_risk_map = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, attack_radius, attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 코옵에서 오너가 아닌 유저는 존 세팅되지 않았기 때문에 없으면 재설정 되도록
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
		end
		self:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	end

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	--공격 대상이 2타일 이하 있을 경우
	--슬래시 사용
	--공격 대상이 3타일 이상 떨어져 있을 경우
	--텔레포트 사용 후 공격 대상 뒤로 이동
	local target_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.character.Position)

	if target_diff.magnitude > 2 then
		-- 거리가 멀다면 텔레포트 할 위치 결정 해야 함.

		-- 타겟이 바라 보는 방향
		local target_look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(target))
		-- 타겟 방향 및 위치로부터 이동할 지점 계산. (등 뒤에서 튀어나온다.)
		local estimation_dest = target.Position - target_look_dir_vec * self.character.Bounds.extents.x

		--obstacle 피할수 있는 위치로 수정
		estimation_dest = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.character.Position, estimation_dest, false)

		local in_bound = CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, estimation_dest)

		-- 해당 위치가 바운드 바깥이라면 그냥 정면에서 나오게 한다.
		-- 벽이라면 케릭터 방향으로 공격하도록 수정
		if not in_bound then
			target_look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(target_diff))
			estimation_dest = target.Position - target_look_dir_vec * self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		end

		-- 벽에 끼이는 위치이면 위치 보정.
		local searchBound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(estimation_dest, self.character.Bounds.extents - vector(self.teleport_offset, 0, self.teleport_offset))
		local can, need_move = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetInsideZoneMovement(self.zone_bound, searchBound, 0)

		-- 위치 보정 불가능한 위치로 이동하려고 하면 캔슬.
		if not can then
			return false
		end

		local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
		-- 텔레포트 할 포지션
		local teleport_position = estimation_dest + need_move
		info:AppendPosition(teleport_position)
		-- 베기 방향
		-- 최종 위치 에서 타겟 방향을 다시 계산함.
		if in_bound then
			-- 보기 좋게 4방향으로 공격 할수 있도록..
			target_look_dir_vec = vector_util.to_4way_vector(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - teleport_position))
		end
		info:AppendDirection(target_look_dir_vec)
		-- 텔레포트 해야한다고 알려주기 위한 식별자
		info:AppendNumber(1)

		local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

		return true
	else
		-- 아니라면 그냥 공격 (대상을 향한 4way 방향)
		local attack_direction = vector_util.to_direction(target_diff)
		if attack_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			attack_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		end

		local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction_util.to_vector3(attack_direction))
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local need_teleport = info:GetNumberAt(0)

	-- 텔레포트
	if need_teleport > 0 then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("reset", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local teleport_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
		self.character.Position = teleport_position
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink")
	end

	-- 베기 방향 변수에 저장
	self.slash_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			if self.is_use_risk_map then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()

		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.sfx_holder = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.slash_direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.slash_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		if self.is_use_risk_map then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.slash_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.slash_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then

	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	self.crystal_monster_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CrystalMonsterId", 103516)

	self.ice_spike_area_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeAreaRadius", 8)
	self.ice_spike_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeDamageModifier", 1)
	self.ice_spike_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeRadius", 1)
	self.ice_spike_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeHeight", 8)
	self.ice_spike_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeInterval", 0.5)
	self.ice_spike_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeSpeed", 10)
	self.ice_spike_min_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IceSpikeMinRange", 1)
	self.blink_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BlinkKnockBackForce", 1.1)
	self.blink_knockback_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BlinkKnockBackRadius", 2)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	self.groggy_camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyCameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.groggy_camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyCameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	self.crystal_offset_list = self:get_crystal_offset(params, "CrystalOffsetList")
	self.crystal_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CrystalMoveDuration", 1)

	self.explosion_damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDamageRate", 0.5)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		teleport_prepare = 2,
		teleport = 3,
		interval = 4,
		prepare = 5,
		action = 6,
		explosion_prepare = 7,
		explosion = 8,
		groggy = 9,
		post = 10
	}

	self.ice_spike_count = self.action_duration / self.ice_spike_interval

	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.ice_spike_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.ice_spike_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, range)
	end

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent),
			self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent),
			self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.crystal_monster = nil
	self.crystal_random_pos_list = nil
	self.ice_spike_time_passed = 0
	self.current_ice_spike_count = 0
	self.ice_circle_effect = nil
	self.ice_spike_info_list = nil
	self.crystal_effect_list = nil
	self.is_boss_dead = false
	self.crystal_max_count = 3
	self.crystal_list = nil
	self.crystal_contrail_list = nil
	self.current_crystal_count = 0
	self.crystal_move_time_passed = 0
	self.is_pos_crystal = false
	self.shield_effect = nil
	self.shield_effect_loop = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_crystal, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:get_crystal_offset(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local offset_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			--- get projectile name
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local offset_data = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(info, "Offset")

			local offset = vector(offset_data[1], offset_data[2], offset_data[3])

			table.insert(offset_list, offset)
		end
	end

	return offset_list
end

function local_class:routine_load_crystal()
	if self.crystal_list ~= nil then return end

	self.crystal_list = {}

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 80)
	if stage ~= nil then
		if stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId) ~= nil then
			local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
			exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		end
	end

	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("Characters"):GetSpec(self.crystal_monster_id)

	for i = 1, self.crystal_max_count do
		local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)

		coroutine.yield(loader)

		local monster = loader.Character

		monster.Name = "crystal" .. i
		monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
		monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = "battle2"
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.EventGroupName = "battle2"
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
		monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
		monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
		CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, "enabled")

		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())

		table.insert(self.crystal_list, monster)
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		if self.current_state <= self.state.action then
			self.is_boss_dead = true
		end
	end

	if not self.is_boss_dead and self.crystal_list ~= nil then
		if self:check_crystal_monster(e.FieldObject) then
			if self.current_state <= self.state.action and self.current_state > self.state.none then
				self.current_crystal_count = self.current_crystal_count - 1
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crystal_break", e.FieldObject.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

				if self.current_crystal_count <= 0 then
					--모든 크리스탈 제거에 성공했다면 그로기 타임
					self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_crystal_monster(monster)
	for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(monster, v) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:summon_crystal()
	if self.crystal_contrail_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_contrail_list) do
			v:Dispose()
			v = nil
		end
	end
	self.crystal_contrail_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.crystal_max_count do
		local crystal = self.crystal_list[i]

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = crystal
		heal_info.heal = crystal.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
		thebattle:AddEnemy(crystal)
		crystal.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(crystal, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(crystal.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
				crystal, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

		local crystal_pos = self.zone_bound.center + self.crystal_offset_list[i]
		crystal.Position = crystal_pos
		crystal.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		local contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crystal_contrail", crystal_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		contrail.transform.parent = crystal.transform
		table.insert(self.crystal_contrail_list, contrail)

		local crystal_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crystal",
				crystal_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		crystal_effect.transform.parent = crystal.transform
		table.insert(self.crystal_effect_list, crystal_effect)

	end

	self.current_crystal_count = self.crystal_max_count
end

function local_class:kill_crystal()
	if self.crystal_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.damage = v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				v.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
			end
		end
	end

	if self.crystal_contrail_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_contrail_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				v = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.crystal_contrail_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.crystal_random_pos_list = {}
	self.ice_spike_info_list = {}
	self.crystal_effect_list = {}
	self.ice_spike_time_passed = 0
	self.current_ice_spike_count = 0
	self.is_boss_dead = false
	self.circle_sfx_holder = nil
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		self:end_crystal_effect()
		self:kill_crystal()
		self:reset_ailment()
		self:remove_immune()
		self:dispose_ice_spike()
	end
	self:end_circle()

	if self.shield_effect ~= nil then
		self.shield_effect:Dispose()
		self.shield_effect = nil
	end
	if self.shield_effect_loop ~= nil then
		self.shield_effect_loop:Dispose()
		self.shield_effect_loop = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.crystal_contrail_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_contrail_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				v = nil
			end
		end
	end
	self.crystal_contrail_list = nil

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
		self.teleport_finish = false

		--상태이상 면역
		self:set_ailment_resist()

		--무적
		self:set_immune()
		self.shield_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shield", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.shield_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink", self.character.Position)
		if self.shield_effect ~= nil then
			self.shield_effect:Dispose()
			self.shield_effect = nil
		end
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--캐스팅바
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.action_duration + self.prepare_duration + 1))

		--얼음수정 젠 & 고드름 영역 이팩트
		self:summon_crystal()
		self.is_pos_crystal = false

		--ice circle effect
		self.ice_circle_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("circle",
				self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		--get_random_pos_list
		self.crystal_random_pos_list = self:get_random_pos_list()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ice_circle")
		self.circle_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("rce_circle_loop")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--고드름 랜덤 낙하 시작
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_prepare_duration + 1))

		self:immune_crystal()
		--남은 수정들이 중앙으로 모이기 시작
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crystal_ready",
				self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("circle_move")
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:end_circle()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crystal_explosion", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		--남은 수정 갯수에 비례 데미지
		self:remove_immune_crystal()
		self:update_explosion_damage()
		self:kill_crystal()
		self:end_crystal_effect()

		if self.shield_effect_loop ~= nil then
			self.shield_effect_loop:Dispose()
			self.shield_effect_loop = nil
		end
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("circle_explosion")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:reset_ailment()
		self:remove_immune()

		if self.shield_effect_loop ~= nil then
			self.shield_effect_loop:Dispose()
			self.shield_effect_loop = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shield_end",
				self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		stage_camera:Shake(self.groggy_camera_shake_magnitude, self.groggy_camera_shake_duration)
		self:end_crystal_effect()
		self:end_circle()
		self:dispose_ice_spike()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

		self:reset_ailment()
		self:remove_immune()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_immune()
	self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
end

function local_class:immune_crystal()
	for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			v.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
			v.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_immune_crystal()
	for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			v.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
			v.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			v.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_immune()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
	self.death_type = nil
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:end_circle()
	if self.ice_circle_effect ~= nil then
		self.ice_circle_effect:Dispose()
		self.ice_circle_effect = nil

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("circle_end",
				self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
	if self.circle_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.circle_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.circle_sfx_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:end_crystal_effect()
	if self.crystal_effect_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.crystal_effect_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				v = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_ice_spike()
	if self.ice_spike_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.ice_spike_info_list) do
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end

			if v.contrail ~= nil then
				v.contrail:Dispose()
				v.contrail = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_random_pos_list()
	--pos 중심점
	--radius 범위반지름
	--각도 다르게 360 거리다르게 min ~ radius
	--갯수 - action_duration(8) / interval(0.5) = 16
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / self.ice_spike_count
	local pos_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.ice_spike_count do
		local random_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0, shot_area_angle)
		local angle = shot_area_angle * i - shot_area_angle + random_angle
		local shoot_range = unity_class.random.Range(self.ice_spike_min_range, self.ice_spike_area_radius / 2)
		table.insert(pos_list,{
			angle = angle,
			range = shoot_range
		})
	end

	--순서 섞어준다.
	local random_pos_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(pos_list, {count = self.ice_spike_count})

	return random_pos_list
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.ice_spike_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_ice_spike(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.zone_bound.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.shield_effect_loop = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shield_loop", self.character.Position,
						unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.shield_effect_loop.transform.parent = self.character.transform
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:update_knock_back(dt)
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.circle_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
		else
			self:update_absolute_zero(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		else
			self:update_crystal(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_absolute_zero(dt)
	if self.ice_spike_time_passed < self.ice_spike_interval then
		self.ice_spike_time_passed = self.ice_spike_time_passed + dt
	else
		self.ice_spike_time_passed = 0
		--ice spike발사
		self.current_ice_spike_count = self.current_ice_spike_count + 1
		if self.current_ice_spike_count < self.ice_spike_count then
			local angle = self.crystal_random_pos_list[self.current_ice_spike_count].angle
			local range = self.crystal_random_pos_list[self.current_ice_spike_count].range
			local target_pos = self.target.Position + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0)
					* (unity_class.vector3.right * range)
			local start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, self.ice_spike_height, 0)

			local diff = target_pos - start_pos
			local dist = diff.magnitude
			local move_duration = dist / self.ice_spike_speed

			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("ice_proj", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, vector(0, 0, 0))
			effect.transform.rotation = rot
			local contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("ice_contrail", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ice_spike")

			local ar = self.attack_range_list[self.current_ice_spike_count]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target_pos)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, move_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

			table.insert(self.ice_spike_info_list, {
				index = self.current_ice_spike_count,
				current_pos = start_pos,
				start_pos = start_pos,
				dest_pos = target_pos,
				is_active = true,
				time_passed = 0,
				move_duration = move_duration,
				effect = effect,
				contrail = contrail
			})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_ice_spike(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.ice_spike_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			--낙하
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
			if progress > 1 then
				--아이스스파이크 데미지
				self:update_ice_spike_damage(v)
				--effect
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("ice_explosion", v.dest_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ice_spike_explosion")
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ice_spike_explosion2")
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				if v.contrail ~= nil then
					v.contrail:Dispose()
					v.contrail = nil
				end

				--aatackrange hide
				if self.attack_range_list[v.index] ~= nil then
					self.attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
							self.attack_range_list[v.index]))
				end

				v.is_active = false
			else
				local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(v.effect,
							move_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
				if v.contrail ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(v.contrail,
							move_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_crystal(dt)
	--크리스탈이 중앙으로 이동
	for i = 1, self.crystal_max_count do
		local crystal = self.crystal_list[i]
		if not crystal.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.explosion_prepare_duration))
			if progress == 1 then
				crystal.Position = self.zone_bound.center
			else
				local start_pos = self.zone_bound.center + self.crystal_offset_list[i]
				local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, self.zone_bound.center, progress)
				crystal.Position = move_pos
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion_damage()

	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)

	for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_rate = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage
			if self.current_crystal_count <= 1 then
				damage_rate = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(v) * self.explosion_damage_rate)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.damage = damage_rate

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_ice_spike_damage(info)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(info.dest_pos, self.ice_spike_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - info.dest_pos).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.ice_spike_damage_modifier
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, 'ice_spike_hit')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.blink_knockback_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.blink_knockback_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.crystal_monster = nil
	self.crystal_random_pos_list = nil
	self.ice_spike_info_list = nil
	self.ice_circle_effect = nil
	self.crystal_effect_list = nil
	self.shield_effect_loop = nil
	self.shield_effect = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFrostQueenFrostBiteBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 3)
	self.targeting_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetingDuration", 1.5)

	self.action_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDistance", 3)
	self.move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveSpeed", 9)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1.1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1.2)
	self.bite_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionRange", 7)
	self.bite_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 1)
	self.bite_max_hit = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MaxHit", 3)
	self.bite_bound_size_Width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BiteBoundWidth", 1.5)
	self.bite_bound_size = vector(self.bite_bound_size_Width, 1, self.bite_bound_size_Width)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)

	self.bite_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BiteDuration", 3)

	self.bite_width = math.max(self.bite_bound_size.x, self.bite_bound_size.y, self.bite_bound_size.z)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			vector(self.bite_range, self.bite_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	--wave attack info
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.bite_range, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.bite_bound_size_Width),
			self.bite_duration, self.bite_damage_term, true
	)
	self.attack_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character,
			info, true, 0.1, self.bite_max_hit)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		tracking = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.bite_start_pos = nil
	self.current_bite_pos = nil
	self.bite_effect = nil
	self.is_explosion = false
	self.is_start_bite = false
	self.bite_time_passed = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.is_start_bite = false
	self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.bite_effect ~= nil then
		self.bite_effect:Dispose()
		self.bite_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local dir = diff.normalized
		self.target_dir = dir
		self.target_pos = self.character.Position + (dir * self.bite_range)

		self.bite_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.target_pos, self.bite_bound_size)
		self.bite_move = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.target_pos)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_explosion = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.bite_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.current_bite_pos = self.bite_start_pos

		self.is_action_ani = false
		self.is_start_bite = true

		self.bite_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("frostbite", self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, self.target_dir)
		self.bite_effect.transform.rotation = rot

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_start_bite then
		if self.bite_time_passed < self.bite_duration then
			self.bite_time_passed = self.bite_time_passed + dt
			self:update_bite(dt)
		else
			self:explosion_bite(dt)
			self.is_start_bite = false
			self.bite_time_passed = 0
			if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
				self.attack_calculator:End()
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then

			local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

			if dist > self.action_distance then

				local direction = diff.normalized
				local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.move_speed * dt)

				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = direction
				move_info.magnitude = move_dist
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction),
						true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		else
			--move_duration안에 타겟에게 도달 못하면 패턴진행
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.targeting_duration then
				local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
				local dir = diff.normalized
				self.target_dir = dir
				self.target_pos = self.character.Position + (dir * self.bite_range)

				self.bite_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.target_pos, self.bite_bound_size)
				self.bite_move = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.target_pos)

				battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_bite(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.target_dir:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_dir
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_dir
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_ice_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:explosion_bite(dt)
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.bite_start_pos
	, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, self.target_dir)
	effect.transform.rotation = rot
	self.is_explosion = true

	if self.bite_effect ~= nil then
		self.bite_effect:Dispose()
		self.bite_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.bite_bound_size = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.bite_start_pos = nil
	self.current_bite_pos = nil
	self.bite_effect = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFrostQueenFrostBladeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 1)
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 0.3)
	self.move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveDuration", 4)
	self.move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveSpeed", 9)

	self.blade_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BladeDamageModifier", 1)
	self.blade_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BladeKnockBackForce", 1.1)
	self.blade_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BladeRadius", 10)
	self.blade_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BladeAngle", 30)
	self.blade_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "BladeCount", 6)
	self.blade_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		tracking = 2,--blade_radius범위 내에 타겟이 없다면 타겟을 향하여 이동
		prepare = 3,
		blade_a = 4,
		interval = 5,
		blade_b = 6,
		post = 7
	}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.blade_count do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.blade_radius, self.blade_angle,
				CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)
	end

	--
	self.attack_calculator_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.blade_count do
		local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
		info.DamageTerm = self.blade_damage_term
		info.Duration = self.action_duration
		info.Radius = self.blade_radius
		info.Angle = self.blade_angle
		info.Height = 3
		local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, attack_calculator)
	end

	self.target = nil
	self.frost_blade_info_list = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.frost_blade_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.frost_blade_info_list) do
			if v.is_start then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self.frost_blade_info_list = nil


	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blade_a then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end

		self.frost_blade_info_list = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blade_b then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end
		self.frost_blade_info_list = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.tracking then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.frost_blade_info_list = {}

		for i = 1, self.blade_count do
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.blade_count, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
			local ar = self.attack_range_list[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, self.character.Position, dir)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = self.character.Position
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Direction = dir

			local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-dir.z, dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)

			local create_pos = self.character.Position
			create_pos.y = create_pos.y + 0.03

			table.insert(self.frost_blade_info_list, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				target_dir = dir,
				effect_dir = rot,
				effect = nil,
				time_passed = 0,
				is_start = false
			})
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.blade_a then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("blade_a")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		--set attack attack_calculator
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:Start()
		end
		--TODO: Effect
		for _,v in pairs(self.frost_blade_info_list) do
			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blade", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			effect.transform.rotation = v.effect_dir
			v.effect = effect
			v.is_start = true
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.frost_blade_info_list = {}

		for i = 1, self.blade_count do
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.blade_count + self.blade_angle + 0.1, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
			local ar = self.attack_range_list[i]
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Direction = dir
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, self.character.Position, dir)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.interval_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

			local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-dir.z, dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)

			table.insert(self.frost_blade_info_list, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				target_dir = dir,
				effect_dir = rot,
				effect = nil,
				time_passed = 0,
				is_start = false
			})
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("interval")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.blade_b then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("blade_b")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:Start()
		end

		--TODO: Effect
		for _,v in pairs(self.frost_blade_info_list) do
			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blade", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			effect.transform.rotation = v.effect_dir
			v.effect = effect
			v.is_start = true
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then

			local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

			if dist > self.blade_radius then

				local direction = diff.normalized
				local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.move_speed * dt)

				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = direction
				move_info.magnitude = move_dist
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction),
						true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		else
			--move_duration안에 타겟에게 도달 못하면 패턴 진행
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.blade_a)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blade_a then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.blade_b)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blade_b then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, self.blade_count do
		if not self.attack_calculator_list[i].IsStarted then
			self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
		end

		local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Position)
				local dir = diff.normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.blade_damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + self.blade_knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.frost_blade_info_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reload_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reload then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.reload_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_reload_count < self.proj_max_count then
			self.current_reload_count = self.current_reload_count + 1
			self.reload_pos = self.character.Position + self.reload_effect_offset + self.missile_offset_list[self.current_reload_count].offset
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.reload then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.reload_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("missile", self.reload_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local angle = self.missile_offset_list[self.current_reload_count].angle
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle + 180, unity_class.vector3.up)
		effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
		local start_rot = effect.transform.localRotation
		local contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail", self.reload_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		contrail.transform.parent = effect.transform

		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

		table.insert(self.missile_info_list, {
			is_active = true,
			index = self.current_reload_count,
			effect = effect,
			trail = contrail,
			start_rot = start_rot,
			start_pos = self.reload_pos,
			target_pos = nil,
			current_pos = nil,
			time_passed = 0,
			move_duration = 1,
			state = self.missile_state.scale

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("reload")

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_missile(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.reload_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reload_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.reload_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.reload)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reload then
		if self.time_passed >= self.reload_duration then
			if self.current_reload_count < self.proj_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.reload_prepare)
			else
				self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_missile(dt)
	if self.missile_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.missile_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				if v.state == self.missile_state.scale then
					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
							v.time_passed, 0, 1, self.scale_duration))
					if progress == 1 then
						if v.effect ~= nil then
							v.effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
							v.state = self.missile_state.rotate
							v.target_pos = self.target.Position
							v.time_passed = 0
						end
					else
						v.effect.transform.localScale = progress * unity_class.vector3.one
						end
				elseif v.state == self.missile_state.rotate then
					local progress = v.time_passed / self.rotate_duration
					if progress > 1 then
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("fire", v.start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
						self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot")
						v.state = self.missile_state.shoot
						v.time_passed = 0

						local diff = v.start_pos - v.target_pos
						local dist = diff.magnitude
						v.move_duration = dist / self.missile_speed

						--attack_range
						local ar = self.attack_range_list[v.index]
						battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, v.target_pos)
						battle_range_util.show(ar, v.move_duration)
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
					else
						local dir = (vector_util.get_x0z(v.target_pos - v.start_pos)).normalized
						v.target_dir = dir
						local end_rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)
						if v.effect ~= nil then
							v.effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(
									v.start_rot, end_rot, progress)
						end
					end
				elseif v.state == self.missile_state.shoot then
					local progress = v.time_passed / v.move_duration
					if progress > 1 then
						if v.effect ~= nil then
							v.effect:Dispose()
							v.effect = nil
						end
						if v.contrail ~= nil then
							v.contrail:Dispose()
							v.contrail = nil
						end

						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
						self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit")
						self:update_missile_damage(v.target_pos, dt)

						self.attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
								self.attack_range_list[v.index]))

						v.state = self.missile_state.finish
						v.is_active = false
					else
						local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, progress)
						if v.effect ~= nil then
							v.effect.transform.position = move_pos
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_missile_damage(pos, dt)
	--폭발 데미지 체크
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.proj_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - pos).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	end

	self.state = nil

	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.missile_offset_list = nil
	self.reload_effect_offset = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.missile_state = nil
	self.missile_info_list = nil
end

return {
