function local_class:get_teleport_position()
	local pos = nil
	local dir = nil
	local is_ver = true
	local dist = 0
	for _,v in pairs(self.teleport_pos_list) do
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - v.pos).magnitude
		if math.abs(diff) > dist then
			dist = math.abs(diff)
			pos = v.pos
			dir = v.dir
			is_ver = v.is_vertical
		end
	end
	if is_ver then
		self.energy_ball_distance = self.energy_ball_distance_ver
	else
		self.energy_ball_distance = self.energy_ball_distance_hor
	end
	self.target_dir = dir
	self.target_pos = pos

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(
			self.energy_ball_distance, self.energy_ball_radius * 2), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.teleport_finish = false
	self.is_explosion = false
	self.current_energy_ball_pos = nil
	self.aoe_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.energy_ball_effect) then
		self.energy_ball_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.energy_ball_effect = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:get_teleport_position()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("teleport", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("teleport_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("teleport", self.target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("teleport")
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.dest_pos = self.target_pos + self.target_dir * self.energy_ball_distance
		self.shot_diff = self.dest_pos - self.target_pos
		self.energy_ball_move_duration = self.shot_diff.magnitude / self.energy_ball_speed

		self.energy_ball_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("energy_ball", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.start_aoe_sfx then
		self:aoe_sfx_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:energy_ball_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:energy_ball_update(dt)
	if not self.is_explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.energy_ball_move_duration then
			self:explosion_energy_ball()
		else
			self.current_energy_ball_pos = self.target_pos + self.time_passed / self.energy_ball_move_duration * self.shot_diff
			self.energy_ball_effect.transform.position = self.current_energy_ball_pos

			--TODO: 진행중 일정간격으로 aoe를 설치 해줘야 한다.
			local diff = self.current_energy_ball_pos - self.target_pos
			if math.abs(diff.magnitude) > self.aoe_interval_range * self.aoe_count + (self.energy_ball_radius / 2) then
				self:set_aoe()
			end


			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.current_energy_ball_pos, self.energy_ball_radius)

			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

				local is_hit_delayed = false
				for i = #self.shot_hit_list, 1, -1 do
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.shot_hit_list[i].fo) then
						self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time = self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
						if self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
							is_hit_delayed = true
						else
							table.remove(self.shot_hit_list, i)
						end
					end
				end

				if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
						fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
				else
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					table.insert(self.shot_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.energy_ball_damage_delay })
				end
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_aoe()
	local aoe_pos = self.target_pos + (self.target_dir * (self.aoe_interval_range * self.aoe_count + (self.energy_ball_radius / 2)))

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, aoe_pos,
			self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec)

	self.aoe_count = self.aoe_count + 1

	if not self.start_aoe_sfx then
		self.aoe_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("aoe")
		self.start_aoe_sfx = true
	end

	self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_spec.duration
end

function local_class:explosion_energy_ball()
	self.is_explosion = true
	if not is_unity_null(self.energy_ball_effect) then
		self.energy_ball_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.energy_ball_effect = nil

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.current_energy_ball_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
	self:shoot_sub_shot()
end

function local_class:aoe_sfx_update(dt)
	if self.aoe_sfx_duration <= 0 then
		if self.aoe_sfx ~= nil then
			self.aoe_sfx:Stop()
			self.aoe_sfx = nil
		end
		self.start_aoe_sfx = false
	else
		self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_sfx_duration - dt
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_sub_shot()
	local center_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - self.current_energy_ball_pos).normalized
	for i = 1, self.shot_amount do
		if i ~= self.shot_amount / 2 + 1 then
			local angle = self.shot_angle / self.shot_amount * i
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle - (self.shot_angle / 2), 0) * center_dir

			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.current_energy_ball_pos, dir, 0, -1, nil, false, 0)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.current_energy_ball_pos, 0.3)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
	if self.aoe_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aoe_sfx:Stop()
		self.aoe_sfx = nil
	end
	self.start_aoe_sfx = false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.teleport_pos_list = nil
	self.current_energy_ball_pos = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.shot_hit_list = nil
	self.energy_ball_effect = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.aoe_sfx = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:is_loaded()

		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local hittable = self.shoot_helper:IsHittable(target)

	return hittable
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.canceled = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character,
			self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.canceled then
		return
	end

	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1));
	local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)

	if idx >= 0 then
		if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and self.attack_range ~= nil then
			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(pos, unity_class.vector3.zero, 1, nil, false)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos)
			local dist = (pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
			local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
			self.attack_range:Show(land_time)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	else

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fire_random_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_random_shot then
		if self.shoot_trigger then
			if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shot_timing then
			self.shoot_trigger = true

			for i,pos in pairs(self.random_shot_positions) do
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - self.current_position)
				local dist = diff.magnitude
				local direction = diff.normalized

				self.shoot_helper:SingleShoot(self.current_position, direction, dist + 0.5, i + 100, nil, false)

				local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.random_attack_ranges[i], pos, pos.y)
				battle_range_util.show(self.random_attack_ranges[i], land_time)
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.random_attack_ranges[i])
			end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_main_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_main_shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fire_main_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_main_shot then
		if self.shoot_trigger then
			if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_duration then
				if self.main_shot_count < self.main_shot_count_total then

			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - self.current_position)

			if dist > self.projectile_max_dist then

			info:AppendPosition(pos)
			info:AppendInteger(self.main_shot_count)

					self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(owner.Owner, cmd)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

function local_class:sync(info)

		return
	end

	local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	local idx = info:GetIntegerAt(0)
	-- shot_count가 100은 안 넘는다고 가정
	if idx < 100 then
		self.shoot_trigger = true
		self.main_shot_count = idx

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - self.current_position)
		local dist = diff.magnitude
		local direction = diff.normalized

		self.shoot_helper:SingleShoot(self.current_position, direction, dist + 0.5, idx, nil, false)

		local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_ranges[idx], pos, pos.y)
		battle_range_util.show(self.main_attack_ranges[idx], land_time)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.main_attack_ranges[idx])
	else
		if idx == 100 then
			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe_main'), self.main_shot_aoe_spec)
		else
			local index = stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe_random'), self.random_shot_aoe_spec)
			if self.random_aoe_index_list ~= nil then
				--이미 캔슬되서 nil 인경우 예외처리
				table.insert(self.random_aoe_index_list, index)
			end
		end

function local_class:get_random_positions()
	local pos_list = {}

	local min_dist = 4
	local pos_count = 0
	local reset_count = 0
	local from, to = self:get_angle_from_to()
	local angle_range = to - from
	if angle_range < 0 then
		angle_range = 2 * math.pi + angle_range
	end
	local angle = 0
	local i = 0
	while i < self.random_shot_count do
		local pos = self.current_position
		local cnt = 0;
		while (true) do
			local fmod = math.fmod(cnt, self.random_shot_count)
			if angle_range < math.pi / 2 and self.random_shot_count > 2 then
				if fmod == self.random_shot_count - 1 then
					angle = unity_class.random.Range(0, angle_range) + from
				else
					angle = unity_class.random.Range(angle_range / (self.random_shot_count - 1) * fmod,
							angle_range / (self.random_shot_count - 1) * (fmod + 1)) + from
				end
			else

function local_class:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir_vector3)

		if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and (is_random_shot and self.random_attack_ranges[idx] ~= nil or self.main_attack_ranges[idx] ~= nil) then
			self.shoot_helper:SingleShoot(self.current_position, direction, dist + 0.5, label, nil, false)
			if is_random_shot then
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.random_attack_ranges[idx], pos)
				local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
				self.random_attack_ranges[idx]:Show(land_time)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.random_attack_ranges[idx]))
			else
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.main_attack_ranges[idx], pos)
				local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
				self.main_attack_ranges[idx]:Show(land_time)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_ranges[idx]))
			end
		end
	else
		if is_random_shot then
			local index = stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe_random'), self.random_shot_aoe_spec)
			table.insert(self.random_aoe_index_list, index)
		else
			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe_main'), self.main_shot_aoe_spec)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_random_shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fire_random_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_random_shot then
		if self.shoot_trigger then
			if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shot_timing then
			self.shoot_trigger = true

			for i,v in pairs(self.random_shot_positions) do
				local owner = self.character
				local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(owner)
				info:AppendPosition(v)
				info:AppendNumber(0)
				info:AppendNumber(i)

				local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(owner,
						self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
				command_util.publish_cmd(owner.Owner, cmd)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_main_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_main_shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fire_main_shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_main_shot then
		if self.shoot_trigger then
			if self.time_passed >= self.random_shot_duration then
				if self.main_shot_count < self.main_shot_count_total then
					self:change_state(self.state.prepare_main_shot)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shot_timing then
			self.shoot_trigger = true

			local owner = self.character
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(owner)
			local pos = self.target.Position
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - self.current_position)
			local dist = diff.magnitude
			if dist > self.projectile_max_dist then
				pos = self.current_position + diff.normalized * self.projectile_max_dist
			end

			self.main_shot_count = self.main_shot_count + 1
			info:AppendPosition(pos)
			info:AppendNumber(1)
			info:AppendNumber(self.main_shot_count)

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(owner,
					self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(owner.Owner, cmd)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_random_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_random_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_main_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fire_main_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare_random_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.random_shot_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.fire_random_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.shoot_trigger = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_main_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_shot_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.fire_main_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.shoot_trigger = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.canceled or self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	local owner = self.character
	local pos = hit_info.position
	pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(owner)
	info:AppendPosition(pos)

	if label < 100 then
		local attack_range = self.main_attack_ranges[label]
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(owner, attack_range))
		attack_range:Hide()
		info:AppendNumber(1)
	else
		local attack_range = self.random_attack_ranges[label - 100]
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(owner, attack_range))
		attack_range:Hide()
		info:AppendNumber(0)
	end

	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(owner,
			self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(owner.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.random_shot_positions = nil
	self.canceled = true
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	for i,v in ipairs(self.random_attack_ranges) do
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		v:Hide()
	end

	for i,v in ipairs(self.main_attack_ranges) do
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		v:Hide()
	end

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil and self.random_aoe_index_list ~= nil then
		for _,index in ipairs(self.random_aoe_index_list) do
			CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoeByIndex(self.character, index, true)
		end
	end
	self.random_aoe_index_list = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.main_shot_aoe_spec = nil
	self.random_shot_aoe_spec = nil

	for i, v in ipairs(self.random_attack_ranges) do
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
	end
	self.random_attack_ranges = nil

	for i, v in ipairs(self.main_attack_ranges) do
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
	end
	self.main_attack_ranges = nil

	self.current_state = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	local battle_zone =  CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(zone.center,
			unity_class.vector3(zone.size.x - 2,zone.size.y - 2,zone.size.z - 2))
	self.battle_zone = battle_zone
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossGraboidSpinChargeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1) -- 돌진 데미지
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.0)
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDuration", 1.35)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1.5)
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 20)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeWidth", 2)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.35)
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTiming", 0.25)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, "LockDirection")
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "SideOnly")

	-- 투사체
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "monster_shot_small_red_energy")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge = 3,
		shoot = 4
	}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.charge_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 4, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end


function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_distance
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
	if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
		direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, nil, direction, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리 (none 은 exit 할 것 없음)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 준비 상태 종료
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 종료
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 발사 종료
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 준비 상태 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("spin")
		-- spin charge 때 spin sound 는 loop가 아니므로 그냥 play 하고 forget
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("spin", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
	else
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.target_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.charge_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					local knock_direction = direction

					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = self.target_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true

			-- 패턴 발사
			local shoot_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			-- 키가 높아서 투사체가 안맞음. 높이 조정 (기본 높이와 내 바운드 extents 의 차만큼 내려야 함)
			local y_offset = self.character.Bounds.extents.y - 0.35
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirection(shoot_dir, y_offset * unity_class.vector3.down, -1, 0)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then

					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Position), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash", nil)
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

					-- 발사 스테이트로 전환
					self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.charge_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.shoot_timing = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.target_direction = nil
	self.shot_complete = nil

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	local attack_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.fall_damage_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	battle_range_util.hide(attack_range)
	obj.fall_attack_range = attack_range

	return obj
end

function rock_class:set_params(fall_duration, fall_damage_radius, fall_damage_modifier)
	self.fall_duration = fall_duration
	self.fall_damage_radius = fall_damage_radius
	self.fall_damage_modifier = fall_damage_modifier
end

function rock_class:unset_params()
	self.fall_duration = nil
	self.fall_damage_radius = nil
	self.fall_damage_modifier = nil
end

function rock_class:activate()
	self.is_active = true
	self.current_state = self.state.fall
	self.time_passed = 0

	local init_pos = self.x0z_position + self.fall_height * unity_class.vector3.up
	if is_unity_null(self.fx) then
		self.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.rock_key, init_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	else
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx, init_pos)
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.fall_attack_range, self.x0z_position, self.x0z_position.y)
	battle_range_util.show(self.fall_attack_range, self.fall_duration)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.action.character, self.fall_attack_range)
end

function rock_class:deactivate(show_fx)
	self.is_active = false
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	if not is_unity_null(self.fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	if self.fall_attack_range then
		battle_range_util.hide(self.fall_attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.action.character, self.fall_attack_range)
	end

	if show_fx then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.break_key, self.x0z_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
end

function rock_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 낙하중일 경우에만 포지션 업데이트
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.fall then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:update_rock_fall()
end

function rock_class:update_rock_fall()
	if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
		-- 낙하 완료
		self.current_state = self.state.idle
		self.vfo.Position = self.x0z_position
		self.vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.x0z_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.x0z_position, self.fall_damage_radius, 4)
		local sender = self.action.character
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects.Values[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(sender, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position) - self.x0z_position)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
				end

				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = sender
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.fall_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
				damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		battle_range_util.hide(self.fall_attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(sender, self.fall_attack_range)
		return
	end

	local progress = self.time_passed / self.fall_duration
	local current_height = (1 - progress * progress) * self.fall_height
	local pos = self.x0z_position + current_height * unity_class.vector3.up
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
end

function rock_class:dispose()
	if self.fall_attack_range then
		battle_range_util.hide(self.fall_attack_range)
		if self.action ~= nil then
			battle_range_util.publish_end(self.action.character, self.fall_attack_range)
		end
	end

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	if self.vfo then
		self.vfo:Dispose()
	end
	self.vfo = nil
	self.fall_attack_range = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		burrow = 2,
		move = 3,
		unburrow = 4,
		interval = 5,
		prepare = 6,
		charge = 7,
		shoot = 8,
		groggy = 9,
		post = 10
	}

	-- burrow
	self.burrow_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BurrowDuration', 1)
	self.burrow_move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BurrowMoveSpeed', 6)

	-- unburrow
	self.unburrow_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'UnburrowDuration', 1)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.1)
	self.rock_spawn_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnRockCount', 4)

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)

	-- charge
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDuration', 0.5)
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 8)
	self.charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 1)
	self.max_charge_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeCount', 3)
	self.charge_speed = self.charge_distance / self.charge_duration

	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionRadius', 3)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)

	-- shoot
	self.wait_after_shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WaitAfterShootDuration', 0.5)

	-- groggy
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 2)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	-- damage
	local rock_fall_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockFallDamageModifier', 1)
	self.unburrow_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'UnburrowDamageModifier', 1)
	self.charge_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDamageModifier', 1)
	self.rock_crash_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockCrashDamageModifier', 1)

	-- 코옵용 타겟 마커
	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	-- 돌진 벽 충돌시 투사체
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'WallCrashProjectile', 'graboid_rock_piece_proj')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'WallProjColumns', 6)
	pattern_Info.parallel = false
	pattern_Info.spreadAngle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WallProjSpreadAngle', 60)
	self.wall_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 바위 파괴 시 파편 프로젝타일
	local proj_name_2 = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'RockCrashProjectile', 'demon_rock_piece')
	local spec_2 = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name_2)
	local ps_2 = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local pattern_Info_2 = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info_2.columns = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'RockProjColumns', 6)
	pattern_Info_2.parallel = false
	pattern_Info_2.spreadAngle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockProjSpreadAngle', 60)
	self.rock_shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps_2, spec_2, pattern_Info_2, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 돌진
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.charge_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_width / 2, 4, self.charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	self.rock_explosion_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()

	local damage_radius = math.sqrt(rock_class.x_length ^ 2 + rock_class.z_length ^ 2)
	local rock_fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockFallDuration', 1)
	rock_class:set_params(rock_fall_duration, damage_radius, rock_fall_damage_modifier)
	self.rock_list = {}

	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	self.center_offset = self.character.Bounds.center - self.character.Position

	-- 상태 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.wall_shoot_helper ~= nil and self.rock_shoot_helper then
		return self.wall_shoot_helper:IsLoaded() and self.rock_shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if self.wall_shoot_helper == nil or self.rock_shoot_helper == nil then
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local hittable = self.wall_shoot_helper:IsHittable(target) and self.rock_shoot_helper:IsHittable(target)

	return hittable
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local rock_fall_positions = {}
	local targets = {}
	table.insert(targets, target)

	local index = 0
	while(true) do
		index = index + 1
		local marker_name = 'RockSpawn_' .. index
		if not field:HasMarker(marker_name) then
			break
		end
		table.insert(rock_fall_positions, field:GetMarker(marker_name).position)
	end

	if #rock_fall_positions == 0 then
		table.insert(rock_fall_positions, unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.max.x - 3, 0, self.zone_bound.max.z - 3))
		table.insert(rock_fall_positions, unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.max.x - 3, 0, self.zone_bound.min.z + 3))
		table.insert(rock_fall_positions, unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.min.x + 3, 0, self.zone_bound.max.z - 3))
		table.insert(rock_fall_positions, unity_class.vector3(self.zone_bound.min.x + 3, 0, self.zone_bound.min.z + 3))
	end

	self:shuffle(rock_fall_positions)
	local spawn_amount = math.max(self.rock_spawn_amount, 0)
	for i = #rock_fall_positions, spawn_amount + 1, -1 do
		table.remove(rock_fall_positions, i)
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.Create(self.character, rock_fall_positions, nil, targets)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.zone_bound.center)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.zone_bound.size)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	local poses = info.Positions
	self.charge_count = 0

	local start_rock_count = #self.rock_list
	for i = 1, poses.Count - 2 do repeat
		if i <= start_rock_count and self.rock_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.rock_list[i].x0z_position = poses[i - 1]
			break
		end

		local new_rock = rock_class:new(self, i)
		new_rock.x0z_position = poses[i - 1]

		table.insert(self.rock_list, new_rock)
	until true end

	local zone_center = poses[poses.Count - 2]
	local zone_size = poses[poses.Count - 1]
	self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(zone_center, zone_size)
	self.constraint_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center - vector_util.get_x0z(self.center_offset),
			self.zone_bound.size - self.character.Bounds.size - unity_class.vector3(constants.epsilon,0,constants.epsilon))

	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	local duration_passed = 0
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		duration_passed = self.burrow_duration

		if next_state ~= self.state.move then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		duration_passed = self.move_duration

		-- 이펙트 제거
		if self.move_effect ~= nil then
			self.move_effect:Dispose()
			self.move_effect = nil
		end
		-- 비헤이비어 복구
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty('Instance',
						CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		-- 취소 되었다면 일반 돌출 애니메이션
		if next_state ~= self.state.interval then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('out2')
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		duration_passed = self.unburrow_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		duration_passed = self.interval_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		duration_passed = self.prepare_duration

		self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.charge_attack_range)
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.charge_attack_range)
		self.charge_attack_range = nil

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			if self.collision_checked then
				self.collision_checked = nil
				self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()
				battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		duration_passed = self.charge_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		duration_passed = self.wait_after_shoot_duration
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		duration_passed = self.groggy_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		duration_passed = self.post_duration

	end

	if next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('in')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('in', nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.move_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.target_pos = self.zone_bound.center

		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('move', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 데미지 및 충돌 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
		local distance = diff.magnitude
		self.move_duration = distance / self.burrow_move_speed
	elseif next_state == self.state.unburrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('out')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('out', nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('out', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 튀어 나오는 위치에 데미지 줌
		local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.charge_width, 4)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects.Values[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
				end

				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.unburrow_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
				damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

		for _, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
			rock:activate()
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', nil)

		-- 충돌할 rock 인덱스, 없으면 nil
		local rock_collision_index, actual_charge_time = self:check_rock_collision()
		if rock_collision_index then
			self.collision_checked = true
			local rock = self.rock_list[rock_collision_index]
			self.rock_explosion_range:SetupByPosition(rock.x0z_position, rock.x0z_position.y)
			self.rock_explosion_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + actual_charge_time - 0.1)
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range)
		end

		local actual_charge_dist = math.min(actual_charge_time / self.charge_duration, 1) * self.charge_distance
		self.charge_attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(unity_class.vector2(actual_charge_dist + 1, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		self.charge_attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Position.y)
		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.charge_attack_range)
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('spin')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spin', nil)
		self.charge_count = self.charge_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range)

		for _, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
			if rock.is_active then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', rock.x0z_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				rock:deactivate()
				self.rock_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(rock.x0z_position, unity_class.vector3(0,0,-1), 2, 0, nil, false)
			end
		end
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		for _, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
			if rock.is_active then
				rock:deactivate()
			end
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed - duration_passed
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 바위 오브젝트는 패턴 종료 전에 전부 파괴됨
	self:update_rocks(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self:update_move(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.unburrow)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.unburrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.unburrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		-- 싱크 대기
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			--- 몬스터 오너 기준 최대 어그로 타겟
			self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTargetWithCharacter(self.character, nil, nil, true)

			--- 돌진 방향, 포지션 싱크
			local target_pos = self:get_target_pos(self.target)
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - self.character.Position))
			trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.character.Position)
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir)

			--- 커맨드 생성
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
			self:update_charge(dt)
		else
			if self.charge_count < self.max_charge_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.wait_after_shoot_duration then
			if self.charge_count < self.max_charge_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			if self.charge_count < self.max_charge_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_rocks(dt)
	for _, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
		if rock.is_active then
			rock:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	local progress = math.min(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_duration))
	local current_pos = self.character.Position
	local next_pos = self.target_pos * progress + self.move_start_pos * (1 - progress)
	local diff = next_pos - current_pos
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	move_info.magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	local progress = math.min(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.charge_duration))
	local current_pos = self.character.Position
	local next_pos = self.target_pos * progress + self.move_start_pos * (1 - progress)
	local diff = next_pos - current_pos
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	move_info.magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = move_info.direction
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

-- 돌진 전에 미리 돌과 충돌 할지 계산, 없으면 nil 반환
function local_class:check_rock_collision()
	local crash_time = -1
	local least_crash_time = -1

	-- 이동한 바운드의 AABB
	local move_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Bounds.center + 0.5 * self.charge_distance * self.charge_direction,
			self.character.Bounds.size + self.charge_distance * unity_class.vector3
			(math.abs(self.charge_direction.x), math.abs(self.charge_direction.y), math.abs(self.charge_direction.z)))

	local x_extents_sum = self.character.Bounds.extents.x + rock_class.x_length * 0.5
	local z_extents_sum = self.character.Bounds.extents.z + rock_class.z_length * 0.5
	local x_charge_speed = math.abs(self.charge_direction.x * self.charge_speed)
	local z_charge_speed = math.abs(self.charge_direction.z * self.charge_speed)
	local result
	for i, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do repeat
		if not rock.is_active then
			break
		end

		local fo = rock.vfo
		if not move_bound:Intersects(fo.Bounds) then
			break
		end

		-- 돌진 방향에 수직인 벡터, 방향은 무관
		local perp_vector = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_direction.z, self.charge_direction.y, -self.charge_direction.x)

		-- 두 바운드를 돌진 방향으로 정사영
		-- 정사영한 바운드 범위가 겹치지 않으면 충돌 안 한 것
		local a,b,c,d = perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.min.z,
		perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.max.z,
		perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.min.z,
		perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.max.z
		-- rock
		local min_fo = math.min(a,b,c,d)
		local max_fo = math.max(a,b,c,d)
		a,b,c,d = perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.min.z,
		perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.max.z,
		perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.min.z,
		perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.max.z
		-- character
		local min = math.min(a,b,c,d)
		local max = math.max(a,b,c,d)

		-- 실제 충돌 체크, 가장 가까운 대상 체크
		if min < max_fo and min_fo < max then
			local x_dist = x_charge_speed ~= 0 and math.abs(fo.Bounds.center.x - self.character.Bounds.center.x) - x_extents_sum or 0
			local z_dist = z_charge_speed ~= 0 and math.abs(fo.Bounds.center.z - self.character.Bounds.center.z) - z_extents_sum or 0
			local x_dt = x_dist <= 0 and 0 or x_dist / x_charge_speed
			local z_dt = z_dist <= 0 and 0 or z_dist / z_charge_speed
			crash_time = math.max(x_dt, z_dt)
			if least_crash_time >= 0 then
				if crash_time < least_crash_time then
					least_crash_time = crash_time
					result = i
				end
			else
				least_crash_time = crash_time
				result = i
			end
		end
	until true end

	-- 충돌하는 rock의 인덱스 반환, 없으면 nil
	return result, least_crash_time < 0 and self.charge_duration or least_crash_time
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.charge then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent)) then
		return false
	end

	local blocker = e.Blocker
	if blocker == nil then
		return false
	end

	local blocker_type = blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType()
	if not (blocker_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) or
			blocker_type == typeof(CS.Oak.OneWayGateCrashBehaviour)) then
		return false
	end

	-- 충돌 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('crash', nil)
	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

	local collision_rock_index = -1
	for i, rock in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(blocker, rock.vfo) then
			collision_rock_index = i
			break
		end
	end

	if collision_rock_index > 0 then
		self:on_crash_rock(collision_rock_index)
	else
		self:on_crash_wall()
	end

	self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_crash_rock(collision_rock_index)
	local rock = self.rock_list[collision_rock_index]
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(rock.x0z_position, self.explosion_radius, 4)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do repeat
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end

		local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - rock.x0z_position).normalized
		local knock_direction = direction

		if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.rock_crash_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction

		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	until true end
	objects:Dispose()

	-- rock 파괴
	rock:deactivate(true)

	-- 그로기
	self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
end

function local_class:on_crash_wall()
	--- 싱크 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	--- 발사 방향 싱크
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		return
	end

	local direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		local position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		self.character.Position = position
		self.charge_direction = direction
		self.target = target

		self.move_start_pos = position
		self.target_pos = position + direction * self.charge_distance

		if self.show_target_arrow then
			coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
		end

		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	else
		local y_offset = self.character.Bounds.extents.y - 0.35
		self.wall_shoot_helper:ShootDirection(direction, y_offset * unity_class.vector3.down, 1, 0)

		self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == 1 then
		if self.wall_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.wall_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		end
	else
		if self.rock_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.rock_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none or self.current_state > self.state.unburrow then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Subject) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
		self.target = e.Target
		--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
		if self.show_target_arrow then
			coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_target_pos(target)
	local t = target and target or self.target
	local target_pos = unity_class.vector3(t.Position.x, t.Position.y, t.Position.z)
	local zone_center = self.constraint_bound.center
	local extent_x = self.constraint_bound.extents.x
	local extent_z = self.constraint_bound.extents.z
	if target_pos.x > zone_center.x + extent_x then
		target_pos.x = zone_center.x + extent_x
	elseif target_pos.x < zone_center.x - extent_x then
		target_pos.x = zone_center.x - extent_x
	end
	if target_pos.z > zone_center.z + extent_z then
		target_pos.z = zone_center.z + extent_z
	elseif target_pos.z < zone_center.z - extent_z then
		target_pos.z = zone_center.z - extent_z
	end
	return target_pos
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.rock_list ~= nil then
		if self.rock_list then
			for i,v in ipairs(self.rock_list) do
				v:dispose()
				self.rock_list[i] = nil
			end
			self.rock_list = nil
		end
	end
	rock_class:unset_params()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
