		return
	end

	self.target = target
	local poses = info.Positions
	self.charge_count = 0

	self.rock_fall_positions = {}
	self.rock_attack_ranges = {}
	for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
		table.insert(self.rock_fall_positions, poses[i])
	end
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local new_field_object = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		new_field_object.Name = 'BossGraboidRock_' .. i
		new_field_object.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3(1.75, 2, 1.55))
		new_field_object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		new_field_object.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		new_field_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		table.insert(self.rock_field_objects, new_field_object)

		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, 1.5, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.rock_attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
end

function local_class:update_rock_field_object(dt)
	if self.rock_update then
		self.rock_update_time = self.rock_update_time + dt

		if self.rock_update_time < self.interval_duration then
			local progress = self.rock_update_time / self.interval_duration
			local current_height = (1 - progress * progress) * 10.0
			for i,v in ipairs(self.rock_fall_positions) do
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.rock_objects[i],
						v + current_height * unity_class.vector3.up, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		else
			self.rock_update = false

			for i,pos in ipairs(self.rock_fall_positions) do
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(pos, 1.5, 3.5)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized
						local knock_direction = direction

						if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
							knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
						end

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = direction
						damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()

				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.rock_objects[i],
						pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shockWave', pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.rock_field_objects[i].Position = pos
				self.rock_field_objects[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('rock', pos)

				self.rock_attack_ranges[i]:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.rock_attack_ranges[i]))
				self.rock_attack_ranges[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_rock_field_object(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.underground)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		if self.time_passed > self.move_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.burrow_move_speed * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.current_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.charge_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.current_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

						self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
					local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
					for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
						local fo = objects[index]

						if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					local knock_direction = direction

					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = self.current_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			if self.charge_count < self.charge_count_total then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if not self.shot_complete then
			self.shot_complete = true

			local shoot_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			local y_offset = self.character.Bounds.extents.y - 0.35
			self.wall_shoot_helper:ShootDirection(shoot_dir, y_offset * unity_class.vector3.down, 1, 0)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.wait_after_shoot_duration then
			if self.charge_count < self.charge_count_total then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			if self.charge_count < self.charge_count_total then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if next_state ~= self.state.underground then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		-- 이펙트 제거
		if self.move_effect ~= nil then
			self.move_effect:Dispose()
			self.move_effect = nil
		end
		-- 비헤이비어 복구
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty('Instance',
						CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		-- 취소 되었다면 일반 돌출 애니메이션
		if next_state ~= self.state.interval then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('out2')
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

			if self.collision_checked then
				self.collision_checked = nil
				self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.collision_checked then
			self.collision_checked = nil
			self.rock_explosion_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('in')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('in', nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.underground then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('move', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 데미지 및 충돌 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.battle_zone.center - self.character.Position)
		local distance = diff.magnitude
		self.direction = diff.normalized
		self.move_duration = distance / self.burrow_move_speed
	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('out')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('out', nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('out', self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 튀어 나오는 위치에 데미지 줌
		local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.charge_width, 4)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects.Values[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		self.rock_update = true;
		self.rock_update_time = 0
		stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

		for i,v in ipairs(self.rock_fall_positions) do
			local attack_range = self.rock_attack_ranges[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, v)
			battle_range_util.show(attack_range, self.interval_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))

			local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('rock', v + 10 * unity_class.vector3.up, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			table.insert(self.rock_objects, fx)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.current_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.current_direction)
		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', nil)

		--- 돌 충돌 체크
		self.collision_checked = nil
		local distance = -1
		local prev_distance = -1
		local move_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Bounds.center + self.current_direction * 0.5 * self.charge_distance,
				self.character.Bounds.size + self.charge_distance * unity_class.vector3
				(math.abs(self.current_direction.x), math.abs(self.current_direction.y), math.abs(self.current_direction.z)))
		for i,fo in pairs(self.rock_field_objects) do
			if move_bound:Intersects(fo.Bounds) then
				local perp_vector = unity_class.vector3(self.current_direction.z, self.current_direction.y, -self.current_direction.x)

				local a,b,c,d = perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.min.z,
								perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.max.z,
								perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.min.z,
								perp_vector.x * fo.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * fo.Bounds.max.z
				local min_fo = math.min(a,b,c,d)
				local max_fo = math.max(a,b,c,d)
				a,b,c,d = perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.min.z,
						perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.min.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.max.z,
						perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.min.z,
						perp_vector.x * self.character.Bounds.max.x + perp_vector.z * self.character.Bounds.max.z
				local min = math.min(a,b,c,d)
				local max = math.max(a,b,c,d)

				if min < max_fo and min_fo < max then
					prev_distance = distance
					distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, fo.Position)
					if prev_distance >= 0 then
						if distance < prev_distance then
							self.collision_checked = i
						end
					else
						self.collision_checked = i
					end
				end
			end
		end

		--- 충돌할 돌 폭발 범위 표시
		if self.collision_checked then
			local fo = self.rock_field_objects[self.collision_checked]
			distance = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, fo.Position)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.rock_explosion_range, fo.Position)
			self.rock_explosion_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.charge_duration * distance / self.charge_distance - 0.1)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.rock_explosion_range))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('spin')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spin', nil)
		self.charge_count = self.charge_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		for i,v in pairs(self.rock_field_objects) do
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', v.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			self.rock_field_objects[i] = nil

			self.rock_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(v.Position, unity_class.vector3(0,0,-1), 2, 0, nil, false)
		end
		for i,v in pairs(self.rock_objects) do
			v:Dispose()
			self.rock_objects[i] = nil
		end
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.rock_update = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					-- 충돌 이펙트
					-- self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('crash', blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Position), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('crash', nil)
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

					for i,v in pairs(self.rock_field_objects) do
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(blocker, v) then
							local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.rock_field_objects[i].Position, self.explosion_radius, 4)
							for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
								local fo = objects.Values[index]

								-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
								if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

									local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
									local knock_direction = direction

									if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
										knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
									end

									local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
									damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
									damage_info.sender = self.character
									damage_info.target = fo
									damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
									damage_info.direction = direction
									damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
									damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
									damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

									command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
								end
							end
							objects:Dispose()

							self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', v.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
							v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
							table.remove(self.rock_field_objects, i)
							self.rock_objects[i]:Dispose()
							table.remove(self.rock_objects, i)
							self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
							return
						end
					end

					self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == 1 then
		if self.wall_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.wall_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		end
	else
		if self.rock_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.rock_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.rock_fall_positions ~= nil then
		for i in ipairs(self.rock_fall_positions) do
			self.rock_fall_positions[i] = nil
		end
		self.rock_fall_positions = nil
	end

	if self.rock_attack_ranges ~= nil then
		for i in ipairs(self.rock_attack_ranges) do
			self.rock_attack_ranges[i]:Hide()
			self.rock_attack_ranges[i] = nil
		end
		self.rock_attack_ranges = nil
	end

	for i,v in pairs(self.rock_field_objects) do
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', v.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		self.rock_field_objects[i] = nil
	end

	for i,v in pairs(self.rock_objects) do
		v:Dispose()
		self.rock_objects[i] = nil
	end

	self.target = nil
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()

function local_class:is_loaded()

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()

function local_class:start(info)

	if target == nil then

	self.start_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.target = target

function local_class:cancel()
	for _,v in pairs(self.shot_ranges) do
		self:return_shot_range(v)
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		-- 다음 스테이트가 잠복 상태가 아니면 어택레인지 뿌린것 꺼주고 애니메이션 끔
		if next_state ~= self.state.underground then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		self.speed_to_use = nil
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		-- 이펙트 제거
		if self.move_effect ~= nil then
			self.move_effect:Dispose()
			self.move_effect = nil
		end

		-- 지하에서 나올 때 비헤이비어 복원
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty("Instance",
						CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		-- pop 상태로 넘어가는게 아니라면 out2 애니메이션으로 바꿔줌
		if next_state ~= self.state.pop then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out2")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.loop_sound_holder ~= nil then
			self.loop_sound_holder:Stop()
			self.loop_sound_holder = nil
		end
		-- 크래시 비헤이비어 다시 복원
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.cannon_timer = nil
		self.cannon_count = nil
		self.directional_timer = nil
		self.directional_count = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("in")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("in", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.underground then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("move", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 지하에 들어갈 때 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		-- 거리 / 속도 계산
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_position - self.character.Position).magnitude
		local est_time = diff / self.move_speed
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.start_position)
		if est_time < self.min_underground_time then
			self.speed_to_use = math.max(diff / self.min_underground_time, self.min_speed_to_use)
			self.attack_range:Show(self.min_underground_time)
		else
			self.speed_to_use = self.move_speed
			self.attack_range:Show(est_time)
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.pop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("out", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("out", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		-- 튀어 나올때 데미지
		self:pop_damage()
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 회전 중에 크래시 비헤이비어 변경
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("spin")
		self.loop_sound_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("spin", nil)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer_mod
		self.cannon_count = 0
		self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer_mod
		self.directional_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("finish")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:pop_damage()
	-- 튀어 나오는 위치에 데미지 줌
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.start_position, self.attack_radius, 4)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 2000

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:crash_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		-- 버로우 완료 시 지하 이동 상태로 전환
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.underground)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		-- 지하에서 목표 위치로 이동. 완료시 돌출 상태로 전환
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_position - self.character.Position)

		if diff:IsAlmostZero() then
			if self.time_passed >= self.min_underground_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.pop)
			end
		else
			local direction = diff.normalized
			local remain_distance = diff.magnitude
			local to_be_move = self.speed_to_use * dt

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = direction
			move_info.magnitude = unity_class.mathf.Min(remain_distance, to_be_move)

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			if self.time_passed >= self.min_underground_time and to_be_move >= remain_distance then
				self:change_state(self.state.pop)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.pop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 대상 따라다니면서 이동
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		local direction = diff.normalized

		if not direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			local remain_distance = diff.magnitude
			local to_be_move = self.follow_speed * dt

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = direction
			move_info.magnitude = unity_class.mathf.Min(remain_distance, to_be_move)

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end

		-- 충돌 데미지
		self:crash_damage(dt)

		-- 투사체 발사
		if self.cannon_count < self.cannon_max_shot then
			self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer + dt
			if self.cannon_timer >= self.cannon_interval then
				self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer - self.cannon_interval

				-- 모든 적에게 발사
				local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
				if targets ~= nil then
					for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
						-- FIXME: Sync command로 position 지정해서 쏘는게 바람직
						self.cannon_shoot_helper:ShootTargetObject(targets[index], unity_class.vector3.zero, index, false, 0)
						local pos = targets[index].Position
						local range = self:get_shot_range()
						local dist = (pos - self.character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
						local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed
						battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
						battle_range_util.show(range, land_time)
						self.shot_ranges[index] = range
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
					end
					targets:Dispose()
				end

				self.cannon_count = self.cannon_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.directional_count < self.directional_max_shot then
			self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer + dt
			if self.directional_timer >= self.directional_interval then
				self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer - self.directional_interval

				-- 방향 돌려가며 발사
				local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.directional_count * self.directional_shot_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
				-- 키가 높아서 투사체가 안맞음. 높이 조정 (기본 높이와 내 바운드 extents 의 차만큼 내려야 함)
				local y_offset = self.character.Bounds.extents.y - 0.35
				self.directional_shoot_helper:ShootDirection(dir, y_offset * unity_class.vector3.down, -1, -1, nil, false, 0)

				self.directional_count = self.directional_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_shot_range()
	if #self.range_pool > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.range_pool)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.aoe_spec.radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_shot_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.range_pool ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.range_pool, range)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.force_canceled = true
	self:cancel()

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.force_canceled then return end

	local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- 강제 취소 이후엔 무시
	if self.force_canceled then return true end

	if label >= 0 then
		-- 라벨 붙은 것은 곡사. 데미지 처리 및 장판 생성을 위한 싱크
		if self.cannon_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.cannon_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

			local pos = hit_info.position
			pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)

function local_class:is_loaded()

		return false
	end

	if self.directional_shoot_helper ~= nil and not self.directional_shoot_helper:IsLoaded() then

	end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local center_pos = self.zone_bound.center
	center_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(center_pos):GetHeightAt(center_pos)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, center_pos, nil, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.start_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.force_canceled = false

	self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	for _,v in pairs(self.shot_ranges) do
		self:return_shot_range(v)
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		-- 다음 스테이트가 잠복 상태가 아니면 어택레인지 뿌린것 꺼주고 애니메이션 끔
		if next_state ~= self.state.underground then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
			battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		self.speed_to_use = nil
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)

		-- 이펙트 제거
		if self.move_effect ~= nil then
			self.move_effect:Dispose()
			self.move_effect = nil
		end

		-- 지하에서 나올 때 비헤이비어 복원
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
				self.death_type = nil
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty("Instance",
						CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		-- pop 상태로 넘어가는게 아니라면 out2 애니메이션으로 바꿔줌
		if next_state ~= self.state.pop then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out2")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.loop_sound_holder ~= nil then
			self.loop_sound_holder:Stop()
			self.loop_sound_holder = nil
		end
		-- 크래시 비헤이비어 다시 복원
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.cannon_timer = nil
		self.cannon_count = nil
		self.directional_timer = nil
		self.directional_count = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("in")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("in", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.underground then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("move", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 지하에 들어갈 때 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		-- 거리 / 속도 계산
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_position - self.character.Position).magnitude
		local est_time = diff / self.move_speed
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.start_position, self.start_position.y)
		if est_time < self.min_underground_time then
			self.speed_to_use = math.max(diff / self.min_underground_time, self.min_speed_to_use)
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.min_underground_time)
		else
			self.speed_to_use = self.move_speed
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, est_time)
		end
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
	elseif next_state == self.state.pop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("out", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("out", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		-- 튀어 나올때 데미지
		self:pop_damage()
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 회전 중에 크래시 비헤이비어 변경
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("spin")
		self.loop_sound_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("spin", nil)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer_mod
		self.cannon_count = 0
		self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer_mod
		self.directional_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("finish")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:pop_damage()
	-- 튀어 나오는 위치에 데미지 줌
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.start_position, self.attack_radius, 4)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 2000

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:crash_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		-- 버로우 완료 시 지하 이동 상태로 전환
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.underground)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		-- 지하에서 목표 위치로 이동. 완료시 돌출 상태로 전환
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_position - self.character.Position)

		if diff:IsAlmostZero() then
			if self.time_passed >= self.min_underground_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.pop)
			end
		else
			local direction = diff.normalized
			local remain_distance = diff.magnitude
			local to_be_move = self.speed_to_use * dt

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = direction
			move_info.magnitude = unity_class.mathf.Min(remain_distance, to_be_move)

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			if self.time_passed >= self.min_underground_time and to_be_move >= remain_distance then
				self:change_state(self.state.pop)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.pop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

		-- 이동 싱크
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		local direction = diff.normalized
		if not direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			local remain_distance = diff.magnitude
			local to_be_move = self.follow_speed * dt

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = direction
			move_info.magnitude = unity_class.mathf.Min(remain_distance, to_be_move)

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.character.Position)

		-- 충돌 데미지
		self:crash_damage(dt)

		-- 투사체 발사
		if self.cannon_count < self.cannon_max_shot then
			self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer + dt
			if self.cannon_timer >= self.cannon_interval then
				self.cannon_timer = self.cannon_timer - self.cannon_interval

				-- 모든 적에게 발사
				local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
				if targets ~= nil then
					for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
						local pos = targets[index].Position
						trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)
					end
					targets:Dispose()
				end

				self.cannon_count = self.cannon_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.directional_count < self.directional_max_shot then
			self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer + dt
			if self.directional_timer >= self.directional_interval then
				self.directional_timer = self.directional_timer - self.directional_interval

				-- 방향 돌려가며 발사
				local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.directional_count * self.directional_shot_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
				trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir)

				self.directional_count = self.directional_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, 1)
		else
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, 0)
		end

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	else

		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_shot_range(range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, range)
	range:Hide()

	if self.range_pool ~= nil then

	end

function local_class:force_cancel()

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.force_canceled then return end

	if not trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) or not trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		return
	end

	local label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 0)

	if label == 2 then
		local pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)
		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, pos, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec)
	else
		local poses = info.Positions
		local current_pos = poses[0]
		self.character.Position = current_pos

		if poses.Count > 1 then
			for i = 1, poses.Count - 1 do
				local pos = poses[i]
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(pos - current_pos)
				local dist = diff.magnitude
				local direction = diff.normalized
				self.cannon_shoot_helper:SingleShoot(current_pos, direction, dist + 0.5, i, nil, false)

				local range = self:get_shot_range()
				local land_time = dist / self.projectile_speed

				range:Show(land_time)
				self.shot_ranges[i] = range
				battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, range)
			end
		end

		if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
			local directions = info.Directions
			for i = 1, directions.Count do
				local dir = directions[i - 1]
				-- 키가 높아서 투사체가 안맞음. 높이 조정 (기본 높이와 내 바운드 extents 의 차만큼 내려야 함)
				local y_offset = self.character.Bounds.extents.y - 0.35
				self.directional_shoot_helper:ShootDirection(dir, y_offset * unity_class.vector3.down, -1, -1, nil, false, 0)
			end
		end

		if label == 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	-- 강제 취소 이후엔 무시
	if self.force_canceled then return true end

	if label >= 0 then
		-- 라벨 붙은 것은 곡사. 데미지 처리 및 장판 생성을 위한 싱크
		if self.cannon_shoot_helper ~= nil then
			self.cannon_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)

			local pos = hit_info.position
			pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)

			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, 2)
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		end
		self:return_shot_range(self.shot_ranges[label])
	else
		-- 라벨 안붙은 것은 직사. 단순 데미지 처리
		if self.directional_shoot_helper ~= nil then

		end
	end

	-- action state 중에 폭탄 데미지 받았을 시 중지
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then

	self.cannon_interval = nil

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		-- 취소됐다면 애니메이션 끔
		if next_state ~= self.state.underground then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out2")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되었다면 일반 돌출 애니메이션
		if next_state ~= self.state.attack then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out2")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.target = nil
		self.shot_complete = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("in")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("in", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.underground then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("move", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 데미지 및 충돌 비헤이비어 변경
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack then

		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("out", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("out", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.attack_radius, 4)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo

				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then

	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.underground)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		-- 대상 따라다니다가 거리가 충분히 가깝다면 다음 상태로
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

		if diff.magnitude < 0.15 then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			local direction = diff.normalized

			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.move_speed * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then

			end
		end

		-- 공격 시간 완료 후 종료
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_delay then
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.attack then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out2")
			self:reset_behaviour()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.target = nil
		self.shot_complete = nil
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self:reset_behaviour()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration + self.burrow_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.burrow then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("in")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("in", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.underground then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 지하 이펙트
		self.move_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("move", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		-- 데미지 및 충돌 비헤이비어 변경
		self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		end
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.SpineController:SetShadowAlpha(0)

		-- 타겟 확정
		local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.character.Position.y)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_delay))
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("out")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("out", nil)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("out", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 튀어 나오는 위치에 데미지 줌
		local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Position, self.attack_radius, 4)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects.Values[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:reset_behaviour()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.time_passed = 0
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 스테이트 별 업데이트

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.burrow)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.burrow then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
		if self.time_passed >= self.burrow_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.underground)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.underground then
		-- 싱크 대기
		if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			return
		end

		local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		if dist < self.attack_trigger_dist then
			local next_pos = self.target.Position
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, next_pos)
		else
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir)
			trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, math.min(dist, self.move_speed * dt))
		end

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true

			for index = 1, self.shot_num do
				local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 360 * index / self.shot_num, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
				local target_position = self.character.Position + self.shot_distance * dir
				self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(target_position, unity_class.vector3.zero, index, nil, false)
			end
		end

		-- 공격 시간 완료 후 종료
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_target(info) then
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)

		if self.show_target_arrow and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, target)
		end
		self.target = target
	elseif trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		local direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		local magnitude = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = direction
		move_info.magnitude = magnitude

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position, self.target.Position.y)
	else
		local end_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.character.Position = end_pos
		self:change_state(self.state.attack_delay)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state > self.state.burrow then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Subject) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
		self.target = e.Target
		--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
		if self.show_target_arrow then
			coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.burrow_duration = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.move_speed = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.shoot_timing = nil
	self.shot_num = nil
	self.shot_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossHarvesterBounceBallRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		prepare = 1,
		shoot = 2
	}

	self.prepare_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareTime", 0)
	self.firing_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FiringTime", 0.4)
	self.bullet_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "BulletAmount", 6)
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTiming", 0)

	self.shoot_timing = math.min(self.firing_time, self.shoot_timing)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "harvester_bounce_ball")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	--self.remove_projectile = {}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	return self.shoot_helper:IsHittable(target)
end

function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd);

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.prepare_time <= 0 then
		self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.prepare_time > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot = nil
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.prepare_time > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_time))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot = false
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--if #self.remove_projectile > 0 then
	--	for k,v in pairs(self.remove_projectile) do
	--		v:Deactive()
	--		table.remove(self.remove_projectile, k) -- TODO: 임시
	--	end
	--end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if not self.shoot then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
				self.shoot = true

				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("02_harvester_shoot_01")

				local circle_shoot_spread_angle = 360 / self.bullet_amount
				for i = 0, self.bullet_amount - 1 do
					local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(i * circle_shoot_spread_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.back
					self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.35, 0), rot_dir.normalized, math.floor(unity_class.time.time * 10) + i)
				end
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.firing_time then
			self:change_state()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	--local projectile = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(label)
	--table.insert(self.remove_projectile, projectile)

	return true
end

	--return bool
end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	--self.remove_projectile = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
