		vector(0, 0, 2),
		vector(0, 0, -2)
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bounds = bound

	local center = self.zone_bounds.center
	local modX = self.zone_bounds.size.x / 3
	local modZ = self.zone_bounds.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, self.zone_bounds.size.y, modZ)

	--순간이동 위치 지정
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	--1,2번은 중앙위, 중앙아래
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size).center)
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size).center)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local hittable = self.shoot_helper:IsHittable(target)

	return hittable
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.teleport_index = 1
	self.main_shot_info_list = {}
	self.current_main_shot_index = 1
	self.is_center_move_finish = false
	self.target = target
	self.teleport_finish = false
	self.random_index = 0
	self.start_aoe_sfx = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.explosion_info_list = nil

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_Range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
					self.character, v))
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.sub_shot_attack_range_list) do
		for _,v2 in pairs(v) do
			if not is_unity_null(v2) then
				v2:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
						self.character, v2))
			end
		end
	end

	--캔슬 될 경우 main, sub모두 폭발 후 삭제
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if not v.is_hit then
			self:explosion_mine(v)
			v.is_hit = true
		end

		if v.shot_effect ~= nil then
			v.shot_effect:Dispose()
			v.shot_effect = nil
		end

		for _,v2 in pairs(v.sub_shot_info_list) do
			if not v2.is_hit then
				self:explosion_mine(v2)
				v2.is_hit = true
			end

			if v2.shot_effect ~= nil then
				v2.shot_effect:Dispose()
				v2.shot_effect = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if self.aoe_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aoe_sfx:Stop()
		self.aoe_sfx = nil
	end
	self.start_aoe_sfx = false

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.proj then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_teleport_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_Range_list[self.current_main_shot_index]:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
		self.attack_Range_list[self.current_main_shot_index]))

		for _,v in pairs(self.sub_shot_attack_range_list[self.current_main_shot_index]) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
	elseif next_state == self.state.proj then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot_proj")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot_proj", nil)
		self:shoot_proj()
	elseif next_state == self.state.random_teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
		self.teleport_finish = false
		if not self.is_static_teleport then
			self.random_teleport_position = self:get_random_teleport_position()
		else
			-- 순차 텔레포트 위치로
			self.random_teleport_position = self.teleport_markers[self.teleport_index]
			self.teleport_index = self.teleport_index + 1
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.random_teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.random_teleport_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		local target_pos = self:check_overlap_main_shot(self.target.Position)
		self.target_pos = target_pos
		self.sub_shot_pos_list = {}
		for i = 0, self.sub_shot_count - 1 do
			local random_pos = self:get_sub_shot_position_for_zone_bounds(target_pos, i)
			if i == 1 then
				local diff = self.sub_shot_pos_list[1] - random_pos
				if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < 0.7 then
					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bounds.center - random_pos).normalized
					random_pos = random_pos + (dir * 1.2)
					random_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(random_pos, battle_util.get_height(random_pos) + 0.2)
				end
			end
			table.insert(self.sub_shot_pos_list, random_pos)
		end
		local ar = self.attack_Range_list[self.current_main_shot_index]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.main_shot_prepare_duration)

		for i = 1, self.sub_shot_count do
			local sub_ar = self.sub_shot_attack_range_list[self.current_main_shot_index][i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(sub_ar, self.sub_shot_pos_list[i])
			battle_range_util.show(sub_ar, self.main_shot_prepare_duration)
			if (self.is_risk_map_on) then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, sub_ar))
			end
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("main_shot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("main_shot_prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_main_shot()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("main_shot")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("main_shot", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.main_shot_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("teleport")
		local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("teleport_start")
		if has_value then
			sfx_info.parent = nil
			music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		end
		self.is_teleport_effect = false
		self.teleport_finish = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion_prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
			local diff = self.character.Position - v.current_pos
			v.dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.zone_bounds.center, battle_util.get_height(self.zone_bounds.center) + 0.2)
			v.start_pos = v.current_pos
			v.diff = diff
			v.life_time = diff.magnitude / self.main_shot_speed_to_center
			v.progress_time = 0
			v.aoe_count = 0
			v.is_aoe_move_finish = false
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
			for _,v2 in pairs(v.sub_shot_info_list) do
				self:explosion_mine(v2)
			end
		end
		self:sub_shot_aoe_start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		--state none
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_random_teleport_position()
	local diff = 0
	local target_pos

	--target의 position이 center반경 x일 경우 3,4,5,6번중 랜덤
	local center_diff = (self.zone_bounds.center - self.target.Position).magnitude
	if 1 > math.abs(center_diff) then
		if self.random_index == 0 then
			self.random_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(3, 6))
			return self.sliced_zone_bounds[self.random_index]
		else
			local random_idx_list = {}
			for i = 3, 6 do
				if i ~= self.random_index then
					table.insert(random_idx_list, i)
				end
			end
			local select_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(1, 3))
			self.random_index = random_idx_list[select_index]
			return self.sliced_zone_bounds[self.random_index]
		end
	end

	--현재 target의 position과 가장 먼곳을 찾는다.
	for _,v in pairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		local mag = (v - self.target.Position).magnitude
		if math.abs(mag) > diff then
			diff = mag
			target_pos = v
		end
	end

	--self.random_index = 0
	return target_pos
end

function local_class:shoot_proj()
	for i = 1, self.proj_shot_amount do
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 360 - (360 / self.proj_shot_amount) * i, 0) * unity_class.vector3.left
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirection(dir, vector(0, -0.5, 0), 0, 0, nil, false)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_main_shot(target_pos)
	--main은 target위치로 발사 sub는 main반경 2거리에 중복되지 않도록 랜덤 발사
	--main이 이전 main과 겹치면 x축 +-1 위치에 랜덤 생성
	if self.current_main_shot_index + 1 <= self.main_shot_repeat_count then
		self.current_main_shot_index = self.current_main_shot_index + 1
	else
		self.current_main_shot_index = 4
	end

	local target_pos = self.target_pos
	local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset

	local sub_shot_info = {}
	for i = 1, self.sub_shot_count do
		table.insert(sub_shot_info, {
			start_pos = start_pos,
			dest_pos = self.sub_shot_pos_list[i],
			progress_time = 0,
			diff = self.sub_shot_pos_list[i] - start_pos,
			hit_radius = self.sub_shot_radius,
			life_time = (self.sub_shot_pos_list[i] - start_pos).magnitude / self.main_shot_speed,
			is_active = true,
			is_hit = false,
			is_move_finish = false,
			is_mine_ready = false,
			damage_modifier = self.sub_shot_damage_modifire,
			effect_key_name = "sub_shot_explosion",
			shot_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("sub_shot", start_pos)
		})
	end

	local main_shot_diff = target_pos - start_pos


		local info = {
			start_pos = start_pos,
			dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, battle_util.get_height(target_pos) + 0.2),
			current_pos = start_pos,
			progress_time = 0,
			diff = main_shot_diff,
			hit_radius = self.main_shot_radius,
			life_time = main_shot_diff.magnitude / self.main_shot_speed,
			is_active = true,
			is_hit = false,
			is_move_finish = false,
			is_mine_ready = false,
			damage_modifier = self.main_shot_damage_modifire,
			effect_key_name = "main_shot_explosion",
			shot_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("main_shot", start_pos),
			sub_shot_info_list = sub_shot_info
		}

	table.insert(self.main_shot_info_list, info)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shooting_main_shot, self, info, true))
	for _,v in pairs(info.sub_shot_info_list) do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shooting_main_shot, self, v, false))
	end
end

function local_class:check_overlap_main_shot(target_pos)
	--좌우 먼저 체크 후 그래도 겹친다면 상하까지 체크해서 최종 pos를 리턴
	target_pos = self:get_position_for_zone_bounds(target_pos)
	local check_pos = target_pos

	--main shot overlap check
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local diff = check_pos - v.dest_pos
			if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < self.main_shot_check_range then
				for _,v2 in pairs(self.main_shot_overlap_offset) do
					check_pos = self:get_position_for_zone_bounds(target_pos + v2)
					if self:check_overlap_position(check_pos) and self:check_zone_bounds(check_pos) then
						return check_pos
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return check_pos
end

function local_class:check_overlap_position(pos)
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local diff = pos - v.dest_pos
			if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < self.main_shot_check_range then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:get_position_for_zone_bounds(pos)
	local result_pos = pos
	if pos.x < self.zone_bounds.min.x + 1 then
		result_pos.x = self.zone_bounds.min.x + self.main_shot_radius * 1.2
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x - 1 then
		result_pos.x = self.zone_bounds.max.x - self.main_shot_radius * 1.2
	end

	if pos.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z + 1 then
		result_pos.z = self.zone_bounds.min.z + self.main_shot_radius * 1.2
	elseif pos.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z - 1 then
		result_pos.z = self.zone_bounds.max.z - self.main_shot_radius * 1.2
	end

	return result_pos
end

function local_class:get_sub_shot_position_for_zone_bounds(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / self.sub_shot_count
	local range = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 30, shot_area_angle * (index + 1))

	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, range, 0)
			* unity_class.vector3.right * self.sub_shot_range

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bounds.min.x + 1 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x - 1 then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z + 1 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z - 1 then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	return random_pos
end

function local_class:check_zone_bounds(pos)
	if pos.x < self.zone_bounds.min.x + 1 then
		return false
	elseif pos.x > self.zone_bounds.max.x - 1 then
		return false
	end

	if pos.z < self.zone_bounds.min.z + 1 then
		return false
	elseif pos.z > self.zone_bounds.max.z - 1 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:check_target()

	if self.start_aoe_sfx then
		self:aoe_sfx_update(dt)
	end

	if self.main_shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_mine(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.proj)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.proj then
		if self.time_passed >= self.proj_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.random_teleport_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.random_teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.is_teleport_effect = true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.random_teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
			if not self.teleport_finish then
				self.teleport_finish = true
				self.character.Position = self.random_teleport_position
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.main_shot_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.main_shot)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_action_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.main_shot_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.main_shot_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.main_shot_interval then
			if self.current_main_shot_index <= self.main_shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.random_teleport_prepare)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.teleport_effect_delay and not self.is_teleport_effect then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then

				self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bounds.center)

				    .transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
				character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
				self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:move_main_shot(dt)

			if self:is_aoe_move_finish() then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then

end

function local_class:update_mine(dt)
	if self.main_shot_info_list == nil or self.current_state >= self.state.explosion_prepare then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if not v.is_hit and v.is_mine_ready then
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.dest_pos, v.hit_radius)

			for _,v2 in pairs(fo_list) do
				if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v2.EntityGroup) or
						v2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
						lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v2) then
				else
					self:explosion_mine(v)
					v.is_hit = true
				end
			end
			fo_list:Dispose()
		end

		for _,v2 in pairs(v.sub_shot_info_list) do
			if not v2.is_hit and v2.is_mine_ready then
				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v2.dest_pos, v2.hit_radius)

				for _,v3 in pairs(fo_list) do
					if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v3.EntityGroup) or
							v3.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
							lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v3) then
					else
						self:explosion_mine(v2)
						v2.is_hit = true
					end
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:main_shot_aoe_update(v)
	if v.is_active then
		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.dest_pos - v.start_pos).normalized
		local aoe_pos = v.start_pos + (dir * (self.aoe_interval_range * v.aoe_count + (self.main_shot_radius / 2)))

		stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, aoe_pos,
				self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec, nil, nil, nil, self.is_risk_map_on)

		v.aoe_count = v.aoe_count + 1
	end

	if not self.start_aoe_sfx then
		self.aoe_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("aoe")
		self.start_aoe_sfx = true
	end

	self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_spec.duration
end

function local_class:sub_shot_aoe_start()
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		for _,v2 in pairs(v.sub_shot_info_list) do
			if not v2.is_hit then
				stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, v2.dest_pos,
						nil, self.sub_shot_aoe_spec, nil, nil, nil, self.is_risk_map_on)
				local aoe_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("aoe", v2.dest_pos)
				aoe_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shooting_main_shot(info, is_main_shot)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local gravity = 5.5
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(self.main_shot_vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	y_calculator:ScaleTime(self.main_shot_horizontal_speed)
	local land_effect_key = "main_shot_land"
	if not is_main_shot then
		land_effect_key = "sub_shot_land"
	end

	while not info.is_move_finish do
		if not info.is_active or info.is_move_finish == nil then
			return
		elseif y_calculator:IsDone() then
			info.shot_effect.transform.position = info.dest_pos
			info.current_pos = info.dest_pos
			info.is_move_finish = true
			info.is_mine_ready = true
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_land", info.dest_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(land_effect_key, info.dest_pos)
			return
		else
			y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			local progress = y_calculator:GetProgress()
			local move_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - progress) + info.dest_pos * progress
			move_pos.y = y_calculator:GetDistance() + info.dest_pos.y
			info.shot_effect.transform.position = move_pos
			info.current_pos = move_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_main_shot_move(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and not v.is_move_finish then
			if v.progress_time <= v.life_time then
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				v.shot_effect.transform.position = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.life_time * v.diff
				v.current_pos = v.shot_effect.transform.position
			else
				v.shot_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos
				v.current_pos = v.dest_pos
				v.is_move_finish = true
				v.is_mine_ready = true
			end
		end
		for _,v2 in pairs(v.sub_shot_info_list) do
			if v2.is_active and not v2.is_move_finish then
				if v2.progress_time <= v2.life_time then
					v2.progress_time = v2.progress_time + dt
					v2.shot_effect.transform.position = v2.start_pos + v2.progress_time / v2.life_time * v2.diff
					v2.current_pos = v2.shot_effect.transform.position
				else
					v2.shot_effect.transform.position = v2.dest_pos
					v2.current_pos = v2.dest_pos
					v2.is_move_finish = true
					v2.is_mine_ready = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_main_shot(dt)
	--main shot은 보스를 향해 이동하며 aoe생성
	--이동
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and not v.is_aoe_move_finish then
			v.is_hit = true
			if v.progress_time <= v.life_time then
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				v.current_pos = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.life_time * v.diff
				v.shot_effect.transform.position = v.current_pos
				local diff = v.current_pos - v.start_pos
				if math.abs(diff.magnitude) > self.aoe_interval_range * v.aoe_count + (self.main_shot_radius / 2) then
					self:main_shot_aoe_update(v)
				end
			else
				v.shot_effect.transform.position = v.dest_pos
				v.current_pos = v.dest_pos
				v.is_aoe_move_finish = true
				if v.shot_effect ~= nil then
					v.shot_effect:Dispose()
					v.shot_effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_aoe_move_finish()
	for _,v in pairs(self.main_shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active and not v.is_aoe_move_finish then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:aoe_sfx_update(dt)
	if self.aoe_sfx_duration <= 0 then
		if self.aoe_sfx ~= nil then
			self.aoe_sfx:Stop()
			self.aoe_sfx = nil
		end
		self.start_aoe_sfx = false
	else
		self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_sfx_duration - dt
	end
end

function local_class:explosion_mine(mine_info)
	if mine_info.is_active == false then return end

	--subProjectile들은 현재위치에서 폭발
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(mine_info.dest_pos, mine_info.hit_radius)

	--폭파 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(mine_info.effect_key_name, mine_info.dest_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(mine_info.effect_key_name, mine_info.dest_pos)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else

			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - mine_info.dest_pos).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = mine_info.damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit_shot", nil)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	if not is_unity_null(mine_info.shot_effect) then
		mine_info.shot_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_explosion", nil)
	mine_info.shot_effect = nil
	mine_info.is_active = false
end

function local_class:update_main_shot(dt)
	self:update_main_shot_move(dt)
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.attack_Range_list = nil
	self.sub_shot_attack_range_list = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.sub_shot_pos_list = nil
	self.sub_shot_aoe_spec = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.main_shot_info_list = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.shot_offset = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.main_shot_overlap_offset = nil
	self.random_teleport_position = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossHarvesterSingleRaidChargeBattleAction")

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	--specs
	self.atk_mod = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackModifier", 2)
	self.speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Speed", 30)
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDuration", 0.6)
	self.strike_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StrikeDelay", 0.75)
	self.hit_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HitRadius", 1.0)
	self.spread_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SpreadDistance", 1)
	self.thunder_lines = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MaximumLightningLineCount", 3)
	self.thunders_in_line = math.floor(self.charge_duration * self.speed / self.spread_distance) + 1
	--attack_range
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.thunder_lines * self.thunders_in_line do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.hit_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward))
		self.attack_range_list[i]:Hide();
	end

	--key
	self.rush_key = 'rush'
	self.thunder_key = 'thunder'
	self.shoot_key = 'shoot'

	self.shadow_transform = self.character.Transform:Find("shadow")
	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.attack_range_idx = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.origin_pos = nil

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		moving = 2,
		after_moving = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return false
	end

	self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.shadow_transform == nil then
		self.shadow_transform = self.character.Transform:Find("shadow")
	end
	self.current_thunder_count = 0
	self.attack_range_idx = 0
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.origin_pos = self.character.Position
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_dir))

	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.rush_key)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_key)

	self.current_state = self.state.moving

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
	if self.shadow_transform ~= nil then
		self.shadow_transform.localScale = vector_util.one
	end

	for i = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		if self.attack_range_list[i].gameObject.activeSelf then
			self.attack_range_list[i]:Hide()

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[i]))
		end
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed < 0.5 then
		local fly_progress = math.sin(math.pi * self.time_passed)
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.up * fly_progress
		self.shadow_transform.localScale = vector_util.one * math.max(1-fly_progress, 0.4)
	end

	if self.attack_range_idx < self.thunders_in_line and self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration * self.attack_range_idx / self.thunders_in_line then
		self:show_attack_range_use_idx(self.attack_range_idx)
		self.attack_range_idx = self.attack_range_idx + 1
	end

	if self.current_thunder_count < self.thunders_in_line and self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration * self.attack_range_idx / self.thunders_in_line + self.strike_delay then
		self:strike_thunder_use_idx(self.current_thunder_count)
		self.current_thunder_count = self.current_thunder_count + 1
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.moving then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.target_dir
		move_info.magnitude = self.speed * dt

		local atomicMove = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.LockedDirection, false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, atomicMove)

		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self.current_state = self.state.after_moving
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.after_moving then
		if self.current_thunder_count >= self.thunders_in_line then
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
			self.shadow_transform.localScale = vector_util.one
			message_system:SendSync(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action))
			self:cancel()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:show_attack_range_use_idx(idx)
	for i = 0, self.thunder_lines - 1 do
		local current_idx = idx + i * self.thunders_in_line + 1

		local offset = (i- (self.thunder_lines - 1) / 2) * self.spread_distance
		local offset_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, vector_util.up) * self.target_dir
		local breadth_offset = offset * offset_direction

		local ratio = idx * (self.speed * self.charge_duration) / self.thunders_in_line
		local shoot_direction_offset = self.target_dir * ratio

		local create_pos = self.origin_pos + breadth_offset + shoot_direction_offset

		if not self.zone_bound:Contains(create_pos) then
			return
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[current_idx], create_pos)
		self.attack_range_list[current_idx]:Show(self.strike_delay)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[current_idx]))
	end
end


function local_class:strike_thunder_use_idx(idx)

		local offset_direction = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, vector_util.up) * self.target_dir

		if not self.zone_bound:Contains(create_pos) then
			return
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thunder_key, create_pos)

		if idx % 5 == 0 and i == math.floor(self.thunder_lines / 2) then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.thunder_key)
		end

		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(create_pos, self.hit_radius)

		for j = 0, fo_list.Count-1 do
			local fo = fo_list[j]

			if(not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character)) then
				goto continue
			end

			local dmg_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

			dmg_info.convertAttackTo = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Light

			::continue::

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[current_idx]))
	end
end


function local_class:dispose()
	self.shadow_transform = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
			self.charge_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.charge_fx = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.calculator:End()
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
			self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.laser_fx = nil
		self.start_aoe = false
	--elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	--	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')

		self.target_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position.x = self.follow_x_pos
		self.target_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_position)

		if self.target_position.x > self.character.Position.x then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.target_position, vector_util.right)
		else
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.target_position, vector_util.left)
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)


		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.laser_point.position, direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local shot_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.laser_point.position.x, self.target_position.y, self.target_position.z)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('laser', shot_pos)

		self.calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.calculator:Start()
		local laser_position = self.laser_point.position
		laser_position.y = 0
		-- 키값, 위치, 생성방향, 따라다닐 트랜스폼
		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', laser_position, direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			local current_pos_z = self.target_position.z
			local target_pos_z = self.target.Position.z
			local diff_z = math.abs(current_pos_z - target_pos_z)

			local z_result = target_pos_z
			if diff_z > self.tracking_speed * dt then
				if target_pos_z > current_pos_z then
					z_result = current_pos_z + self.tracking_speed * dt
				else
					z_result = current_pos_z - self.tracking_speed * dt
				end
			end

			self.target_position.z = z_result
			local t = self.character.Position
			self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(t.x, t.y, z_result)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 레이저 발사 되며 데미지 입는 대상들 검색해서 데미지
		local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, objects.Count -1 do
			local fo = objects[i]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				if fo.Position.z > self.character.Position.z then
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
				else
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
				end
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration - 0.5 then
			if self.start_aoe == false then
				-- 발사 완료후 장판 깔기
--[[				local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('field')
				if has_value then
					sfx_info.playPosition = self.target_position
					sfx_info.parent = nil
				end]]

				--장판 매니저

				self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = direction_util.to_vector3( vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
				local aoe_position = self.character.Position
				aoe_position.x = self.zone_bounds.center.x
				aoe_position.z = aoe_position.z - 0.25
				stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, aoe_position,
						self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('field'), self.aoe_spec, nil, nil, nil)

				self.start_aoe = true
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			-- TimeLimit로 자동 Dispose 되도록 널로 바꿈
			if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
				self.laser_fx:Dispose()
			end
			if self.laser_fx ~= nil then
				self.laser_fx = nil
			end
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--외부에서 리소스 들고있는것들 해제
function local_class:force_cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
		self.laser_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.laser_fx = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
		self.charge_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.charge_fx = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self:cancel()
end

-- 내부에서 생성한것들 삭제 하고 상태 none 으로 전환
function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	-- 장판 제거
	if not is_unity_null(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager) then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end

	--애니메이션 제거
	--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.tracking_duration = nil
	self.tracking_speed = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.laser_length = nil
	self.laser_width = nil
	self.calculator = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.laser_fx = nil
	self.charge_fx = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.laser_point = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post_single')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post_single')

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare_laser')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare_laser')

		self.target_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position.x = self.follow_x_pos
		self.target_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_position)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.laser_attack_range, self.target_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range))
		self.laser_attack_range:Show(self.laser_prepare_duration)

		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare_laser', self.laser_point.position,
				direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action_laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action_laser')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action_laser')

		local shot_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.character.Position.x, self.target_position.y, self.target_position.z)
	 self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('laser', shot_pos)
		self.calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.calculator:Start()


		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', self.laser_point.position,
				direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)), self.character.transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post_laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post_laser')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post_laser')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:drop_missile(dt)

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_single then
		if self.time_passed >= self.single_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action_single)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_single then
		if self.time_passed >= self.single_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post_single)
		else
			self.single_missile_shot_time = self.single_missile_shot_time + dt
			if self.single_missile_shot_time >= self.single_missile_delay then
				self:shoot_to_manual()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_single then
		if self.time_passed >= self.single_post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_laser)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_laser then

		if self.time_passed >= self.laser_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action_laser)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_laser then

		local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[i]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.laser_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				if fo.Position.z > self.character.Position.z then
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
				else
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
				end
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.laser_knock_back_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed <= self.laser_tracking_duration then
			local current_pos_z = self.target_position.z
			local target_pos_z = self.target.Position.z
			local diff_z = math.abs(current_pos_z - target_pos_z)

			local z_result = target_pos_z
			if diff_z > self.laser_tracking_speed * dt then
				if target_pos_z > current_pos_z then
					z_result = current_pos_z + self.laser_tracking_speed * dt
				else
					z_result = current_pos_z - self.laser_tracking_speed * dt
				end
			end

			self.target_position.z = z_result
			local t = self.character.Position
			self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(t.x, t.y, z_result)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.laser_attack_range, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.laser_action_duration then
			-- 발사 완료후 장판 깔기
			local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('laser_field')
			if has_value then
				sfx_info.playPosition = self.target_position
				sfx_info.parent = nil
			end

			-- TimeLimit로 자동 Dispose 되도록 널로 바꿈
			if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
				self.laser_fx:Dispose()
			end
			self.laser_fx = nil
			--장판 매니저
			self.laser_aoe_spec.rotateDirection = direction_util.to_vector3( vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.character.Position,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('laser_field'), self.laser_aoe_spec, nil,
					sfx_info, nil)

			self:change_state(self.state.post_laser)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.laser_post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

-- 커스텀 함수
function local_class:prepare_missile()
	if self.single_missiles == nil then
		self.single_missiles = {}
	end

	for i = 1, self.single_missile_count do
		local range = self:get_single_attack_range()
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.single_missiles, {
			start_position = nil,
			target_position = nil,
			--이동시간
			move_duration = nil,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_launched = false,
			label = 0,
			attack_range = range
		})
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_to_manual()
	self.single_missile_shot_time = 0
	if self.single_missiles ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.single_missiles do
			if self.single_missiles[i].is_launched == false then
				self.single_missiles[i].is_launched = true
				self.single_missiles[i].start_position = self.missile_point_list[self.missile_point_count % 2 + 1].position
				self.single_missiles[i].target_position = self.target.Position
				self.single_missiles[i].move_duration = (self.target.Position - self.single_missiles[i].start_position).magnitude / self.single_missile_speed - 0.3
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.single_missiles[i].attack_range, self.target.Position)
				self.single_missiles[i].attack_range:Show(self.single_missiles[i].move_duration)
				self.single_missiles[i].label = i
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.single_missiles[i].attack_range))
				--프로젝타일 미사일
				self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(self.target.Position, self.missile_point_list[self.missile_point_count % 2 + 1].localPosition, self.single_missiles[i].label, nil, false)
				self.missile_point_count = self.missile_point_count + 1
				break
			end
		end

		if self.missile_point_count >= self.single_missile_count then
			self.missile_point_count = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:drop_missile(dt)
	if self.single_missiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.single_missiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 발사된 미사일만 계산 함..
			if self.single_missiles[i].is_launched then

				self.single_missiles[i].time_passed =  self.single_missiles[i].time_passed + dt
				local prog = self.single_missiles[i].time_passed / self.single_missiles[i].move_duration
				if prog > 1 then
					prog = 1
				end
				--위치 업데이트 해야 하는데 직선으로 변경됨
				local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.single_missiles[i].start_position, self.single_missiles[i].target_position, prog)
				local dist = calc_pos - self.single_missiles[i].target_position
				if  dist:IsAlmostZero() then
					self:remove_missile(i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_missile(i)
	-- 어택레인지 반환
	self:return_single_attack_range(self.single_missiles[i].attack_range)
	self.single_missiles[i].attack_range = nil
	-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
	table.remove(self.single_missiles, i)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--print('try on hit ', hit_info.position, ' ', hit_info.hitType, ' ', hit_info.target)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		if hit_info.hitType == CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.MapHit then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			-- 장판 생성
			if self.single_aoe_spec ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, hit_info.position, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('missile_field'), self.single_aoe_spec)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('missile_field', hit_info.position)
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

 function local_class:get_single_attack_range()
	if #self.single_attack_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.single_attack_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.single_attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_single_attack_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.single_attack_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.single_attack_ranges, range)
	end
end

-- 취소 및 정리 루틴.
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel_single()
	self:cancel_laser()
	self:cancel_common()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel_common()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	if not is_unity_null(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager) then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel_single()
	if self.single_missiles ~= nil then
		for i = #self.single_missiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_single_attack_range(self.single_missiles[i].attack_range)
			self.single_missiles[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.single_missiles, i)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(self.single_attack_ranges) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel_laser()
	if self.laser_fx ~= nil then
		self.laser_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.laser_fx = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
		self.charge_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.charge_fx = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.laser_attack_range) then
		self.laser_attack_range:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.single_prepare_duration = nil
	self.single_action_duration = nil
	self.single_post_duration = nil
	self.single_attack_range = nil
	self.single_missile_count = nil
	self.single_damage_modifier = nil
	self.single_missile_delay = nil
	self.single_missile_speed = nil
	self.single_aoe_spec = nil
	self.single_missile_shot_time = nil

	self.single_attack_ranges = nil

	self.zone_bounds = nil

	self.laser_damage_modifier = nil
	self.laser_prepare_duration = nil
	self.laser_tracking_duration = nil
	self.laser_tracking_speed = nil
	self.laser_action_duration = nil
	self.laser_post_duration = nil
	self.laser_length = nil
	self.laser_width = nil
	self.calculator = nil
	self.laser_aoe_spec = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then-- 실제 액션 실행 ( 스포트라이트 실행 밎 캐릭터 추적
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then--액션시간이 지나면 종료됨
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self.missile_shot_time = self.missile_shot_time + dt
			if self.missile_shot_time >= self.missile_delay then
				self:shoot_to_manual()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then--뒷정리..
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--미사일 미리 준비함.
function local_class:prepare_missile()
	if self.missiles == nil then
		self.missiles = {}
	end

	for i = 1, self.missile_count do
		local range = self:get_fall_range()
		range:Hide()
		--타격위치
		table.insert(self.missiles, {
			--발사시작 위치
			start_position = nil,
			--목표위치
			target_position = nil,
			--이동시간
			move_duration = nil,
			--발사후 지난시간
			time_passed = 0,
			-- 발사 되었는가
			is_launched = false,
			--미사일 label
			label = 0,
			--발사 레인지 이펙트
			attack_range = range
		})
	end
end

--공중에서 매뉴얼 캐릭터에게 딜레이 시간당 1발씩 떨어트림.
function local_class:shoot_to_manual()
	self.missile_shot_time = 0
	if self.missiles ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.missiles do
			if self.missiles[i].is_launched == false then
				local reposition_direction = self.missile_point_count % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1
				local reposition_vector = vector(1.1, 0, reposition_direction * 0.5)
				self.missiles[i].is_launched = true
				self.missiles[i].start_position = self.missile_point_list[self.missile_point_count % 2 + 1].localPosition + reposition_vector
				self.missiles[i].target_position = self.target.Position
				self.missiles[i].move_duration = (self.target.Position - (self.character.Bounds.center + self.missiles[i].start_position)).magnitude / self.missile_speed
				self.missiles[i].label = i
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.missiles[i].attack_range, self.target.Position)
				battle_range_util.show(self.missiles[i].attack_range, self.missiles[i].move_duration)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.missiles[i].attack_range))
				-- 시작위치, 타겟위치, 레이블, 중간계산?

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shoot', self.missiles[i].start_position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('missile', self.character)
				self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(self.target.Position, self.missiles[i].start_position, self.missiles[i].label, nil, false)
				self.missile_point_count = self.missile_point_count + 1
				break
			end
		end
		if self.missile_point_count >= self.missile_count then
			self.missile_point_count = 0
		end
	end
end

--발사된 미사일 리스트 위치 업데이트
function local_class:drop_missile(dt)
	if self.missiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.missiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 발사된 미사일만 계산 함..
			if self.missiles[i].is_launched then

				self.missiles[i].time_passed =  self.missiles[i].time_passed + dt
				local prog = self.missiles[i].time_passed / self.missiles[i].move_duration
				if prog > 1 then
					prog = 1
				end
					--위치 업데이트 해야 하는데 직선으로 변경됨
				local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.missiles[i].start_position, self.missiles[i].target_position, prog)
				local dist = calc_pos - self.missiles[i].target_position
				if  dist:IsAlmostZero() then
					self:remove_missile(i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_missile(i)
	-- 어택레인지 반환
	self:return_fall_range(self.missiles[i].attack_range)
	self.missiles[i].attack_range = nil
	-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
	table.remove(self.missiles, i)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--print('try on hit ', hit_info.position, ' ', hit_info.hitType, ' ', hit_info.target)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		if hit_info.hitType == CS.Oak.Projectile.HitType.MapHit then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			-- 장판 생성
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', hit_info.position)
			if self.aoe_spec ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, hit_info.position, self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('field'), self.aoe_spec)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('field', hit_info.position)
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:get_fall_range()
	if #self.fall_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.fall_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_range, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_fall_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.fall_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.fall_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()

	if self.missiles ~= nil then
		for i = #self.missiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_fall_range(self.missiles[i].attack_range)
			self.missiles[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.missiles, i)
		end
	end
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.missile_count = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.missile_delay = nil
	self.missile_speed = nil
	self.aoe_spec = nil
	self.missile_proj_name = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.missiles = nil
	self.missile_shot_time = nil
	self.missile_point_list = nil
	self.missile_point_count = nil
	self.fall_ranges = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossHelicopterSupportFireBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	-- 캐스팅 시간
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)
	-- 유지시간
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 4)
	-- 마무리 시간
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.5)
	-- 공격범위(반지름)
	self.attack_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRange', 2.0)
	-- 호밍속도
	self.homming_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HommingSpeed', 3.0)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	-- 데미지 텀 몇초에 한번씩 데미지 들어가는가
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.02)
	-- 탄 이펙트 보여주는 시간
	self.bullet_effect_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BulletEffectTime', 0.3)
	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}
	self.bullet_effect_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Bullet', 'FX_GunShot_Groundhit')

	self.damage_time_passed = 0

	self.spot_light = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(self.character.Position, self.attack_range)
	self.spot_light:Hide()

	self.target = nil
	self.spot_light_effect = nil
	self.bullet_sfx = nil

	self.laser_point = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:send_damage_routine()

	--공격
		--데미지 입을 대상자
	local cantidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position, self.attack_range, 4)
	for i = 0, cantidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = cantidates.Values[i]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dest_pos = fo.Position
			local target_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(dest_pos - self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position)
			local target_dist = target_diff.magnitude
			if target_dist <= self.attack_range then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
	cantidates:Dispose()


end

function local_class:bullet_effect_routine()
	--이전상태에서 액션으로 넘어가기전까지 대기
	while self.current_state == self.state.prepare do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local random_range = self.attack_range * 0.9

	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = "02_gun_shoot_05"
	--sfx_info.parent = self.spot_light
	sfx_info.loop = true
	sfx_info.maxDistance = 10
	sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop

	self.bullet_sfx = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	self.bullet_sfx:SetPosition(self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position)

	--액션스테이트로 넘어간 다음부터 시작
	while self.current_state == self.state.action do
		if self.spot_light_effect ~= nil then
			local pos = self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
			local z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('supportfire', pos + vector(x, 0, z))
			self.bullet_sfx:SetPosition(self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.02)
	end
	self:stop_bullet_sfx()
end

function local_class:stop_bullet_sfx()
	if self.bullet_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.bullet_sfx:FadeOut(0.1)
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:set_spot_light_position(point)
	if not is_unity_null(point) then
		self.laser_point = point
	end

end



function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	-- 다음스테이트아 실제 실행 스테이트
	--elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	--elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		--공격 스팟라이트 준비 시작, 본인 앞쪽으로 스팟라이트 생성
		local dir = self.laser_point.position - self.character.Position
		local spot_pos = self.character.Position + dir.normalized * 5
		self.target_position = spot_pos
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.spot_light, self.target_position)
		self.spot_light_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('spotlight', self.spot_light.CacheTransform.position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spot_light))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		-- 여기선 스팟라이트가 쫒아다니고 있음.
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bullet_effect_routine, self))
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		if not is_unity_null(self.spot_light_effect) then
			self.spot_light_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.spot_light_effect = nil
		self:stop_bullet_sfx()
		self.spot_light:Hide()--스팟라이트 종료처리
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spot_light))
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then--준비모션 실행
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then-- 실제 액션 실행 ( 스포트라이트 실행 밎 캐릭터 추적
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then--액션시간이 지나면 종료됨
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else--실제 진행되는중
			-- 동일한 속도로 쫒아가도록 수정

			--self.target_position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.spot_light_effect.transform.position, self.target.Position, self.homming_speed * dt)

			local finalDiff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.spot_light_effect.transform.position  , 0)
			self.target_position = self.target_position + finalDiff.normalized * self.homming_speed * dt
			self.spot_light_effect.transform.position = self.target_position;
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.spot_light, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spot_light))

			self.damage_time_passed = self.damage_time_passed + dt
			--계속 쫒아가야 함.
			if self.damage_time_passed >= self.damage_term then
				self.damage_time_passed = 0
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.send_damage_routine, self))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then--뒷정리..
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--외부 진행 캔슬 (내가 들고있는 외부 이펙트등 삭제할것)
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.spot_light) then
		self.spot_light:Hide()
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.spot_light_effect) then
		self.spot_light_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.spot_light_effect = nil

	self:stop_bullet_sfx()

	self:cancel()
end

-- 내부에 내가 들고 있는 것들 해지하고 상태 self.state.none 으로 변경.
function local_class:cancel()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

-- 나머지 기타 변수들 포함하여 통합 해제
function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--사용된 변수 전부 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.homming_speed = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.damage_term = nil
	self.bullet_effect_time = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.bullet_effect_name = nil
	self.damage_time_passed = nil
	self.spot_light = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.spot_light_effect = nil
	self.bullet_sfx = nil
	self.laser_point = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.current_wave_pos = self.wave_start_pos

		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.target_direction.z, self.target_direction.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		local effect_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + self.target_direction * self.wave_offset_dist
		self.laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", effect_pos,
				vector(0, angle, 0), nil)
		self.laser_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
		self.laser_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(0.0, 1, 1)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_wave(dt)

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, 0.3))
			if progress < 1 and self.time_passed < 0.5 then
				self.laser_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(progress, 1, 1)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.target_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_dark_01')
