				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit")
			end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_restriction(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	if self.is_start_laser_effect then
		self:update_laser_effect(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:restriction_check(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_laser_effect(dt)
	if self.laser_time_passed > self.laser_effect_duration and self.laser_effect_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.laser_effect_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				v = nil
			end
		end
		self.laser_effect_list = nil
		self.is_start_laser_effect = false
	else
		self.laser_time_passed = self.laser_time_passed + dt
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local prev_dir = nil
	local prev_attack_range_dir = nil
	if self.target_dir ~= nil then
		prev_dir = self.target_dir
		prev_attack_range_dir = self:get_attack_range_dir(vector_util.to_direction(prev_dir))
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
	self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff.normalized))
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

	if prev_dir ~= nil and prev_dir == self.target_dir then
		return
	end

	self.current_attack_dir, self.is_ver_dir = self:get_attack_range_dir(vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

	if prev_attack_range_dir ~= nil then
		self.attack_range_list[prev_attack_range_dir]:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
				self.character, self.attack_range_list[prev_attack_range_dir]))
	end

	local ar_pos = self.attack_info_list[self.current_attack_dir].start_pos
	self.start_attack_pos = ar_pos
	local ar = self.attack_range_list[self.current_attack_dir]
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, ar_pos, self.target_dir)
	battle_range_util.show(ar)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
end

function local_class:get_attack_range_dir(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return self.attack_range_dir.left, false
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return self.attack_range_dir.right, false
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return self.attack_range_dir.front, true
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return self.attack_range_dir.back, true
	end

	return self.attack_range_dir.back
end

function local_class:update_restriction(dt)
	if self.restriction_info_list == nil then
		return
	else
		if #self.restriction_info_list == 0 and self.target_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(self.target_list) do
				if character_util.has_active_buff(v, self.speed_cap_buff_name) then
					buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, v)
					buff_manager:CureAllDebuffs(self.character, v)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for idx = #self.restriction_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.restriction_info_list[idx].is_active then
			self.restriction_info_list[idx].time_passed = self.restriction_info_list[idx].time_passed + dt
			if self.restriction_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.restriction_duration then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.restriction_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.restriction_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.restriction_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end
				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("restriction_end", self.restriction_info_list[idx].target.Bounds.center)
				self.restriction_info_list[idx].is_active = false
				self:release_target(self.restriction_info_list[idx].target)
				table.remove(self.restriction_info_list, idx)

			elseif self.restriction_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.restriction_damage_term * self.restriction_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1 then
				--1초마다 퍼뎀
				self:restriction_damage(self.restriction_info_list[idx].target)
				self.restriction_info_list[idx].damage_count = self.restriction_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:restriction_damage(target)
	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, target.EntityGroup) or
			target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, target) then
	else
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

-- 타겟 락
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 캐릭터 조작 금지

		--애니메이션 세트, 루프
		target:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
		-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
		target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
		target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		-- 속박 이팩트
		local restriction_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("restriction", target.Bounds.center)

		-- 스피드캡 버프
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		else
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.Stop(target)
			--local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			--cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			--controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Disabled
		end

		table.insert(self.restriction_info_list, {
			effect = restriction_effect,
			pos = target.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_active = true,
			target = target,
			damage_count = 0
		})
	end
end

-- 타겟 락 해제
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
			end
		else
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			--local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			--cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			--controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.attack_range_dir = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_info_list = nil
	self.restriction_info_list = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.current_attack_dir = nil
	self.ground_effect = nil
	self.laser_effect_list = nil
	self.target_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash1 then

			self.slash_attack_calculator:End()
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

			self.wave_attack_calculator:End()

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash1")

		self.slash_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.slash_attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.target_dir = diff.normalized
		--대기중 타겟 추적
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then

		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.target_dir.z, self.target_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle - 90, unity_class.vector3.up)

end

function local_class:get_fx_rot_left(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(80, unity_class.vector3.down)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(250, unity_class.vector3.down)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(0, unity_class.vector3.down)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(170, unity_class.vector3.down)
	end

	return unity_class.quaternion.identity
end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.wave)
		else
			self:jump_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wave then
		if self.time_passed >= self.wave_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_wave(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_move(dt)
	--케스팅 시간동안 캐릭터 추적
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

	--타겟과의 거리가 slash / 2범위보다 크면 접근 아니면 캐스팅 캔슬하고 바로 slash
	if dist > self.slash_radius / 2 then

		local direction = diff.normalized
		local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.move_speed * dt)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = direction
		move_info.magnitude = move_dist
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction),
				true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		return true
	else
		self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff.normalized))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

		return false
	end
end

function local_class:update_slash(dt)
	if not self.slash_attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.slash_attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.slash_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.slash_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)
	if not self.wave_attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.wave_attack_calculator:Start()

function local_class:jump_update(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.jump_time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration)
	local movement = progress - self.jump_progress
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.jump_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.jump_distance * movement

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.jump_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.jump_time_passed = self.jump_time_passed + dt
	self.jump_progress = progress
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self.wave_attack_calculator = nil

end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_attack_range) then

				self.character, self.slash_attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.dash_effect) then
		self.dash_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.dash_effect = nil

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
		self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.charge_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.charge_attack_calculator:End()
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.dash_effect) then
			self.dash_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.dash_effect = nil

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_attack_range))
		self.slash_attack_range:Hide()

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.slash_attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.slash_attack_calculator:End()
		end

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--타겟위치까지 만 돌진하기 때문에 attackrange 새로 셋팅
		local dist = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude

		if dist < self.charge_min_distance then
			dist = self.charge_min_distance
		end

		self.charge_move_duration = dist / self.charge_speed

		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.charge_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(dist, self.charge_width))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.charge_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.charge_attack_calculator:Start()
		self.charge_start_pos = self.character.Position

		self.dash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dash", self.character.Bounds.center
		, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)

		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.charge_direction.z, self.charge_direction.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		self.dash_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("charge")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("charge")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge")
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:set_dir_for_target()

		--타격지점은 전방 2거리의 원형지점
		self.slash_position = self.character.Bounds.center + (self.charge_direction * self.slash_range)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.slash_attack_range, self.slash_position)
		self.slash_attack_range:Show(self.slash_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.slash_attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("slash_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.slash then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.slash_attack_calculator.Position = self.slash_position
		self.slash_attack_calculator.Direction = self.charge_direction
		self.slash_attack_calculator:Start()

		--local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("slash", self.slash_position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
		--local rotation = self:get_fx_rot(vector_util.to_direction(self.lock_dir))
		--slash_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

		local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.charge_direction.z, self.charge_direction.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("slash", self.slash_position,
				vector(0, angle, 0), nil)
		slash_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("slash")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("slash")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("slash")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_slash_effect()
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-self.target_dir.z, self.target_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle - 90, unity_class.vector3.up)

			vector(0, angle, 0), nil)

function local_class:get_fx_rot(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(180, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(0, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.up)
	end

	return unity_class.quaternion.identity
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	self.charge_direction = dir
	self.lock_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.lock_dir))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.charge_move_duration then
				self:update_charge(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_slash(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	--damage
	self.charge_attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.charge_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.charge_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	--wall Crash
	local crashed_wall = false
	local movement = self.charge_speed * dt
	local sorted_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(self.character.Bounds,
			self.charge_speed * dt * self.charge_direction)
	local dists = sorted_list.Keys
	local ifos = sorted_list.Values
	for i = 0, ifos.Count - 1 do
		local ifo = ifos[i]
		if (ifo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(ifo.CrashBehaviour) then
			movement = dists[i].distance
			crashed_wall = true

			-- 화면 흔들기
			stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.3)

			-- 벽꿍 이팩트
			--local wall_pos = self.character.Position + self.charge_direction * movement
			--self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_impact", wall_pos)
			--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_charge", nil)
			break
		end
	end
	sorted_list:Dispose()

	if crashed_wall then
		self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:update_slash(dt)
	if not self.slash_attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.slash_attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.slash_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do

	for _, v in pairs(self.monster_pop_amount_list) do
		total_rand_num = total_rand_num + v
	end

	local rand_map = pattern_util.vertexes_on_donut(pos, 0, self.energy_radius, total_rand_num)
	local map_count = 1
	for iter = 1, #self.monster_list do
		local monsters = self.monster_list[iter].list
		local s_count = self.monster_pop_count_list[iter] % #monsters
		local amount = self.monster_pop_amount_list[iter]
		for i = 1, amount do
			local monster = monsters[i + s_count]
			monster.Position = rand_map[map_count]
			monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.skipEffect = true
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
			if thebattle == nil then
				print('### GetBattleForMyParty is null!!! id = ' .. self.monster_list[iter].id)
				break
			end

			thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
			monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false

			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
					monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			map_count = map_count + 1
		end
		self.monster_pop_count_list[iter] = self.monster_pop_count_list[iter] + amount
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage_energy()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.energy_end_pos, vector_util.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', self.zone_bound.center)

	self.energy_calculator:Start()
	self.energy_calculator.Position = self.energy_end_pos

	local objects = self.energy_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character) == false then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.energy_damage_modifier

			if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 then
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(fo)

			elseif fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and fo.name ~= nil then
				local length = string.len(fo.name)
				local sub = string.sub(fo.name, length, length)
				local idx = tonumber(sub)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_stone_remove', idx, 'pattern'}))
			end
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.energy_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:request_create_stone(pos)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{ 'boss_icedragon_create_stone', pos.x, pos.y, pos.z }))
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_monster, self))
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = #self.monster_death_ignore_list, 1, -1 do
		local name = self.monster_death_ignore_list[i]
		if e.FieldObject.Name == name then
			e.FieldObject.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			table.remove(self.monster_death_ignore_list, i)
			return
		end
	end

	if self:check_gimmick_monster(e.FieldObject) then
		local info = {
			fo = e.FieldObject,
			time_passed = 0,
			pos = e.FieldObject.Bounds.center
		}
		character_util.set_active_state(e.FieldObject, 'disabled')
		table.insert(self.stone_summon_list, info)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('summon', e.FieldObject.Bounds.center, vector_util.zero)
	end

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
			self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
		end

		for iter = 1, #self.monster_list do
			local list = self.monster_list[iter].list
			for i = 1, #list do
				local fo = list[i]
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * 10
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_clear_everything' then
		self:kill_all_active_monster()
	end
end

function local_class:kill_all_active_monster()
	-- 몬스터 전부 죽이자
	for iter = 1, #self.monster_list do
		local list = self.monster_list[iter].list
		for i = 1, #list do
			local fo = list[i]
			if fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * 10
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				if self:check_gimmick_monster(fo) then
					table.insert(self.monster_death_ignore_list, fo.name)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_gimmick_monster(monster)
	local list = nil
	for _, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if v.id == self.gimmick_monster_id then
			list = v.list
			break
		end
	end

	if list == nil then
		return false
	end

	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(monster, v) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:routine_load_monster()
	if self.monster_list ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.monster_list = {}

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 80)
	if stage ~= nil then
		if stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId) ~= nil then
			local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
			exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.monster_id_list do
		local id = self.monster_id_list[i]
		local is_gimmick = id == self.gimmick_monster_id
		local amount = self.monster_pop_amount_list[i] * 2
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(id)
		if spec == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND MONSTER SPEC!!! ID = ' .. id)
			break
		end
		local monster_table = { }
		for num = 1, amount do
			local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
			coroutine.yield(loader)
			local monster = loader.Character
			if monster == nil then
				print('### CANT FIND Character!!! ID = ' .. id)
				break
			end

			monster.Name = spec.Name == nil and 'icedragon_monster'.. num or spec.Name .. num
			monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
			monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
			monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'battle2'
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.EventGroupName = 'battle2'
			monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disppear)
			monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = is_gimmick
					and CS.Oak.DeathType.EtherealProstrate
					or CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
			monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
			monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
			CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
			local changed_weapon = false
			--디폴트 무기 설정
			if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
				local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
				local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
				monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
				changed_weapon = true
			end

			if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
				local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
				local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
				monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
				changed_weapon = true
			end
			stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)


			coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
			table.insert(monster_table, monster)
		end
		table.insert(self.monster_list,
				{
					id = id,
					name = spec.Name,
					list = monster_table
				})
		table.insert(self.monster_pop_count_list, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	-- is right?
	local r = self.energy_radius
	local center = self.character.Position.x >= bound.center.x
			and vector(self.character.Bounds.min.x - self.energy_drop_width / 2 - r, bound.center.y, bound.center.z)
			or vector(self.character.Bounds.max.x + self.energy_drop_width / 2 + r, bound.center.y, bound.center.z)
	local size = vector(self.energy_drop_width, bound.size.y - r * 2, bound.size.z - r * 2)
	self.energy_drop_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size)

	-- 디버그용
	--CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(center, vector(size.x, size.z))

	-- 여기서 대표로 보스 락 걸어버림
	if self.zone_bound.center.x < self.character.Bounds.center.x then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	else
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossIceDragonIceBreathBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.phase = {
		one = 1,
		two = 2,
	}

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- preapre(각 페이즈 breath ~ 애니 렝스로)
	self.prepare_duration = nil --CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2.5)
	self.prev_knockback_force = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'PrevKnockbackForce')

	-- action
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 3.0)
	self.action_offset_x = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionOffsetX', 5.0)
	self.action_offset_z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionOffsetZ', 1.0)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude')
	self.camera_shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration')

	self.attack_radius = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackRadius')
	self.attack_angle = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackAngle')
	self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageModifier')
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce')
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 1.0)

	self.action_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	self.action_pos = nil

	self.attack_calculator = { }
	self.attack_range = { }

	-- post(preapre와 마찬가지)
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.fx_howl = nil

	-- ani 타이밍들
	self.fx_cast_timing = 0.1
	self.fx_cast_run = false

	self.fx_howl_disable_timing = 3.1
	self.fx_howl_disable_run = false

	self.current_phase = self.phase.one

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	-- event sub
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	self.action_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	self.action_pos = self.action_dir == vector_util.right
			and self.character.Position + vector(self.action_offset_x, self.character.Position.y, self.action_offset_z)
			or self.character.Position - vector(self.action_offset_x, self.character.Position.y, self.action_offset_z)

	self.fx_cast_run = false
	self.fx_howl_disable_run = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- TODO: 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range[self.current_phase]:Hide()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range[self.current_phase]))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator[self.current_phase]:End()

		if self.fx_howl ~= nil then
			self.fx_howl:Dispose()
			self.fx_howl = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- TODO: 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('breath' .. self.current_phase)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)

		self.prepare_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('breath' .. self.current_phase)

		local ar = self.attack_range[self.current_phase]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(ar, self.action_pos, self.action_dir, self.character.Position.y)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self:publish_knockback()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('loop' .. self.current_phase)		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('breath', self.zone_bound.center)

		self.attack_calculator[self.current_phase]:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('breath' .. self.current_phase, self.action_pos, self.action_dir)
		if self.fx_howl == nil then
			local pos = self.character.Position + vector(-4.8, 0, -1.23)
			self.fx_howl = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('howl', pos, vector_util.zero)
		end

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude[self.current_phase], self.camera_shake_duration[self.current_phase])
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_clear_everything' }))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end' .. self.current_phase)
		self.post_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('end' .. self.current_phase)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:publish_knockback()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if not character_util.is_dead(v) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.action_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.prev_knockback_force[self.current_phase]
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calculator[self.current_phase].Position = self.action_pos
	self.attack_calculator[self.current_phase].Direction = self.action_dir
	local objects = self.attack_calculator[self.current_phase]:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier[self.current_phase]
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.action_dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force[self.current_phase]
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- TODO: 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.fx_cast_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.fx_cast_timing then
			local pos = self.action_pos + vector(0.76, 0, 0.76)
			local rot = vector(0, -45, 0)
			local fx_cast = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', pos, vector_util.zero, self.bone_follower.gameObject.transform)
			fx_cast.transform.localEulerAngles = rot
			self.fx_cast_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.fx_howl_disable_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.fx_howl_disable_timing then
			if self.fx_howl then
				self.fx_howl:Dispose()
				self.fx_howl = nil
			end
			self.fx_howl_disable_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end
		self:publish_damage(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_phase_change' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
	end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		action = 2,
	}

	self.action_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('shift')
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1.0)

	self.stomp_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StompTime', 0.6)
	self.howl_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HowlTime', 1.5)

	self.stomp_use = false
	self.howl_use = false

	self.fx_snow = nil
	self.fx_howl = nil

	self.sfx_snow = nil

	self.fx_shift_offset = vector(3, 0, -4)
	self.fx_wave_offset1 = vector(-1.8, 0, -4.6)
	self.fx_wave_offset2 = vector(-0.7, 0, 1.65)
	self.fx_howl_offset = vector(-5.15, 0, 10.89)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.2)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.5)

	self.fx_howl_timing = self.action_duration - 0.4
	self.fx_howl_run = false

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.stomp_use = false
	self.howl_use = false
	self.fx_howl_run = false
	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 여기서 idle ani 교체
		self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle_phase2'
		message_system:Send(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(self.character)))

		if self.fx_howl ~= nil then
			self.fx_howl:Dispose()
			self.fx_howl = nil
		end
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shift')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('snow', self.zone_bound.center) -- one shot

		self.fx_snow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('snow', self.zone_bound.center, vector_util.zero)
		self.sfx_snow = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('snow_loop', self.zone_bound.center)

		self:set_ailment_resist()

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:reset_ailment()

		if self.fx_howl ~= nil then
			self.fx_howl:Disepose()
			self.fx_howl = nil
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_time then
		if self.stomp_use == false then
			local pos = self.character.Position
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shift', pos + self.fx_shift_offset, vector_util.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave', pos + self.fx_wave_offset1, vector_util.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave', pos + self.fx_wave_offset2, vector_util.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.zone_bound.center)

			stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			self:publish_knockback()
			self.stomp_use = true
		end
	end

	if self.fx_howl_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.fx_howl_timing then
		if self.fx_howl ~= nil then
			self.fx_howl:Dispose()
			self.fx_howl = nil
		end
		self.fx_howl_run = true
	end

	if self.howl_use == false and self.time_passed >= self.howl_time then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('howl', self.zone_bound.center)

		local pos = self.character.Position
		self.fx_howl = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('howl', pos + self.fx_howl_offset, vector_util.zero)
		self.fx_howl.transform.localScale = vector(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		self.howl_use = true
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:publish_knockback()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if not character_util.is_dead(v) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	if self.fx_howl ~= nil then
		self.fx_howl:Dispose()
		self.fx_howl = nil
	end

	if self.fx_snow ~= nil then
		self.fx_snow:Dispose()
		self.fx_snow = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_snow ~= nil then
		-- sfx 는 dispose 가 아니라 stop
		self.sfx_snow:Stop()
		self.sfx_snow = nil
	end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- TODO: 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- TODO: 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.zone_bound.center)

		local ar_pos = vector(self.character.Bounds.min.x, self.punch_end_pos.y, self.punch_end_pos.z)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, ar_pos, self.punch_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self:set_ailment_resist()

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready_loop')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.move)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:reset_ailment()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame_hand(dt)
	if self.current_hand_state == nil or self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.none then
		return
	end

	self.hand_time_passed = self.hand_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.move then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.hand_time_passed, 0, 1, self.punch_duration))
		local pos = self.punch_start_pos + self.punch_dir * (self.punch_distance * progress)
		self.hand.Position = pos
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.fx_wave_run == false and self.hand_time_passed >= self.fx_wave_timing then
			stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			pos = self.character.Position + vector(-8.6, 0, -5)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave', pos, vector_util.zero)
			self.fx_wave_run = true
		end

		if progress >= 1 then
			self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.holding)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.holding then
		if self.hand_time_passed > self.hand_holding_time or self.hand_destroyed then
			self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.retreat)
		end

	elseif self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.retreat then
		if self.hand_time_passed > self.retreat_duration then
			self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.none)
			return
		else
			self.hand.Position = self.hand.Position + -direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction) * self.retreat_speed * dt
			return
		end
	end
end


function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 핸드 관리 위해 따로 관리
	self:update_frame_hand(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- TODO: 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration - self.prepare_loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_loop)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		if self.sfx_stomp_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.sfx_stomp_timing then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.zone_bound.center)
			self.sfx_stomp_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_hand()
	if self.hand == nil then
		self.hand = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		self.hand.Name = 'LeftHand'
		self.hand.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.attack_size_x, 2, self.attack_size_z))
		self.hand.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.hand.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		self.hand.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.none)
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_remove_left_hand' then
		if self.hand ~= nil then
			if self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.move or self.current_hand_state == self.hand_state.holding then
				self:change_hand_state(self.hand_state.retreat)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.hand.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		--- 왼쪽으로 밀도록
		local knockback_direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

local local_class = newclass('BossIceDragonScratchBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		prepare_loop = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2.0)
	local ani_time = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('prepare')
	self.loop_duration = math.max(0, self.prepare_duration - ani_time)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1.0)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.5)
	self.action_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionWidth', 5.0)
	self.scratch_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ScratchWidth', 2.0)
	self.scratch_interval_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ScratchIntervalWidth', 2.0)
	self.scratch_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ScratchMaxCount', 3)
	self.scratch_calculator = nil -- set_battle_zone
	self.scratch_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ScratchDamageModifier', 1.0)
	self.scratch_ar_list = {}

	self.x_limit = nil
	self.is_right = true

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	self.sfx_break_timing = 1.4
	self.sfx_break_run = false

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	-- event sub
	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.sfx_break_run = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end


function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:hide_attack_ranges()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.zone_bound.center)

		self.tracking_time_passed = 0

		self:update_attack_range()
		self:show_attack_ranges()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('loop')


	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack1', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack2', self.zone_bound.center)

		self:publish_scratch_damage()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:hide_attack_ranges()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- update tracking
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.tracking_time_passed = self.tracking_time_passed + dt
		if self.tracking_time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			self:update_attack_range()
		end
	end

	-- update
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration - self.loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_loop)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		if self.time_passed >= self.loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.sfx_break_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.sfx_break_timing then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break', self.zone_bound.center)
			self.sfx_break_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range()
	local t_pos = self.target.Position
	if self.is_right then
		if t_pos.x < self.x_limit then
			t_pos.x = self.x_limit
		end

		for i = 1, #self.scratch_ar_list do
			local ar = self.scratch_ar_list[i]
			local x = t_pos.x - (self.scratch_width + self.scratch_interval_width) * (i - 1)
			local pos = vector(x, self.target.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos, self.target.Position.y)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		end
	else
		if t_pos.x > self.x_limit then
			t_pos.x = self.x_limit
		end

		for i = 1, #self.scratch_ar_list do
			local ar = self.scratch_ar_list[i]
			local x = t_pos.x + (self.scratch_width + self.scratch_interval_width) * (i - 1)
			local pos = vector(x, self.target.Position.y, self.zone_bound.center.z)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos, self.target.Position.y)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_ranges()
	for _, ar in pairs(self.scratch_ar_list) do
		ar:Show(self.prepare_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_attack_ranges()
	for _, ar in pairs(self.scratch_ar_list) do
		ar:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
	end
end

function local_class:publish_scratch_damage()
	for _, ar in pairs(self.scratch_ar_list) do
		self.scratch_calculator:Start()
		local pos = ar.CacheTransform.position
		self.scratch_calculator.Position = pos
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('scratch', pos, vector_util.zero)
		local objects = self.scratch_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character) == false then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.scratch_damage_modifier
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee

				-- 빙하발사로 생성된 몹들
				if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 then
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
					damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(fo)

					-- 빙하석
				elseif fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and fo.name ~= nil then
					local length = string.len(fo.name)
					local sub = string.sub(fo.name, length, length)
					local idx = tonumber(sub)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_icedragon_stone_remove', idx, 'pattern'}))
				end
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
		self.scratch_calculator:End()
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local size = vector(self.scratch_width, bound.size.z)
	for _ = 1, self.scratch_max_count do
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.scratch_ar_list, ar)
	end

	size = vector(self.scratch_width, 2, bound.size.z)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, 1, 1)
	self.scratch_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)

	if self.zone_bound.center.x < self.character.Bounds.center.x then
		self.is_right = true
		self.x_limit = self.character.Bounds.min.x - self.action_width
	else
		self.is_right = false
		self.x_limit = self.character.Bounds.max.x + self.action_width
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossIceDragonShieldBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

	-- 내부 스테이트

	self.fx_shield = nil

	-- event sub

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.hit_time_passed = 0

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 최초 발동 이후 패턴을 시작하지 않고 n초마다 보호막 생성(ai trigger하고 이 조건에서 체크)
	if self.shield_count > 0 then
		self:create_shield()
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('howl')

		self:create_shield()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:reset_ailment()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.hit_time_passed <= self.fx_hit_cooltime then
		self.hit_time_passed = self.hit_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- TODO: 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_shield()
	local amount = 0
	if self.shield_count > 0 then
		amount = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.character) * self.shield_add_modifier)
	else
		amount = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(self.character) * self.shield_modifier)
	end

	buff_util.add_shield(self.character, self.character, amount)
	self.shield_count = self.shield_count + 1

	if self.fx_shield ~= nil then
		self.fx_shield:Dispose()
		self.fx_shield = nil
	end
	self.fx_shield = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shield', self.character.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75), vector_util.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('show', self.zone_bound.center)
	self:publish_knockback()
end

function local_class:publish_knockback()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if not character_util.is_dead(v) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
			local force = self.shield_count > 0 and self.knockback_force2 or self.knockback_force
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		local shield_amount = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield
		if shield_amount > 0 and self.hit_time_passed >= self.fx_hit_cooltime then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('hit', self.character.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75), vector_util.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', self.zone_bound.center)
			self.hit_time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	if self.character == nil or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Target) == false then
		return false
	end

	local is_expired = false
	for _, v in pairs(e.BuffIds) do
		if v == 20500 or v == 20501 then
			is_expired = true
			break
		end
	end

	if is_expired == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.fx_shield ~= nil then
		self.fx_shield:Dispose()
		self.fx_shield = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', self.character.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75), vector_util.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break', self.zone_bound.center)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_icedragon_shield' then
		self:create_shield()
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	if self.fx_shield ~= nil then
		self.fx_shield:Dispose()
		self.fx_shield = nil
	end

	if self.on_buff_expired_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
		self.on_buff_expired_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end
