local local_class = newclass('BossIceDragonStrikeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		prepare_loop = 3,
		action = 4,
		holding = 5,
		retreat = 6
	}

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 3)
	local t = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('ready')
	self.prepare_loop_duration = math.max(0, self.prepare_duration - t)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TrackingDuration', 1)
	self.tracking_pos = nil

	-- action
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 1.0)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRadius', 2.5)
	self.attack_boundary_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackBoundaryWidth', 6)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1)

	self.holding_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HoldingDurationWithLeftHand', 0.5)

	-- 내려치기 z offset
	self.action_z_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionZOffset', -1)

	-- retreat
	self.retreat_duration = self.cs_battle_action:GetCharacterAnimationDuration('return')

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeMagnitude', 0.2)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraShakeDuration', 0.5)

	self.fx_wave_timing = 0.3
	self.fx_wave_run = false

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- TODO: 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.holding then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.retreat then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- TODO: 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.zone_bound.center)

		self.tracking_time_passed = 0
		self:update_tracking()
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.fx_wave_run = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready_loop')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('ice', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif next_state == self.state.holding then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack_loop')

	elseif next_state == self.state.retreat then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('return')

	elseif next_state == self.state.none then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:reset_ailment()
	end

	self.tracking_time_passed = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- TODO: 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.tracking_time_passed = self.tracking_time_passed + dt
		if self.tracking_time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			self:update_tracking()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration - self.prepare_loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_loop)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_loop then
		self.tracking_time_passed = self.tracking_time_passed + dt
		if self.tracking_time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			self:update_tracking()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_loop_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.fx_wave_run == false and self.time_passed >= self.fx_wave_timing then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('wave', self.tracking_pos, vector_util.zero)
			self:publish_damage() -- 데미지 처리도 타이밍에 맞게 해주자
			stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			self.fx_wave_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.holding)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.holding then
		if self.time_passed >= self.holding_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.retreat)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.retreat then
		if self.time_passed >= self.retreat_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking()
	self.tracking_pos = unity_class.vector3(
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.target.Position.x, self.left_margin, self.right_margin),
			0,
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.target.Position.z, self.down_margin, self.up_margin))

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.tracking_pos, self.character.Position.y)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:publish_damage()
	self.attack_calculator:Start()
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.tracking_pos
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		local knockback_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.tracking_pos).normalized
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.attack_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.attack_radius, 2, 100, -1, 0, false)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.right_margin = bound.center.x + bound.size.x / 2 - self.attack_radius
	self.left_margin = self.right_margin - self.attack_boundary_width
	self.up_margin = bound.center.z + bound.size.z / 2 - self.attack_radius
	self.down_margin = bound.center.z + self.attack_radius + self.action_z_offset
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossInquisitorBoomerangBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveDuration", 1)
	self.ready_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ReadyDuration", 1)
	self.front_action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FrontActionDuration", 3)
	self.back_action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BackActionDuration", 3)
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.move_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveSpeed", 3)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1)
	self.slash_effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SlashEffectDelay", 0.1)

	self.proj_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ProjCount", 5)
	self.proj_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjRadius", 1)
	self.proj_start_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjStartRange", 3)
	self.proj_front_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FrontDistance", 5)
	self.proj_back_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BackDistance", 15)
	self.proj_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjSpeed", 5)
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 1)
	self.proj_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjAngle", 180)

	self.attack_calculator_list = {}
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.proj_count do
		local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = 99
		info.Duration = 99
		info.Radius = self.proj_radius
		info.Height = 3
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, ac)

		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.proj_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		move = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		ready = 4,
		action = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	self.boomerang_state = {
		none = 1,
		action_front = 2,
		interval = 3,
		action_back = 4,
		finish = 5
	}

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.none
	self.boomerang_info_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.boomerang_time_passed = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.boomerang_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
			self:dispose_boomerang(_)
			self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
		end
		self.boomerang_info_list = nil
	end
	self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.none

	self.is_slash_effect = false
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.move)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if next_state ~= self.state.prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			self.attack_range_list[_]:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[_]))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.ready then
			self:cancel_boomerang()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self:cancel_boomerang()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.move then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff.normalized))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))

		self.boomerang_info_list = {}
		self:prepare_boomerang()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.ready then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ready")
		self:start_boomerang()
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.action_front
		self.boomerang_time_passed = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_slash_ani_for_dir(dir)
	--방향별 애니메이션 방향 셋팅
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return "slash_rev"
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return "slash"
	end

	return "slash"
end

function local_class:prepare_boomerang()
	local start_pos = self.character.Position
	local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	for i = 1, self.proj_count do
		local center_angle = self.proj_angle / (self.proj_count - 1) * (i - 1)
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (self.proj_angle / 2), 0) * direction

		local proj_pos = start_pos + dir * self.proj_start_range
		local dest_pos = proj_pos + dir * self.proj_front_distance
		local move_duration = (dest_pos - proj_pos).magnitude / self.proj_speed

		local info = {
			is_active = false,
			state = self.boomerang_state.ready,
			index = i,
			start_pos = proj_pos,
			dest_pos = dest_pos,
			pos = proj_pos,
			dir = dir,
			progress_time = 0,
			move_duration = move_duration,
			effect = nil
		}

		table.insert(self.boomerang_info_list, info)

		local ar = self.attack_range_list[i]
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, proj_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_boomerang_return()
	for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
		if v.effect ~= nil then
			local dir = -v.dir
			local start_pos = v.dest_pos
			local dest_pos = start_pos + dir * self.proj_back_distance
			v.dir = dir
			v.start_pos = start_pos
			v.dest_pos = dest_pos
			v.is_active = true
			v.pos = start_pos
			v.move_duration = (dest_pos - start_pos).magnitude / self.proj_speed
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_boomerang()
	for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
		v.is_active = true
		v.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("boomerang", v.pos + vector(0, 1, 0))

		self.attack_range_list[_]:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[_]))

		self.attack_calculator_list[_]:Start()
		self.attack_calculator_list[_].Position = v.pos
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_boomerang_state(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.time_passed < self.move_duration then

			local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

			if dist > 0.3 then

				local direction = diff.normalized
				local move_dist = unity_class.mathf.Min(diff.magnitude, self.move_speed * dt)

				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				move_info.direction = direction
				move_info.magnitude = move_dist
				local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(direction),
						true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.DiagonalAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
			else
				self.target_dir = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(diff.normalized))
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			end
		else
			--move_duration안에 타겟에게 도달 못하면 패턴 시작
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.ready)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ready_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_effect_delay and not self.is_slash_effect then
			local slash_fx_name = self:get_slash_ani_for_dir(vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir))
			local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(slash_fx_name, self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_dir, self.character.Transform)
			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.back, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
			slash_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

			self.is_slash_effect = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_boomerang_state(dt)
		if self.boomerang_info_list ~= nil then
			self:update_boomerang_damage(dt)
		end
	if self.current_boomerang_state ~= self.boomerang_state.none then
		self.boomerang_time_passed = self.boomerang_time_passed + dt
		if self.current_boomerang_state == self.boomerang_state.action_front then
			if self.boomerang_time_passed <= self.front_action_duration then
				self:update_boomerang_front(dt)
			else
				self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.interval
				self.boomerang_time_passed = 0
			end
		elseif self.current_boomerang_state == self.boomerang_state.interval then
			if self.boomerang_time_passed <= self.interval_duration then
			else
				self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.action_back
				self.boomerang_time_passed = 0
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("return")
				self:prepare_boomerang_return()
			end
		elseif self.current_boomerang_state == self.boomerang_state.action_back then
			if self.boomerang_time_passed <= self.back_action_duration then
				self:update_return_boomerang(dt)
			else
				self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.none
				self.boomerang_time_passed = 0

				if self.boomerang_info_list ~= nil then
					for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
						self:dispose_boomerang(_)
						self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
					end
					self.boomerang_info_list = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_boomerang_front(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
					self.boomerang_time_passed, 0, 1, v.move_duration))

			local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
			v.effect.transform.position = move_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
			v.pos = move_pos

			self.attack_calculator_list[_].Position = v.pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_return_boomerang(dt)
	if self.boomerang_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.boomerang_time_passed / v.move_duration)

			local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(v.start_pos, v.dest_pos, progress)
			v.effect.transform.position = move_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
			v.pos = move_pos

			self.attack_calculator_list[_].Position = v.pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_boomerang_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
			if self.boomerang_info_list[i].is_active then
				local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

						local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.boomerang_info_list[i].pos).normalized
						local knock_direction = direction
						if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
							knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
						end
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.direction = direction
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
						damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')
						local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
						command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)

						self:dispose_boomerang(i)

						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("hit", fo.Position)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_boomerang(idx)
	self.boomerang_info_list[idx].is_active = false
	if self.boomerang_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
		self.boomerang_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
		self.boomerang_info_list[idx].effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:cancel_boomerang()
end

function local_class:cancel_boomerang()
	if self.boomerang_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.boomerang_info_list) do
			self:dispose_boomerang(_)
			self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
		end
		self.boomerang_info_list = nil
		self.current_boomerang_state = self.boomerang_state.none
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.boomerang_state = nil
	self.current_boomerang_state = nil
	self.boomerang_info_list = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,

local local_class = newclass('BossInquisitorCircleBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.ready_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ReadyDuration", 1)
	self.slash_effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SlashEffectDelay", 0.1)

	self.scythe_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScytheRadius", 2)
	self.scythe_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScytheSpeed", 10)
	self.scythe_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScytheDuration", 5)
	self.scythe_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ScytheDamageTerm", 1)
	self.circle_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CircleRadius", 4)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1)
	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		ready = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.scythe_count = 2
	if self.enhanced then
		self.scythe_count = 4
	end

	self.attack_calculator_list = {}
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	self.circle_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.scythe_count do
		local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = self.scythe_damage_term
		info.Duration = 99
		info.Radius = self.scythe_radius
		info.Height = 3
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_list, ac)

		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.scythe_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)

		local ar2 = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.circle_radius + self.scythe_radius * 0.5, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar2:Hide()
		table.insert(self.circle_attack_range_list, ar2)
	end

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.scythe_pos_list = nil
	self.scythe_info_list = nil
	self.current_scythe_index = 0
	self.circle_time_passed = 0
	self.is_start_circle = false
	self.is_active_scythes = false
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	self:set_scythe_position()
end

function local_class:set_scythe_position()
	local center_pos = self.zone_bound.center
	local slice_range_x = self.zone_bound.size.x / 4
	local slice_range_z = self.zone_bound.size.z / 4

	self.scythe_pos_list = {
		vector(center_pos.x - slice_range_x, 0, center_pos.z + slice_range_z),
		vector(center_pos.x + slice_range_x, 0, center_pos.z + slice_range_z),
		vector(center_pos.x + slice_range_x, 0, center_pos.z - slice_range_z),
		vector(center_pos.x - slice_range_x, 0, center_pos.z - slice_range_z)
	}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.scythe_info_list = {}
	self.circle_time_passed = 0
	self.current_scythe_index = 0
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.is_start_circle = false
	self.is_active_scythes = false
	self.is_slash_effect = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		self.cast_effect = nil
	end

	if self.circle_attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.circle_attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.ready then
			self:cancel_scythe()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end

		if self.circle_attack_range_list ~= nil then
			for _,v in pairs(self.circle_attack_range_list) do
				v:Hide()
			end
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self:cancel_scythe()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", self.character.Position)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self:set_circle_scythe()
	elseif next_state == self.state.ready then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("ready")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("ready")
		self:ready_scythes()
		self.is_active_scythes = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.is_start_circle = true
		self:start_scythes()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_circle_scythe()
	if not self.enhanced then
		local start_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		self:set_scythe(start_index)
		self:set_scythe(start_index + 2)
	else
		for i = 1, 4 do
			self:set_scythe(i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_scythe(pos_index)
	--회전 축 기준 중심방향에서 생성 준비(위치잡고 어택레인지만 표시)
	self.current_scythe_index = self.current_scythe_index + 1
	local circle_pos = self.scythe_pos_list[pos_index]
	local dir = (circle_pos - self.zone_bound.center).normalized
	local start_pos = circle_pos - (dir * self.circle_radius)
	local info = {
		index = self.current_scythe_index,
		is_active = false,
		is_start_circle = false,
		center_pos = circle_pos,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		start_dir = dir,
		effect = nil
	}
	table.insert(self.scythe_info_list, info)

	local ar = self.attack_range_list[self.current_scythe_index]
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, start_pos)
	battle_range_util.show(ar, self.prepare_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
end

function local_class:ready_scythes()
	--이펙트 생성 및 데미지 시작
	for i, v in pairs(self.scythe_info_list) do
		v.is_active = true
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("scythe", v.start_pos + vector(0, 1, 0))
		v.current_pos = v.start_pos
		v.effect = effect

		self.attack_calculator_list[i]:Start()
		self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = v.start_pos
		self.attack_range_list[i]:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[i]))

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.circle_attack_range_list[i], v.center_pos)
		battle_range_util.show(self.circle_attack_range_list[i], self.ready_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:start_scythes()
	--회전 시작
	for _,v in pairs(self.scythe_info_list) do
		v.is_start_circle = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_active_scythes then
		self:update_scythe_damage(dt)
	end
	if self.is_start_circle then
		self:update_circle(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.ready)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ready then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ready_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_effect_delay and not self.is_slash_effect then
			local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("slash", self.character.Position)
			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.forward, vector_util.get_x0z(unity_class.vector3.forward)).eulerAngles.y
			slash_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

			self.is_slash_effect = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_scythe()
	if self.scythe_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.scythe_info_list) do
		v.is_active = false
		if v.effect ~= nil then
			v.effect:Dispose()
			v.effect = nil
		end

		self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
	end
	self.is_start_circle = false
end

function local_class:update_circle(dt)
	self.circle_time_passed = self.circle_time_passed + dt
	if self.circle_time_passed > self.scythe_duration then
		for _,v in pairs(self.scythe_info_list) do
			v.is_active = false
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end

			self.attack_calculator_list[_]:End()
		end
		self.is_start_circle = false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.scythe_info_list do
		local info = self.scythe_info_list[i]
		if info.is_active then
			local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, (self.circle_time_passed * self.scythe_speed * 10), 0)
					* -info.start_dir).normalized
			local pos = info.center_pos + dir * self.circle_radius
			pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
			info.effect.transform.position = pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
			info.current_pos = pos
			self.attack_calculator_list[i].Position = pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_scythe_damage(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.attack_calculator_list do
		if self.scythe_info_list[i].is_active then
			local objects = self.attack_calculator_list[i]:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.scythe_info_list[i].current_pos).normalized
					local knock_direction = direction
					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
					end

					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)

					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("scythe_hit", fo.Position)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

function local_class:cancel_scythe()

local local_class = newclass('BossInquisitorGuillotineBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.tail_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TailPrepareDuration", 1)
	self.tail_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TailDuration", 1)
	self.guillotine_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GuillotinePrepareDuration", 1)
	self.guillotine_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GuillotineDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.slash_effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SlashEffectDelay", 0.1)

	self.tail_attack_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "tailAttackMaxCount", 3)
	self.tail_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "tailRadius", 1)
	self.tail_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "tailDamageModifier", 0.1)

	self.prison_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrisonDuration", 3)
	self.prison_max_hp = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'PrisonHp', 10)
	self.tail_interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TailIntervalDuration", 0.5)
	self.speed_cap_buff_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'SpeedCapBuffName',
			'buff_villain_android_manual_bug_care')


	-- 꼬리공격 어택레인지 생성
	self.tail_attack_Range_list = {}
	self.tail_attack_calculator_list = {}

	for i = 1, 2 do
		-- 꼬리 공격 계산기 생성
		local tail_info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		tail_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		tail_info.DamageTerm = 1
		tail_info.Duration = 0.2
		tail_info.Radius = self.tail_radius
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, tail_info, false, 0, 1)
		table.insert(self.tail_attack_calculator_list, ac)

		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.tail_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		table.insert(self.tail_attack_Range_list, ar)
	end

	--속박 관련 변수
	self.default_gimmick_position = unity_class.vector3(999, 0, 999)
	self.gimmick_size = unity_class.vector3(1, 2, 1)
	self.gimmick_count = 4
	self.prison_gimmick_pool_list = {}
	self.gimmick_list = {}
	self.prison_info_list = {}
	self.current_tail_count = 0

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		tail_prepare = 3,
		tail = 4,

		guillotine_prepare = 6,

	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.bite_time_passed = 0

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)

		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end

	self:release_lock()
	self.prison_info_list ={}
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.tail_info_list = {}
	self.current_tail_count = 0
	self.is_slash_effect = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail then

		for _,v in pairs(self.tail_info_list) do
			v.is_active = false
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end

			if not v.is_hit then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", v.pos)
				v.is_end_effect = true
			end
		end

		for _,v in pairs(self.tail_attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail_interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.guillotine_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.guillotine then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		self.aura_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.tail_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:find_targets()
	elseif next_state == self.state.tail then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_tail_count = self.current_tail_count + 1
		self:start_tail_attack()
	elseif next_state == self.state.tail_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.guillotine_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--속박에 갖혀있는 케릭터 감옥지속시간 진행 안되도록
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			v.is_active = false
			v.is_guillotine = true
		end

		if self.aura_effect ~= nil then
			self.aura_effect:Dispose()
			self.aura_effect = nil
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("guillotineprepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("guillotineprepare", self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.guillotine then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("guillotine")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("guillotine2")
		--속박된 캐릭터 즉사
		self:guillotine_damage()
		self:release_lock()
		self.prison_info_list ={}
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:find_targets()
	--타겟타피 넉백
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	local target_count = targets.Count

	local index_list = {}
	for i = 1, target_count do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	local random_idx_list = {1}

	if target_count > 1 then
		random_idx_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = 2})
	end

	self.tail_info_list = nil
	self.tail_info_list = {}

	for i, v in pairs(random_idx_list) do
		if targets[v - 1] ~= nil then
			local target = targets[v - 1]
			table.insert(self.tail_info_list,
					{
						target = target,
						pos = target.Position,
						effect = nil,
						is_active = false,
						time_passed = 0,
						is_end_effect = false,
						is_hit = false
			})

			local ar = self.tail_attack_Range_list[i]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target.Position)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.tail_prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_tail_attack()
	for _,v in pairs(self.tail_info_list) do
		v.is_active = true
		v.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", v.pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison")

		self.tail_attack_Range_list[_]:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.tail_attack_Range_list[_]))

		self.tail_attack_calculator_list[_].Position = v.pos
		self.tail_attack_calculator_list[_]:Start()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_prison(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tail_prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tail_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tail)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tail_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tail_interval)
		else
			self:update_tail(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tail_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tail_interval_duration then
			if self.current_tail_count >= self.tail_attack_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.guillotine_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.tail_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.guillotine_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.guillotine_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.guillotine)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.guillotine then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_effect_delay and not self.is_slash_effect then
			local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("slash", self.character.Position)
			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.forward, vector_util.get_x0z(unity_class.vector3.forward)).eulerAngles.y
			slash_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

			self.is_slash_effect = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.guillotine_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tail(dt)
	--피격되면 속박 건다.
	for _,v in pairs(self.tail_info_list) do
		local objects = self.tail_attack_calculator_list[_]:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
					fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or
					character_util.has_active_buff(fo, 'expedition_damage_immune') then
				--???
			else
				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - v.pos).normalized

				if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.tail_damage_modifier
				damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_magwi_rock_thunder_01')

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				--속박 걸자
				if not self:check_hit_target(self.prison_info_list, fo) then
					CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo.Name, 0, false, fo)
					self:lock_target(fo)
				end
				v.is_hit = true
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:guillotine_damage()
	for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.target.EntityGroup) or
				v.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v.target) then
		else
			local damage_rate = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v.target
			damage_info.damage = damage_rate

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			--감옥 종료
			if v.effect ~= nil then
				v.effect:Dispose()
				v.effect = nil
			end
			--감옥 폭파 이펙트 && 길로틴 이팩트
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("guillrotine", v.pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", v.pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_end")
			v.is_active = false

			self:return_gimmick_object(v.prison_fo)
			self:release_target(v.target)
		end
	end
	self.prison_info_list = {}
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_prison(dt)
	if self.prison_info_list == nil then return end

	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
			self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed = self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed + dt
			if self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.prison_duration then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end
				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_end")
				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 타겟 락
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 캐릭터 조작 금지

		--애니메이션 세트, 루프
		target:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
		-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
		target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
		target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		-- 속박 이팩트
		--local prison_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison", target.Position)
		local prison_fo = self:init_gimmick(target.Position)

		-- 스피드캡 버프
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		else
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.Stop(target)
			--local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			--cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			--controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
		end

		-- 속방중이라면 상태이상 무효?
		local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoKnockBackByDamage
		target.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

		table.insert(self.prison_info_list, {
			pos = target.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_active = true,
			target = target,
			damage_count = 0,
			prison_fo = prison_fo
		})
	end
end

-- 타겟 락 해제
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
			end
		else
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			--local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			--cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			--controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end

		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker(target.Name)

		--상태이상 무효 해제
		target.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
	end
end

function local_class:release_lock()
	if self.prison_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			if v.is_active or v.is_guillotine then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				self:return_gimmick_object(v.prison_fo)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", v.pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_end", v.pos)
				self:release_target(v.target)
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end

		self.prison_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:release_lock_for_target(target)
	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active or self.prison_info_list[idx].is_guillotine then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.prison_info_list[idx].target) then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end
				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_end", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	if self.prison_info_list == nil then return end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		-- 보스의 사망판정이라면 속박 걸려있는 모든 캐릭터를 풀어줌.
		if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
			for i = #self.gimmick_list, 1, -1 do
				self:release_lock()
			end
		end
	else
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.target) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.prison_fo.fo) then
				self:release_lock_for_target(v.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.gimmick_pool_size = self.gimmick_count
	for i = 1, self.gimmick_pool_size do
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(i)
		table.insert(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
	end
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_object()
	if #self.prison_gimmick_pool_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list)
	else
		self.gimmick_pool_size = self.gimmick_pool_size + 1
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(self.gimmick_pool_size)
		return gimmick_object
	end
end

function local_class:create_gimmick_object(index_number)
	-- HACK: 풀링 한 오브젝트에 FieldObject 컴포넌트 직접 붙여서 내부에서 핸들링
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison", self.default_gimmick_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local go = effect.gameObject
	local fo = go:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))

	fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.gimmick_size)
	fo.Name = 'inquisitor_prision_' .. index_number

	-- 타격 가능한 물체
	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

	-- 오브젝트 스펙 생성
	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.FieldObjectSpec()
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecHpBase(fo_spec, self.prison_max_hp)
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecGrowthRate(fo_spec, 1)

	--기본 NullFieldObjectStatsBehaviour 이기 때문에 새로 설정함.
	local stats_behaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour()
	stats_behaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec
	fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour = stats_behaviour

	-- 데미지 1씩 들어가도록
	fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	go:SetActive(false)

	local gimmick_object = { }
	gimmick_object.fx = effect
	gimmick_object.fo = fo

	return gimmick_object
end

function local_class:return_gimmick_object(gimmick_object)
	gimmick_object.fo.Position = self.default_gimmick_position
	gimmick_object.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	table.insert(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
end

function local_class:init_gimmick(pos, idx)
	local gimmick_object = self:get_gimmick_object()
	local fo = gimmick_object.fo

	-- 기믹 활성화 하는 시점에 heal 을 해준다.
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = self.prison_max_hp
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = fo

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	fo.Position = pos
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison", fo.Position)

	return gimmick_object
	-- 마커 표시
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:reset_ailment()
	self:release_lock()
	self.prison_info_list ={}

	for _,v in pairs(self.tail_attack_Range_list) do
		v:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end

	if self.aura_effect ~= nil then
		self.aura_effect:Dispose()
		self.aura_effect = nil
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	for i = #self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, 1, -1 do
		local gimmick_object = table.remove(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, i)
		-- FieldObject 컴포넌트 파괴
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gimmick_object.fo)
		-- 이펙트 해제
		if gimmick_object.effect ~= nil then
			gimmick_object.effect:Dispose()
		end

		gimmick_object.fo = nil
		gimmick_object.effect = nil
	end

	self.prison_gimmick_pool_list = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.speed_cap_buff_name = nil
	self.tail_attack_Range_list = nil
	self.tail_attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.default_gimmick_position = nil
	self.gimmick_size = nil
	self.prison_gimmick_pool_list = nil
	self.gimmick_list = nil
	self.prison_info_list = nil
	self.tail_info_list = nil
	self.aura_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

local local_class = newclass('BossInquisitorPhaseshiftBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionPrepareDuration", 3)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.stomp_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompDuration", 0.3)
	self.stomp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StompRadius", 3)
	self.dangling_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DanglingDuration", 1)
	self.attack_range_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRangeDelay", 1.2)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallDuration", 0.3)
	self.jump_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "JumpTime", 0.3)
	self.jump_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "JumpHeight", 15)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.1)
	self.knockback_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackRadius", 5)

	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)


	-- 스톰프 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = 1
	info.Duration = 0.2
	info.Radius = self.stomp_radius
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false, 0, 1)

	-- 스톰프 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.stomp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		jump = 3,
		dangling = 4,
		fall = 5,
		stomp = 6,
		action_prepare = 7,
		action = 8,
		post = 9
	}

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.target = nil
	self.bite_time_passed = 0
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.aura_effect = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.is_attack_range_start = false
	self.is_immune = false
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_jump_start = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump")
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("fall")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		--self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("rage")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.aura_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("aura", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("rage")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.aura_effect ~= nil then
			self.aura_effect:Dispose()
			self.aura_effect = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration - self.attack_range_delay and not self.is_attack_range_start then
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
				self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration + self.attack_range_delay)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

				self.is_attack_range_start = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action_prepare)
		else
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			--???
		else
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.zone_bound.center, self.knockback_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.zone_bound.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character

			damage_info.direction = direction

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
	if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
		direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end

	direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, direction)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:cancel()

		self.slash_attack_range:Hide()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end
