function local_class:get_slash_ani_for_dir(dir)
	--방향별 애니메이션 방향 셋팅
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return "slash_rev"
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return "slash"
	end

	return "slash"
end

function local_class:get_fx_offset_for_dir(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return vector(0, 0, -2)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return vector(0, 0, -2)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return vector(0, 0, -1)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return vector(0, 1, -1)
	end

	return vector(0, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			self:update_charge(dt)
			local crashed_wall = self:update_charge_crash_wall(dt)

			if crashed_wall then
				self:crash_wall()
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shake")
				self:change_state(self.state.action_interval)
			end
		else
			self:crash_wall()
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.action_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_interval_duration then
			if self.is_enhanced then
				-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				-- 돌진 방향 보정
				self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, direction)
				self:change_state(self.state.phase2_charge_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.phase2_charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.phase2_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.phase2_charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.phase2_charge then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.phase2_action_duration then
			self:update_charge(dt)
			local crashed_wall = self:update_charge_crash_wall(dt)

			if crashed_wall then
				self:crash_wall()
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shake")
				self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
			end
		else
			self:crash_wall()
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash_action then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_effect_delay and not self.is_slash_effect then
			local slash_fx_name = self:get_slash_ani_for_dir(vector_util.to_direction(self.slash_direction))
			local slash_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(slash_fx_name, self.character.Bounds.center, self.slash_direction, self.character.Transform)
			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.forward, vector_util.get_x0z(self.slash_direction)).eulerAngles.y
			slash_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)

			self.is_slash_effect = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.slash_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_slash(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:crash_wall()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
			{
				--이벤트 정의
				'inquisitor_rush_damaged',
				-- 현재 구슬 모드값 보내서 모드에 따른 동작 배틀액션에서 정의 할수 있도록 함.
				self.character.Position.x,
				self.character.Position.y,
				self.character.Position.z
			}))
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shake")
		end
	end

local local_class = newclass('BossInvaderCoreLaserBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 2.5)
	self.tracking_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingSpeed", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 3)
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 3)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.laser_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserLength", 20)
	self.laser_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserWidth", 3)

	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = 0.5
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.laser_length/2, 4, self.laser_width/2)
	self.calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.aoe_spec = CS.Oak.AreaOfEffectManager.AoeSpecParams()
	self.aoe_spec.shape = CS.AttackRangeShape.Rectangle
	self.aoe_spec.rectSize = unity_class.vector2(10, 2)
	self.aoe_spec.rotateDirection = unity_class.vector3.right
	self.aoe_spec.duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDuration", 8)
	self.aoe_spec.damageTerm = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldDamageTerm", 0.5)
	self.aoe_spec.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FieldModifier", 2.5)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.laser_length, self.laser_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		groggy = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	--  따라다닐 범위표시의 x축 기준점 (중앙)
	cmd:AppendNumber(self.zone_bound.center.x)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target
	self.follow_x_pos = info:GetNumberAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
			self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.laser_fx = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')

		-- attack range Initialize
		self.target_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position.x = self.follow_x_pos
		self.target_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_position)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')

		-- 레이저 발사 FIXME: 오프셋 손으로 맞춤
		local root_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.character.Position.x + 0.5, self.target_position.y+0.5, self.target_position.z)
		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('laser', root_pos, unity_class.vector3.right)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('laser', root_pos)

		self.calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.calculator:Start()
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 타겟 추적
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			-- 트래킹 스피드 적용해서 추적 + 캐릭터 위치 변경
			local cur_z = self.target_position.z
			local target_z = self.target.Position.z
			local diff_z = math.abs(cur_z - target_z)

			local z_result = target_z
			if diff_z > self.tracking_speed * dt then
				if target_z > cur_z then
					z_result = cur_z + self.tracking_speed * dt
				else
					z_result = cur_z - self.tracking_speed * dt
				end
			end

			self.target_position.z = z_result
			local t = self.character.Position
			self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(t.x, t.y, z_result)

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		-- 발사 완료 후 장판
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue("crack")
			if has_value then
				sfx_info.playPosition = self.target_position
				sfx_info.parent = nil
			end

			-- TimeLimit로 자동 Dispose 되도록 널로 바꿈
			self.laser_fx = nil

			stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, self.target_position,
					self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("crack"), self.aoe_spec, nil,
					sfx_info, nil)

			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 장판 제거
	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.aoe_spec = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossInvaderCoreMeteorBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.slice_columns = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ZoneColumns", 5)
	self.slice_rows = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ZoneRows", 3)

	self.meteor_init_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "MeteorOffset", unity_class.vector3(0, 10, 0))
	self.meteor_fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FallDuration", 1.5)

	self.meteor_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Radius", 1.5)
	self.target_shot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotNum", 3)
	self.target_shot_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotDelay", 0.5)
	self.target_shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotInterval", 1)
	self.random_shot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RandomShotNum", 8)
	self.random_shot_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RandomShotDelay", 0.5)
	self.random_shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RandomShotInterval", 0.8)

	self.use_shooter = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "UseShot", false)

	-- 투사체
	if self.use_shooter == true then
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
		local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "monster_shot_small_red_energy")
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
		local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
		self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)
	else
		self.shoot_helper = nil
	end

	-- 레인지 미리 생성
	self.random_attack_ranges = {}
	self.target_attack_ranges = {}

	for _ = 1, self.random_shot_amount do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.meteor_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.random_attack_ranges, range)
	end
	for _ = 1, self.target_shot_amount do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.meteor_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.target_attack_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_range()
	if #self.random_attack_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.random_attack_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.meteor_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	range:Hide()

	if self.random_attack_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.random_attack_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.sliced_zone_bounds == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	-- 랜덤샷 정보 추가
	if self.sliced_zone_bounds ~= nil then
		local available_shoot_points = {}
		for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
			table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound)
		end

		local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = self.random_shot_amount})
		for _, bound in ipairs(random_points) do
			local rand_x = (math.random() - 0.5) * bound.extents.x + bound.center.x
			local rand_z = (math.random() - 0.5) * bound.extents.z + bound.center.z
			local final_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(unity_class.vector3(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
			cmd:AppendPosition(final_pos)
		end
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target

	-- 메테오 위치 읽기
	self.meteors = {}
	local poses = info.Positions
	for i = 0, poses.Count-1 do
		local pos = poses[i]

		local range = self:get_range()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))

		table.insert(self.meteors, {
			activated = false,
			time_passed = - self.random_shot_delay - i * self.random_shot_interval,
			position = pos,
			attack_range = range,
			fragile = false
		})
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	-- 캔슬시 activate 안된 메테오 제거
	if self.meteors ~= nil then
		for i = #self.meteors, 1, -1 do
			if self.meteors[i].activated == false then
				if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].pooled_object) then
					self.meteors[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.meteors[i].pooled_object = nil

				if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].contrail) then
					self.meteors[i].contrail:TriggeredDispose()
				end
				self.meteors[i].contrail = nil

				self:return_range(self.meteors[i].attack_range)
				self.meteors[i].attack_range = nil

				table.remove(self.meteors, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')

		self.current_shot_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 메테오 리스트 업데이트 (떨어지면 폭발+8방향 투사체)
	if self.meteors ~= nil then
		for i = #self.meteors, 1, -1 do
			local time_passed = self.meteors[i].time_passed + dt
			self.meteors[i].time_passed = time_passed

			if self.meteors[i].activated == false then
				if time_passed >= 0 then
					self.meteors[i].activated = true

					-- 이펙트 켜고 어택레인지 보이게
					self.meteors[i].attack_range:Show(self.meteor_fall_duration)
					local fx_pos = self.meteors[i].position + self.meteor_init_offset
					self.meteors[i].meteor_create_position = fx_pos
					self.meteors[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("meteor" ,fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.meteors[i].contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail" ,fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("meteor", fx_pos)
				end
			else
				if time_passed < self.meteor_fall_duration then
					if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].pooled_object) then
						local prog = time_passed / self.meteor_fall_duration
						local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.meteors[i].meteor_create_position, self.meteors[i].position, prog)
						CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.meteors[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

						if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].contrail) then
							CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.meteors[i].contrail, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
						end
					end
				else
					-- 폭발
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.meteors[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.meteors[i].position)

					local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.meteors[i].position, self.meteor_radius, 4)
					for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
						local fo = objects.Values[index]

						-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
						if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
							damage_info.sender = self.character
							damage_info.target = fo
							damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
							damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						end
					end
					objects:Dispose()

					-- 투사체 발사
					if self.use_shooter and self.meteors[i].fragile == true then
						local shoot_pos = self.meteors[i].position + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.15, 0)
						self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.forward, 0, -1, nil, false, 0)
					end

					-- 완료
					if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].pooled_object) then
						self.meteors[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.meteors[i].pooled_object = nil

					if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].contrail) then
						self.meteors[i].contrail:TriggeredDispose()
					end
					self.meteors[i].contrail = nil

					self:return_range(self.meteors[i].attack_range)
					self.meteors[i].attack_range = nil

					table.remove(self.meteors, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 일정 시간 마다 대상 위치에 메테오
		if self.current_shot_count < self.target_shot_amount and self.time_passed >= self.target_shot_delay + self.target_shot_interval * self.current_shot_count then
			self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1

			local pos = self.target.Position
			local range = self:get_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, pos)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			range:Show(self.meteor_fall_duration)

			local fx_pos = pos + self.meteor_init_offset

			table.insert(self.meteors, {
				activated = true,
				time_passed = 0,
				position = pos,
				attack_range = range,
				meteor_create_position = fx_pos,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("meteor" ,fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero),
				contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail" ,fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero),
				fragile = true
			})

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("meteor", fx_pos)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 메테오 제거
	if self.meteors ~= nil then
		for i = #self.meteors, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].pooled_object) then
				self.meteors[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.meteors[i].pooled_object = nil

			if not is_unity_null(self.meteors[i].contrail) then
				self.meteors[i].contrail:TriggeredDispose()
			end
			self.meteors[i].contrail = nil

			self:return_range(self.meteors[i].attack_range)
			self.meteors[i].attack_range = nil

			table.remove(self.meteors, i)
		end

		self.meteors = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	for _,v in pairs(self.random_attack_ranges) do v = nil end
	for _,v in pairs(self.target_attack_ranges) do v = nil end
	self.random_attack_ranges = nil
	self.target_attack_ranges = nil
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	local left = bound.min.x
	local top = bound.max.z
	local dx = bound.size.x / self.slice_columns
	local dz = bound.size.z / self.slice_rows
	local size = unity_class.vector3(dx, 1, dz)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	for i = 1, self.slice_columns do
		for j = 1, self.slice_rows do
			local each_pos = unity_class.vector3(left + (i-0.5)*dx, 0, top - (j-0.5)*dz)
			table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(each_pos, size))
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossInvaderCoreMissileBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.733)
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTiming", 0.1)
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 3)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.orb_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "OrbRadius", 1.5)
	self.fly_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FlyDuration", 5)
	self.fly_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FlyDistance", 15)

	self.target_shot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotNum", 9)
	self.target_shot_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotDelay", 0.5)
	self.target_shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetShotInterval", 0.5)

	self.shoot_offset = unity_class.vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0)

	-- 투사체
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "monster_shot_small_red_energy")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = 0.75
	info.Duration = self.fly_duration
	info.Radius = self.orb_radius
	info.Height = 3
	self.calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.virtual_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.fly_distance, self.orb_radius*2, 0)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		groggy = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
	if target_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
		target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end
	cmd:AppendDirection(target_dir)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target
	self.shot_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')

		self.shoot = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.orb ~= nil then

		local time_passed = self.orb.time_passed + dt
		self.orb.time_passed = time_passed

		if time_passed < self.orb.fly_duration then
			local prog = time_passed / self.orb.fly_duration
			local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.orb.departure, self.orb.destination, prog)

			if not is_unity_null(self.orb.pooled_object) then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.orb.pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end

			if not is_unity_null(self.orb.contrail) then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.orb.contrail, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end

			self.calculator.Position = calc_pos
			local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			if self.orb.shot_count < self.target_shot_amount and time_passed >= self.target_shot_delay + self.target_shot_interval * self.orb.shot_count then
				self.orb.shot_count = self.orb.shot_count + 1
				local shoot_pos = calc_pos + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.15, 0)
				local target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - shoot_pos).normalized
				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, target_direction, 0, -1, nil, false, 0)
			end
		else
			-- 다 못쐈으면 한번 더 쏨
			if self.orb.shot_count < self.target_shot_amount then
				self.orb.shot_count = self.orb.shot_count + 1
				local shoot_pos = self.orb.destination + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.15, 0)
				local target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - shoot_pos).normalized
				self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, target_direction, 0, -1, nil, false, 0)
			end

			-- 제거
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.orb.destination, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.orb.destination)

			if not is_unity_null(self.orb.pooled_object) then
				self.orb.pooled_object:Dispose()
			end

			if not is_unity_null(self.orb.contrail) then
				self.orb.contrail:TriggeredDispose()
			end

			if self.orb.virtual_range ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.orb.virtual_range))
			end

			self.orb.calculator:End()
			self.orb = nil
		end
	end


	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shoot = true

			local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.virtual_range, start_pos, self.shot_direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_range))

			self.calculator.Position = start_pos
			self.calculator:Start()

			self.orb = {
				time_passed = 0,
				shot_count = 0,
				fly_duration = self.fly_duration,
				departure = start_pos,
				destination = start_pos + self.shot_direction * self.fly_distance,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero),
				contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("contrail" ,start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero),
				virtual_range = self.virtual_range,
				calculator = self.calculator
			}
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("projectile", start_pos)
		end


		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 오브 제거
	if self.orb ~= nil then
		if not is_unity_null(self.orb.pooled_object) then
			self.orb.pooled_object:Dispose()
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.orb.contrail) then
			self.orb.contrail:Dispose()
		end

		if self.orb.virtual_range ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.orb.virtual_range))
		end

		self.orb.calculator:End()

		self.orb = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.hit_target_list = {}
	self.knockback_target_list = {}
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.aoe_count = 0
	self.barrier_sfx_holder = nil
	self.barrier_effect = nil
	self.is_barrier_start = false
	self.start_aoe_sfx = false
	self.aoe_sfx = nil
	self.aoe_sfx_duration = 0
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self.charge_start_pos = nil
	self.is_barrier_start = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.barrier_effect ~= nil then
		self.barrier_effect:Dispose()
		self.barrier_effect = nil
	end

	if self.barrier_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.barrier_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.barrier_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.repeat_charge then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		--attackrange start
		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.charge_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1
		self.charge_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.aoe_count = 0

		if not self.is_barrier_start then
			self.barrier_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shield", self.character.Position , unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.barrier_effect.transform:SetParent(self.character.transform)
			self.barrier_sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("loop")
			self.is_barrier_start = true
		end
		self.charge_dir = self:get_charge_direction()
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.repeat_charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")

		if self.barrier_effect ~= nil then
			self.barrier_effect:Dispose()
			self.barrier_effect = nil
		end

		if self.barrier_sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.barrier_sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.barrier_sfx_holder = nil
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("finish", self.character.Position , unity_class.vector3.zero)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_charge_direction()
	local target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
	local charge_dir = self:modify_charge_direction(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, target_dir, 0.25)
	return charge_dir
end

function local_class:camera_shake()
	if self.shake_magnitude > 0 and self.shake_duration > 0 then
		local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
		shake_info.type = CS.Oak.ShakeType.Random
		shake_info.magnitude = self.shake_magnitude
		shake_info.duration = self.shake_duration
		shake_info.useUnscaledTime = false
		shake_info.name = "invader_director"
		shake_info.diminishScale = self.shake_diminish
		shake_info.timePassed = 0
		stage_camera:Shake(shake_info)
	end
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(idx, dir)

end

function local_class:modify_charge_direction(bound, char_bound, org_dir, threshold)
	local check_top = bound.max.z - char_bound.max.z < threshold
	local check_bot = char_bound.min.z - bound.min.z < threshold
	local check_left = char_bound.min.x - bound.min.x < threshold
	local check_right = bound.max.x - char_bound.max.x < threshold

	if check_top and check_bot and check_left and check_right then
		return org_dir
	end

	if not check_top and not check_bot and not check_left and not check_right then
		return org_dir
	end

	local rad = math.atan(org_dir.z, org_dir.x)

	if check_top and check_bot then
		if check_left then
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		end

		if check_right then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		end

		if math.abs(rad) > 0.5 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		else
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		end
	end

	if check_left and check_right then
		if check_top then
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end

		if check_bot then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		end

		if rad > 0 then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		else
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end
	end

	if check_top and check_left then
		if rad > 0 and rad < 0.75 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		end

		if math.abs(rad) > 0.5 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end
	end

	if check_top and check_right then
		if rad > 0.25 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		end

		if math.abs(rad) < 0.5 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.back
		end

		return org_dir
	end

	if check_bot and check_left then
		if rad < 0 and rad > -0.75 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.right
		end

		if math.abs(rad) > 0.5 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		end

		return org_dir
	end

	if check_bot and check_right then
		if rad < -0.25 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.left
		end

		if math.abs(rad) < 0.5 * math.pi then
			return unity_class.vector3.forward
		end

		return org_dir
	end

	if check_top then
		if rad > 0 then
			if rad < 0.5 * math.pi then
				return unity_class.vector3.right
			else
				return unity_class.vector3.left
			end
		end
	end

	if check_bot then
		if rad < 0 then
			if rad > -0.5 * math.pi then
				return unity_class.vector3.right
			else
				return unity_class.vector3.left
			end
		end
	end

	if check_left then
		if math.abs(rad) > 0.5 * math.pi then
			if rad > 0 then
				return unity_class.vector3.forward
			else
				return unity_class.vector3.back
			end
		end

		return org_dir
	end

	if check_right then
		if math.abs(rad) < 0.5 * math.pi then
			if rad > 0 then
				return unity_class.vector3.forward
			else
				return unity_class.vector3.back
			end
		end

		return org_dir
	end

	return org_dir
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:update_knockback_delay(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			self:update_charge_attack_range()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.current_charge_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.repeat_charge)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			self:update_charge_damage(dt)
			self:update_charge_move(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.repeat_charge then
		if self.time_passed >= 0.1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge_attack_range()
	if self.target ~= nil then
		local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_knockback_delay(dt)
	--넉백 딜레이 적용
	if self.knockback_target_list == nil then return end
	if #self.knockback_target_list <= 0 then return end

	for i = #self.knockback_target_list, 1, -1 do
		self.knockback_target_list[i].time_passed = self.knockback_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
		if self.knockback_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.knockback_target_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge_damage(dt)
	--피격 딜레이 적용
	for i = #self.hit_target_list, 1, -1 do
		self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed = self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
		if self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.hit_target_list, i)
		end
	end

	local charge_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_bound_size)
	local move_mag = self.charge_speed * dt
	local move = move_mag * self.charge_dir

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(charge_bound, move)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or
				self:check_hit_target(self.hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(target_dir).normalized
			local move_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(self.charge_dir).normalized
			local det = vector_util.cross(move_dir_xz, target_dir_xz)

			local angle = -90
			if det > 0 then
				angle = 90
			end

			local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
					* self.charge_dir.normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = self.charge_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			if battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
				self:camera_shake()
			end

			table.insert(self.hit_target_list, {
				target = v,
				time_passed = self.damage_term
			})
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_charge_move(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.charge_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.charge_speed * dt
	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_dir), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	local diff = self.character.Position - self.charge_start_pos
	if math.abs(diff.magnitude) > self.aoe_interval_range * self.aoe_count + (self.aoe_spec.radius / 2) then
		self:set_aoe()
	end
end

function local_class:set_aoe()
	local aoe_pos = self.charge_start_pos + (self.charge_dir * (self.aoe_interval_range * self.aoe_count + (self.aoe_spec.radius / 2)))

	local aoe_hit_fn = nil
	if self.is_active_aoe_knockback then
		aoe_hit_fn =self.on_aoe_hit_func
	end

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, aoe_pos,
			self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool("aoe"), self.aoe_spec, aoe_hit_fn)

	self.aoe_count = self.aoe_count + 1

	if not self.start_aoe_sfx then
		self.aoe_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("aoe")
		self.start_aoe_sfx = true
	end

	self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_spec.duration
end

-- 장판에 데미지 주기 위한 콜백
function local_class:on_aoe_hit(fo, dir, param1, param2)
	if not is_unity_null(fo) and not self:check_hit_target(self.knockback_target_list, fo) then
		local angle = -90

		local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * dir
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
		damage_info.modifier = param1
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.2

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		table.insert(self.knockback_target_list, {
			target = fo,
			time_passed = self.aoe_knockback_delay
		})
	end
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		local blocker = e.Blocker
		if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
			if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then

				if self.current_state == self.state.action then
					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")

					self:camera_shake()
					--벽꿍 했으면 카운트 체크하여 그로기 또는 인터벌로
					if self.current_charge_count < self.repeat_count then
						self:change_state(self.state.repeat_charge)
					else
						self:change_state(self.state.post)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.charge_dir = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.barrier_sfx_holder = nil
	self.barrier_effect = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossSalamandraBonFireBattleAction')

--길드레이드용 invaderdirector 클론패턴
--지정 위치에 클론들을 소환만 하도록 별도의 행동은 하지 않는다.
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	--분신 소환 갯수
	self.clone_summon_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "CloneSummonCount", 4)

	--클론 이름 리스트
	self.clone_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "CloneName", "invader_director_clone_")
	self.drone_life_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DroneLifeTime", 1)
	self.drone_summon_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DroneSummonDistance", 3)
	self.is_clone_level_for_boss = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsCloneLevelBoss", false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil
	self.clone_list = {}
	self.drone_list = nil
	self.is_active_dron = 0
	self.dron_duration = 0

	self.on_stage_start_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), self.on_stage_start_event_func)

	self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	if self.clone_list ~= nil then
		self.clone_list = nil
		self.clone_list = {}
	end

	local level = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Level
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, level)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local clone = get_character(self.clone_name .. i)
		if clone ~= nil then
			clone.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			if self.is_clone_level_for_boss then
				clone.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
			end
			table.insert(self.clone_list, clone)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)

		self:kill_all_clones()
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	--분신 생성 위치 지정
	-- 이동가능한 지점 지정
	local center = bound.center
	local modX = bound.size.x / 4
	local modZ = bound.size.z / 4
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.summon_positions == nil then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)

	-- 미리 준비한 위치로 커맨드
	for _,point in ipairs(self.summon_positions) do
		info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(point))
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_breath_done" }))
		return
	end

	-- 무적세팅
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.All)

	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)
	local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character)

	-- 즉시 소환
	local summon_points = info.Positions
	local count = 0
	for _, summon_character in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
		if not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(summon_character) then
			local pos = summon_points[count]
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon", pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("summon", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			summon_character.Position = pos
			summon_character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = summon_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = summon_character

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(summon_character, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(summon_character.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(summon_character, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))


			if targets ~= nil then
				for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
					battle:AddAggro(summon_character, targets[index], 999999)
				end
				targets:Dispose()
			end

			count = count + 1
			if count >= summon_points.Count then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:remove_summons()
	if self.summon_characters ~= nil then
		for _, summon_character in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
			if not is_unity_null(summon_character) then
				if not summon_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					summon_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = summon_character
					damage_info.target = summon_character
					damage_info.damage = summon_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					summon_character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 무적옵션과 비헤이비어 되돌림
function local_class:option_reset()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_breath_done" }))
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.proj_fx) then
		self.proj_fx:Dispose()
		self.proj_fx = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_holder_1 ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder_1:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder_1 = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_holder_2 ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder_2:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder_2 = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self:option_reset()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:remove_summons()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		self.projectile_start_position = self.character.Position + self.fx_offset
		self.proj_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", self.projectile_start_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self.sfx_holder_1 = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("loop1", self.projectile_start_position)
		self.sfx_holder_2 = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("loop2", self.projectile_start_position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		local roar_fx_pos = self.character.Position + self.fx_offset
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("roar", roar_fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("roar")
		self.attack_started = false
		self.attack_counter = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
		self:option_reset()

	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
		self:option_reset()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.attack_delay then
			-- 투사체 위치 갱신
			local prog = self.time_passed / self.attack_delay
			local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.projectile_start_position, self.zone_center_pos, prog)

			if not is_unity_null(self.proj_fx) then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.proj_fx, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end

			if self.sfx_holder_1 ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder_1:SetPosition(calc_pos)
			end

			if self.sfx_holder_2 ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder_2:SetPosition(calc_pos)
			end

		elseif not self.attack_started then
			self.attack_started = true

			-- 소환한 몬스터 제거
			self:remove_summons()

			if not is_unity_null(self.proj_fx) then
				local p = self.proj_fx.transform.position
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", p)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", p, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.proj_fx:Dispose()
				self.proj_fx = nil
			end

			if self.sfx_holder_1 ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder_1:Stop()
				self.sfx_holder_1 = nil
			end

			if self.sfx_holder_2 ~= nil then
				self.sfx_holder_2:Stop()
				self.sfx_holder_2 = nil
			end
		else
			-- 공격 판정 다단히트 화
			if self.attack_counter < self.damage_split and
					self.time_passed - self.attack_delay >= self.attack_counter * self.damage_interval then
				-- 전체 공격
				local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
				if targets ~= nil then
					for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
						local fo = targets[i]
						-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
						if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

							local direction = unity_class.vector3.down

							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
							damage_info.sender = self.character
							damage_info.target = fo
							damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier / self.damage_split
							damage_info.direction = direction

							if self.attack_counter == 0 then
								damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
								damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
								damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
							end

							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						end
					end
					targets:Dispose()
				end

				self.attack_counter = self.attack_counter + 1
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			-- 스테이트 끝났는데 덜때렸으면 이시점에서 때리고 넘어감
			if self.attack_counter < self.damage_split then
				local remain = self.damage_split - self.attack_counter
				for l = 1, remain do
					local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
					if targets ~= nil then
						for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
							local fo = targets[i]
							-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
							if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

								local direction = unity_class.vector3.down

								local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
								damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
								damage_info.sender = self.character
								damage_info.target = fo
								damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier / self.damage_split
								damage_info.direction = direction

								command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
							end
						end
						targets:Dispose()
					end
				end
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroy(e)
	-- 모든 소환 몬스터 죽었다면 prepare 상태에서 action 건너 뛰고 그로기
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		for _, summon_character in ipairs(self.summon_characters) do
			if summon_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead == false then
				return false
			end
		end

		-- 자폭
		if not is_unity_null(self.proj_fx) then
			local p = self.proj_fx.transform.position
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", p)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", p, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.proj_fx:Dispose()
			self.proj_fx = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_holder_1 ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder_1:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder_1 = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_holder_2 ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder_2:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder_2 = nil
		end

		self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(self.proj_fx) then
		self.proj_fx:Dispose()
		self.proj_fx = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_holder_1 ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder_1:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder_1 = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_holder_2 ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder_2:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder_2 = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.on_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.summon_characters = nil
	self.summon_positions = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	local center = bound.center
	self.zone_center_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(center)
end

-- 소환 몬스터 리스트 업
function local_class:initialize_summons()
	self.summon_characters = {}
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.summon_name_base, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			table.insert(self.summon_characters, obj)
		end
	end

	local markers = field:GetAllMarkers()
	self.summon_positions = {}
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local marker_name = string.format("%s%d", self.marker_name_base, i)

		local has_value, marker = markers:TryGetValue(marker_name)
		if has_value == true then
			table.insert(self.summon_positions, marker.position)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	if #self.summon_positions == 0 then
		self.summon_positions = {
			unity_class.vector3(self.zone_center_pos.x - 1, 0, self.zone_center_pos.z + 1),
			unity_class.vector3(self.zone_center_pos.x + 1, 0, self.zone_center_pos.z + 1),
			unity_class.vector3(self.zone_center_pos.x - 1, 0, self.zone_center_pos.z - 1),
			unity_class.vector3(self.zone_center_pos.x + 1, 0, self.zone_center_pos.z - 1)
		}
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.mines ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.mines, 1, -1 do
			local mine_time = self.mines[i].time_passed + dt
			self.mines[i].time_passed = mine_time

			if mine_time < 0 then
				-- 아직 생성 전
			elseif self.mines[i].activated == false then
				-- 오브젝트 생성
				self.mines[i].activated = true
				self.mines[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("mine", self.mines[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("mine", self.mines[i].position)
			else
				-- 충돌 검사
				local hit = false
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.mines[i].position, self.mine_radius, 4)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.mine_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = unity_class.vector3.forward
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.mine_knock_back_force

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

						hit = true
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()

				if hit or mine_time >= self.mine_life_time then
					-- 폭파 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.mines[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.mines[i].position)

					-- 오브젝트 삭제
					if not is_unity_null(self.mines[i].pooled_object) then
						self.mines[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.mines[i].pooled_object = nil

					-- 어택레인지 반환
					self:return_mine_range(self.mines[i].attack_range)
					self.mines[i].attack_range = nil

					-- 데이터 삭제 및 리스트에서 제거
					table.remove(self.mines, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attacked and self.time_passed >= self.attack_timing then
			self.attacked = true

			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			local fx_pos = self.damage_bound.center
			fx_pos.x = self.damage_bound.max.x
			-- fx_pos.x = self.character.Position.x
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("attack", battle_util.get_ground_pos(fx_pos), unity_class.vector3.left)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack", self.damage_bound.center)

			-- 공격 범위 데미지
			local objects = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.damage_bound.max, self.damage_bound, true)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = unity_class.vector3.back
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.slash_knock_back_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:terminate_mines()
	-- 남은 지뢰 강제로 제거
	if self.mines ~= nil then
		for i = #self.mines, 1, -1 do
			if not is_unity_null(self.mines[i].pooled_object) then
				self.mines[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.mines[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택레인지 반환
			self:return_mine_range(self.mines[i].attack_range)
			self.mines[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.mines, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self:terminate_mines()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	-- 배틀 존에 맞춰서 데미지 바운드와 어택 레인지 고정시킴
	local top_center = bound.center
	top_center.z = bound.max.z - self.slash_zone_breadth/2
	top_center = battle_util.get_ground_pos(top_center)
	local size_x = bound.size.x

	if self.damage_bound == nil then
		self.damage_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(top_center, unity_class.vector3(size_x, 10, self.slash_zone_breadth))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		top_center.y = top_center.y + 0.05
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(top_center, unity_class.vector2(size_x, self.slash_zone_breadth), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayReverse)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	-- 지뢰 깔릴 위치 미리 잘라두기
	local left = bound.min.x
	local top = bound.min.z + self.mine_zone_breadth

	local dx = size_x / self.mine_columns
	local dz = self.mine_zone_breadth / self.mine_rows
	local size = unity_class.vector3(dx, 4, dz)

	self.mine_candi_bounds = {}
	for i = 1, self.mine_columns do
		for j = 1, self.mine_rows do
			local each_pos = unity_class.vector3(left + (i-0.5)*dx, 0, top - (j-0.5)*dz)
			table.insert(self.mine_candi_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(each_pos, size))
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
