local local_class = newclass('BossInvaderDragonShotBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 2.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 3)
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootTiming", 0.1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.shot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotSpeed", 15)

	self.explosion_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionInterval", 1)
	self.lv1_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RadiusLv1", 2)
	self.lv2_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RadiusLv2", 4)
	self.lv3_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RadiusLv3", 6)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.lv1_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.virtual_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.lv3_radius)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			-- dispose fx
			if not is_unity_null(self.prepare_fx) then
				self.prepare_fx:Dispose()
			end
			self.prepare_fx = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 발사 실패 시 레인지 지움
		if not self.shoot then
			-- dispose prepare fx
			if not is_unity_null(self.prepare_fx) then
				self.prepare_fx:Dispose()
			end
			self.prepare_fx = nil

			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")

		-- attack range
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.shoot_timing + 0.2)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		-- casting effect
		self.prepare_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.shoot = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:explode_damage(lv, t_pos)
	-- 폭발 범위 이펙트 + 사운드 + 데미지

	local candidates
	local excepts

	if lv == 1 then
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.lv1_radius)
		excepts = nil
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion1", t_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion1", t_pos)
	elseif lv == 2 then
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.lv2_radius)
		excepts = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.lv1_radius)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion2", t_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion2", t_pos)
	elseif lv == 3 then
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.lv3_radius)
		excepts = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(t_pos, self.lv2_radius)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion3", t_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion3", t_pos)
	end

	for index = 0, candidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = candidates.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			if excepts == nil or excepts:ContainsValue(fo) == false then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
	candidates:Dispose()
	if excepts ~= nil then
		excepts:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.explosion_shot ~= nil then
		self.explosion_shot.time_passed = self.explosion_shot.time_passed + dt

		if self.explosion_shot.time_passed <= self.explosion_shot.fly_duration then
			-- 투사체 위치 갱신
			local prog = self.explosion_shot.time_passed / self.explosion_shot.fly_duration
			local calc_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.explosion_shot.departure_position, self.explosion_shot.destination_position, prog)

			if not is_unity_null(self.explosion_shot.shot_object) then
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.explosion_shot.shot_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			end
		else
			if self.explosion_shot.progress == 0 then
				-- 1차 폭발
				self.explosion_shot.progress = 1

				-- 폭발 데미지 처리
				self:explode_damage(self.explosion_shot.progress, self.explosion_shot.destination_position)

				-- 투사체 제거
				if not is_unity_null(self.explosion_shot.shot_object) then
					self.explosion_shot.shot_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.explosion_shot.shot_object = nil

				-- 레인지 갱신
				-- visible range off
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_shot.attack_range))
				self.explosion_shot.attack_range:Hide()
				self.explosion_shot.attack_range = nil

				--virtual range on
				self.explosion_shot.virtual_range = self.virtual_range
				self.explosion_shot.virtual_range.Position = pos
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_shot.virtual_range))
			else
				local time_from_landing = self.explosion_shot.time_passed - self.explosion_shot.fly_duration

				-- 1차 폭발 후 딜레이 두고 2차, 3차 폭발
				if time_from_landing >= self.explosion_shot.progress * self.explosion_interval then
					self.explosion_shot.progress = self.explosion_shot.progress + 1

					-- 폭발 데미지
					self:explode_damage(self.explosion_shot.progress, self.explosion_shot.destination_position)

					if self.explosion_shot.progress >= 3 then
						-- 3차 폭발까지 완료 됐다면 소멸
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_shot.virtual_range))

						self.explosion_shot = nil
					end
				end
			end

		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 타겟 따라다니기
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			self.target_position = self.target.Position
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.shoot and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shoot = true

			-- dispose prepare fx
			if not is_unity_null(self.prepare_fx) then
				self.prepare_fx:Dispose()
			end
			self.prepare_fx = nil

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")

			self.explosion_shot = {
				progress = 0,
				time_passed = 0,
				fly_duration = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target_position) / self.shot_speed,
				departure_position = self.character.Position,
				destination_position = self.target_position,
				shot_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero),
				attack_range = self.attack_range
			}
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 날아가는 이펙트 및 폭발 과정 바로 중단
	if self.explosion_shot ~= nil then
		if not is_unity_null(self.explosion_shot.shot_object) then
			self.explosion_shot.shot_object:Dispose()
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.explosion_shot.attack_range) then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_shot.attack_range))
			self.explosion_shot.attack_range:Hide()
		end

		if self.explosion_shot.virtual_range ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.explosion_shot.virtual_range))
		end

	end
	self.explosion_shot = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	cmd:AppendNumber(self.zone_bound.min.x + self.safe_x)
	cmd:AppendNumber(self.zone_bound.max.x - self.safe_x)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target

	self.follow_z_pos = info:GetNumberAt(0)
	self.follow_x_min = info:GetNumberAt(1)
	self.follow_x_max = info:GetNumberAt(2)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_cast_end" }))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { "invader_dragon_cast_start", tostring(self.prepare_duration) }))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		-- attack range
		local temp_x = self.target.Position.x
		temp_x = math.max(self.follow_x_min, math.min(temp_x, self.follow_x_max))
		self.target_position = unity_class.vector3(temp_x, self.target.Position.y, self.follow_z_pos)
		self.target_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.attack_timing)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self.attacked = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 벽 라이프타임 관리
	if self.wall_info ~= nil then
		self.wall_info.time_passed = self.wall_info.time_passed + dt

		if self.wall_info.time_passed >= self.wall_info.duration then
			self:remove_wall(false)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 타겟 따라다니기
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			local temp_x = self.target.Position.x
			temp_x = math.max(self.follow_x_min, math.min(temp_x, self.follow_x_max))
			self.target_position = unity_class.vector3(temp_x, self.target.Position.y, self.follow_z_pos)
			self.target_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_position)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attacked and self.time_passed >= self.attack_timing then
			self.attacked = true

			-- 찍을때 끔
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			-- 공격 범위 데미지
			self.damage_bound.center = self.target_position

			local sort_root = unity_class.vector3(self.target_position.x, self.target_position.y, self.damage_bound.max.z)

			-- 내려치기 이펙트
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("attack", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_magnitude, self.shake_duration)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack", sort_root)

			local objects = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(sort_root, self.damage_bound, true)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					-- 타격 x축 중심선에 대해 수직으로 넉백
					local knock_direction
					if fo.Position.x < sort_root.x then
						knock_direction = unity_class.vector3.left
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.vector3.right
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			-- 벽 생성
			local positions = {}
			local pooled_objects = {}

			-- 공격 지역에 오브젝트 생성 및 위치 저장 (이펙트 기준점 조정)
			local obj_pos = self.target_position - unity_class.vector3(0, 0, self.range_z/2)
			local obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall", obj_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall", obj_pos)

			table.insert(positions, obj_pos)
			table.insert(pooled_objects, obj)

			self.virtual_wall.Position = self.target_position
			self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			self.wall_info = {
				time_passed = 0,
				duration = self.wall_life_time,
				wall = self.virtual_wall,
				positions = positions,
				pooled_objects = pooled_objects,
			}
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_wall(forced)
	if self.wall_info ~= nil then
		-- 오브젝트 제거
		if self.wall_info.pooled_objects ~= nil then
			for i = #self.wall_info.pooled_objects, 1, -1 do
				if not is_unity_null(self.wall_info.pooled_objects[i]) then
					self.wall_info.pooled_objects[i]:Dispose()
				end
				table.remove(self.wall_info.pooled_objects, i)
			end
			self.wall_info.pooled_objects = nil
		end

		if not forced then
			-- 제거 이펙트
			if self.wall_info.positions ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #self.wall_info.positions, 1 do
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_end", self.wall_info.positions[i], unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_end", self.wall_info.positions[i])
				end
			end
		end
		self.wall_info.positions = nil

		self.wall_info.wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		self.wall_info = nil
	end
end
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self:remove_wall(true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.is_shot_start = true
		self.shot_effect_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot",
				self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

--강화패턴용 가장 멀리 있는 타겟을 찾는다.
function local_class:get_target()
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if target_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local dist = 0
	for _, v in pairs(target_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			if dist < vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position) then
				self.shot_target = v
				dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_shot_start then
		self:shot_update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed <= self.trace_target_duration then
				local _, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target, direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
				self.charge_direction = dir
				battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			if self.current_charge_count < self.charge_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.charge_prepare)
			else
				if self.enhanced then
					self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= 0.5 then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_skip_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shot_update(dt)
	if self.shot_passed_time <= self.shot_duration + self.shot_move_duration then
		self.shot_passed_time = self.shot_passed_time + dt

		if is_unity_null(self.shot_effect_obj) then
			return
		end

		if self.shot_passed_time <= self.shot_move_duration then
			self.shot_effect_obj.transform.position =
			self.shot_start_pos + self.shot_passed_time / self.shot_move_duration * self.shot_diff
		end

		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.shot_effect_obj.transform.position, self.shot_radius)

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

			local is_hit_delayed = false
			for i = #self.shot_hit_list, 1, -1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.shot_hit_list[i].fo) then
					self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time = self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
					if self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.shot_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
						is_hit_delayed = true
					else
						table.remove(self.shot_hit_list, i)
					end
				end
			end

			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
					fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
			else
				local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.shot_dest_pos).normalized
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				table.insert(self.shot_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.shot_damage_delay })

				--히트 된대상의 어그로 증가
				local aggro = character_util.get_dps(self.character) * self.aggro_multiplier
				command_util.publish_aggro_add(fo, self.character, aggro)
			end
		end

		fo_list:Dispose()
	else
		if not is_unity_null(self.shot_effect_obj) then
			self.shot_effect_obj:Dispose()
		end
		self.shot_effect_obj = nil
		self.is_shot_start = false
		--self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.charge_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range_shot) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range_shot)
	end
	self.shot_effect_obj = nil
	self.shot_dest_pos = nil
	self.shot_hit_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.shot_target = nil
	self.shot_direction = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)

	if is_unity_null(self.virtual_attack_range) then

				self.zone_bounds.size.x, self.shot_radius, 0)
	end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character,
			self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.dark_hand_info_list = {}
	self.dark_hand_hit_list = {}
	self.explosion_hit_list = {}
	self.is_start_animation = false
	self.is_start_casting = false
	self.instantiate_casting_effect = false
	self.is_start_aura_effect = false
	self.is_enabled = true

	self:change_state(self.state.blink_prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	if (self.dark_hand_info_list ~= nil) then
		for _, v in pairs(self.dark_hand_info_list) do
			for _, v2 in pairs(v.effect_obj_list) do
				if not is_unity_null(v2.effect_obj) then
					v2.effect_obj:Dispose()
				end
				v2.effect_obj = nil
				v2 = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.virtual_attack_range) then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.dark_hand_casting_effect) then
		self.dark_hand_casting_effect:Dispose()
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.aura_effect) then
		self.aura_effect:Dispose()
	end

	if is_dispose ~= true then
		if not self.is_enabled then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	end

	if self.casting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.casting_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.blink_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("start", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.blink_center then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink_thunder", self.zone_bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if not self.is_start_action then
			self.aura_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("aura", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.is_start_action = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("casting")
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("casting")
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local shot_start_pos1 = vector(self.zone_bounds.min.x, 0, self.target.Position.z)
		local shot_start_pos2 = vector(self.zone_bounds.max.x, 0, self.target.Position.z)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.virtual_attack_range, shot_start_pos1, vector_util.right, self.character.Position.y)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))

		local dest = self.zone_bounds.center
		dest.z = self.target.Position.z

		local diff1 = dest - shot_start_pos1
		local diff2 = dest - shot_start_pos2

		table.insert(self.dark_hand_info_list, {
			start_action = false,
			end_action = false,
			dest_pos = dest,
			life_time = diff1.magnitude / self.shot_speed,
			is_explosion = false,
			passed_time = 0,
			explosion_time = self.shot_impact_duration,
			explosion_passed_time = 0,

			effect_obj_list = {
				{
					effect_obj = nil,
					start_pos = shot_start_pos1,
					diff = diff1,
					direction = unity_class.vector3.right
				},
				{
					effect_obj = nil,
					start_pos = shot_start_pos2,
					diff = diff2,
					direction = unity_class.vector3.left
				}
			}
		})
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		for i = 1, 2 do
			self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].effect_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dark_hand",
					self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].start_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].start_pos)
		end
		self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].start_action = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		if not is_unity_null(self.aura_effect) then
			self.aura_effect:Dispose()
		end
		if self.casting_sfx ~= nil then
			self.casting_sfx:Stop()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:dark_hand_update(dt)

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.blink_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_enable_delay and self.is_enabled then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
			self.is_enabled = false
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.blink_center)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blink_center then
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_duration then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.is_enabled = true
			self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bounds.center)
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed <= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration and not self.is_start_casting then
			if not self.instantiate_casting_effect then
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("casting",
						self.character.Position + self.casting_effect_offset)
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
				self.instantiate_casting_effect = true
				--캐스팅 사운드
				self.casting_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
				if self.enhanced then
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("enhanced_cast")
				end
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_prepare_duration))
			self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration then
			self.is_start_casting = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

		if self.is_start_casting then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_post_duration))
			self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.one

			if self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_post_duration then
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect:Dispose()
				self.is_start_casting = false
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dark_hand_update(dt)

	--Info가 없다면 실행하지 않음
	if #self.dark_hand_info_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	--중심으로 이동하는 dark_hand 시퀸스들
	for i = #self.dark_hand_info_list, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.dark_hand_info_list[i]
		if info.start_action and not info.end_action then

			if info.passed_time <= info.life_time then
				info.passed_time = info.passed_time + dt

				for _, v in pairs(info.effect_obj_list) do
					v.effect_obj.transform.position = v.start_pos + info.passed_time / info.life_time * v.diff

					local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.effect_obj.transform.position, self.shot_radius)

					for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

						local is_hit_delayed = false
						for i = #self.dark_hand_hit_list, 1, -1 do
							if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].fo) then
								self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time = self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
								if self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
									is_hit_delayed = true
								else
									table.remove(self.dark_hand_hit_list, i)
								end
							end
						end

						if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
								fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
								lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
						else
							local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - info.dest_pos).normalized
							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
							damage_info.sender = self.character
							damage_info.target = fo
							damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
							damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
							damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
							damage_info.knockBackDirection = v.direction
							damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
							table.insert(self.dark_hand_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.shot_damage_delay })
						end
					end

					fo_list:Dispose()
				end
			else
				if info.explosion_passed_time <= info.explosion_time then
					info.explosion_passed_time = info.explosion_passed_time + dt
					if not info.is_explosion then
						for _, effect in pairs(info.effect_obj_list) do
							effect.effect_obj:Dispose()
							effect.effect_obj = nil
						end
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", info.dest_pos)

						--폭발 사운드
						self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", info.dest_pos)

						info.is_explosion = true
					end

					self:impact_damage(info.dest_pos)
				else
					if self.enhanced then
						self:shoot_radial_shot(info.dest_pos)
					end
					self.dark_hand_info_list[i].end_action = true
					self.explosion_hit_list = {}
					self.dark_hand_hit_list = {}
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_radial_shot(pos)
	for i = 1, self.radial_shot_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.radial_shot_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, dir, i, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:impact_damage(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.shot_explosion_radius)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo)
				or table_util.contain_value(self.explosion_hit_list, fo) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.shot_explosion_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.explosion_hit_list, fo)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.virtual_attack_range)
	end

	self.target = nil
	self.virtual_attack_range = nil
	self.dark_hand_info_list = nil
	self.dark_hand_hit_list = nil
	self.explosion_hit_list = nil
	self.dark_hand_casting_effect = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.casting_effect_offset = nil
	self.aura_effect = nil
	self.casting_sfx = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.shot_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotAngle", 180)
	self.laser_rotate_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserRotateSpeed", 30)
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.1)
	self.laser_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDistance", 10)
	self.laser_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserWidth", 1.3)
	self.cristal_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CristalDistance", 4)

	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		laser = 3,
		reverse_laser = 4,

	}

		self.laser_count = 4
	end

			current_distance = 0
		})
	end

	self.cristal_pool = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local v = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		v.Name = string.format("%s%d", "ik_spawn_point_", i)
		v.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.8, 2, 0.8))
		v.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		v.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		table.insert(self.cristal_pool, v)

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)

	end

		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

			"PredetorBattleActionName") then

function local_class:cancel()
	for _,v in pairs(self.cristal_pool) do
		v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
	for _,v in pairs(self.cristal_info_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.cristal_obj) then
			v.cristal_obj:Dispose()
			v = nil
		end
	end
	for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.laser_effect) then
			v.laser_effect:Dispose()
			v = nil
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
	end

	self.cristal_pool = {}
	self.laser_info_list = {}

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.laser then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reverse_laser then
		for _,v in pairs(self.cristal_pool) do
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.cristal_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.cristal_obj) then
				v.cristal_obj:Dispose()
			end
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.laser_info_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v.laser_effect) then
				v.laser_effect:Dispose()
			end
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(v) then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.start_laser_pos = self.predator.Position
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self:spawn_cristal()
	elseif next_state == self.state.laser then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		for i = 1, #self.laser_info_list do
			self.laser_info_list[i].laser_effect = self:laser_create_effect(self.laser_info_list[i].shoot_dir)
			self.laser_info_list[i].current_dir = self.laser_info_list[i].shoot_dir
			self:laser_scale_animation(i, 0)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.reverse_laser then
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:spawn_cristal()
	local start_pos = self.predator.Position
	--local diff = unity_class.vector3.right
	--local direction = diff.normalized
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local center_angle = 120 * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (self.shot_angle / 2), 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local dest_pos = start_pos + dir * self.cristal_distance
		self.cristal_pool[i].Position = dest_pos
		if self.zone_bounds:Contains(dest_pos) then
			self.cristal_pool[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			local cristal_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cristal", dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			table.insert(self.cristal_info_list, {cristal_obj = cristal_object})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.laser)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration  then
			self:change_state(self.state.reverse_laser)
		else
			self:laser_update(dt, false)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.reverse_laser then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration  then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:laser_update(dt, true)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:laser_update(dt, reverse)
	for i = 1, #self.laser_info_list do
		self:laser_check_collision_update(dt, self.laser_info_list[i].current_dir, i)
		local f_angle = self.laser_rotate_speed * dt
		if reverse then
			f_angle = -f_angle
		end
		local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(f_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
				* self.laser_info_list[i].current_dir
		self:laser_rotate(i, rot_dir)
		self:calc_attack_range(i, self.laser_info_list[i].current_dir, self.laser_info_list[i].current_distance)
	end
end

function local_class:laser_check_collision_update(dt, shoot_dir, laser_idx)
	local blocked = false

	local rad = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(shoot_dir.z, shoot_dir.x)
	local sin_rad = unity_class.mathf.Sin(rad)
	local cos_rad = unity_class.mathf.Cos(rad)

	local calc_size = vector(self.laser_width * math.abs(sin_rad), 2, self.laser_width * math.abs(cos_rad))
	local calc_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.start_laser_pos, calc_size)
	local calc_move = shoot_dir * self.laser_distance

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetCollidedFieldObjects(calc_bound, calc_move)
	local idx = 0
	local dists = fo_list.Item1
	local objs = fo_list.Item2
	local is_possible_hit = true
	for i = 0, objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objs[i]
		if string.find(fo.Name, "ik_spawn_point") then
			blocked = true
			local sc = dists[_].distance / 6
			self.laser_info_list[laser_idx].laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(sc, 1, 1)
			self.laser_info_list[laser_idx].current_distance = dists[_].distance
			break
		else
			self.laser_info_list[laser_idx].current_distance = self.laser_distance
		end

		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
		else
			for i = #self.hit_target_list, 1, -1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.hit_target_list[i].target, fo) then
					self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed = self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed - dt
					if self.hit_target_list[i].time_passed <= 0 then
						table.remove(self.hit_target_list, i)
					else
						is_possible_hit = false
					end
				end
			end

			if is_possible_hit then
				local least_col_dist = self.laser_width * 0.5 + fo.Bounds.extents:GetXz().magnitude
				local dist_to_laser = CS.GeometryUtils.PointLineDistance(fo.Position,
				self.start_laser_pos, self.start_laser_pos + shoot_dir * self.laser_distance, false)

				if dist_to_laser < least_col_dist then
					local dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(calc_move).normalized
					local target_dir_xz = vector_util.get_xz(fo.Bounds.center - self.start_laser_pos).normalized
					local det = vector_util.cross(dir_xz, target_dir_xz)
					local angle = 110
					if det > 0 then
						angle = -110
					end

					local knockback_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * calc_move.normalized


					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.1

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					table.insert(self.hit_target_list, {
						target = fo,
						time_passed = self.damage_term
					})
				end
			end
		end

		if not blocked then
			self.laser_info_list[laser_idx].laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(self.laser_full_scale, 1, 1)
		end
		idx = idx + 1
	end

	dists:Dispose()
	objs:Dispose()
end

function local_class:laser_rotate(laser_index, shoot_dir)
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(shoot_dir.z, -shoot_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	self.laser_info_list[laser_index].laser_effect.transform.rotation = rotation
	self.laser_info_list[laser_index].current_dir = shoot_dir
end

function local_class:laser_create_effect(shoot_dir)
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(shoot_dir.z, -shoot_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local create_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.start_laser_pos)
	local laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", create_pos,
			vector(0, angle, 0), self.predator.Transform)
	laser_effect.transform.localRotation = rotation
	laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(self.laser_full_scale, 1, 1)

	return laser_effect
end

function local_class:laser_scale_animation(laser_index, progress)
	self.laser_info_list[laser_index].laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(self.laser_full_scale, 1, progress)
end

function local_class:calc_attack_range(laser_index, dir, dist)
	local direction = dir.normalized
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[laser_index], self.start_laser_pos, direction, dist)
	self.attack_range_list[laser_index].Size = vector(dist, self.laser_width)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[laser_index], 1000))
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.start_laser_pos = nil
	self.laser_info_list = nil
	self.shoot_dir_list = nil
	self.cristal_pool = nil
	self.cristal_info_list = nil

	for _,v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
		end
		v = nil
	end
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.predator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

			-- 투사체 위치 갱신
			local calc_pos = self.throw_shot.start_position + self.throw_shot.time_passed * self.throw_shot.fly_speed * self.throw_shot.fly_direction

			-- 바운드 밖으로 나간다면 그 자리에서 wall action 실행
			if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, calc_pos) then
				local new_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bound:ClosestPoint(calc_pos))

			else
				-- 위치 업데이트
				if not is_unity_null(self.throw_shot.pooled_object) then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.throw_shot.pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

				local objects = self.throw_shot.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					end

				objects:Dispose()
			end
		else
			local calc_pos = self.throw_shot.start_position + self.throw_shot.fly_duration * self.throw_shot.fly_speed * self.throw_shot.fly_direction


			if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.zone_bound, calc_pos) then
				local new_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bound:ClosestPoint(calc_pos))
				self:trigger_wall(self.throw_shot.pooled_object, new_pos)
			else
				self:trigger_ground(self.throw_shot.pooled_object, calc_pos)
			end

			self.throw_shot.calculator:End()
			self.throw_shot = nil
		end
	end

		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.activate then
		-- wall/ground 액션 실행 안됐다면 실행
		if self.trigger_flag == false then
			self.trigger_flag = self.current_optional_action.MetaTable:trigger()
		end

		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.stomp_action) then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.stomp_action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.stomp_action)
			end
		end

		-- wall/ground 액션 실행 안됐다면 실행
		if self.trigger_flag == false then
			self.trigger_flag = self.current_optional_action.MetaTable:trigger()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.punish then
		-- TODO: 얼린 캐릭터 복귀 시키기
		-- TODO: 모든 대상에게 데미지
	end
end

	-- TODO: 인터렉트 할 FO 가져와서 위치 세팅
	self.current_optional_action = self.wall_action
	self.trigger_flag = self.wall_action.MetaTable:trigger()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_reverse then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			self.cristal_pool[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			self.cristal_info_list[i].cristal_obj:Dispose()
		end
		self.cristal_info_list = {}
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.target_direction = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.zone_bounds.center - self.character.Position)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self:spawn_cristal()

	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then

		self.current_shoot_count = 0

function local_class:spawn_cristal()
	local start_pos = self.character.Position
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_direction)
	local direction = diff.normalized
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local center_angle = 45 * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle - (self.shot_angle / 2), 0) * direction
		local dest_pos = start_pos + dir * self.cristal_distance
		self.cristal_pool[i].Position = dest_pos
		self.cristal_pool[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		local cristal_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cristal", dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	end

function local_class:shoot_update(dt, is_reverse)

		else

			if self.current_shoot_count >= self.shot_amount then
				self.shoot_update_end = true
			end
		end
		self.shoot_time_passed = 0
		self.shoot_ready = false
	else
		if self.shoot_time_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			self.shoot_ready = true
		else
			self.shoot_time_passed = self.shoot_time_passed + dt
		end
	end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
	if dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.side_only == true then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		else
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		end
	end

	if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir_to_look)
	end

	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_enabled = true
	self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		if self.is_jump_start then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
		end
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		v:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_active_stomp_attack_range = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target.Position, false)
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target.Position, false)
		self.is_start_stomp_effect = false
		self.is_start_stomp_animation = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.jump_prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
			v:Start()
		end
		self.is_jump_start = false

		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
		end
		stage_camera:Shake(self.stomp_camera_shake_magnitude, self.stomp_camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:cross_attack_range_update()
	local center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position))
	local height = battle_util.get_height(center_pos)

	local start_dir1 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local start_dir2 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -45, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local start_pos1 = center_pos - start_dir1 * (self.stomp_distance / 2)
	local start_pos2 = center_pos - start_dir2 * (self.stomp_distance / 2)

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[1], start_pos1, start_dir1, height)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[2], start_pos2, start_dir2, height)
	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
	if not self.is_active_stomp_attack_range then
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Show(self.jump_duration + self.dangling_duration + self.fall_duration)
		end
		self.is_active_stomp_attack_range = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range", center_pos)
	end

	self.attack_calculator_list[1].Position = center_pos
	self.attack_calculator_list[1].Direction = start_dir1
	self.attack_calculator_list[2].Position = center_pos
	self.attack_calculator_list[2].Direction = start_dir2
	self.stomp_center_pos = center_pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.target_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target.Position, false)
		self:cross_attack_range_update()
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.target_position = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, false)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if not self.is_start_stomp_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
			self.is_start_stomp_animation = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration - 0.2 and not self.is_start_stomp_effect then

			local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position, battle_util.get_height(self.target_position) + 0.1)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", effect_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", effect_pos)
			self.is_start_stomp_effect = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
					battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
				if self.current_repeat_count < self.stomp_repeat_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			else
				self:stomp_damage_update(dt)
			end
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stomp_damage_update(dt)
	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel(is_dispose)
	self:cancel(is_dispose)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
		end
	end

	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.delay then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
			self.attack_range:Hide()
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			self.smoke_fx = nil
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration + self.delay_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.delay_duration)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.synced = false
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("charge")
		self.smoke_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smoke", self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.wind_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wind", self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 준비 시간동안 돌진 방향 추적
		self.charge_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.delay)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.delay_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then

		-- 부딫힌 가벽 제거
		local n = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1))
		if n >= 0 then
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
					{ 'break_ice_wall', 'invader_ice_wall_' .. n }))

			-- 벽 충돌시 그로기
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action and not self.synced then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self.synced = true

					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("crash", blocker.Bounds:ClosestPoint(self.character.Bounds.center), unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("crash")
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

					-- 싱크 커맨드
					local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
					local virtual_wall_key = 'invader_ice_wall_'
					if (string.sub(blocker.Name, 1, #virtual_wall_key) == virtual_wall_key) then
						info:AppendNumber(tonumber(string.sub(blocker.Name, #virtual_wall_key+1)))
					end

					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.charge_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:cancel()
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Send(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

	self.stomp_range:Hide()
	if self.is_risk_map_on then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_range))
	end


	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	-- remove proj
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end

			if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].wall) then
				self.contexts[i].wall:Dispose()

			-- 어택 레인지 반납

			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.contexts[i].attack_range))

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.showAttackRange then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.stomp_range, self.stomp_pos)

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.stomp_range:Hide()
		self.character.Position = self.stomp_pos
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("fall")
