		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		-- Disabled로 세팅해둔 상태면 캔슬됬을 때 켜줘야한다.
		if self.current_state == self.state.jump or self.current_state == self.state.showAttackRange or self.current_state == self.state.fall then
			self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

			elseif self.contexts[i].wall_state == self.wall_state.action then
				self:update_calculator(self.contexts[i].calculator, self.contexts[i].dir, dt)

				if time_passed > self.contexts[i].invoke_time then
					self:change_wall_state(self.contexts[i], self.wall_state.post)
				end
			elseif self.contexts[i].wall_state == self.wall_state.post then
				self:update_calculator(self.contexts[i].calculator, self.contexts[i].dir, dt)

				if time_passed > self.contexts[i].invoke_time then

					self.contexts[i].attack_range = nil
					-- 계산기 반납
					self.contexts[i].calculator:End()
					self.contexts[i].calculator = nil

					if self.contexts[i].ball_calculator ~= nil then
						self.contexts[i].ball_calculator:End()
						self.contexts[i].ball_calculator = nil
					end
					-- 이펙트 반납
					self.contexts[i].wall:Dispose()
					self.contexts[i].wall = nil
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.contexts, i)

				end
			elseif self.contexts[i].wall_state == self.wall_state.waiting then
				if time_passed > self.contexts[i].invoke_time then
					self:change_wall_state(self.contexts[i], self.wall_state.prepare)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress
		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.showAttackRange)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.showAttackRange then
		if self.time_passed >= self.show_attack_range_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))

		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.stomp_pos, self.stomp_radius, 2)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects.Values[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					local knock_direction = direction

					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
			stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

			-- 발사
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_left))
			end

			self.attack_calculator_left.Position = self.wall_left_start_pos

			local d = (self.wall_left_start_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude

			self.left_proj_calculator:End()
			self.left_proj_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			self.left_proj_calculator:Start()

			table.insert(self.contexts, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				time_passed = 0,
				invoke_time = d / self.proj_speed,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil),
				attack_range = self.attack_range_left,

				dir = unity_class.vector3.right,
				ball_calculator = self.left_proj_calculator,

				wall_state = self.wall_state.none,
				dest_pos = self.wall_left_start_pos,
				calculator = self.attack_calculator_left,
			})

				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_left, self.wall_left_start_pos)
				self.attack_range_left:Show(d / self.proj_speed + 0.1)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_right))
			end

			self.attack_calculator_right.Position = self.wall_right_start_pos

			d = (self.wall_right_start_pos - self.character.Position).magnitude

			self.right_proj_calculator:End()
			self.right_proj_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			self.right_proj_calculator:Start()

			table.insert(self.contexts, {
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				time_passed = 0,
				invoke_time = d / self.proj_speed,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil),

			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_right, self.wall_right_start_pos)
				self.attack_range_right:Show(d / self.proj_speed + 0.1)
			end


			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_wall_state(context, state)

	if context.wall_state == state then
		return
	end

	if state == self.wall_state.prepare then

		if not is_unity_null(context.pooled_object) then
			context.pooled_object:Dispose()
			context.pooled_object = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_end", context.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		if self.current_wall_count < self.max_wall_num then

			local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(context.dest_pos, unity_class.vector2(self.wall_width, self.wall_length), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
			attack_range:Hide()

			local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
			info.Center = context.dest_pos
			info.DamageTerm = -1
			info.Duration = self.action_duration
			info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.wall_width / 2, 2, self.wall_length / 2)
			local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

			local context_new = {
				start_pos = context.start_pos,
				time_passed = 0,
				invoke_time = 0,
				attack_range = attack_range,

				dir = context.dir,

				wall_state = self.wall_state.none,
				dest_pos = context.dest_pos,
				calculator = calculator
			}

			table.insert(self.contexts, context_new)

			self.current_wall_count = self.current_wall_count + 1
			self:change_wall_state(context_new, self.wall_state.waiting)
		end

		context.calculator:Start()
		context.invoke_time = 0.05

	elseif state == self.wall_state.action then
		context.wall = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall", context.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall", context.dest_pos)

		context.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, context.attack_range))
		context.invoke_time = 0.1

	elseif state == self.wall_state.post then
		context.wall:Dispose()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_end", context.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_end", context.dest_pos)
		context.invoke_time = 0.2

	elseif state == self.wall_state.waiting then
		context.calculator:End()

		if context.dir == unity_class.vector3.left then
			context.dest_pos = context.dest_pos + unity_class.vector3.left * self.between_wall_distance
		else
			context.dest_pos = context.dest_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * self.between_wall_distance
		end

		context.calculator.Position = context.dest_pos
		context.invoke_time = self.create_wall_interval

		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(context.attack_range, context.dest_pos)
			context.attack_range:Show(context.invoke_time)
		end

	elseif state == self.wall_state.none then
		context.calculator:End()
	end

	context.wall_state = state
	context.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()



end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil

	self.current_state = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range_right) then

function local_class:rotate_vector(vector, angle)
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	return unity_class.vector3(
		vector.x * math.cos(rad) - vector.z * math.sin(rad),0,
		vector.x * math.sin(rad) + vector.z * math.cos(rad))
end

--- 특정 크기의 부채꼴을 대상 방향과 배치할 개수가 주어지면 호 위에 균일하게 배치될 좌표를 돌려줍니다.
function local_class:generate_pie_points(angle, center, direction, radius, num_points)
	local points = {}

	local start_angle = -angle / 2
	local angle_increment = angle / (num_points - 1)

	for i = 0, num_points - 1 do
		-- Calculate the angle for the current point
		local angle = start_angle + i * angle_increment
		-- Rotate the direction vector to get the point on the arc
		local rotated_dir = self:rotate_vector(direction, angle)
		-- Calculate the point position
		local point = {
			x = center.x + rotated_dir.x * radius,
			y = center.y,
			z = center.z + rotated_dir.z * radius
		}
		table.insert(points, point)
	end

	return points
end

function local_class:convert_position_to_inside(zone_bound, destination)
	if zone_bound:Contains(destination) then
		return destination
	else
		--- 이동할 포지션
		local target_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(destination)
		--- 중앙에서 이동할 포지션으로의 방향
		local center_to_target_dir = vector_util.normalized(target_xz - zone_bound.center)
		--- 바운드 외곽 위치
		local edge_pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.BoundaryFromCenter(zone_bound, center_to_target_dir)
		local inner_pos = edge_pos
		inner_pos.y = zone_bound.center.y
		return inner_pos
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 폭탄 모두 제거
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_ranges(self.contexts[i].ranges)
			self.contexts[i].ranges = nil
			-- 계산기 반납
			self:return_calculators(self.contexts[i].calculators)
			self.contexts[i].calculators = nil
			-- 사운드 중지
			if self.contexts[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.contexts[i].sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = nil
			end
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.contexts, i)
		end
	end

	self.override_zone_bounds = nil
end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_complete = nil
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
		--self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			local proj_time_passed =  self.contexts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.contexts[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if self.contexts[i].phase == 1 then
				-- position에서 destination 으로 이동
				if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					local prog = proj_time_passed / self.contexts[i].fly_time
					local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.contexts[i].start_pos, self.contexts[i].dest_pos, prog) +
							10.0 * prog * (1 - prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

					self.contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localPosition = calc_pos + self.bomb_offset
				end

				-- 이동 완료 됐다면 페이즈 넘기면서 어택레인지, 계산기 셋팅
				if proj_time_passed >= self.contexts[i].fly_time then
					-- ranges, calculators 초기화 및 세팅
					local d = self.contexts[i].dest_pos
					self.contexts[i].phase = 2
					self.contexts[i].time_passed = 0
					self.contexts[i].ticker = true
					if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
						self.contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localPosition = d + self.bomb_offset
					end

					for _, c in ipairs(self.contexts[i].calculators) do
						c.Position = d
					end

					for _, r in ipairs(self.contexts[i].ranges) do
						battle_range_util.setup_by_position(r, d)
						r:Show(self.contexts[i].delay_time)
						if self.is_risk_map_on then
							message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, r))
						end
					end
				end
			elseif self.contexts[i].phase == 2 then
				if proj_time_passed < self.contexts[i].delay_time then
					if proj_time_passed >= self.contexts[i].delay_time - self.default_interval then
						-- 폭탄 점멸 컬러 및 사운드 처리
						local s = self.contexts[i].sprite
						local ttp = proj_time_passed - (self.contexts[i].delay_time - self.default_interval)
						local x = 7 * ttp * (1 + ttp)

						if self.default_interval - ttp < 1.15 and self.contexts[i].sfx_holder == nil then
							self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("count")
						else
							local ticker = math.sin(x * 0.6) > 0
							if ticker ~= self.contexts[i].ticker then
								self.contexts[i].ticker = ticker
								self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("tick")
							end
						end

						x = math.abs(math.sin(x))
						s.TintColor = unity_class.color(1, x, x, 1)
						s:Rebuild()
					end
				else
					-- 터트리고 계산기 업데이트
					for _, v in pairs(self.contexts[i].calculators) do
						v:Start()
					end
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.contexts[i].dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
					-- 오브젝트 제거
					if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
						self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end

					-- 어택 레인지 반납
					self:return_ranges(self.contexts[i].ranges)
					self.contexts[i].ranges = nil

					self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil

					self.contexts[i].phase = 3
					self.contexts[i].time_passed = 0
				end

			elseif self.contexts[i].phase == 3 then
				if proj_time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then

					-- 계산기 반납
					self:return_calculators(self.contexts[i].calculators)
					self.contexts[i].calculators = nil
					-- 사운드 중지
					if self.contexts[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
						self.contexts[i].sfx_holder:Stop()
						self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = nil
					end
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.contexts, i)
				else
					self:cross_explosion_update(self.contexts[i].calculators, dt)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then

			local bomb = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("customSprite", self.character.Position + self.bomb_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
			local sprite = bomb:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			sprite.Atlas = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get("spritesheets/projectiles", "projectiles_custom")
			sprite.SpriteName = "boss_terrorist_bomb.png"
			sprite.PixelToWorld = 0.02
			sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = true
			sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
			sprite.SortingLayer = "Under Effects"
			sprite.SortingOrder = 100
			sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
			sprite:Rebuild()
			bomb.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)

			table.insert(self.contexts, {
				phase = 1, -- 1: 비행중, 2: 도착해서 터지는 것 대기
				dest_pos = self.dest_positions[self.current_bomb_index],
				start_pos = self.character.Position,
				time_passed = 0,
				fly_time = self.bomb_fly_time,
				delay_time = self.default_interval,
				pooled_object = bomb,
				sprite = sprite,
				ranges = self:get_ranges(),
				calculators = self:get_calculators()
			})

			self.current_bomb_index = self.current_bomb_index + 1

			local max_shot = self.bomb_shot_use_out_line and self.max_shot + self.second_max_shot or self.max_shot

			if self.current_bomb_index > max_shot then
				self.shot_complete = true
			end

			self.shoot_timing = self.shoot_timing + self.bomb_shot_interval
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cross_explosion_update(list, dt)
	for _, v in pairs(list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	for i, vl in pairs(self.attack_range_sets) do
		for _, v in pairs(vl) do
			if not is_unity_null(v) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
			end
		end
	end
	self.attack_range_sets = nil
	self.attack_calculator_sets = nil

	self.zone_bounds = nil

	self.dest_positions = nil
	self.contexts = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local trigger_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	-- 스톰프 중앙 위치, 좌, 우 벽 생성 포지션
	trigger_info:AppendNumber(0)
	trigger_info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.center_pos))

	for i, v in ipairs(self.left_walls) do
		if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			trigger_info:AppendNumber(100+i)
			trigger_info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.left_wall_poses[i]))
			break
		end
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(self.right_walls) do
		if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			trigger_info:AppendNumber(200+i)
			trigger_info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.right_wall_poses[i]))
			break
		end
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, trigger_info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.bomb_action == nil then
		self.bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossInvaderTerroristTimeBomb")
	end

	local cnt = info.Numbers.Count

	-- 좌/우 생성할 벽 정보 없을 경우 통과
	if cnt > 1 then
		self.stomp_pos = info:GetPositionAt(0)

		--스톰프 위치시 Obstacle 피해서 떨어지도록 함.
		self.stomp_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.character.Position, self.stomp_pos, false)

		local first = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(1, -1))
		local second = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(2, -1))

		-- TODO: FIXME!!!!
		if first > 0 and second > 0 then
			self.left_idx = first % 100
			self.right_idx = second % 100
			self.left_anchor = info:GetPositionAt(1)
			self.right_anchor = info:GetPositionAt(2)
		elseif first >= 200 then
			self.left_anchor = nil
			self.right_idx = first % 100
			self.right_anchor = info:GetPositionAt(1)
		elseif first > 0 then
			self.left_idx = first % 100
			self.left_anchor = info:GetPositionAt(1)
			self.right_anchor = nil
		else
			self.left_anchor = nil
			self.right_anchor = nil

end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Send(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)

	self.stomp_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_range))

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.showAttackRange then
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Send(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneEndEvent.Instance)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)

		message_system:Send(self.character, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)
	elseif next_state == self.state.showAttackRange then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.stomp_range, self.stomp_pos)
		self.stomp_range:Show(self.show_attack_range_time)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range", self.stomp_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.stomp_range))
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.stomp_range:Hide()
		self.character.Position = self.stomp_pos
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("fall")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_calculator(v, nd, dt)
	local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인

			damage_info.modifier = self.wall_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = nd
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = nd
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			local proj_time_passed =  self.contexts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.contexts[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if proj_time_passed < self.contexts[i].fly_time then
				-- 위치 업데이트
				local prog = proj_time_passed / self.contexts[i].fly_time
				local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.contexts[i].start_pos, self.contexts[i].dest_pos, prog)
				if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.contexts[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				end

				-- 투사체 데미지 판정
				self.contexts[i].ball_calculator.Position = calc_pos
				local objects = self.contexts[i].ball_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.proj_damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
			else
				local gap = proj_time_passed - self.contexts[i].fly_time
				-- 투사체 제거 및 판정 개시
				if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj_end", self.contexts[i].dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.contexts[i].calculator:Start()
				end
				self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil

				self:update_calculator(self.contexts[i].calculator, self.contexts[i].dir, dt)

				-- 약간 지연시간 두고 실제 벽 생성 및 종료
				if gap > 0.1 then
					self.contexts[i].wall.Position = self.contexts[i].dest_pos
					self.contexts[i].wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
					self.wall_objects[self.contexts[i].wall.Name] = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall",
							self.contexts[i].dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall", self.contexts[i].dest_pos)

					self:update_custom_zone()

					-- 어택 레인지 반납
					self.contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.contexts[i].attack_range))
					self.contexts[i].attack_range = nil
					-- 계산기 반납
					self.contexts[i].calculator:End()
					self.contexts[i].calculator = nil
					self.contexts[i].ball_calculator:End()
					self.contexts[i].ball_calculator = nil
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.contexts, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress
		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.showAttackRange)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.showAttackRange then
		if self.time_passed >= self.show_attack_range_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.stomp_pos, self.stomp_radius, 2)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects.Values[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					local knock_direction = direction

					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					--damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					--damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					--damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
			stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

			-- 발사
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")
			if self.left_anchor ~= nil then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_left))
				self.attack_calculator_left.Position = self.left_anchor

				local d = (self.left_anchor - self.character.Position).magnitude

				self.left_proj_calculator:End()
				self.left_proj_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
				self.left_proj_calculator:Start()

				table.insert(self.contexts, {
					dest_pos = self.left_anchor,
					start_pos = self.character.Position,
					time_passed = 0,
					fly_time = d / self.proj_speed,
					pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil),
					attack_range = self.attack_range_left,
					calculator = self.attack_calculator_left,
					dir = unity_class.vector3.right,
					wall = self.left_walls[self.left_idx],
					ball_calculator = self.left_proj_calculator
				})
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_left, self.left_anchor)
				self.attack_range_left:Show(d / self.proj_speed + 0.1)
			end

			if self.right_anchor ~= nil then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_right))
				self.attack_calculator_right.Position = self.right_anchor

				local d = (self.right_anchor - self.character.Position).magnitude

				self.right_proj_calculator:End()
				self.right_proj_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
				self.right_proj_calculator:Start()

				table.insert(self.contexts, {
					dest_pos = self.right_anchor,
					start_pos = self.character.Position,
					time_passed = 0,
					fly_time = d / self.proj_speed,
					pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("proj", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil),
					attack_range = self.attack_range_right,
					calculator = self.attack_calculator_right,
					dir = unity_class.vector3.left,
					wall = self.right_walls[self.right_idx],
					ball_calculator = self.right_proj_calculator
				})
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_right, self.right_anchor)
				self.attack_range_right:Show(d / self.proj_speed + 0.1)
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) and e:GetParamAt(0) == "break_ice_wall" then
		local target_wall_name = e:GetParamAt(1)

		for i, v in ipairs(self.left_walls) do
			if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and v.Name == target_wall_name then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_end", v.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_end", v.Position)
				v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				break
			end
		end

		for i, v in ipairs(self.right_walls) do
			if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and v.Name == target_wall_name then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("wall_end", v.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("wall_end", v.Position)
				v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				break
			end
		end

		if self.wall_objects[target_wall_name] ~= nil then
			self.wall_objects[target_wall_name]:Dispose()
		end
		self.wall_objects[target_wall_name] = nil

		self:update_custom_zone()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_custom_zone()
	if self.bomb_action ~= nil then

		local left = self.zone_bounds.min.x
		local right = self.zone_bounds.max.x

		for i, v in ipairs(self.left_walls) do
			if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				break
			else
				left = self.left_wall_poses[i].x + 0.5
			end
		end

		for i, v in ipairs(self.right_walls) do
			if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				break
			else
				right = self.right_wall_poses[i].x - 0.5
			end
		end

		-- pos, size
		local new_center = unity_class.vector3((left + right)/2, 0, self.zone_bounds.center.z)
		local new_size = unity_class.vector3(right-left, 2, self.zone_bounds.size.z)
		local new_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(new_center, new_size)
		self.bomb_action.MetaTable:override_battle_zone(new_bounds)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- remove proj
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self.contexts[i].attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.contexts[i].attack_range))
			self.contexts[i].attack_range = nil
			-- 계산기 반납
			self.contexts[i].calculator:End()
			self.contexts[i].calculator = nil
			self.contexts[i].ball_calculator:End()
			self.contexts[i].ball_calculator = nil
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.contexts, i)
		end
	end

	--break all wall
	for i, v in ipairs(self.left_walls) do
		if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(self.right_walls) do
		if v.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	for _, o in pairs(self.wall_objects) do
		o:Dispose()
	end
	self.wall_objects = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range_left) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range_left)
	end
	self.attack_range_left = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range_right) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range_right)
	end
	self.attack_range_right = nil

	self.attack_calculator_left = nil
	self.attack_calculator_right = nil

	self.left_proj_calculator = nil
	self.right_proj_calculator = nil

	self.left_walls = nil
	self.right_walls = nil
	self.left_wall_poses = nil
	self.right_wall_poses = nil

	self.wall_objects = nil
	self.contexts = nil

	self.bomb_action = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossInvaderTerroristShotGunBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.5)

	-- action 실행 시 실제 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTiming", 0.25)

	-- 보여주기용 부채꼴 정보
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 4)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 100)

	-- 투사체
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)

	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "boss_terrorist_shot")
	local proj_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)

	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.is_risk_map_on = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper:IsLoaded()
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
	if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
		direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, nil, direction, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			if self.is_risk_map_on then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_complete = nil
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.shoot_timing - 0.1)
		if self.is_risk_map_on then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("shot", self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)
			-- 투사체 발사
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirection(self.target_direction, unity_class.vector3.zero, -1, 0, nil, false, 0)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.shoot_timing = nil

	self.target_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotTiming", 0)
	self.bomb_offset = unity_class.vector3(0, 0.25, -0.1)

	self.explosion_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionWidth", 1)
	self.explosion_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDistance", 7)
	self.explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDuration", 0.5)
	self.explosion_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ExplosionDelay", 0)

	self.bomb_fly_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "BombFlyTime", 1)

	self.max_shot = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "BombCount", 4)
	self.default_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DefaultInterval", 3)
	self.interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Interval", 1)

	self.attack_range_sets = {}
	self.attack_calculator_sets = {}

	for _ = 1, self.max_shot do
		-- 어택 레인지
		local ll = {
			CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.explosion_distance, self.explosion_width)),
			CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.explosion_width, self.explosion_distance))
		}
		for _, v in pairs(ll) do
			v:Hide()
		end

		table.insert(self.attack_range_sets, ll)

		-- 공격 판정기
		local cl = {}

		local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = self.character.Position
		info.DamageTerm = -1
		info.Duration = self.explosion_duration
		info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.explosion_distance / 2, 2, self.explosion_width / 2)
		local attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.explosion_delay, 1)
		table.insert(cl, attack_calc)

		local info2 = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
		info2.Center = self.character.Position
		info2.DamageTerm = -1
		info2.Duration = self.explosion_duration
		info2.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.explosion_width / 2, 2, self.explosion_distance / 2)
		local attack_calc2 = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info2, true, self.explosion_delay, 1)
		table.insert(cl, attack_calc2)

		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_sets, cl)
	end

	self.contexts = {}

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 커스텀 아틀라스
	stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Load("spritesheets/projectiles", "projectiles_custom")

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_ranges()
	if #self.attack_range_sets > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_range_sets)
	else
		local ll = {
			CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.explosion_distance, self.explosion_width)),
			CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(self.explosion_width, self.explosion_distance))
		}
		for _, v in pairs(ll) do
			v:Hide()
		end

		return ll
	end
end

function local_class:return_ranges(ranges)
	for _, range in pairs(ranges) do
		range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	if self.attack_range_sets ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_range_sets, range)
	end
end

function local_class:get_calculators()
	if #self.attack_calculator_sets > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_calculator_sets)
	else
		local cl = {}

		local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = self.character.Position
		info.DamageTerm = -1
		info.Duration = self.explosion_duration
		info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.explosion_distance / 2, 2, self.explosion_width / 2)
		local attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.explosion_delay, 1)
		table.insert(cl, attack_calc)

		local info2 = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
		info2.Center = self.character.Position
		info2.DamageTerm = -1
		info2.Duration = self.explosion_duration
		info2.Extents = unity_class.vector3(self.explosion_width / 2, 2, self.explosion_distance / 2)
		local attack_calc2 = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info2, true, self.explosion_delay, 1)
		table.insert(cl, attack_calc2)

		return cl
	end
end

function local_class:return_calculators(calculators)
	for _, calculator in pairs(calculators) do
		calculator:End()
	end

	if self.attack_calculator_sets ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_calculator_sets, calculators)
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:override_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.override_zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 모든 (최대 4개) 타겟 위치 포지션 생성. 모자라면 랜덤.
	local trigger_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)

	local count = 0
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
			trigger_info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(targets[i].Position))
			count = count + 1
			if count >= self.max_shot then
				break
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end

	if count < self.max_shot then
		local min = self.zone_bounds.min
		local max = self.zone_bounds.max
		if self.override_zone_bounds ~= nil then
			min = self.override_zone_bounds.min
			max = self.override_zone_bounds.max
		end
		for _ = 1, self.max_shot - count do
			local random_pos = unity_class.vector3(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min.x + 0.5, max.x - 0.5), 0, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min.z + 0.5, max.z - 0.5))
			trigger_info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(random_pos))
		end
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, trigger_info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.dest_positions =
	{
		info:GetPositionAt(0),
		info:GetPositionAt(1),
		info:GetPositionAt(2),
		info:GetPositionAt(3)
	}

	self.character.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 폭탄 모두 제거
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
				self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil
			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_ranges(self.contexts[i].ranges)
			self.contexts[i].ranges = nil
			-- 계산기 반납
			self:return_calculators(self.contexts[i].calculators)
			self.contexts[i].calculators = nil
			-- 사운드 중지
			if self.contexts[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
				self.contexts[i].sfx_holder:Stop()
				self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = nil
			end
			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.contexts, i)
		end
	end

	self.override_zone_bounds = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_complete = nil
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.contexts ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.contexts, 1, -1 do
			local proj_time_passed =  self.contexts[i].time_passed + dt
			self.contexts[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if self.contexts[i].phase == 1 then
				-- position에서 destination 으로 이동
				if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
					local prog = proj_time_passed / self.contexts[i].fly_time
					local calc_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.contexts[i].start_pos, self.contexts[i].dest_pos, prog) +
							10.0 * prog * (1 - prog) * unity_class.vector3.up

					self.contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localPosition = calc_pos + self.bomb_offset
				end

				-- 이동 완료 됐다면 페이즈 넘기면서 어택레인지, 계산기 셋팅
				if proj_time_passed >= self.contexts[i].fly_time then
					-- ranges, calculators 초기화 및 세팅
					local d = self.contexts[i].dest_pos
					self.contexts[i].phase = 2
					self.contexts[i].time_passed = 0
					self.contexts[i].ticker = false
					if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
						self.contexts[i].pooled_object.transform.localPosition = d + self.bomb_offset
					end

					for _, c in ipairs(self.contexts[i].calculators) do
						c.Position = d
					end

					for _, r in ipairs(self.contexts[i].ranges) do
						battle_range_util.setup_by_position(r, d)
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, r))
					end
				end
			elseif self.contexts[i].phase == 2 then
				if proj_time_passed < self.contexts[i].delay_time then
					if proj_time_passed >= self.contexts[i].delay_time - self.default_interval then
						-- 폭탄 점멸 컬러 및 사운드 처리
						local s = self.contexts[i].sprite
						local ttp = proj_time_passed - (self.contexts[i].delay_time - self.default_interval)
						local x = 7 * ttp * (1 + ttp)

						if self.default_interval - ttp < 1.15 and self.contexts[i].sfx_holder == nil then
							self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("count", self.contexts[i].dest_pos)
						else
							local ticker = math.sin(x * 0.6) > 0
							if ticker ~= self.contexts[i].ticker then
								self.contexts[i].ticker = ticker
								self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("tick", self.contexts[i].dest_pos)
							end
						end

						x = math.abs(math.sin(x))
						s.TintColor = unity_class.color(1, x, x, 1)
						s:Rebuild()
					end
				else
					-- 터트리고 계산기 업데이트
					for _, v in pairs(self.contexts[i].calculators) do
						v:Start()
					end
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.contexts[i].dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.contexts[i].dest_pos)
					-- 오브젝트 제거
					if not is_unity_null(self.contexts[i].pooled_object) then
						self.contexts[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.contexts[i].pooled_object = nil

					self.contexts[i].phase = 3
					self.contexts[i].time_passed = 0
				end

			elseif self.contexts[i].phase == 3 then
				self:cross_explosion_update(self.contexts[i].calculators, dt)

				if proj_time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
					-- 어택 레인지 반납
					self:return_ranges(self.contexts[i].ranges)
					self.contexts[i].ranges = nil
					-- 계산기 반납
					self:return_calculators(self.contexts[i].calculators)
					self.contexts[i].calculators = nil
					-- 사운드 중지
					if self.contexts[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
						self.contexts[i].sfx_holder:Stop()
						self.contexts[i].sfx_holder = nil
					end
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.contexts, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 투사체 발사하는 타이밍 체크해서 발사
		if not self.shot_complete and self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
			self.shot_complete = true

			-- self.dest_positions 에 발사.
			for i, v in ipairs(self.dest_positions) do
				local bomb = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("customSprite", self.character.Position + self.bomb_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero, nil)
				local sprite = bomb:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
				sprite.Atlas = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get("spritesheets/projectiles", "projectiles_custom")
				sprite.SpriteName = "boss_terrorist_bomb.png"
				sprite.PixelToWorld = 0.02
				sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = true
				sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
				sprite.SortingLayer = "Under Effects"
				sprite.SortingOrder = -1
				sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
				sprite:Rebuild()
				bomb.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)

				table.insert(self.contexts, {
					phase = 1, -- 1: 비행중, 2: 도착해서 터지는 것 대기
					dest_pos = v,
					start_pos = self.character.Position,
					time_passed = 0,
					fly_time = self.bomb_fly_time,
					delay_time = self.default_interval + self.interval * (i - 1),
					pooled_object = bomb,
					sprite = sprite,
					ranges = self:get_ranges(),
					calculators = self:get_calculators()
				})
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cross_explosion_update(list, dt)
	for _, v in pairs(list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	for i, vl in pairs(self.attack_range_sets) do
		for _, v in pairs(vl) do
			if not is_unity_null(v) then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
			end
		end
	end
	self.attack_range_sets = nil
	self.attack_calculator_sets = nil

	self.zone_bounds = nil

	self.dest_positions = nil
	self.contexts = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	end

		character_util.jump(self.character, 2, self.jump_duration)

		if self.target.Position.x <= self.character.Position.x then
			self.cast_direction = vector_util.left

			self.cast_direction = vector_util.right

function local_class:land()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('land', self.character.Position)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.land_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			if dir_vector:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.land_atk_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.land_knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.land_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:kick()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('kick', self.character.Position, self.cast_direction)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.kick_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			if dir_vector:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.kick_atk_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.kick_knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.kick_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:calculate_jump_info()
	local jump_vector = self.zone_center - self.character.Position
	self.jump_duration = vector_util.magnitude(jump_vector) / self.jump_speed
	self.jump_direction = vector_util.normalized(jump_vector)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.time_passed > self.jump_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
			self.character.Position = self.zone_center
			self:land()
			--착지 데미지 & 이펙트 & 애니
			return
		end

		self.character.Position = self.character.Position + self.jump_direction * self.jump_speed * dt
		--스파인 오프셋 조절

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.kick)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.kick then
		if self.time_passed > self.kick_duration then
			self:determine_target_dir()
			self.orb_ready_fx:Dispose()
			self.orb_ready_fx = nil
			self.shoot_helper_orb:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
					vector_util.get_x0z(self.orb_pos, 0.5),
					self.target_dir, self.orb_label, -1, nil, false)
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:determine_target_dir()
	if vector_util.dot(self.target.Position - self.character.Position, self.cast_direction) > 0 then
		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.orb_pos))
		return
	end

	local candidate = {}

	for _, fo in pairs(party_manager.UserParty) do
		if vector_util.dot(fo.Position - self.character.Position, self.cast_direction) > 0 then
			table.insert(candidate, fo.Position)
		end
	end

	if #candidate == 0 then
		self.target_dir = self.cast_direction
	else
		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(
				candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #candidate)] - self.orb_pos))
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == self.orb_label and self.shoot_helper_orb ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper_bounce:ShootDirectionAtPosition(vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position, 0.5), vector_util.forward,
				0, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
		self.shoot_helper_orb:OnHit(hit_info)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')

	elseif self.shoot_helper_bounce ~= nil and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		self.shoot_helper_bounce:OnHit(hit_info)local

		damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = hit_info.target
		damage_info.direction = move_info.direction
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = move_info.direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.bounce_knock_back_factor
		damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.bounce_knock_back_force

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_bounce(move_info, hit_info, label)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('bounce')
	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.shoot_helper_orb = nil
	self.shoot_helper_bounce = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
	self.zone_center = bound.center
	self.attack_range_width = bound.extents.z * 2
	self.attack_range_length = bound.extents.x
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			unity_class.vector2(self.attack_range_length, self.attack_range_width))
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		--스파인 오프셋 조절

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		if self.time_passed > self.explosion_delay * self.current_explosion_count then
			self:explode()

			if self.explosion_count == self.current_explosion_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_missiles(dt)
	self.missile_time_passed = self.missile_time_passed + dt

	for i = 1, #self.missile_list do
		if self.missile_list[i].is_loaded and self.missile_list[i].shoot_timing < self.missile_time_passed then
			self.missile_list[i].is_loaded = false
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.missile_list[i].position,
					vector_util.normalized((self.target.Bounds.center - self.missile_list[i].position)))
			self.missile_list[i].ready_fx:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:land()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('land', self.character.Position)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.land_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			if dir_vector:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.land_atk_modifier
			damage_info.direction = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir_vector
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.land_knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackForce = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.land_knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:cancel_all_missiles()
end

function local_class:cancel_all_missiles()
	for i = 1, #self.missile_list do
		if self.missile_list[i].is_loaded then
			self.missile_list[i].is_loaded = false
			self.missile_list[i].ready_fx:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_center = bound.center
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossJungpaPunchDashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareChargeDuration', 0.5)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TraceDuration', 0.6)
	self.ready_fx = nil

	self.charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)
	self.charge_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeLength', 6)
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeSpeed', 12)
	self.charge_duration = self.charge_length / self.charge_speed
	self.charge_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeKnockBackForce', 1)
	self.charge_knockback_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeKnockBackFactor', knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong)
	self.charge_atk_mod = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeAtkModifier', 1)
	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.charge_width, 2, self.charge_width), self.charge_duration, -1)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			vector_util.zero, vector(self.charge_length, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge = 3,
		post = 4,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.manual_target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)

end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.ready_fx:Dispose()
		self.ready_fx = nil

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.manual_target.Position - self.character.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_charge_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_charge_duration))

		self.ready_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch_ready', self.character.Position)

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(
				vector_util.get_x0z(self.manual_target.Position - self.character.Position))

		self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(
						vector_util.to_direction(
								vector_util.get_x0z(self.manual_target.Position - self.character.Position)),
						CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('charge')
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('punch', self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_dir, self.character.Transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('dash')

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end
	--enter
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self.target = battle_util.get_farthest_target_simple(self.cs_battle_action, self.charge_length)
		end

		if self.target == nil then
			self.target = self.manual_target
		end

		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed > self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

		self:update_attack(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_dir
	move_info.magnitude = dt * self.charge_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Bounds.center
	self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for i = objects.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local target = objects[i]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.modifier = self.charge_atk_mod
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.charge_knockback_factor
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.attack_calculator.Position)
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
