local local_class = newclass('BossKadenAICutBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		interval = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.8)

	-- teleport
	self.teleport_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportDistance', 3.0)

	-- interval
	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'IntervalDuration', 0.3)

	-- attack
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.3)
	self.action_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'ActionAmount', 3)
	self.thrust_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ThrustDistance', 5.0)
	self.attack_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackLength', 1.5)
	self.pass_character = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'PassCharacters', true)
	local width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackWidth', 1.0)
	self.attack_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackModifier', 1.0)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1.0)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.attack_length, 1, width), self.action_duration, -1, true)
	self.attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	self.attack_ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, vector(self.thrust_distance, width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- etc
	self.is_use_risk = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)
	self.compare_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(vector_util.zero, self.character.Bounds.size)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)

	if self.teleport_bound == nil then
		local bound = self.zone_bound
		local tb = bounds_util.get_size(self.target)
		local size = vector(bound.size.x - tb.x, bound.size.y, bound.size.z - tb.z)
		self.teleport_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bound.center, size)
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_ar)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_ar))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self:teleport()
		self.target_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(self.target_dir) then
			self.target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_ar, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_ar, self.interval_duration)

		if self.is_use_risk then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_ar))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')
		local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack', bounds_util.get_center(self.character), self.target_dir)
		fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(self.target_dir, vector_util.up)
		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1
		self.attack_calc:Start()

		if self.pass_character then
			self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_thrust(dt)
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			if self.action_count >= self.action_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:teleport()
	local t_pos = self.target.Position
	local f_dir = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.target.Direction)
	local s_dir = (self.target.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or self.target.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) and vector_util.left or vector_util.forward
	local pos_list = {
		t_pos + f_dir * self.teleport_distance,
		t_pos + s_dir * self.teleport_distance,
		t_pos + -f_dir * self.teleport_distance,
		t_pos + -s_dir * self.teleport_distance
	}

	for _, pos in pairs(pos_list) do
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.teleport_bound, pos) then
			goto continue
		end

		self.compare_bound.center = pos
		local move = (t_pos - pos).normalized * self.teleport_distance
		local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.compare_bound, move)
		local is_block = false
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
				is_block = true
				break
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		if not is_block then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_begin', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			self.character.Position = pos
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_end', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction((t_pos - self.character.Position).normalized)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport')
			return
		end

		::continue::
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_begin', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	self.character.Position = t_pos
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_end', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	self.character.Direction = self.target.Direction
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport')
end

function local_class:update_thrust(dt)
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_dir
	move_info.magnitude = self.thrust_distance / self.action_duration * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	return true
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	self.target_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(self.target_dir) then
		self.target_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_ar, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.attack_calc.Position = self.character.Position
	self.attack_calc.Direction = self.target_dir

	local objects = self.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.attack_modifier
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
		local d = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		local xz_target_direction = d:GetXz().normalized
		local xz_move_direction = self.target_dir:GetXz().normalized
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction)
				and unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_dir
				or unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_dir
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_06')
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.5)

	self.tracking_pos = nil

	self.tracking_ar = battle_range_util.create_circle(radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.0)

	-- post

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_range_util.hide(self.tracking_ar)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
		self.tracking_pos = self.target.Position
		battle_range_util.show(self.tracking_ar, self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
			'boss_kaden_ai_req_create_cyclone',
			self.tracking_pos.x,
			self.tracking_pos.y,
			self.tracking_pos.z
		}))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
		return
	end

	local diff_v = self.target.Position - self.tracking_pos
	local move = math.min(self.tracking_speed * dt, diff_v.magnitude)
	self.tracking_pos = self.tracking_pos + move * diff_v.normalized

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.tracking_ar, self.tracking_pos)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.tracking_ar))
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	local marker_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'TeleportMarkers')
	self.teleport_markers = {}
	if marker_names ~= nil then
		for _, name in pairs(marker_names) do
			local marker = field:GetMarker(name)
			if marker ~= nil then
				table.insert(self.teleport_markers, marker)
			end
		end
	end

	self.camera_size = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraSize', 10.0)
	self.camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraDuration', 2.0)
	self.camera_return_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraReturnDuration', 2.0)
	self.buff_name_list = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffNameList')

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 3.0)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- etc
	self.is_show_marker = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsShowMarker', true)
	self.is_marker_active = false

	self.fx_barrier = nil

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.is_marker_active = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.fx_barrier = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('barrier', bounds_util.get_center(self.character),
				vector_util.zero, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
		if self.is_show_marker == true then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('boss_kaden_ai', 0, false, self.character)
		end
		self.is_marker_active = true

		self:teleport()
		self:apply_buffs()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cycloneshot')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
			'boss_kaden_ai_req_cyclone_shoot'
		}))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self:remove_buffs()
		stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_return_duration)

		if self.fx_barrier ~= nil then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('end', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			self.fx_barrier:Dispose()
			self.fx_barrier = nil
		end

		if self.is_marker_active then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('boss_kaden_ai')
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		if self.current_state ~= self.state.post then
			self:remove_buffs()
			stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(self.camera_return_duration)

			if self.fx_barrier ~= nil then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('break', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break')
				self.fx_barrier:Dispose()
				self.fx_barrier = nil
			end

			if self.is_marker_active then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('boss_kaden_ai')
			end
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:teleport()
	if self.teleport_markers == nil then
		return
	end

	local idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.teleport_markers)
	local marker = self.teleport_markers[idx]
	if marker == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = marker.position
	local dir = marker.direction
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_begin', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	self.character.Position = pos
	self.character.Direction = dir
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('teleport_end', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport')
end

function local_class:apply_buffs()
	if self.buff_name_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, name in pairs(self.buff_name_list) do
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, name, 1, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buffs()
	if self.buff_name_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, name in pairs(self.buff_name_list) do
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, name)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
